files.title: Axiom audit
The boundary blow-up: the loss explodes where the density vanishes, so the flow stays positive
variables: variable [DecidableEq V] {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G}
variable {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ}
variable [DecidableEq V] {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G}
variable {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu wf : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ}

decls.name: ratioCap
decls.statement: noncomputable def ratioCap (lamMin wmin L0 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`M := max(1, √(L₀/(w_min λ_min)))`** (`proofs.tex:913`), the exponent of `Lojasiewicz.ratio_le_exp`.

decls.name: one_le_ratioCap
decls.statement: theorem one_le_ratioCap (lamMin wmin L0 : ℝ) : 1 ≤ ratioCap lamMin wmin L0

decls.name: ratioCap_pos
decls.statement: theorem ratioCap_pos (lamMin wmin L0 : ℝ) : 0 < ratioCap lamMin wmin L0

decls.name: edgeDrop
decls.statement: noncomputable def edgeDrop (lamMin pmin wmin L0 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`c := λ_min p_min e^{−M}`**, the worst per-edge drop of the density (`proofs.tex:834`, "strong connectedness provides an edge from a non-vanishing state into the vanishing region, whose ratio explodes").

decls.name: uMin
decls.statement: noncomputable def uMin (V : Type*) [Fintype V] (lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`u_min := m₀ · c^{|V|−1}`**, the floor on the density: `m₀` is a lower bound for the mass `∫u dλ`, and `|V|−1` edges reach every state from the maximiser.

decls.name: edgeDrop_pos
decls.statement: theorem edgeDrop_pos {lamMin pmin wmin L0 : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) : 0 < edgeDrop lamMin pmin wmin L0

decls.name: edgeDrop_le_one
decls.statement: theorem edgeDrop_le_one {lamMin pmin wmin L0 : ℝ} (hlmin1 : lamMin ≤ 1) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) : edgeDrop lamMin pmin wmin L0 ≤ 1
decls.doc: `c ≤ 1`: `λ_min ≤ 1` on a probability, `p_min ≤ 1` on a transition floor, and `e^{−M} ≤ 1` because `M ≥ 1`.

decls.name: uMin_pos
decls.statement: theorem uMin_pos {lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0 : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hm0 : 0 < m0) : 0 < uMin V lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0

decls.name: CrossingFloor
decls.statement: def CrossingFloor (K : V → V → ℝ) (pmin : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **An edge from outside every non-empty proper set into it, carrying `K ≥ p_min`.**

decls.name: exists_cross_of_reflTransGen
decls.statement: theorem exists_cross_of_reflTransGen {R : V → V → Prop} {A : Finset V} {a b : V} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen R a b) (ha : a ∈ A) : b ∉ A → ∃ y ∈ A, ∃ z, z ∉ A ∧ R y z
decls.doc: A walk from inside `A` to outside it crosses the boundary at some step.

decls.name: crossingFloor_of_reach
decls.statement: theorem crossingFloor_of_reach {K : V → V → ℝ} {pmin : ℝ} (hreach : ∀ x y : V, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => 0 < K a b) x y) (hpmin : ∀ y z : V, 0 < K y z → pmin ≤ K y z) : CrossingFloor K pmin
decls.doc: **`CrossingFloor` from irreducibility**: if every state reaches every state along positive entries of `K`, and `p_min` floors the positive entries, the crossing edge is there.

decls.name: exists_edgeFloor
decls.statement: theorem exists_edgeFloor (K : V → V → ℝ) : ∃ pmin : ℝ, 0 < pmin ∧ pmin ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ y z : V, 0 < K y z → pmin ≤ K y z
decls.doc: **A floor on the positive entries always exists**, on a finite state space: the hypothesis `p_min` carries is never vacuous.

decls.name: crossingFloor_phat
decls.statement: theorem crossingFloor_phat {pmin : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hpmin : ∀ y z : V, 0 < B.phat y z → pmin ≤ B.phat y z) : CrossingFloor B.phat pmin
decls.doc: **`CrossingFloor` on the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph**, from `Graph.BackwardPolicy.breach_all` — the irreducibility half of `theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*.

decls.name: ratio_blowup_of_small
decls.statement: theorem ratio_blowup_of_small {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (y z : V) : lam y * u y * K y z / (lam z * u z) ≤ ratio K lam u z
decls.doc: **`r(z) ≥ λ(y)u(y)K(y,z)/(λ(z)u(z))`** (`proofs.tex:834`, "whose ratio explodes"): one edge into `z` already forces the ratio there, and the bound is `∝ 1/u(z)`.

decls.name: logSq_le_logSq_of_one_le
decls.statement: theorem logSq_le_logSq_of_one_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : logSq a ≤ logSq b
decls.doc: `logSq` is monotone above `1`.

decls.name: loss_lower_of_small
decls.statement: theorem loss_lower_of_small {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin : ℝ} (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) {y z : V} (hone : 1 ≤ lam y * u y * K y z / (lam z * u z)) : lamMin * wmin * Real.log (lam y * u y * K y z / (lam z * u z)) ^ 2 ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u)
decls.doc: **`λ_min w_min (log(λ(y)u(y)K(y,z)/(λ(z)u(z))))² ≤ 𝓛`** (`proofs.tex:834`, "`g(r)ν → ∞`"): the loss blows up as `u(z) → 0`, at the logarithmic rate `g = (log x)²` gives it.

decls.name: edge_drop_of_loss_le
decls.statement: theorem edge_drop_of_loss_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin L0 : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hL0 : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ L0) {y z : V} (hyz : pmin ≤ K y z) : edgeDrop lamMin pmin wmin L0 * u y ≤ u z
decls.doc: **The one-edge drop**: if `𝓛 ≤ L₀` then `c·u(y) ≤ u(z)` across every edge `y → z` with `K(y,z) ≥ p_min`.

decls.name: pos_of_loss_le
decls.statement: theorem pos_of_loss_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0 : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hL0 : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ L0) (hm0 : m0 ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam u) (x : V) : uMin V lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0 ≤ u x
decls.doc: **The theorem**: a flow whose loss is at most `L₀` and whose mass is at least `m₀` has density at least `u_min = m₀ c^{|V|−1}` at **every** state.

decls.name: continuous_flow
decls.statement: theorem continuous_flow (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) (x : V) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => u t x) t
decls.doc: A gradient flow is continuous in time at every `t ≥ 0`, state by state.

decls.name: flow_pos_of_pos
decls.statement: theorem flow_pos_of_pos {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) ≤ u t x
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*'s compactness half, along the flow** (`proofs.tex:834`): from a positive initial density the trajectory stays at density at least `u_min`, at every state and every `t ≥ 0`, with `L₀ = 𝓛(μ₀)` and `m₀ = μ₀(𝒮̂)` — the paper's own budgets.

decls.name: flow_pos
decls.statement: theorem flow_pos {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x
decls.doc: **The hypothesis ten files carry, discharged on `[0,∞)`**: a gradient flow of `𝓛_{g,ν}` with `g = (log x)²` started at a positive density stays positive.

decls.name: flow_pos_graph
decls.statement: theorem flow_pos_graph {lam wf : V → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hpmin : ∀ y z : V, 0 < B.phat y z → pmin ≤ B.phat y z) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x
decls.doc: **`hu`, discharged on the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph** — the setting of `theo:training_speed_full` and of `prop:no_distant_equilibrium` itself.

decls.name: mass_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem mass_tendsto {lamMin pmin wmin : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : ∃ minf : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u t)) Filter.atTop (nhds minf)
decls.doc: **The mass converges** — the half of the LaSalle sentence that needs no `ω`-limit: along the flow from a positive initial density the mass is monotone on `[0,∞)` (`mass_monotoneOn`, using `flow_pos`) and bounded above by `‖u₀‖_{L²(λ)}` (Cauchy–Schwarz on the invariant sphere), hence convergent.

decls.name: blowupU
decls.statement: noncomputable def blowupU : Fin 2 → ℝ
decls.doc: `u = (3/2, 1/2)` on the two-state chain.

decls.name: blowupU_pos
decls.statement: theorem blowupU_pos : ∀ x, 0 < blowupU x

decls.name: twoState_crossingFloor
decls.statement: theorem twoState_crossingFloor : CrossingFloor twoStateK (1 / 2 : ℝ)
decls.doc: Every entry of the two-state kernel is `1/2`, so `p_min = 1/2` floors every crossing.

decls.name: twoState_blowup_ratio
decls.statement: theorem twoState_blowup_ratio : ratio twoStateK twoStateLam blowupU 0 = 2 / 3 ∧ ratio twoStateK twoStateLam blowupU 1 = 2

decls.name: twoState_blowup_mean
decls.statement: theorem twoState_blowup_mean : Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam blowupU = 1
decls.doc: **The mass is `1`**.

decls.name: twoState_blowup_loss_le
decls.statement: theorem twoState_blowup_loss_le : lossVal twoStateLam (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) logSq (ratio twoStateK twoStateLam blowupU) ≤ 1 / 2
decls.doc: **`𝓛 ≤ 1/2`**: `(log 3/2)² ≤ 1/4` by `log x ≤ x − 1`, and `(log 2)² ≤ 3/4` by `Real.log_two_lt_d9`.

decls.name: twoState_ratioCap
decls.statement: theorem twoState_ratioCap : ratioCap (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1 (1 / 2) = 1
decls.doc: **`M = 1`** on this instance: `L₀/(w_min λ_min) = 1`.

decls.name: twoState_uMin
decls.statement: theorem twoState_uMin : uMin (Fin 2) (1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2) 1 (1 / 2) 1 = Real.exp (-1) / 4
decls.doc: **`u_min = e^{−1}/4`**, the constant evaluated.

decls.name: twoState_boundary_blowup_check
decls.statement: theorem twoState_boundary_blowup_check : uMin (Fin 2) (1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2) 1 (1 / 2) 1 = Real.exp (-1) / 4 ∧ 0 < Real.exp (-1) / 4 ∧ Real.exp (-1) / 4 ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ x, uMin (Fin 2) (1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2) 1 (1 / 2) 1 ≤ blowupU x
decls.doc: **The non-vacuity check**: `u_min = e^{−1}/4 ≈ 0.0920`, positive, at most the true minimum `1/2`, and `pos_of_loss_le` delivers it at both states of the chain.

files.title: Theorem 10 under its own `C³` hypothesis, for the DB loss on the edge set, and item 2 of the training-speed theorem at `Γ₃`

decls.name: Gamma3
decls.statement: noncomputable def Gamma3 (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, `Γ₃ := sup_{[1−a,1+a]} |g'''|`** (`proofs.tex:675`), with `g'''` the iterated derivative `deriv (deriv (deriv g))`.

decls.name: bddAbove_abs_g3
decls.statement: theorem bddAbove_abs_g3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) : BddAbove ((fun y => |deriv (deriv (deriv g)) y|) '' Icc (1 - a) (1 + a))

decls.name: abs_g3_le_Gamma3
decls.statement: theorem abs_g3_le_Gamma3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a)) : |deriv (deriv (deriv g)) y| ≤ Gamma3 g a

decls.name: Gamma3_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem Gamma3_nonneg {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) : 0 ≤ Gamma3 g a

decls.name: abs_le_quadratic_of_deriv
decls.statement: theorem abs_le_quadratic_of_deriv {e e' : ℝ → ℝ} {M b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (he : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 b, HasDerivAt e (e' s) s) (h0 : e 0 = 0) (hbound : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 b, |e' s| ≤ M * s) : |e b| ≤ M / 2 * b ^ 2
decls.doc: A quadratic fence.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_deriv_of_C3
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_of_C3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a)) : HasDerivAt g (deriv g y) y ∧ HasDerivAt (deriv g) (deriv (deriv g) y) y ∧ HasDerivAt (deriv (deriv g)) (deriv (deriv (deriv g)) y) y
decls.doc: The two derivatives the Taylor argument differentiates, at every point of the window.

decls.name: abs_g2_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_g2_sub_le {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a)) : |deriv (deriv g) t - deriv (deriv g) 1| ≤ Gamma3 g a * |t - 1|
decls.doc: **`|g''(t) − g''(1)| ≤ Γ₃|t − 1|`** on the window, by the mean value theorem.

decls.name: taylor_of_C3
decls.statement: theorem taylor_of_C3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |deriv g y - deriv (deriv g) 1 * (y - 1)| ≤ Gamma3 g a / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the `C³` hypothesis read as the Taylor bound it is used through** (Taylor's formula in `theo:gd_diffusion_full`'s proof, `proofs.tex:616–626`, which Step 1 of the proof invokes): `|g'(y) − g''(1)(y−1)| ≤ (Γ₃/2)(y−1)²` for `|y − 1| ≤ a`, given `g'(1) = 0` — the library's `htaylor` at `gd = g'`, `g2 = g''(1)`, `M3 = Γ₃`.

decls.name: eps0C3
decls.statement: noncomputable def eps0C3 (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `ε₀` of `theo:local_convergence_full` at `g''(1)`, `Γ₃ = Gamma3 g a`.

decls.name: CC3
decls.statement: noncomputable def CC3 (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a wmin wsup : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: gamma0C3
decls.statement: noncomputable def gamma0C3 (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a wmin wsup Bhat : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: constC3_congr
decls.statement: theorem constC3_congr {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (h2 : deriv (deriv g) 1 = deriv (deriv g') 1) (h3 : Gamma3 g a = Gamma3 g' a) (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin = eps0C3 g' a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ∧ CC3 g a wmin wsup = CC3 g' a wmin wsup ∧ gamma0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat = gamma0C3 g' a wmin wsup Bhat
decls.doc: **"depending only on `g''(1)`, `Γ₃`, `a`, `w_min`, `‖w‖_{L^∞}`, `B̂`, `C_∞`"**, as a congruence: two generators with the same `g''(1)` and `Γ₃` have the same `ε₀`, `C`, `γ₀`.

decls.name: epsW_eq_of_lt_one
decls.statement: theorem epsW_eq_of_lt_one {a g2 wmin Kex Bhat : ℝ} (ha1 : a < 1) : epsW a g2 wmin Kex Bhat = min (a / 4) (eps1 g2 wmin Kex Bhat)
decls.doc: **Step 4's `ε := min(a/4, ε₁)`** as printed, for `a < 1`: the library's `min(min(a,1)/4, ε₁)` is the same number.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_C3
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_C3 {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (deriv g) fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ CC3 g a wmin wsup * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the flow clause, under the paper's `C³` hypothesis**: `g` is `C³` at every point of `[1−a,1+a]`, `g'(1) = 0 < g''(1)`, the flow is driven by `g'`, and every constant is the printed formula in `g''(1)` and `Γ₃ = sup_{[1−a,1+a]}|g'''|`.

decls.name: constC3_bounds
decls.statement: theorem constC3_bounds {lam w : V → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) : eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (a / (16 * Cinf lamMin)) ∧ 1 ≤ CC3 g a wmin wsup ∧ 0 < gamma0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the constants**: `ε₀ ∈ (0, a/(16C_∞)]`, `C ≥ 1` and `γ₀ > 0` at the constants of `local_convergence_full_C3`.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_C3
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_C3 {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (deriv g) (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∀ k : ℕ, ((∀ x : V, 0 < 1 + hk k x) ∧ (∀ x : V, |ratio K lam (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ ∀ d : V → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (fun x => 1 + hk k x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (deriv g) fun z => 1 + hk k z) d) 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the gradient-descent clause, under the paper's `C³` hypothesis**: for `0 ≤ γ ≤ γ₀` and `‖h₀‖ ≤ ε₀`, the descent driven by `g'` is well defined at every step — `1 + h_k > 0`, `|r_k − 1| ≤ 2a/3`, and `D_k` is the derivative of `𝓛_{g,ν}` in every direction — and `‖h^⊥_{k+1}‖ ≤ (1 − γϱ/4)‖h^⊥_k‖`.

decls.name: EdgeSet
decls.statement: abbrev EdgeSet (pb : V → V → ℝ) : Type _
decls.doc: **The edge set `E := {(s,s') ∈ 𝒮² : π_←(s' → s) > 0}`** (`proofs.tex:667`), as a subtype of `V × V`; it is a `Fintype` because `V` is.

decls.name: edgeKernelE
decls.statement: def edgeKernelE (pb : V → V → ℝ) (e e' : EdgeSet pb) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`K₂` restricted to `E`**: `K₂(e → e') = [e'.2 = e.1] · π_←(e.1 → e'.1)`, `Lift.edgeKernel` read at the two edges.

decls.name: edgeMeasureE
decls.statement: def edgeMeasureE (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (e : EdgeSet pb) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`λ₂` restricted to `E`**: `λ₂(s,s') = π_←(s' → s) λ(s')`, `Lift.edgeMeasure` at the edge.

decls.name: sum_edgeSet_eq
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeSet_eq {pb : V → V → ℝ} (f : V × V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ p : V × V, ¬ 0 < pb p.2 p.1 → f p = 0) : ∑ e : EdgeSet pb, f e.1 = ∑ p : V × V, f p
decls.doc: A sum over `E` of a function vanishing off `E` is the sum over `𝒮²`.

decls.name: edgeKernel_mem_edgeSet
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernel_mem_edgeSet {pb : V → V → ℝ} {s s' z w : V} (hpos : 0 < edgeKernel pb s s' z w) : 0 < pb w z
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, DB instance: "`K₂` maps `E` into itself"** (`proofs.tex:667`): from any pair, `K₂` charges only pairs of `E`.

decls.name: edgeKernel_eq_zero_of_not_mem
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernel_eq_zero_of_not_mem {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) {s s' z w : V} (hzw : ¬ 0 < pb w z) : edgeKernel pb s s' z w = 0
decls.doc: The same, as vanishing: off `E` the kernel is `0` (`π_← ≥ 0`).

decls.name: edgeMeasure_eq_zero_of_not_mem
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasure_eq_zero_of_not_mem {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (lam : V → ℝ) {s s' : V} (hss : ¬ 0 < pb s' s) : edgeMeasure pb lam s s' = 0
decls.doc: Off `E` the edge measure is `0`.

decls.name: edgeKernelE_isMarkovOn
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernelE_isMarkovOn {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) : Core.IsMarkovOn (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (edgeKernelE pb)
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, DB instance: `K₂` is a Markov kernel on `E`**: non-negative, and every row sums to `1` over `E`.

decls.name: edgeMeasureE_pos
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasureE_pos {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (e : EdgeSet pb) : 0 < edgeMeasureE pb lam e
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, DB instance: `λ₂ > 0` on `E` when `λ > 0`** (`proofs.tex:667`).

decls.name: edgeMeasureE_total
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasureE_total {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : ∑ e : EdgeSet pb, edgeMeasureE pb lam e = 1
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, DB instance: `λ₂` is a probability on `E`** (`proofs.tex:675`: "its second marginal being `λ`").

decls.name: edgeMeasureE_isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasureE_isInvariant {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) : Core.IsInvariant (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (edgeKernelE pb)
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, DB instance: `λ₂` is `K₂`-invariant on `E`**: `Lift.pushEdge_edgeMeasure`, with both sums restricted to `E`, where `λ₂` and `K₂` live.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_DB
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_DB {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {w : EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hpb : Core.IsMarkovOn lam pb) (hinvpb : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ e, lamMin ≤ edgeMeasureE pb lam e) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ e, |w e| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ e, wmin ≤ w e) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : EdgeSet pb → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (Aop (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f)) (hflow : IsGradientFlow (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun e => edgeMeasureE pb lam e * w e) (deriv g) fun s e => 1 + h s e) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (h 0) ≤ eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (h 0)| ≤ CC3 g a wmin wsup * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun e => h t e - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full` for the DB loss** (`proofs.tex:667`): `T = K₂` on the finite edge set `E`, `λ₂` in the role of `λ`, `λ_min := min_E λ₂` (read as a lower bound `lamMin`), `C_∞ = λ_min^{−1/2}`, and a coercivity constant `B̂ ≥ 1` of `K₂` on `L²(λ₂)` as hypothesis.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_DB
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_DB {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {w : EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hpb : Core.IsMarkovOn lam pb) (hinvpb : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ e, lamMin ≤ edgeMeasureE pb lam e) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ e, |w e| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ e, wmin ≤ w e) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : EdgeSet pb → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (Aop (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f)) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun e => hk k e - gam * lossGrad (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => edgeMeasureE pb lam z * w z) (deriv g) (fun z => 1 + hk k z) e) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (hk 0) ≤ eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∀ k : ℕ, ((∀ e, 0 < 1 + hk k e) ∧ (∀ e, |ratio (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => 1 + hk k z) e - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ ∀ d : EdgeSet pb → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => edgeMeasureE pb lam z * w z) (fun e => 1 + hk k e + t * d e) g) (Graph.ipL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (lossGrad (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => edgeMeasureE pb lam z * w z) (deriv g) fun z => 1 + hk k z) d) 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (hk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (hk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full` for the DB loss, the gradient-descent clause**, on `E` with `λ₂`, as `local_convergence_full_DB`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv2
decls.statement: noncomputable def logSqDeriv2 (x : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `g''(x) = 2(1 − log x)/x²` for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv3
decls.statement: noncomputable def logSqDeriv3 (x : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `g'''(x) = (4 log x − 6)/x³` for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_logSqDeriv
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_logSqDeriv {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : HasDerivAt logSqDeriv (logSqDeriv2 y) y

decls.name: hasDerivAt_logSqDeriv2
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_logSqDeriv2 {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : HasDerivAt logSqDeriv2 (logSqDeriv3 y) y

decls.name: deriv_logSq_eq
decls.statement: theorem deriv_logSq_eq {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : deriv logSq y = logSqDeriv y ∧ deriv (deriv logSq) y = logSqDeriv2 y ∧ deriv (deriv (deriv logSq)) y = logSqDeriv3 y
decls.doc: On `(0, ∞)`, the three derivatives of `logSq` are `logSqDeriv`, `logSqDeriv2`, `logSqDeriv3`.

decls.name: logSq_C3
decls.statement: theorem logSq_C3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - (1/2 : ℝ)) (1 + 1/2), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 logSq y
decls.doc: `g = (log x)²` is `C³` (indeed `C^∞`) at every point of `[1/2, 3/2]`.

decls.name: logSq_deriv_one
decls.statement: theorem logSq_deriv_one : deriv logSq 1 = 0

decls.name: logSq_deriv2_one
decls.statement: theorem logSq_deriv2_one : deriv (deriv logSq) 1 = 2

decls.name: Gamma3_logSq
decls.statement: theorem Gamma3_logSq : Gamma3 logSq (1/2) = 48 + 32 * Real.log 2
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full` item 2, `Γ₃ = sup_{[1/2,3/2]} |g'''| = 48 + 32 log 2`** for `g = (log x)²` (`proofs.tex:1013`, the radius of item 2): `|g'''(x)| = (6 − 4 log x)/x³` is largest at `x = 1/2`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv_taylor_Gamma3
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_taylor_Gamma3 (y : ℝ) (hy : |y - 1| ≤ 1/2) : |logSqDeriv y - 2 * (y - 1)| ≤ (48 + 32 * Real.log 2) / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`htaylor` for `logSqDeriv` at `a = 1/2`, `g''(1) = 2`, `M₃ = Γ₃ = 48 + 32 log 2`**, derived from `C³` through `taylor_of_C3`, not from the elementary `LogSqTaylor` bound.

decls.name: eps0Gamma3
decls.statement: noncomputable def eps0Gamma3 (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`ε₀` of `theo:training_speed_full` item 2** (`proofs.tex:1013`): Theorem 10's radius for `g = (log x)²` at `a = 1/2`, `g''(1) = 2`, `Γ₃ = 48 + 32 log 2`.

decls.name: eps0Gamma3_eq
decls.statement: theorem eps0Gamma3_eq (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup Bhat lamMin = eps0C3 logSq (1/2) wmin wsup Bhat lamMin
decls.doc: `eps0Gamma3` **is** `eps0C3 logSq (1/2)`: item 2's radius is Theorem 10's radius as `local_convergence_full_C3` computes it from `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: eps0_antitone_M3
decls.statement: theorem eps0_antitone_M3 {g2 a wmin wsup Bhat Ci M M' : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 < g2) (ha : 0 < a) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hB : 0 < Bhat) (hCi : 0 < Ci) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hMM : M ≤ M') : eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M' wsup) Bhat) Ci (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M') wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M') wsup) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M wsup) Bhat) Ci (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M) wsup)
decls.doc: **The radius is antitone in `M₃`.**

decls.name: eps0Gamma3_le_eps0Sq
decls.statement: theorem eps0Gamma3_le_eps0Sq {wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hB : 0 < Bhat) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) : eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ≤ eps0Sq wmin wsup Bhat lamMin
decls.doc: **Item 2's radius is at most the one the strict library assembles at `M₃ = 24`**: `24 ≤ 48 + 32 log 2`.

decls.name: eps0Gamma3_pos
decls.statement: theorem eps0Gamma3_pos {lamMin wmin wsup Bhat : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hB : 0 < Bhat) : 0 < eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup Bhat lamMin

decls.name: eps0Gamma3_le_sqrt
decls.statement: theorem eps0Gamma3_le_sqrt {lamMin wmin wsup Bhat : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) : eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ≤ Real.sqrt lamMin / 32

decls.name: training_speed_full_Gamma3
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_full_Gamma3 {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam gr uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen gr) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : (∀ x, lam x = Graph.visits G gr x / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)) ∧ Graph.minOver G lam = Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G gr) / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u t)) ≤ ((lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)))⁻¹ + (wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam) / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)) / (wmin * Graph.minOver G lam))))) ^ 2 * t)⁻¹) ∧ ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (T0 (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0))) (cDelta wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (delta0 (eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))))), Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - 1) ≤ eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam) ∧ ∃ cinf : ℝ, Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => cinf) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t₁ ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - cinf) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoSigma 2 wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.sigmaStar G uH) * (t - t₁)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, items 1 and 2, at the paper's radius** (`proofs.tex:999–1035`): `TrainingSpeed.training_speed_full_of_init` with `ε₀` Theorem 10's radius at `Γ₃ = sup_{[1/2,3/2]}|g'''| = 48 + 32 log 2` (`eps0Gamma3`, which is `eps0C3 logSq (1/2)` by `eps0Gamma3_eq`), in place of the radius at `M₃ = 24`.

decls.name: extE
decls.statement: noncomputable def extE (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (u : EdgeSet pb → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: The edge flow `μ = uλ₂` of a density `u` on `E`, as a measure on `𝒮²`, `0` off `E`.

decls.name: extE_apply
decls.statement: theorem extE_apply (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (u : EdgeSet pb → ℝ) (e : EdgeSet pb) : extE pb lam u e.1.1 e.1.2 = edgeMeasureE pb lam e * u e

decls.name: ratio_edgeE_eq
decls.statement: theorem ratio_edgeE_eq {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (u : EdgeSet pb → ℝ) (e : EdgeSet pb) : ratio (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) u e = pushEdge pb (extE pb lam u) e.1.1 e.1.2 / extE pb lam u e.1.1 e.1.2
decls.doc: **The ratio of `K₂` on `E` is the lifted ratio `d(μK₂)/dμ` on `𝒮²`**, at `μ = uλ₂`.

decls.name: loss_edgeE_eq_db
decls.statement: theorem loss_edgeE_eq_db {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) {u : EdgeSet pb → ℝ} (hu : ∀ e, 0 ≤ u e) (nu : EdgeSet pb → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) : loss (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) nu u g = ∑ e : EdgeSet pb, nu e * g (marg₁ (extE pb lam u) e.1.2 * pb e.1.2 e.1.1 / (marg₁ (extE pb lam u) e.1.1 * disint (extE pb lam u) e.1.1 e.1.2))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, DB instance: the loss is the DB loss** (`prop:db_lift` on `E`): the balance loss of `K₂` on `(E, λ₂)` at `μ = uλ₂`, for any generator `g` and training weights `ν̂`, is the detailed-balance loss of `(F, π_→^μ)`, `F = m₁μ`, `π_→^μ` the disintegration — `Lift.db_lift_ratio`, read on `E`.

decls.name: logSq_C3_bundle
decls.statement: theorem logSq_C3_bundle : (∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - (1/2 : ℝ)) (1 + 1/2), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 logSq y) ∧ deriv logSq 1 = 0 ∧ 0 < deriv (deriv logSq) 1
decls.doc: **The `C³` bundle is inhabited by the paper's generator**: `g = (log x)²` at `a = 1/2`.

decls.name: isGradientFlow_one
decls.statement: theorem isGradientFlow_one {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hgd : gd 1 = 0) : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd (fun _ _ => 1)
decls.doc: A balanced start is a gradient flow: at `u ≡ 1` the ratio is `1` and `g'(1) = 0`.

decls.name: pbU
decls.statement: noncomputable def pbU : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ
decls.doc: The uniform backward policy on two states.

decls.name: lamU
decls.statement: noncomputable def lamU : Fin 2 → ℝ
decls.doc: Its invariant probability.

decls.name: pbU_pos
decls.statement: theorem pbU_pos (p : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : 0 < pbU p.2 p.1

decls.name: sum_edgeSetU
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeSetU (F : EdgeSet pbU → ℝ) : ∑ e, F e = F ⟨(0, 0), pbU_pos _⟩ + F ⟨(0, 1), pbU_pos _⟩ + F ⟨(1, 0), pbU_pos _⟩ + F ⟨(1, 1), pbU_pos _⟩

decls.name: pbU_markov
decls.statement: theorem pbU_markov : Core.IsMarkovOn lamU pbU

decls.name: pbU_invariant
decls.statement: theorem pbU_invariant : Core.IsInvariant lamU pbU

decls.name: coer_edgeU
decls.statement: theorem coer_edgeU (f : EdgeSet pbU → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) f) ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) (Aop (edgeKernelE pbU) (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) f)
decls.doc: **The coercivity hypothesis of the DB instance is inhabited**: for the uniform policy on two states, `B̂ = 2` is a coercivity constant of `K₂` on `(E, λ₂)` — the value `1 + C` `lem:lift_coercivity` gives from `C = 1`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_DB_witness
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_DB_witness : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) (fun _ => 0)| ≤ CC3 logSq (1/2) 1 1 * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) fun _ => 0) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) (fun _ => 0 - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL (deriv (deriv logSq) 1) 1 2 * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pbU lamU) fun _ => 0)
decls.doc: **The DB bundle, all hypotheses at once, on the two-state uniform policy**: `local_convergence_full_DB` applies with `g = (log x)²`, `a = 1/2`, `w ≡ 1`, `λ_min = 1/4`, `B̂ = 2`, and the balanced flow `h ≡ 0`.

files.title: Discrete gradient descent contracts by `1 − εϱ` per step

decls.name: inner_sq_le_of_symm_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem inner_sq_le_of_symm_nonneg {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hsymm : ∀ x y : E, ⟪T x, y⟫ = ⟪x, T y⟫) (hnn : ∀ y : E, 0 ≤ ⟪y, T y⟫) (x y : E) : ⟪x, T y⟫ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, T x⟫ * ⟪y, T y⟫
decls.doc: **Cauchy–Schwarz for a symmetric positive semi-definite form.** If `T` is symmetric and `⟪y, Ty⟫ ≥ 0` for every `y`, then `⟪·, T·⟫` is a positive semi-definite symmetric bilinear form and obeys `⟪x, Ty⟫² ≤ ⟪x, Tx⟫⟪y, Ty⟫`.

decls.name: norm_apply_le_of_symm_bounds
decls.statement: theorem norm_apply_le_of_symm_bounds {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {S : Set E} {c : ℝ} (hsymm : ∀ x y : E, ⟪T x, y⟫ = ⟪x, T y⟫) (hnn : ∀ y : E, 0 ≤ ⟪y, T y⟫) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hinv : ∀ x ∈ S, T x ∈ S) (hub : ∀ y ∈ S, ⟪y, T y⟫ ≤ c * ‖y‖ ^ 2) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ S) : ‖T x‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖
decls.doc: **From the form to the norm, without the spectral theorem.** Let `T` be symmetric with `⟪y, Ty⟫ ≥ 0` everywhere, let `S` be a set carried into itself by `T`, and suppose `⟪y, Ty⟫ ≤ c‖y‖²` on `S` with `0 ≤ c`.

decls.name: H_proj_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem H_proj_eq_zero {H Pi : E →L[ℝ] E} (hPisa : ∀ x y : E, ⟪Pi x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Pi y⟫) (hHsa : ∀ x y : E, ⟪H x, y⟫ = ⟪x, H y⟫) (hPiH : ∀ x : E, Pi (H x) = 0) (x : E) : H (Pi x) = 0
decls.doc: **`ΠH = 0` gives `HΠ = 0`** when both `Π` and `H` are self-adjoint.

decls.name: stable_frozen_discrete
decls.statement: theorem stable_frozen_discrete {H Pi : E →L[ℝ] E} {rho Lam eps : ℝ} {h : ℕ → E} (hPisa : ∀ x y : E, ⟪Pi x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Pi y⟫) (hPiPi : ∀ x : E, Pi (Pi x) = Pi x) (hHsa : ∀ x y : E, ⟪H x, y⟫ = ⟪x, H y⟫) (hPiH : ∀ x : E, Pi (H x) = 0) (hcoer : ∀ x : E, rho * ‖x - Pi x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, H x⟫) (hup : ∀ x : E, ⟪x, H x⟫ ≤ Lam * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hepsL : eps * Lam ≤ 1) (hrho : eps * rho ≤ 1) (hstep : ∀ k, h (k + 1) = h k - eps • H (h k)) : (∀ k, Pi (h k) = Pi (h 0)) ∧ ∀ k, ‖h k - Pi (h k)‖ ≤ (1 - eps * rho) ^ k * ‖h 0 - Pi (h 0)‖
decls.doc: **`theo:db_stable_frozen_full`, the discrete half** (statement `proofs.tex:592–602`, proof `proofs.tex:604–610`): along the descent recursion `h_{k+1} = h_k − εHh_k`, the component `Πh_k` is conserved and `‖h_k − Πh_k‖ ≤ (1 − εϱ)^k‖h_0 − Πh_0‖` — the paper's "the contraction factor per step is `1 − εϱ`".

decls.name: scalar_discrete_check
decls.doc: **The discrete contraction, evaluated, attained, and separated from its square root.** On `E = ℝ` with `H = 2·id`, `Π = 0`, `ε = 1/4`, `ϱ = 2`, `Λ = 2` and `h_k = 5·(1/2)^k` — a genuine solution of `h_{k+1} = h_k − εHh_k`, since `h_k − (1/4)(2h_k) = h_k/2` — `stable_frozen_discrete` gives `‖h_k‖ ≤ (1 − εϱ)^k‖h_0‖` with `1 − εϱ = 1/2`, and the two sides are **equal at every `k`**.

files.title: The discrete global phase: gradient descent converges from every positive initialization, with a step chosen from it

decls.name: taylor_upper
decls.statement: theorem taylor_upper {F F' F'' : ℝ → ℝ} {γ C : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hF : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 γ, HasDerivAt F (F' s) s) (hF' : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 γ, HasDerivAt F' (F'' s) s) (hC : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 γ, F'' s ≤ C) : F γ ≤ F 0 + γ * F' 0 + C * γ ^ 2 / 2
decls.doc: **Taylor's formula, one-sided**: `F(γ) ≤ F(0) + γF'(0) + Cγ²/2` when `F'' ≤ C` on `[0,γ]`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_line
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_line (a b s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => a - t * b) (-b) s
decls.doc: The line `t ↦ a − tb`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_div_line
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_div_line {a b s : ℝ} (h : a - s * b ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun t => b / (a - t * b)) ((b / (a - s * b)) ^ 2) s
decls.doc: `t ↦ b/(a − tb)` has derivative `(b/(a − sb))²`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_sq_logdiff
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_sq_logdiff {a b c d s : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a - s * b) (hc : 0 < c - s * d) : HasDerivAt (fun t => (Real.log (a - t * b) - Real.log (c - t * d)) ^ 2) (2 * (Real.log (a - s * b) - Real.log (c - s * d)) * (d / (c - s * d) - b / (a - s * b))) s
decls.doc: **`q(t) = (log(a − tb) − log(c − td))²`**, the per-state loss term along a line, and its first derivative.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_sq_logdiff_deriv
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_sq_logdiff_deriv {a b c d s : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a - s * b) (hc : 0 < c - s * d) : HasDerivAt (fun t => 2 * (Real.log (a - t * b) - Real.log (c - t * d)) * (d / (c - t * d) - b / (a - t * b))) (2 * (d / (c - s * d) - b / (a - s * b)) ^ 2 + 2 * (Real.log (a - s * b) - Real.log (c - s * d)) * ((d / (c - s * d)) ^ 2 - (b / (a - s * b)) ^ 2)) s
decls.doc: The second derivative of `q`.

decls.name: sq_logdiff_deriv2_le
decls.statement: theorem sq_logdiff_deriv2_le (l τ ρ : ℝ) : 2 * (τ - ρ) ^ 2 + 2 * l * (τ ^ 2 - ρ ^ 2) ≤ (4 + 2 * |l|) * (τ ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)

decls.name: Mp
decls.statement: noncomputable def Mp (M : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: b1
decls.statement: noncomputable def b1 (M : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`b₁ := 2M'e^{M'}`** (`proofs.tex:1048`), the bound on `|g'|` on `[e^{−M'}, e^{M'}]`.

decls.name: b2
decls.statement: noncomputable def b2 (M : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: b3
decls.statement: noncomputable def b3 (W umin M : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: exp_Mp
decls.statement: theorem exp_Mp (M : ℝ) : Real.exp (Mp M) = 3 * Real.exp M

decls.name: exp_two_Mp
decls.statement: theorem exp_two_Mp (M : ℝ) : Real.exp (2 * Mp M) = 9 * Real.exp M ^ 2

decls.name: Mp_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem Mp_nonneg {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 ≤ Mp M

decls.name: b3_bracket_eq
decls.statement: theorem b3_bracket_eq (M : ℝ) : (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) * (b2 M * (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) + 2 * b1 M) = (1 + 3 * Real.exp M) * (18 * (1 + Mp M) * Real.exp M ^ 2 * (1 + 3 * Real.exp M) + 12 * Mp M * Real.exp M)
decls.doc: The bracket of `b₃`, in `E = e^M`.

decls.name: b3_bracket_ge
decls.statement: theorem b3_bracket_ge {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : M * (Real.exp M + 1) ≤ (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) * (b2 M * (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) + 2 * b1 M) ∧ (4 + 2 * Mp M) * (1 + Real.exp M ^ 2) ≤ (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) * (b2 M * (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) + 2 * b1 M) ∧ 8 ≤ (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) * (b2 M * (1 + Real.exp (Mp M)) + 2 * b1 M)
decls.doc: The three lower bounds on the bracket of `b₃` the proof spends: the relative step (`M(e^M+1)`), the second derivative (`(4 + 2M')(1 + e^{2M})`, the form this file's `f''` bound takes), and `8` (for `γ ≤ u_min²/(32‖w‖_{L^∞})`).

decls.name: pushMass_line
decls.statement: theorem pushMass_line (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u v : V → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (y : V) : pushMass K lam (fun x => u x - s * v x) y = pushMass K lam u y - s * pushMass K lam v y

decls.name: ratio_line
decls.statement: theorem ratio_line (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u v : V → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (y : V) : ratio K lam (fun x => u x - s * v x) y = (pushMass K lam u y - s * pushMass K lam v y) / (lam y * u y - s * (lam y * v y))

decls.name: pushMass_eq_densAct
decls.statement: theorem pushMass_eq_densAct {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (v : V → ℝ) (y : V) : pushMass K lam v y = lam y * Core.densAct lam K v y

decls.name: logSq_div_eq
decls.statement: theorem logSq_div_eq {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) : logSq (p / q) = (Real.log p - Real.log q) ^ 2

decls.name: exp_neg_le_of_abs_log_le
decls.statement: theorem exp_neg_le_of_abs_log_le {r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : |Real.log r| ≤ M) : Real.exp (-M) ≤ r ∧ r ≤ Real.exp M
decls.doc: `e^{−M} ≤ r ≤ e^M` from `|log r| ≤ M`.

decls.name: abs_lossGrad_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_lossGrad_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} {W M umin : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hw0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (humin0 : 0 < umin) (humin : ∀ x, umin ≤ u x) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hlog : ∀ x, |Real.log (ratio K lam u x)| ≤ M) (x : V) : |lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x| ≤ 2 * M * W * (Real.exp M + 1) * u x / umin ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|D(u)| ≤ 2M‖w‖_{L^∞}(e^M+1)u/u_min²`**: `|P†ψ| ≤ max|ψ| ≤ 2M‖w‖e^M/u_min` and `|rψ| ≤ 2M‖w‖/u`, read against `u ≥ u_min` (`proofs.tex:1062`).

decls.name: rel_step_le
decls.statement: theorem rel_step_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} {W M umin γ : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hw0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (humin0 : 0 < umin) (humin : ∀ x, umin ≤ u x) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hlog : ∀ x, |Real.log (ratio K lam u x)| ≤ M) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ : γ * b3 W umin M ≤ 1) (x : V) : γ * |lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x| ≤ u x / 2

decls.name: pushMass_mono
decls.statement: theorem pushMass_mono {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam v v' : V → ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (h : ∀ x, v x ≤ v' x) (y : V) : pushMass K lam v y ≤ pushMass K lam v' y

decls.name: pushMass_smul
decls.statement: theorem pushMass_smul (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (y : V) : pushMass K lam (fun x => c * u x) y = c * pushMass K lam u y

decls.name: abs_logdiff_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_logdiff_le {a a' c c' : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (ha1 : a / 2 ≤ a') (ha2 : a' ≤ 3 * a / 2) (hc1 : c / 2 ≤ c') (hc2 : c' ≤ 3 * c / 2) : |Real.log a' - Real.log c'| ≤ |Real.log (a / c)| + Real.log 3
decls.doc: `|log(a − sb) − log(c − sd)| ≤ |log(a/c)| + ln 3` when both lines stay within a factor two of `a` and `c`: the ratio moves by at most a factor `3` along the segment (`proofs.tex:1062`).

decls.name: descent_step
decls.statement: theorem descent_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} {W M umin γ : ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hw0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hW0 : 0 ≤ W) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (humin0 : 0 < umin) (humin : ∀ x, umin ≤ u x) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hlog : ∀ x, |Real.log (ratio K lam u x)| ≤ M) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ : γ * b3 W umin M ≤ 1) : (∀ x, u x / 2 ≤ u x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x) ∧ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (fun x => u x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x)) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) - γ / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`*(3)*, the descent lemma** (`proofs.tex:1062–1066`): on a positive density whose ratio is within `e^{±M}` of `1` and which is at least `u_min`, one step `u⁺ = u − γD(u)` with `0 ≤ γ ≤ 1/b₃` satisfies `u⁺ ≥ u/2` and `𝓛(u⁺) ≤ 𝓛(u) − (γ/2)‖D(u)‖²`.

decls.name: abs_log_ratio_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_log_ratio_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin L0 : ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hL : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ L0) (x : V) : |Real.log (ratio K lam u x)| ≤ ratioCap lamMin wmin L0
decls.doc: **The positivity floor** (`proofs.tex:1061`): `𝓛(u) ≤ L₀` and `Πu ≥ m₀` give `e^{−M} ≤ r(u) ≤ e^M`, i.e.

decls.name: meanL2_lossGrad_nonpos
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_lossGrad_nonpos {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hwpos : ∀ x, 0 < wf x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) : Graph.meanL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u) ≤ 0
decls.doc: `ΠD(u) ≤ 0`, `prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(1)*, read at `ν = wλ`.

decls.name: region_step
decls.statement: theorem region_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W L0 m0 γ : ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0) (ratioCap lamMin wmin L0) ≤ 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hL : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ L0) (hm : m0 ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam u) : (∀ x, uMin V lamMin pmin wmin L0 m0 ≤ u x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 < u x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x) ∧ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (fun x => u x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x)) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) - γ / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam u ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => u x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u x) ^ 2 = Graph.nrmL2 lam u ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv u) ^ 2
decls.doc: **One step inside the region** (`proofs.tex:1060–1071`): a positive `u` with `𝓛(u) ≤ L₀` and `Πu ≥ m₀` has `u ≥ u_min`, and one step at `0 ≤ γ ≤ 1/b₃` keeps positivity, descends by `(γ/2)‖D‖²`, raises the mass, and adds exactly `γ²‖D‖²` to the squared norm.

decls.name: traj_region
decls.statement: theorem traj_region {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) : ∀ k, (∀ x, 0 < uk k x) ∧ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk k)) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ^ 2 + 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk k)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2 + 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))
decls.doc: **The region is invariant** (`proofs.tex:1067–1071`): every iterate is positive, has loss at most `𝓛(μ₀)`, mass at least `m₀`, and `‖u_k‖² + 2γ𝓛(u_k) ≤ ‖u₀‖² + 2γ𝓛(μ₀)`.

decls.name: traj_a
decls.statement: theorem traj_a {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) (hγL : 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) : ∀ k, (∀ x, uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) ≤ uk k x) ∧ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk (k + 1))) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk k)) - γ / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k)) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ^ 2 = Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k)) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, assertion *3(a)*** (`proofs.tex:1023`): for every `k`, `u_k ≥ u_min`, the loss descends by `(γ/2)‖D(u_k)‖²`, the mass does not decrease, and `‖u_{k+1}‖² = ‖u_k‖² + γ²‖D(u_k)‖² ≤ 2‖u₀‖²`.

decls.name: inv_recursion
decls.statement: theorem inv_recursion {L : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hL : ∀ k, 0 ≤ L k) (hrec : ∀ k, L (k + 1) ≤ L k - a * L k ^ 2) : ∀ k : ℕ, L k ≤ ((L 0)⁻¹ + k * a)⁻¹
decls.doc: A real sequence with `L_{k+1} ≤ L_k − aL_k²` satisfies `L_k ≤ (L_0^{−1} + ka)^{−1}` (`proofs.tex:1077`), with Lean's `0^{−1} = 0` standing in for the paper's `+∞` at a balanced start.

decls.name: traj_nrm_le
decls.statement: theorem traj_nrm_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) (hγL : 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) : ∀ k, Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ∧ 0 < Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k)
decls.doc: `‖u_k‖ ≤ √2‖u₀‖` and `0 < ‖u_k‖` along the descent.

decls.name: traj_b
decls.statement: theorem traj_b {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) (hγL : 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) : ∀ k : ℕ, lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk k)) ≤ ((lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))⁻¹ + k * γ * (wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) * W * ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))))) ^ 2 / 4)⁻¹
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, assertion *3(b)*, the discrete Łojasiewicz envelope** (`proofs.tex:1024`, proof `:1072–1077`): `𝓛(u_k) ≤ (𝓛(μ₀)^{−1} + kγκ²/4)^{−1}` with the continuous phase's `κ = w_min λ_min^{1/2}/(‖u₀‖‖w‖_{L^∞}M)`.

decls.name: traj_entry
decls.statement: theorem traj_entry {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ Bhat eps0 : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) (hγL : 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (heps0 : 0 < eps0) (heps1 : eps0 ≤ 1 / 32) : ∀ k : ℕ, ⌈k0real γ (kappa wmin lamMin (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) W (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))))) lamMin wmin (delta1 eps0 (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) Bhat (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)))⌉₊ ≤ k → (∀ x, |ratio K lam (uk k) x - 1| ≤ delta1 eps0 (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) Bhat (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0))) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk k)) ≤ eps0 * Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => uk k x / Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) - 1) ≤ eps0
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`*(3)*, the entry bound** (`proofs.tex:1078`): for every `k ≥ k₀(γ)`, `|r(u_k) − 1| ≤ δ₁` at every state, `‖u_k − Πu_k‖ ≤ ε₀m₀`, and `‖u_k/Πu_k − 1‖ ≤ ε₀`.

decls.name: perpL2_div_sub_one
decls.statement: theorem perpL2_div_sub_one {lam u : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {m : ℝ} (hm : m ≠ 0) : perpL2 lam (fun x => u x / m - 1) = fun x => m⁻¹ * perpL2 lam u x
decls.doc: The deviation of `u/m` from `1`, orthogonalised, is `m⁻¹` times that of `u`.

decls.name: traj_c
decls.statement: theorem traj_c {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ Bhat M3 : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) (hγL : 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) (hγ0 : γ ≤ gamma0At M3 wmin W Bhat * Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) (hM3 : 24 ≤ M3) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) : ∀ k : ℕ, ⌈k0real γ (kappa wmin lamMin (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) W (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))))) lamMin wmin (delta1 (eps0At M3 wmin W Bhat lamMin) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) Bhat (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)))⌉₊ ≤ k → Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - γ * rhoL 2 wmin Bhat / (4 * Graph.meanL2 lam (uk ⌈k0real γ (kappa wmin lamMin (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) W (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))))) lamMin wmin (delta1 (eps0At M3 wmin W Bhat lamMin) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) Bhat (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)))⌉₊) ^ 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, assertion *3(c)*'s contraction** (`proofs.tex:1079`): with `m := Πu_{k₀(γ)}` and `h_j := u_{k₀+j}/m − 1`, homogeneity gives `h_{j+1} = h_j − (γ/m²)D(1 + h_j)`, the step `γ/m²` is at most `γ₀`, `‖h_0‖ ≤ ε₀`, and `LocalConvergence.local_convergence_gd` gives the per-step contraction; multiplying by `m` gives `‖u_{k+1} − Πu_{k+1}‖ ≤ (1 − γϱ/(4m²))‖u_k − Πu_k‖`.

decls.name: loss_le_perp_sq
decls.statement: theorem loss_le_perp_sq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u : V → ℝ} {W m : ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hW0 : 0 ≤ W) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : ∀ x, 31 / 32 * m ≤ u x) (hr : ∀ x, |ratio K lam u x - 1| ≤ 1 / 32) : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ 24 / 5 * W * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam u) ^ 2 / m ^ 2

decls.name: limit_arith
decls.statement: theorem limit_arith {mk minf m ξ e0 : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmk : m ≤ mk) (hkinf : mk ≤ minf) (hsq : minf ^ 2 ≤ mk ^ 2 + 13 / 10 * ξ ^ 2) (hξ0 : 0 ≤ ξ) (hξ : ξ ≤ e0 * m) (he1 : e0 ≤ 1 / 32) : minf - mk ≤ ξ ^ 2 / m ∧ ξ + (minf - mk) ≤ 9 / 8 * ξ
decls.doc: The real arithmetic closing *(d)* (`proofs.tex:1088`): from `0 < m ≤ Πu_k ≤ m_∞`, `m_∞² ≤ (Πu_k)² + (13/10)‖ξ‖²` and `‖ξ‖ ≤ ε₀m` with `ε₀ ≤ 1/32`, the gap is at most `‖ξ‖²/m` and `‖ξ‖ + (m_∞ − Πu_k) ≤ (9/8)‖ξ‖`.

decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_sub_const_le {lam u : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (c : ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u x - c) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam u) + |Graph.meanL2 lam u - c|

decls.name: past_bound
decls.statement: theorem past_bound {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {lamMin W γ m e0 : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hW0 : 0 < W) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hmpos : 0 < m) (he1 : e0 ≤ 1 / 32) (hCe : Cinf lamMin * e0 ≤ 1 / 32) (hmono : Monotone fun j => Graph.meanL2 lam (uk j)) (hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun j => Graph.meanL2 lam (uk j))) (hmk : m ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k)) (hr32 : ∀ x, |ratio K lam (uk k) x - 1| ≤ 1 / 32) (hξm : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk k)) ≤ e0 * m) (hγW : γ * (32 * W) ≤ m ^ 2) (hsq : ∀ j, k ≤ j → Graph.meanL2 lam (uk j) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ^ 2 + Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk k)) ^ 2 + 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk k))) : (⨆ j, Graph.meanL2 lam (uk j)) - Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk k)) ^ 2 / m ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => uk k x - ⨆ j, Graph.meanL2 lam (uk j)) ≤ 9 / 8 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (uk k))
decls.doc: **The estimates of *(d)* at one `k ≥ k₀`** (`proofs.tex:1080–1088`), from the entry bound, the monotone mass, the non-increasing `‖u‖² + 2γ𝓛` and `γ ≤ m²/(32‖w‖_{L^∞})`.

decls.name: traj_d
decls.statement: theorem traj_d {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin pmin wmin W γ Bhat M3 : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hKM : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hcross : CrossingFloor K pmin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hW : ∀ x, wf x ≤ W) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγb : γ * b3 W (uMin V lamMin pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)))) ≤ 1) (hγL : 2 * γ * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0)) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) (hγ0 : γ ≤ gamma0At M3 wmin W Bhat * Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) (hM3 : 24 ≤ M3) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) : Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk ⌈k0real γ (kappa wmin lamMin (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) W (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))))) lamMin wmin (delta1 (eps0At M3 wmin W Bhat lamMin) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) Bhat (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)))⌉₊) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk ⌈k0real γ (kappa wmin lamMin (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) W (ratioCap lamMin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (uk 0))))) lamMin wmin (delta1 (eps0At M3 wmin W Bhat lamMin) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) Bhat (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)))⌉₊) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ∧ Monotone (fun k => Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k)) ∧ ∃ minf : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k)) Filter.atTop (nhds minf) ∧ minf ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ∧ Balanced K lam (fun _ => minf)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, assertions *3(c)* (the bounds on `Πu_{k₀}`) and *3(d)*** (`proofs.tex:1029–1030`, proof `:1079–1088`): `Πu_k` increases to some `m_∞ ≤ √2‖u₀‖`, `m_∞λ` is balanced, and for `k ≥ k₀(γ)`, `m_∞ − Πu_k ≤ ‖u_k − Πu_k‖²/Πu_{k₀}` and `‖u_k − m_∞‖ ≤ (9/8)‖u_k − Πu_k‖`; moreover `‖u_k − m_∞‖ → 0`, the convergence the item's header announces.

decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`*(3)*: `γ_* := min(1/b₃, (‖u₀‖²/2)𝓛(μ₀)^{−1}, γ₀m₀²)`** (`proofs.tex:1051`), with the paper's convention `𝓛(μ₀)^{−1} := +∞` at a balanced start read as dropping the middle entry.

decls.name: gammaStar_pos
decls.statement: theorem gammaStar_pos {b3v U0 L0 γ0 m0 : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b3v) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hL0 : 0 ≤ L0) (hγ0 : 0 < γ0) (hm0 : 0 < m0) : 0 < gammaStar b3v U0 L0 γ0 m0

decls.name: le_gammaStar
decls.statement: theorem le_gammaStar {b3v U0 L0 γ0 m0 γ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b3v) (hL0 : 0 ≤ L0) (h : γ ≤ gammaStar b3v U0 L0 γ0 m0) : γ * b3v ≤ 1 ∧ 2 * γ * L0 ≤ U0 ^ 2 ∧ γ ≤ γ0 * m0 ^ 2
decls.doc: What `0 ≤ γ ≤ γ_*` delivers: `γb₃ ≤ 1`, `2γ𝓛(μ₀) ≤ ‖u₀‖²` and `γ ≤ γ₀m₀²`.

decls.name: k0
decls.statement: noncomputable def k0 (γ U0 W M sigStar wmin lamMin e0 m0 : ℝ) : ℕ
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`*(3)*: `k₀(γ) := ⌈32‖u₀‖⁴‖w‖²_{L^∞}M²σ_*²/(γw_min³λ_min³ε₀²m₀²)⌉`** (`proofs.tex:1056`), the printed closed form.

decls.name: k0real_eq
decls.statement: theorem k0real_eq {γ U0 W M sigStar wmin lamMin e0 m0 : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hW : 0 < W) (hM : 0 < M) (hsig : 0 < sigStar) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hm0 : 0 < m0) : k0real γ (kappa wmin lamMin U0 W M) lamMin wmin (delta1 e0 m0 (sigStar / Real.sqrt lamMin) U0) = 32 * U0 ^ 4 * W ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * sigStar ^ 2 / (γ * wmin ^ 3 * lamMin ^ 3 * e0 ^ 2 * m0 ^ 2)
decls.doc: **The two forms of `k₀(γ)` agree** (`proofs.tex:1056`, "the last equality by `B̂_σ = σ_*λ_min^{−1/2}`").

decls.name: no_uniform_step
decls.statement: theorem no_uniform_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf u0 : V → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hwpos : ∀ x, 0 < wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) (hbal : ¬ Balanced K lam u0) (hγ : 0 < γ) : ∃ y : V, ∃ s0 : ℝ, 0 < s0 ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s0 → s * u0 y - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (fun x => s * u0 x) y < 0
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`*(3)*, no step bound independent of the initialization exists** (`proofs.tex:1032`, proof `:1090`): for every `γ > 0` and every positive non-balanced `u₀`, there is a state `y` at which `su₀ − γD(su₀)` is negative for every small enough `s > 0`.

decls.name: training_speed_gd
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_gd {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup pmin γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hpmin : ∀ y z : V, 0 < B.phat y z → pmin ≤ B.phat y z) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγs : γ ≤ gammaStar (b3 wsup (uMin V (Graph.minOver G lam) pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap (Graph.minOver G lam) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))))) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (gamma0At Gamma3Val wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) : (∀ k, (∀ x, uMin V (Graph.minOver G lam) pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) ≤ uk k x) ∧ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk (k + 1))) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk k)) - γ / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k)) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ^ 2 = Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k)) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, item *3*, gradient descent with a step chosen from the initialization** (`proofs.tex:1021–1033`, proof `:1048–1090`).

decls.name: minPos
decls.statement: noncomputable def minPos (K : V → V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`p_min`, the smallest positive transition probability** of a kernel (`proofs.tex:1000`); `1` if no entry is positive.

decls.name: minPos_pos
decls.statement: theorem minPos_pos (K : V → V → ℝ) : 0 < minPos K

decls.name: minPos_le
decls.statement: theorem minPos_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {y z : V} (hyz : 0 < K y z) : minPos K ≤ K y z

decls.name: minPos_le_one
decls.statement: theorem minPos_le_one {K : V → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) [Nonempty V] : minPos K ≤ 1
decls.doc: `p_min ≤ 1` for a Markov kernel on a non-empty state space.

decls.name: no_uniform_step_graph
decls.statement: theorem no_uniform_step_graph {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam wf u0 : V → ℝ} {wmin γ : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) (hbal : ¬ Balanced B.phat lam u0) (hγ : 0 < γ) : ∃ y : V, ∃ s0 : ℝ, 0 < s0 ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s0 → s * u0 y - γ * lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (fun x => s * u0 x) y < 0
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`*(3)*, the necessity sentence on the paper's setting** (`proofs.tex:1032`): on the loop closure, for every step `γ > 0` and every non-balanced positive `u₀`, `su₀ − γD(su₀)` leaves the positive cone for every small enough `s > 0`; no step bound independent of the initialization exists.

decls.name: exists_descent_seq
decls.statement: theorem exists_descent_seq (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam wf u0 : V → ℝ) (γ : ℝ) : ∃ uk : ℕ → V → ℝ, uk 0 = u0 ∧ ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x
decls.doc: **The descent sequence exists**: `hstep` is a recursion, and any `u₀` starts one.

decls.name: training_speed_gd_inhabited
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_gd_inhabited {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH wf u0 : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup pmin : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) : ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ γ ≤ gammaStar (b3 wsup (uMin V (Graph.minOver G lam) pmin wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam u0)) (Graph.meanL2 lam u0)) (ratioCap (Graph.minOver G lam) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam u0)))) (Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam u0)) (gamma0At Gamma3Val wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam u0) ∧ ∃ uk : ℕ → V → ℝ, uk 0 = u0 ∧ ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x
decls.doc: **The hypotheses of `training_speed_gd` are inhabited** on every instance of its setting and every positive initialization: `γ_* > 0`, and the descent at `γ = γ_*` is a sequence.

decls.name: cycle_training_speed_gd_nonvacuous
decls.statement: theorem cycle_training_speed_gd_nonvacuous : ¬ Balanced (Graph.CycleExample.pol (p := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2) ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ γ ≤ gammaStar (b3 1 (uMin (Fin 5) (Graph.minOver Graph.CycleExample.cyc (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2))) (minPos (Graph.CycleExample.pol (p := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat) 1 (lossVal (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (fun _ => 1) logSq (ratio (Graph.CycleExample.pol (p := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2))) (Graph.meanL2 (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2))) (ratioCap (Graph.minOver Graph.CycleExample.cyc (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2))) 1 (lossVal (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (fun _ => 1) logSq (ratio (Graph.CycleExample.pol (p := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2))))) (Graph.nrmL2 (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2)) (lossVal (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (fun _ => 1) logSq (ratio (Graph.CycleExample.pol (p := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2))) (gamma0At Gamma3Val 1 1 (BhatSigma Graph.CycleExample.cyc (Graph.CycleExample.hitExp (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)))) (Graph.meanL2 (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2)) ∧ ∃ uk : ℕ → Fin 5 → ℝ, uk 0 = Graph.CycleExample.uInfl 2 ∧ ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad (Graph.CycleExample.pol (p := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2)) (fun z => Graph.CycleExample.lam (1/2) z * 1) logSqDeriv (uk k) x
decls.doc: **Non-vacuity on `rem:cycle_no_stalemate`'s five-vertex cycle** at `p = 1/2`, `w ≡ 1`, from the over-inflated density `u₀ = uInfl 2`, which is **not** balanced (`r(s₀) = 2`): the setting's predicates hold, and a step `0 < γ ≤ γ_*` and its descent sequence exist, so `training_speed_gd` applies to a non-balanced start.

decls.name: training_speed_gd_minPos
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_gd_minPos {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγs : γ ≤ gammaStar (b3 wsup (uMin V (Graph.minOver G lam) (minPos B.phat) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap (Graph.minOver G lam) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))))) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (gamma0At Gamma3Val wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) : (∀ k, (∀ x, uMin V (Graph.minOver G lam) (minPos B.phat) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0)) ≤ uk k x) ∧ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk (k + 1))) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk k)) - γ / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k)) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk k) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ^ 2 = Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk k) ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k)) ^ 2 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk (k + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) ^ 2) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, item *3*, at the paper's own `p_min`** — the smallest positive transition probability of the loop-closed backward policy (`minPos`), which is the constant `proofs.tex:1000` names: `training_speed_gd` with its floor hypotheses discharged by `minPos_pos`, `minPos_le_one` and `minPos_le`.

decls.name: training_speed_gd_minPos_ennreal
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_gd_minPos_ennreal {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup γ : ℝ} {uk : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < uk 0 x) (hstep : ∀ k, uk (k + 1) = fun x => uk k x - γ * lossGrad B.phat lam (fun z => lam z * wf z) logSqDeriv (uk k) x) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγs : γ ≤ gammaStar (b3 wsup (uMin V (Graph.minOver G lam) (minPos B.phat) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) (ratioCap (Graph.minOver G lam) wmin (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))))) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0)) (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))) (gamma0At Gamma3Val wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (uk 0))) : (∀ k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk k))) ≤ ((ENNReal.ofReal (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))))⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal (k * γ * (wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam) / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (uk 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0)) / (wmin * Graph.minOver G lam))))) ^ 2 / 4))⁻¹) ∧ (Balanced B.phat lam (uk 0) ↔ (ENNReal.ofReal (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (uk 0))))⁻¹ = ⊤)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, assertion *3(b)*, as printed** (`proofs.tex:1024`), with the convention `𝓛(μ₀)^{−1} := +∞` at a balanced start (`proofs.tex:1004`): the envelope read in `[0,∞]`, where `0⁻¹ = ∞` and `∞⁻¹ = 0`, together with `(𝓛(μ₀))⁻¹ = ∞ ↔ μ₀` balanced.

decls.name: Gamma3_logSq_eq_Gamma3Val
decls.statement: theorem Gamma3_logSq_eq_Gamma3Val : GFNBounds.Balance.Gamma3 GFNBounds.Balance.logSq (1/2) = Gamma3Val
decls.doc: **`Γ₃ = sup_{[1/2,3/2]}|g'''|` for `g = (log x)²`** is `Gamma3Val` (`Gamma3_logSq`).

decls.name: eps0At_Gamma3Val_eq
decls.statement: theorem eps0At_Gamma3Val_eq (wmin W Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : eps0At Gamma3Val wmin W Bhat lamMin = GFNBounds.Balance.eps0Gamma3 wmin W Bhat lamMin
decls.doc: **The entry radius of item *3* is item *2*'s**, `eps0Gamma3`.

decls.name: gamma0At_Gamma3Val_eq
decls.statement: theorem gamma0At_Gamma3Val_eq (wmin W Bhat : ℝ) : gamma0At Gamma3Val wmin W Bhat = GFNBounds.Balance.gamma0C3 GFNBounds.Balance.logSq (1/2) wmin W Bhat
decls.doc: **The step cap `γ₀` of item *3* is Theorem 10's** for `g = (log x)²` at `a = 1/2`.

files.title: The gradient field at `μ = (1+h)λ`: `D = A†[g''(1) w Ah_⊥] + E` with `‖E‖ ≤ Kε‖Ah_⊥‖`

decls.name: C4
decls.statement: noncomputable def C4 (wsup g2 M3 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`C₄ := ‖w‖_{L^∞}(4g''(1) + 3M₃)`** (`proofs.tex:626`), the constant of the pointwise remainder in the expansion of `φ`.

decls.name: Cg
decls.statement: noncomputable def Cg (g2 a M3 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`C_g := g''(1) + aM₃/2`** (`proofs.tex:628`), the Lipschitz constant of `g'` at `1` on the window `[1−a, 1+a]`.

decls.name: C5
decls.statement: noncomputable def C5 (g2 a M3 wsup : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`C₅ := (16/3)C_g‖w‖_{L^∞}`** (`proofs.tex:628`), the constant of the `(r−1)φ` term.

decls.name: Kexp
decls.statement: noncomputable def Kexp (g2 a M3 wsup : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`K := 2C₄ + C₅`** (`proofs.tex:631`), the constant of `eq:gradient_expansion`.

decls.name: linHess
decls.statement: noncomputable def linHess (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (h : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **The paper's `H = g''(1) A† M_w A`** (`proofs.tex:571`), read on densities: the operator whose `h_⊥`-image is the linear part of the gradient field.

decls.name: linHess_eq
decls.statement: theorem linHess_eq (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (h : V → ℝ) : linHess K lam w g2 h = fun x => g2 * Adj K (fun y => w y * Aop K lam h y) x
decls.doc: The unapplied form of `linHess`; see the `perpL2`/`Aop` twins in `L2Toolkit`.

decls.name: linHess_apply
decls.statement: theorem linHess_apply (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) : linHess K lam w g2 h x = g2 * Adj K (fun y => w y * Aop K lam h y) x

decls.name: Adj_sub
decls.statement: theorem Adj_sub (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Adj K (fun y => a y - b y) x = Adj K a x - Adj K b x

decls.name: Adj_smul
decls.statement: theorem Adj_smul (K : V → V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (a : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Adj K (fun y => c * a y) x = c * Adj K a x

decls.name: densAct_smul
decls.statement: theorem densAct_smul (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) (y : V) : Core.densAct lam K (fun z => c * u z) y = c * Core.densAct lam K u y
decls.doc: `P(c·u) = c·Pu`, at every state and with no hypothesis.

decls.name: Aop_smul
decls.statement: theorem Aop_smul (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) (y : V) : Aop K lam (fun z => c * u z) y = c * Aop K lam u y
decls.doc: `A(c·u) = c·Au`.

decls.name: meanL2_const_mul
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_const_mul (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (a : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => c * a x) = c * Graph.meanL2 lam a
decls.doc: `Π(c·a) = c·Πa`.

decls.name: ipL2_smul_right
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_smul_right (lam a b : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam a (fun x => c * b x) = c * Graph.ipL2 lam a b

decls.name: ratio_one_add_sub_one
decls.statement: theorem ratio_one_add_sub_one {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam h : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) (hu : 1 + h y ≠ 0) : ratio K lam (fun x => 1 + h x) y - 1 = Aop K lam h y / (1 + h y)
decls.doc: **`r − 1 = Ah/(1+h)`** (`proofs.tex:578`, restated at `proofs.tex:623`) at the flow `μ = (1+h)λ`.

decls.name: abs_Aop_le_two_sup
decls.statement: theorem abs_Aop_le_two_sup {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam h : V → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (y : V) : |Aop K lam h y| ≤ 2 * eps
