decls.statement: theorem global_dichotomy_full_one_converges {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {wmin : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) ∧ Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 fun _ => Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:global_dichotomy_full`*(1)*, the convergence clause, for `g = (log x)²`**: on the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph, with `ν = wλ` and `w ≥ w_min > 0`, the gradient flow converges to a balanced flow from every initialization `μ₀ ∼ λ` — explicitly, to the constant density `‖u₀‖_{L²(λ)} > 0`.

files.title: The two corollaries of the first variation: the FM gradient and the DB gradient

decls.name: hasDerivAt_loss_atStates
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_loss_atStates {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {gdv : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hg : ∀ z : V, HasDerivAt g (gdv z) (ratio K lam u z)) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam nu (fun x => u x + t * d x) g) (∑ x, nu x * (gdv x * (dirPush K lam u d x - ratio K lam u x * dirDens u d x))) 0
decls.doc: **`proofs.tex:469–470` with a pointwise differentiability hypothesis**: the first variation of the balance loss, before the adjoint step, asking only that `g` be differentiable at each value the ratio takes.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_loss_ipL2_atStates
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_loss_ipL2_atStates {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hg : ∀ z : V, HasDerivAt g (gd (ratio K lam u z)) (ratio K lam u z)) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam nu (fun x => u x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u (fun z => nu z / (lam z * u z)) gd) d) 0
decls.doc: **`theo:first_variation_full` at `ν_G = λ`, with a pointwise differentiability hypothesis.** `FirstVariation.hasDerivAt_loss_ipL2` with `hg` weakened; the adjoint step (`FirstVariation.firstVariation_adjoint`) is reused unchanged, which is why the represented density is still `MassIdentity.lossGradDensity`.

decls.name: densAct_reversal_eq_funAct
decls.statement: theorem densAct_reversal_eq_funAct {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) phi x = funAct K phi x
decls.doc: **`d([φλ]π_→^λ)/dλ = π_← φ`** (`proofs.tex:407`, `:442`), at every state carrying `λ`-mass: the density action of the `λ`-reversal is the function action of the kernel.

decls.name: fmGradDensity_eq
decls.statement: theorem fmGradDensity_eq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (gd : ℝ → ℝ) (x : V) : lossGradDensity K lam u (fun z => lam z * u z / (lam z * u z)) gd x = Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) (fun y => gd (ratio K lam u y)) x - ratio K lam u x * gd (ratio K lam u x)
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas`, the first display, on densities** (`proofs.tex:488`): at `ν = μ = F_←` the weight `dν/dμ` is `1`, so `MassIdentity.lossGradDensity` is the paper's `(π_→^λ − r)[g'(r)λ]` with no weight left in the bracket.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_fmLoss_ipL2
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_fmLoss_ipL2 {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun x => lam x * u x) (fun x => u x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (fun x => Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) (fun y => gd (ratio K lam u y)) x - ratio K lam u x * gd (ratio K lam u x)) d) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas`, the first display** (`proofs.tex:487–489`): the derivative of `t ↦ 𝓛_{g,F_←}(F_← + tδ)` at `t = 0` is `⟨(π_→^λ − r)[g'(r)λ] ∣ δ⟩_λ`.

decls.name: fmGradDensity_sq_eq
decls.statement: theorem fmGradDensity_sq_eq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (x : V) : Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) (fun y => 2 * (ratio K lam u y - 1)) x - ratio K lam u x * (2 * (ratio K lam u x - 1)) = 2 * (Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) (ratio K lam u) x - 1 - ratio K lam u x ^ 2 + ratio K lam u x)
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas`, the second display's expansion** (`proofs.tex:493–494`): 2(π_→^λ − r)[(r−1)λ] = 2(π_→^λ(rλ) − λ − r²λ + rλ), read on `λ`-densities.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_fmLoss_sq_ipL2
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_fmLoss_sq_ipL2 {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun x => lam x * u x) (fun x => u x + t * d x) fun z => (z - 1) ^ 2) (Graph.ipL2 lam (fun x => 2 * (Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) (ratio K lam u) x - 1 - ratio K lam u x ^ 2 + ratio K lam u x)) d) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas` for `g(x) = (x−1)²`** (`proofs.tex:492–494`), in the paper's own second form `2(π_→^λ(rλ) − λ − r²λ + rλ)`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_abs_sub_one
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_abs_sub_one {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 1) : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => |z - 1|) (Real.sign (y - 1)) y
decls.doc: **`|z−1|` is differentiable off `1`**, with derivative the sign of `y−1`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_fmLoss_abs_ipL2
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_fmLoss_abs_ipL2 {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hne : ∀ x, ratio K lam u x ≠ 1) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun x => lam x * u x) (fun x => u x + t * d x) fun z => |z - 1|) (Graph.ipL2 lam (fun x => Core.densAct lam (Core.reversal lam K) (fun y => Real.sign (ratio K lam u y - 1)) x - ratio K lam u x * Real.sign (ratio K lam u x - 1)) d) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas` for `g(x) = |x−1|`** (`proofs.tex:497`, `:501`), on a flow that is nowhere balanced: `g'(r)` is `ε(r) = sign(r−1)` and the first display holds unchanged, ∇^λ_{F_←} 𝓛_{g,F_←} = (π_→^λ − r)[ε(r)λ].

decls.name: twoState_hasDerivAt_fmLoss
decls.statement: theorem twoState_hasDerivAt_fmLoss : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss twoStateK twoStateLam (fun x => twoStateLam x * twoStateU x) (fun x => twoStateU x + t * (![1, 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) x) fun z => (z - 1) ^ 2) (5 / 16) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas` evaluated.** On `π_←(i→j) = 1/2`, `λ = (1/2,1/2)`, `F_← = (1,1/2)` — i.e.

decls.name: twoState_hasDerivAt_fmLoss_abs
decls.statement: theorem twoState_hasDerivAt_fmLoss_abs : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss twoStateK twoStateLam (fun x => twoStateLam x * twoStateU x) (fun x => twoStateU x + t * (![1, 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) x) fun z => |z - 1|) (3 / 8) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:gradient_formulas` evaluated for `g(x) = |x−1|`.** The same chain and the same direction: `r = (3/4, 3/2)`, nowhere `1`, so `hasDerivAt_fmLoss_abs_ipL2` applies and `ε(r) = (−1, +1)`.

decls.name: edgeKernelProd
decls.statement: def edgeKernelProd (pb : V → V → ℝ) : V × V → V × V → ℝ
decls.doc: `K₂` on `V × V`: `Lift.edgeKernel` uncurried, which is the shape `theo:first_variation_full` takes a kernel in.

decls.name: edgeMeasureProd
decls.statement: def edgeMeasureProd (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) : V × V → ℝ
decls.doc: `λ₂` on `V × V`: `Lift.edgeMeasure` uncurried, `λ₂(s,s') = π_←(s'→s)λ(s')`.

decls.name: dualEdgeKernelProd
decls.statement: def dualEdgeKernelProd (pf : V → V → ℝ) : V × V → V × V → ℝ
decls.doc: `K₂^{λ₂}` on `V × V`: `Lift.dualEdgeKernel` uncurried — the forward edge kernel `(s,s') ↦ (s', π_→^λ(s'))` of `lem:lift_wellposed`.

decls.name: edgeKernelProd_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernelProd_nonneg {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (p q : V × V) : 0 ≤ edgeKernelProd pb p q
decls.doc: `K₂ ≥ 0` — `Lift.edgeKernel_nonneg`, re-indexed.

decls.name: edgeMeasureProd_pos
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasureProd_pos {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpb : ∀ x y, 0 < pb x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (p : V × V) : 0 < edgeMeasureProd pb lam p
decls.doc: **`λ₂ > 0` everywhere**, which is what `theo:first_variation_full`'s `μ ∼ λ` becomes on `𝒮²` in the finite model.

decls.name: invariant_edgeKernelProd
decls.statement: theorem invariant_edgeKernelProd {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant pb lam) : Invariant (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, invariance, on `V × V`**: `λ₂ K₂ = λ₂`.

decls.name: isReversalPair_edgeKernelProd
decls.statement: theorem isReversalPair_edgeKernelProd {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpf : ∀ x y, lam x * pf x y = lam y * pb y x) : Core.IsReversalPair (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) (edgeKernelProd pb) (dualEdgeKernelProd pf)
decls.doc: **`K₂^{λ₂}` *is* the forward edge kernel of `lem:lift_wellposed`** (`proofs.tex:513`, `:521`): `(λ₂, K₂, K₂*)` is a reversal pair in the sense of `lem:adjoint`*(1)*.

decls.name: ratio_edgeKernelProd
decls.statement: theorem ratio_edgeKernelProd (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (u : V × V → ℝ) (p : V × V) : ratio (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) u p = pushEdge pb (fun a b => u (a, b) * edgeMeasure pb lam a b) p.1 p.2 / (edgeMeasureProd pb lam p * u p)
decls.doc: **`r̂ = d(μK₂)/dμ` is `Lift`'s lifted balance ratio**: for the edge flow `μ = u·λ₂`, `MassIdentity.ratio` on `(𝒮², λ₂, K₂)` is `Lift.pushEdge μ / μ`.

decls.name: ratio_edgeKernelProd_db
decls.statement: theorem ratio_edgeKernelProd_db (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (u : V × V → ℝ) (hmu : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ u (s, s') * edgeMeasure pb lam s s') (p : V × V) : ratio (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) u p = marg₁ (fun a b => u (a, b) * edgeMeasure pb lam a b) p.2 * pb p.2 p.1 / (marg₁ (fun a b => u (a, b) * edgeMeasure pb lam a b) p.1 * disint (fun a b => u (a, b) * edgeMeasure pb lam a b) p.1 p.2)
decls.doc: **`r̂` is the detailed-balance edge ratio** (`prop:db_lift`, `proofs.tex:528`): r̂(s,s') = F(s') π_←(s'→s) / (F(s) π_→^μ(s→s')), F = m₁μ, so the loss differentiated below really is the `g`-divergence DB loss with frozen backward policy.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_dbLoss_ipL2
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_dbLoss_ipL2 {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {nuhat u : V × V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant pb lam) (hpb : ∀ x y, 0 < pb x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hpf : ∀ x y, lam x * pf x y = lam y * pb y x) (hu : ∀ p, 0 < u p) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (d : V × V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) nuhat (fun p => u p + t * d p) g) (Graph.ipL2 (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) (fun p => Core.densAct (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) (dualEdgeKernelProd pf) (fun q => gd (ratio (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) u q) * (nuhat q / (edgeMeasureProd pb lam q * u q))) p - ratio (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) u p * (gd (ratio (edgeKernelProd pb) (edgeMeasureProd pb lam) u p) * (nuhat p / (edgeMeasureProd pb lam p * u p)))) d) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:db_gradient`** (`proofs.tex:539–542`): the derivative of `t ↦ 𝓛_{DB,g,ν̂}(μ + tδ)` at `t = 0` is `⟨(K₂^{λ₂} − r̂)[g'(r̂)(dν̂/dμ)λ₂] ∣ δ⟩_{λ₂}`.

decls.name: twoStateEdgeU
decls.statement: def twoStateEdgeU : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℝ
decls.doc: The `λ₂`-density of the edge flow used by `twoStateEdge_hasDerivAt_dbLoss`: `u(0,0) = 1`, `u(0,1) = 3`, `u(1,0) = 2`, `u(1,1) = 4`.

decls.name: twoStateEdge_hasDerivAt_dbLoss
decls.statement: theorem twoStateEdge_hasDerivAt_dbLoss : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss (edgeKernelProd twoStateK) (edgeMeasureProd twoStateK twoStateLam) (fun p => edgeMeasureProd twoStateK twoStateLam p * twoStateEdgeU p) (fun p => twoStateEdgeU p + t * (1 : ℝ)) fun z => (z - 1) ^ 2) (-17 / 32) 0
decls.doc: **`cor:db_gradient` evaluated.** On `π_←(i→j) = 1/2` and `λ = (1/2,1/2)`, so that `λ₂ ≡ 1/4` and `π_→^λ = π_←`, take the edge flow `μ = u·λ₂` with `u` as in `twoStateEdgeU` — `μ = (1/4, 3/4, 1/2, 1)` — and `ν̂ = μ`, so `dν̂/dμ ≡ 1`.

files.title: The `L²(λ)` shelf the frozen-policy convergence block stands on: `A = P − I`, its adjoint, and a continuity bootstrap

decls.name: ipL2_comm
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_comm (lam a b : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam a b = Graph.ipL2 lam b a

decls.name: ipL2_sub_left
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_sub_left (lam a b c : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam (fun x => a x - b x) c = Graph.ipL2 lam a c - Graph.ipL2 lam b c

decls.name: ipL2_sub_right
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_sub_right (lam a b c : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam a (fun x => b x - c x) = Graph.ipL2 lam a b - Graph.ipL2 lam a c

decls.name: meanL2_sub
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_sub (lam a b : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => a x - b x) = Graph.meanL2 lam a - Graph.meanL2 lam b
decls.doc: `Π(a − b) = Πa − Πb`.

decls.name: nrmL2_neg
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_neg (lam a : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => -a x) = Graph.nrmL2 lam a

decls.name: nrmL2_smul
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_smul (lam a : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => c * a x) = |c| * Graph.nrmL2 lam a

decls.name: nrmL2_add_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_add_le {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a b : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => a x + b x) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam a + Graph.nrmL2 lam b
decls.doc: **The triangle inequality for `‖·‖_{L²(λ)}`**, from the Cauchy–Schwarz `Graph.ipL2_le_mul_nrmL2`.

decls.name: nrmL2_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_sub_le {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a b : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => a x - b x) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam a + Graph.nrmL2 lam b
decls.doc: `‖a − b‖_λ ≤ ‖a‖_λ + ‖b‖_λ` — the form the two "norm at most `2`" bounds consume.

decls.name: nrmL2_le_of_abs_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_le_of_abs_le {lam a b : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hab : ∀ x, |a x| ≤ c * |b x|) : Graph.nrmL2 lam a ≤ c * Graph.nrmL2 lam b
decls.doc: **A pointwise domination transfers to the norm**: `|a| ≤ c|b|` everywhere gives `‖a‖_λ ≤ c‖b‖_λ`.

decls.name: abs_le_nrmL2_div_sqrt
decls.statement: theorem abs_le_nrmL2_div_sqrt {lam : V → ℝ} {lamMin : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (a : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Real.sqrt lamMin * |a x| ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam a
decls.doc: **`‖·‖_{L^∞} ≤ ‖·‖_{L²(λ)}/√λ_min`**, the paper's `C_∞ = (min λ)^{−1/2}` (`proofs.tex:613`), with `λ_min` a hypothesis rather than a minimum over a `MarkedGraph`.

decls.name: Aop
decls.statement: noncomputable def Aop (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam h : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **The paper's `A = P − I`** (`eq:linearized_flow`, `proofs.tex:566`; `proofs.tex:741`), acting on densities: `P` is `Core.densAct`, the density action of the kernel `K` on `𝓜²(λ)`.

decls.name: Adj
decls.statement: def Adj (K : V → V → ℝ) (φ : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **The paper's `A† = P† − I`**, acting on functions: `P†` is the function action `(P†φ)(x) = ∑_y K(x,y)φ(y)`, the `L²(λ)`-adjoint of `P` by `lem:adjoint`*(3)*.

decls.name: perpL2
decls.statement: def perpL2 (lam h : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **The paper's `h^⊥ := h − m`** with `m = Πh` a scalar (`proofs.tex:621`).

decls.name: perpL2_eq
decls.statement: theorem perpL2_eq (lam h : V → ℝ) : perpL2 lam h = fun x => h x - Graph.meanL2 lam h
decls.doc: The unapplied form of `perpL2`.

decls.name: perpL2_apply
decls.statement: theorem perpL2_apply (lam h : V → ℝ) (x : V) : perpL2 lam h x = h x - Graph.meanL2 lam h

decls.name: Aop_eq
decls.statement: theorem Aop_eq (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam h : V → ℝ) : Aop K lam h = fun y => Core.densAct lam K h y - h y
decls.doc: The unapplied form of `Aop`.

decls.name: Aop_apply
decls.statement: theorem Aop_apply (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam h : V → ℝ) (y : V) : Aop K lam h y = Core.densAct lam K h y - h y

decls.name: Adj_eq
decls.statement: theorem Adj_eq (K : V → V → ℝ) (φ : V → ℝ) : Adj K φ = fun x => funAct K φ x - φ x
decls.doc: The unapplied form of `Adj`.

decls.name: Adj_apply
decls.statement: theorem Adj_apply (K : V → V → ℝ) (φ : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Adj K φ x = funAct K φ x - φ x

decls.name: funAct_sub
decls.statement: theorem funAct_sub (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) : funAct K (fun y => a y - b y) = fun x => funAct K a x - funAct K b x
decls.doc: `P†` is linear: `P†(a − b) = P†a − P†b`.

decls.name: densAct_sub
decls.statement: theorem densAct_sub (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) (y : V) : Core.densAct lam K (fun x => a x - b x) y = Core.densAct lam K a y - Core.densAct lam K b y
decls.doc: `P` is linear: `P(a − b) = Pa − Pb`, at every state and with no hypothesis (both sides vanish together where `λ` does).

decls.name: funAct_const
decls.statement: theorem funAct_const {K : V → V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (c : ℝ) (x : V) : funAct K (fun _ => c) x = c
decls.doc: **`P†𝟏 = 𝟏`**: the function action fixes the constants, `K` being row-stochastic.

decls.name: densAct_const
decls.statement: theorem densAct_const {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (c : ℝ) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : Core.densAct lam K (fun _ => c) y = c
decls.doc: **`P𝟏 = 𝟏` `λ`-almost everywhere**: the density action fixes the constants wherever `λ` charges, `λ` being invariant.

decls.name: Aop_const
decls.statement: theorem Aop_const {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (c : ℝ) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : Aop K lam (fun _ => c) y = 0
decls.doc: **`A𝟏 = 0`**, `λ`-almost everywhere.

decls.name: Adj_const
decls.statement: theorem Adj_const {K : V → V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (c : ℝ) (x : V) : Adj K (fun _ => c) x = 0

decls.name: Aop_perpL2
decls.statement: theorem Aop_perpL2 {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (h : V → ℝ) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : Aop K lam (perpL2 lam h) y = Aop K lam h y
decls.doc: **`Ah = Ah_⊥`** — the first of the four facts `proofs.tex:621` recalls.

decls.name: ipL2_Adj_left
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_Adj_left {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (φ h : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam (Adj K φ) h = Graph.ipL2 lam φ (Aop K lam h)
decls.doc: **`⟪A†φ ∣ h⟫_λ = ⟪φ ∣ Ah⟫_λ`** — `A† = P† − I` is the `L²(λ)`-adjoint of `A = P − I`, `lem:adjoint`*(3)* minus the identity on both sides.

decls.name: meanL2_funAct
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_funAct {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (φ : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (funAct K φ) = Graph.meanL2 lam φ
decls.doc: **`∫ P†φ dλ = ∫ φ dλ`** read on `Π`: this is `Balance.integral_funAct` of `GFNBounds/Balance/MassIdentity.lean`, which the paper writes `⟨φ, P𝟏⟩ = ∫φ dλ` (`proofs.tex:802`).

decls.name: meanL2_Adj
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_Adj {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (φ : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (Adj K φ) = 0
decls.doc: **`Π A†φ = 0`**: `A†` lands in the mean-zero subspace.

decls.name: invariant_of_isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem invariant_of_isInvariant {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) : Invariant K lam
decls.doc: `Core.IsInvariant` implies the `Balance` spelling of invariance; the two are the same statement, `Core.IsInvariant` merely bundling `λ ≥ 0` with it.

decls.name: nrmL2_funAct_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_funAct_le {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (φ : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (funAct K φ) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam φ
decls.doc: **`‖P†‖ ≤ 1`** — `Core.nrmL2_funAct_le`, restated for `Balance.funAct`.

decls.name: nrmL2_densAct_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_densAct_le {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (u : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (Core.densAct lam K u) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam u
decls.doc: **`‖P‖ ≤ 1`** — `Core.nrmL2_densAct_le`, re-exported.

decls.name: nrmL2_Aop_le_two
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_Aop_le_two {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (h : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam h) ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam h
decls.doc: **`‖A‖ ≤ 2`** (`proofs.tex:621`, and `proofs.tex:609` where it buys `ε‖H‖ ≤ 1`): the triangle inequality against `‖P‖ ≤ 1`.

decls.name: nrmL2_Adj_le_two
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_Adj_le_two {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (φ : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (Adj K φ) ≤ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam φ

decls.name: nrmL2_sq_eq_mean_sq_add_perp
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_sq_eq_mean_sq_add_perp {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (h : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam h ^ 2 = Graph.meanL2 lam h ^ 2 + Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam h) ^ 2
decls.doc: **Pythagoras**: `‖h‖² = (Πh)² + ‖h_⊥‖²` when `λ` is a probability.

decls.name: abs_meanL2_le_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem abs_meanL2_le_nrmL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (h : V → ℝ) : |Graph.meanL2 lam h| ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam h

decls.name: nrmL2_perpL2_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_perpL2_le {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (h : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam h) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam h

decls.name: sqrt_one_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem sqrt_one_sub_le {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) : Real.sqrt (1 - x) ≤ 1 - x / 2
decls.doc: `√(1 − x) ≤ 1 − x/2` on `[0,1]` — the concavity step behind a "contracts by `1 − γϱ/4`" reading of a "contracts by `1 − γϱ/2`" bound on the square (`proofs.tex:655–656`).

decls.name: bootstrap_of_continuous
decls.statement: theorem bootstrap_of_continuous {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hcont : ∀ x, Continuous fun t => h t x) (hstart : ∀ x, |h 0 x| ≤ eps / 2) (hboot : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) t, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) → ∀ x, |h t x| ≤ eps / 2) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, |h t x| ≤ eps / 2
decls.doc: **The continuation bootstrap** — the shape of Step 4 of `theo:local_convergence_full` (`proofs.tex:643`: *"on any interval where `‖h_s‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε` the estimates above give `‖h_t‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε/2`: by continuity the interval is all of `ℝ₊`"*), stated for a family of continuous scalar functions and with no flow in sight.

files.title: The edge lift: detailed balance is flow matching one step up

decls.name: sum_rotate
decls.statement: theorem sum_rotate (F : V → V → V → ℝ) : ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, F a b c = ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ a, F a b c
decls.doc: Moving the outermost of three summation indices to the innermost position.

decls.name: marg₁
decls.statement: def marg₁ (mu : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **first marginal** `m₁μ(s) = ∑_{s'} μ(s,s')` — the marginal in the *first* coordinate, which is what `μ = F ⊗ π_→^μ` (`proofs.tex:525`) means by `F := m₁μ`.

decls.name: marg₂
decls.statement: def marg₂ (mu : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **second marginal** `m₂μ(s') = ∑_s μ(s,s')`.

decls.name: edgeKernel
decls.statement: def edgeKernel (pb : V → V → ℝ) (s _s' z w : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`def:edge_lift`, the kernel** (`proofs.tex:505–508`).

decls.name: edgeKernel_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernel_nonneg {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (s s' z w : V) : 0 ≤ edgeKernel pb s s' z w
decls.doc: `K₂` is non-negative.

decls.name: edgeKernel_total
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernel_total {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (s s' : V) : ∑ z, ∑ w, edgeKernel pb s s' z w = 1
decls.doc: `K₂` is a Markov kernel on `𝒮²`: each row sums to `1`.

decls.name: edgeMeasure
decls.statement: def edgeMeasure (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`def:edge_lift`, the edge measure** (`proofs.tex:509`): `λ₂(ds ds') := π_←(s' → ds) λ(ds')`, i.e.

decls.name: edgeMeasure_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasure_nonneg {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (s s' : V) : 0 ≤ edgeMeasure pb lam s s'

decls.name: marg₂_edgeMeasure
decls.statement: theorem marg₂_edgeMeasure {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) : marg₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) = lam
decls.doc: **`λ₂` has second marginal `λ`** (`proofs.tex:521`, "both marginals of `λ₂` equal `λ`").

decls.name: marg₁_edgeMeasure
decls.statement: theorem marg₁_edgeMeasure {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant pb lam) : marg₁ (edgeMeasure pb lam) = lam
decls.doc: **`λ₂` has first marginal `λ`** (`proofs.tex:521`, and the "`λπ_← = λ`" of the invariance step).

decls.name: edgeMeasure_total
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasure_total {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : ∑ s, ∑ s', edgeMeasure pb lam s s' = 1
decls.doc: `λ₂` is a probability measure on `𝒮²` when `λ` is one on `𝒮`.

decls.name: pushEdge
decls.statement: def pushEdge (pb : V → V → ℝ) (mu : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: The action of `K₂` on measures: `μ ↦ μK₂`, written out as `(μK₂)(z,w) = ∑_{s,s'} μ(s,s') K₂((s,s') → (z,w))`.

decls.name: pushEdge_apply
decls.statement: theorem pushEdge_apply (pb : V → V → ℝ) (mu : V → V → ℝ) (z w : V) : pushEdge pb mu z w = pb w z * marg₁ mu w
decls.doc: **`eq:muK2_density`** (`proofs.tex:517–520`), in its division-free form: (μK₂)(s,s') = π_←(s' → s) · (m₁μ)(s'), which is the paper's `μK₂(ds ds') = π_←(s' → ds)(m₁μ)(ds')`.

decls.name: pushEdge_eq_edgeMeasure_mul
decls.statement: theorem pushEdge_eq_edgeMeasure_mul (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (mu : V → V → ℝ) {s s' : V} (h : lam s' ≠ 0) : pushEdge pb mu s s' = edgeMeasure pb lam s s' * (marg₁ mu s' / lam s')
decls.doc: **`eq:muK2_density`** as the paper writes it, as a density against `λ₂`: d(μK₂)/dλ₂ (s,s') = d(m₁μ)/dλ (s').

decls.name: pushEdge_edgeMeasure
decls.statement: theorem pushEdge_edgeMeasure {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant pb lam) : pushEdge pb (edgeMeasure pb lam) = edgeMeasure pb lam
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, invariance** (`proofs.tex:512`, proved at `proofs.tex:521`: "taking `μ = λ₂`, whose first marginal is `λπ_← = λ`, yields invariance").

decls.name: dualEdgeKernel
decls.statement: def dualEdgeKernel (pf : V → V → ℝ) (_s s' z w : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the dual kernel** (`proofs.tex:513`): the edge lift `(s,s') ↦ (s', π_→^λ(s'))` of the dual forward policy, i.e.

decls.name: edgeKernel_dual
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernel_dual {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (s s' z w : V) : edgeMeasure pb lam s s' * edgeKernel pb s s' z w = edgeMeasure pb lam z w * dualEdgeKernel pf z w s s'
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the duality identity** `λ₂ ⊗ K₂ = K₂* ⊗ λ₂` (`proofs.tex:521`), read pointwise on a finite space: λ₂(s,s') · K₂((s,s') → (z,w)) = λ₂(z,w) · K₂*((z,w) → (s,s')).

decls.name: funActEdge
decls.statement: def funActEdge (pb : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: The action of `K₂` on **functions**: `(K₂f)(s,s') = ∑_{z,w} K₂((s,s') → (z,w)) f(z,w)`.

decls.name: funActEdge_apply
decls.statement: theorem funActEdge_apply (pb : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) (s s' : V) : funActEdge pb f s s' = ∑ z, pb s z * f z s
decls.doc: `(K₂f)(s,s') = ∫ f(z,s) π_←(s → dz)`: the value depends on `s` alone, the new second coordinate being the old first one.

decls.name: dualFunActEdge
decls.statement: def dualFunActEdge (pf : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: The action of `K₂*` on functions.

decls.name: dualFunActEdge_apply
decls.statement: theorem dualFunActEdge_apply (pf : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) (s s' : V) : dualFunActEdge pf f s s' = ∑ w, pf s' w * f s' w

decls.name: inner_funActEdge
decls.statement: theorem inner_funActEdge {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (f g : V → V → ℝ) : ∑ s, ∑ s', edgeMeasure pb lam s s' * funActEdge pb f s s' * g s s' = ∑ s, ∑ s', edgeMeasure pb lam s s' * f s s' * dualFunActEdge pf g s s'
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the dual clause in its `L²(λ₂)` form**: `⟨K₂ f, g⟩_{λ₂} = ⟨f, K₂* g⟩_{λ₂}`, so the edge lift of the dual forward policy *is* the adjoint.

decls.name: disint
decls.statement: noncomputable def disint (mu : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **disintegration** `π_→^μ` of an edge flow: `π_→^μ(s → s') = μ(s,s')/F(s)` with `F = m₁μ` (`proofs.tex:525`).

decls.name: marg₁_mul_disint
decls.statement: theorem marg₁_mul_disint {mu : V → V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ mu s s') (s s' : V) : marg₁ mu s * disint mu s s' = mu s s'
decls.doc: **The disintegration reassembles, everywhere**: `F(s) · π_→^μ(s → s') = μ(s,s')` for every `(s,s')`, with no positivity hypothesis on `F`.

decls.name: DetailedBalance
decls.statement: def DetailedBalance (pb : V → V → ℝ) (F : V → ℝ) (pf : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **Detailed balance of `(F, π_→)` with respect to `π_←`** (`proofs.tex:530`): `F(s) π_→(s → s') = F(s') π_←(s' → s)` at every pair.

decls.name: db_lift_ratio
decls.statement: theorem db_lift_ratio {pb : V → V → ℝ} {mu : V → V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ mu s s') (s s' : V) : pushEdge pb mu s s' / mu s s' = marg₁ mu s' * pb s' s / (marg₁ mu s * disint mu s s')
decls.doc: **`prop:db_lift`, the ratio identity** (`proofs.tex:534`): the lifted balance ratio `d(μK₂)/dμ` *is* the detailed-balance edge ratio F(s') π_←(s' → s) / (F(s) π_→^μ(s → s')).

decls.name: db_lift_loss
decls.statement: theorem db_lift_loss {pb : V → V → ℝ} {mu : V → V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ mu s s') (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nu : V → V → ℝ) : ∑ s, ∑ s', nu s s' * g (pushEdge pb mu s s' / mu s s') = ∑ s, ∑ s', nu s s' * g (marg₁ mu s' * pb s' s / (marg₁ mu s * disint mu s s'))
decls.doc: **`prop:db_lift`, the loss identity** (`proofs.tex:526–529`): for **any** `g` and any training distribution `ν̂` on `𝒮²`, ∫ g(d(μK₂)/dμ) dν̂ = ∫ g( F(ds')π_←(s'→ds) / (F(ds)π_→^μ(s→ds')) ) dν̂, the `g`-divergence detailed-balance loss with frozen backward policy.

decls.name: db_lift_iff
decls.statement: theorem db_lift_iff {pb : V → V → ℝ} {mu : V → V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ mu s s') : pushEdge pb mu = mu ↔ DetailedBalance pb (marg₁ mu) (disint mu)
decls.doc: **`prop:db_lift`, the "in particular"** (`proofs.tex:530`): `μK₂ = μ` if and only if `(F, π_→^μ)` satisfies detailed balance with respect to `π_←`.

decls.name: l2sq
decls.statement: def l2sq (w f : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `‖f‖²_{L²(λ)} = ∑_x λ(x) f(x)²`, the finite-space reading of the paper's `L²(λ)` norm.

decls.name: l2sq₂
decls.statement: def l2sq₂ (w f : V → V → ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: l2norm
decls.statement: noncomputable def l2norm (w f : V → ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: l2norm₂
decls.statement: noncomputable def l2norm₂ (w f : V → V → ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: sq_sum_le_sum_sq
decls.statement: theorem sq_sum_le_sum_sq {p φ : V → ℝ} (hp : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∑ z, p z = 1) : (∑ z, p z * φ z) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ z, p z * φ z ^ 2
decls.doc: **Jensen against a probability weight**: `(∑ p φ)² ≤ ∑ p φ²` when `p ≥ 0` and `∑ p = 1`.

decls.name: condFwd
decls.statement: def condFwd (pf : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **forward** conditional expectation `(E f)(x) = ∫ f(x,w) π_→^λ(x → dw)`, the average of `f` over the second coordinate given the first, under `λ₂`.

decls.name: marg₁_smul_edgeMeasure
decls.statement: theorem marg₁_smul_edgeMeasure {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (f : V → V → ℝ) (x : V) : marg₁ (fun s s' => f s s' * edgeMeasure pb lam s s') x = lam x * condFwd pf f x
decls.doc: `d(m₁(f λ₂))/dλ = E f` — the first marginal of the measure with `λ₂`-density `f` is `λ · (E f)`, the average of `f` against the **forward** conditional.

decls.name: pushEdge_density
decls.statement: theorem pushEdge_density {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (f : V → V → ℝ) (s s' : V) : pushEdge pb (fun a b => f a b * edgeMeasure pb lam a b) s s' = edgeMeasure pb lam s s' * condFwd pf f s'
decls.doc: **The `λ₂`-density action of `K₂`**: if `μ = f λ₂` then `μK₂ = ((s,s') ↦ (E f)(s')) λ₂`.

decls.name: l2sq_condFwd_le
decls.statement: theorem l2sq_condFwd_le {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hpfnn : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ pf u v) (hpfrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2sq lam (condFwd pf f) ≤ l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) f
decls.doc: **Jensen for the forward conditional**: `‖E f‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ‖f‖_{L²(λ₂)}`, squared.

decls.name: edgeDensAct_contraction
decls.statement: theorem edgeDensAct_contraction {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hpfnn : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ pf u v) (hpfrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (fun _ s' => condFwd pf f s') ≤ l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) f
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the contraction** (`proofs.tex:512`, proved at `proofs.tex:521`): `‖μK₂‖_{𝓜²(λ₂)} ≤ ‖μ‖_{𝓜²(λ₂)}`, read on `λ₂`-densities and squared.

decls.name: edgeDensAct_contraction_norm
decls.statement: theorem edgeDensAct_contraction_norm {pb pf : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hpfnn : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ pf u v) (hpfrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hpf : ∀ u v, lam u * pf u v = lam v * pb v u) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (fun _ s' => condFwd pf f s') ≤ l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) f
decls.doc: The contraction in norm form: `‖K₂ f‖_{L²(λ₂)} ≤ ‖f‖_{L²(λ₂)}`.

decls.name: condBack
decls.statement: def condBack (pb : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **backward** conditional `g_f(x) := ∫ f(z,x) π_←(x → dz)` of `proofs.tex:555`.

decls.name: funActEdge_eq_condBack
decls.statement: theorem funActEdge_eq_condBack (pb : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : funActEdge pb f = fun s _ => condBack pb f s
decls.doc: `(K₂ f)(s,s') = g_f(s)`, the `n = 1` case of `proofs.tex:555`.

decls.name: funActEdge_iterate
decls.statement: theorem funActEdge_iterate (pb : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : (funActEdge pb)^[m + 1] f = fun s _ => (funAct pb)^[m] (condBack pb f) s
decls.doc: **`(K₂^n f)(s,s') = (P^{n−1} g_f)(s)`** (`proofs.tex:555`), where `P` is the function action of `π_←` — `GFNBounds.Balance.funAct`, reused from `MassIdentity`.

decls.name: edgeMean
decls.statement: def edgeMean (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `Π₂ f = ∫ g_f dλ` (`proofs.tex:555`), the mean projection of `L²(λ₂)`.

decls.name: edgeMean_eq_integral
decls.statement: theorem edgeMean_eq_integral (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : edgeMean pb lam f = ∑ s, ∑ s', edgeMeasure pb lam s s' * f s s'
decls.doc: `Π₂ f = ∫ f dλ₂`: the paper's `∫ g_f dλ` really is the mean of `f` against the edge measure.

decls.name: l2sq₂_of_fst
decls.statement: theorem l2sq₂_of_fst {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant pb lam) (G : V → ℝ) : l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (fun s _ => G s) = l2sq lam G
decls.doc: A function of the **first** coordinate has the same `L²(λ₂)` norm as its `L²(λ)` norm: the first marginal of `λ₂` is `λ` (`marg₁_edgeMeasure`, which is where invariance enters).

decls.name: l2sq_condBack_le
decls.statement: theorem l2sq_condBack_le {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2sq lam (condBack pb f) ≤ l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) f
decls.doc: **Jensen for the backward conditional** (`proofs.tex:555`): `‖g_f‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ‖f‖_{L²(λ₂)}`, squared.

decls.name: edgeDeviation
decls.statement: noncomputable def edgeDeviation (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: `K₂^n − Π₂` on `L²(λ₂)`, whose operator norm is the paper's `β̂_n`.

decls.name: deviation
decls.statement: noncomputable def deviation (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: `P^n − Π` on `L²(λ)`, whose operator norm is the paper's `β_n`.

decls.name: lift_mixing
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) {n : ℕ} (hbeta : ∀ g : V → ℝ, l2norm lam (deviation pb lam n g) ≤ b * l2norm lam g) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (edgeDeviation pb lam (n + 1) f) ≤ b * l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) f
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing`** (`proofs.tex:550–551`, proof `proofs.tex:554–561`), as the transfer of bounds it is: > every `b ≥ 0` with `‖(P^n − Π) g‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ b ‖g‖_{L²(λ)}` for all `g` also satisfies > `‖(K₂^{n+1} − Π₂) f‖_{L²(λ₂)} ≤ b ‖f‖_{L²(λ₂)}` for all `f`, which read on the least such `b` is `β̂_{n+1} ≤ β_n`, i.e.

decls.name: OpBound
decls.statement: def OpBound (w : V → ℝ) (A : (V → ℝ) → (V → ℝ)) (b : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `b` is an operator-norm bound for `A` on `L²(λ)`.

decls.name: OpBound₂
decls.statement: def OpBound₂ (w : V → V → ℝ) (A : (V → V → ℝ) → (V → V → ℝ)) (b : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `b` is an operator-norm bound for `A` on `L²(λ₂)`.

decls.name: opNorm
decls.statement: noncomputable def opNorm (w : V → ℝ) (A : (V → ℝ) → (V → ℝ)) : ℝ
decls.doc: The operator norm on `L²(λ)`, as the infimum of the bounds.

decls.name: opNorm₂
decls.statement: noncomputable def opNorm₂ (w : V → V → ℝ) (A : (V → V → ℝ) → (V → V → ℝ)) : ℝ
decls.doc: The operator norm on `L²(λ₂)`, as the infimum of the bounds — the paper's `β̂_n` at `A = K₂^n − Π₂`.

decls.name: bddBelow_opBound₂
decls.statement: theorem bddBelow_opBound₂ (w : V → V → ℝ) (A : (V → V → ℝ) → (V → V → ℝ)) : BddBelow {b | OpBound₂ w A b}
decls.doc: The set of bounds is bounded below by `0`, which is all `csInf_le` needs.

decls.name: lift_mixing_opNorm
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_opNorm {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hbeta : OpBound lam (deviation pb lam n) b) : opNorm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (edgeDeviation pb lam (n + 1)) ≤ b
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing` on the operator norm**: `β̂_{n+1} ≤ b` for every bound `b` of `P^n − Π`.

decls.name: lift_mixing_opNorm_le
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_opNorm_le {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) {n : ℕ} (hattained : OpBound lam (deviation pb lam n) (opNorm lam (deviation pb lam n))) : opNorm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (edgeDeviation pb lam (n + 1)) ≤ opNorm lam (deviation pb lam n)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing`, the `≤` half** (the paper now states the equality, proved with no `hattained` in `LiftFinite.lean` as `lift_mixing_dens`): `β̂_{n+1} ≤ β_n`, i.e.

decls.name: lam_mul_reversal
decls.statement: theorem lam_mul_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (u v : V) : lam u * B.reversal lam u v = lam v * B.phat v u
decls.doc: **`Graph.Universality.reversal` is the paper's dual forward policy**: `λ ⊗ π_→^λ = π_← ⊗ λ` in coordinates, `λ(u)·π_→^λ(u → v) = λ(v)·π̂_←(v → u)`.

decls.name: pushEdge_edgeMeasure_graph
decls.statement: theorem pushEdge_edgeMeasure_graph {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) : pushEdge B.phat (edgeMeasure B.phat lam) = edgeMeasure B.phat lam
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, invariance, on a marked graph.**

decls.name: edgeKernel_dual_graph
decls.statement: theorem edgeKernel_dual_graph (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (s s' z w : V) : edgeMeasure B.phat lam s s' * edgeKernel B.phat s s' z w = edgeMeasure B.phat lam z w * dualEdgeKernel (B.reversal lam) z w s s'
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the duality identity, on a marked graph**, with the dual kernel built from `Graph.Universality.reversal`.

decls.name: inner_funActEdge_graph
decls.statement: theorem inner_funActEdge_graph (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (f g : V → V → ℝ) : ∑ s, ∑ s', edgeMeasure B.phat lam s s' * funActEdge B.phat f s s' * g s s' = ∑ s, ∑ s', edgeMeasure B.phat lam s s' * f s s' * dualFunActEdge (B.reversal lam) g s s'
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the adjoint, on a marked graph**: the edge lift of the `λ`-reversal is the `L²(λ₂)`-adjoint of `K₂`.

decls.name: edgeDensAct_contraction_graph
decls.statement: theorem edgeDensAct_contraction_graph (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure B.phat lam) (fun _ s' => condFwd (B.reversal lam) f s') ≤ l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure B.phat lam) f
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_wellposed`, the contraction, on a marked graph.** The three properties of the reversal it needs — non-negativity, row sums `1`, and the defining identity — are `reversal_nonneg`, `sum_reversal` and `lam_mul_reversal`; none is rebuilt.

decls.name: db_lift_iff_graph
decls.statement: theorem db_lift_iff_graph {mu : V → V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ mu s s') : pushEdge B.phat mu = mu ↔ DetailedBalance B.phat (marg₁ mu) (disint mu)
decls.doc: **`prop:db_lift`, the "in particular", on a marked graph**: an edge flow is `K₂`-invariant exactly when its first marginal and its disintegration are in detailed balance with the frozen backward policy.

decls.name: lift_mixing_graph
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_graph {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) {n : ℕ} (hbeta : ∀ g : V → ℝ, l2norm lam (deviation B.phat lam n g) ≤ b * l2norm lam g) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure B.phat lam) (edgeDeviation B.phat lam (n + 1) f) ≤ b * l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure B.phat lam) f
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing` on a marked graph.**

files.title: The edge lift transfers mixing and coercivity: `β̂_n = β_{n−1}`, and `C` lifts to `1 + C`
variables: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {p : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p]

decls.name: l2norm_eq_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem l2norm_eq_nrmL2 (w f : α → ℝ) : l2norm w f = Graph.nrmL2 w f
decls.doc: `Lift.l2norm` is `Graph.nrmL2`: the two spellings of `‖·‖_{L²(w)}` agree.

decls.name: opBound_opNorm
decls.statement: theorem opBound_opNorm {w : α → ℝ} {A : (α → ℝ) → (α → ℝ)} (hne : ∃ b, OpBound w A b) : OpBound w A (opNorm w A)
decls.doc: **The operator norm is attained in finite dimension**: if `A` has some bound on `L²(w)`, then `opNorm w A`, the infimum of its bounds, is itself a bound.

decls.name: opBound_of_adjoint
decls.statement: theorem opBound_of_adjoint {w : α → ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) {A B : (α → ℝ) → (α → ℝ)} (hadj : ∀ u v, Graph.ipL2 w (A u) v = Graph.ipL2 w u (B v)) {b : ℝ} (hb : OpBound w B b) : OpBound w A b
decls.doc: **A bound of an adjoint is a bound**: if `⟪Au, v⟫_w = ⟪u, Bv⟫_w` for all `u, v`, every bound of `B` on `L²(w)` bounds `A`.

decls.name: opNorm_eq_of_adjoint
decls.statement: theorem opNorm_eq_of_adjoint {w : α → ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) {A B : (α → ℝ) → (α → ℝ)} (hadj : ∀ u v, Graph.ipL2 w (A u) v = Graph.ipL2 w u (B v)) : opNorm w A = opNorm w B
decls.doc: **Adjoint operators have the same operator norm** on a weighted finite `L²` — the step "`β_n` and `β̂_n` are also the norms of the function actions" of `proofs.tex:565`, with no spectral theorem: the two sets of bounds coincide.

decls.name: densDeviation
decls.statement: noncomputable def densDeviation (K : α → α → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : α → ℝ) : α → ℝ
decls.doc: The **density-action deviation** `P^n − Π` on `L²(w)`, with `P = Core.densAct w K` the action `u ↦ d((uw)K)/dw` — the operator whose norm is the paper's mixing coefficient (`lem:lift_mixing`, "`β_n := ‖π_←^n − Π‖_{L²(λ)}` […] of the density actions").

decls.name: densDeviation_eq
decls.statement: theorem densDeviation_eq (K : α → α → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : α → ℝ) : densDeviation K w n u = fun y => (Core.densAct w K)^[n] u y - ∑ x, w x * u x
decls.doc: The unapplied form of `densDeviation` (kb `0021`).

decls.name: densDeviation_apply_eq
decls.statement: theorem densDeviation_apply_eq (K : α → α → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : α → ℝ) (y : α) : densDeviation K w n u y = (Core.densAct w K)^[n] u y - ∑ x, w x * u x

decls.name: deviation_eq
decls.statement: theorem deviation_eq (K : α → α → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : α → ℝ) : deviation K w n g = fun x => (funAct K)^[n] g x - ∑ y, w y * g y
decls.doc: The unapplied form of `Lift.deviation` (kb `0021`).

decls.name: ipL2_densAct_iterate
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_densAct_iterate {K : α → α → ℝ} {w : α → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant w K) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (n : ℕ) (u v : α → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 w ((Core.densAct w K)^[n] u) v = Graph.ipL2 w u ((funAct K)^[n] v)
decls.doc: `⟪P^n u, v⟫_w = ⟪u, (P†)^n v⟫_w`: `Core.ipL2_densAct_funAct` iterated.

decls.name: ipL2_sub_const_left
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_sub_const_left (w a b : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 w (fun x => a x - c) b = Graph.ipL2 w a b - c * ∑ x, w x * b x
decls.doc: `⟪a − c, b⟫_w = ⟪a, b⟫_w − c·∫b dw`.

decls.name: ipL2_densDeviation
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_densDeviation {K : α → α → ℝ} {w : α → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant w K) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (n : ℕ) (u v : α → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 w (densDeviation K w n u) v = Graph.ipL2 w u (deviation K w n v)
decls.doc: **The density deviation is the `L²(w)`-adjoint of the function deviation**: `⟪(P^n − Π)u, v⟫_w = ⟪u, ((P†)^n − Π)v⟫_w`.

decls.name: opNorm_densDeviation
decls.statement: theorem opNorm_densDeviation {K : α → α → ℝ} {w : α → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant w K) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (n : ℕ) : opNorm w (densDeviation K w n) = opNorm w (deviation K w n)
decls.doc: **`β_n` read on the density action equals `β_n` read on the function action**, on any finite `L²(w)` with `w` a non-negative `K`-invariant weight: `‖P^n − Π‖ = ‖(P†)^n − Π‖`.

decls.name: nrmL2_funAct_iterate_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_funAct_iterate_le {K : α → α → ℝ} {w : α → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn w K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant w K) (n : ℕ) (g : α → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 w ((funAct K)^[n] g) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 w g
decls.doc: `‖(P†)^n g‖ ≤ ‖g‖`: the function action iterated is still a contraction.

decls.name: opBound_deviation_two
decls.statement: theorem opBound_deviation_two {K : α → α → ℝ} {w : α → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn w K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant w K) (htot : ∑ x, w x = 1) (n : ℕ) : OpBound w (deviation K w n) 2
decls.doc: **`2` bounds `(P†)^n − Π`** on `L²(w)` for a `w`-a.e.

decls.name: condBack_snd
decls.statement: theorem condBack_snd {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (φ : V → ℝ) : condBack pb (fun _ s' => φ s') = φ
decls.doc: `g_f = φ` for `f(z,s') := φ(s')` (`proofs.tex:569`: "`g_f = φ`, `π_←(s' → ·)` being a probability").

decls.name: l2sq₂_of_snd
decls.statement: theorem l2sq₂_of_snd {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (φ : V → ℝ) : l2sq₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (fun _ s' => φ s') = l2sq lam φ
decls.doc: `‖f‖_{L²(λ₂)} = ‖φ‖_{L²(λ)}` for `f(z,s') := φ(s')` (`proofs.tex:569`: "the second marginal of `λ₂` being `λ`").

decls.name: edgeDeviation_succ
decls.statement: theorem edgeDeviation_succ (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : edgeDeviation pb lam (n + 1) f = fun s _ => deviation pb lam n (condBack pb f) s
decls.doc: `K₂^{n+1} − Π₂` applied to `f` is `P^n − Π` applied to `g_f`, read at the first coordinate (`eq:lift_mixing_identity` before the norms are taken).

decls.name: lift_mixing_ge
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_ge {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hb : OpBound₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (edgeDeviation pb lam (n + 1)) b) : OpBound lam (deviation pb lam n) b
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing`, the `≥` half** (`proofs.tex:569`, "Conversely, …"): every bound of `K₂^{n+1} − Π₂` on `L²(λ₂)` is a bound of `P^n − Π` on `L²(λ)`, tested on `f(z,s') := φ(s')`.

decls.name: lift_mixing_opNorm_eq
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_opNorm_eq {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (n : ℕ) : opNorm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (edgeDeviation pb lam (n + 1)) = opNorm lam (deviation pb lam n)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing` on the function actions, as an equality**: `β̂_{n+1} = β_n`, i.e.

decls.name: pairKernel
decls.statement: def pairKernel (pb : V → V → ℝ) (p q : V × V) : ℝ
decls.doc: `K₂` on pairs: `K₂(p → q) = edgeKernel pb p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2`.

decls.name: pairMeasure
decls.statement: def pairMeasure (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (p : V × V) : ℝ
decls.doc: `λ₂` on pairs: `λ₂(p) = π_←(p.2 → p.1)·λ(p.2)`.

decls.name: pairKernel_isMarkov
decls.statement: theorem pairKernel_isMarkov {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) : Core.IsMarkov (pairKernel pb)
decls.doc: `K₂` is a Markov kernel on `V × V`.

decls.name: pairMeasure_isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem pairMeasure_isInvariant {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) : Core.IsInvariant (pairMeasure pb lam) (pairKernel pb)
decls.doc: **`λ₂` is `K₂`-invariant, on pairs** (`lem:lift_wellposed`'s invariance, `Lift.pushEdge_edgeMeasure` uncurried): `λ₂` is a non-negative `K₂`-invariant measure on `V × V`.

decls.name: pairMeasure_total
decls.statement: theorem pairMeasure_total {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : ∑ p, pairMeasure pb lam p = 1
decls.doc: `λ₂` is a probability on `V × V`.

decls.name: funAct_pairKernel
decls.statement: theorem funAct_pairKernel (pb : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : funAct (pairKernel pb) (Function.uncurry f) = Function.uncurry (funActEdge pb f)
decls.doc: `K₂`'s function action commutes with uncurrying.

decls.name: funAct_pairKernel_iterate
decls.statement: theorem funAct_pairKernel_iterate (pb : V → V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : (funAct (pairKernel pb))^[n] (Function.uncurry f) = Function.uncurry ((funActEdge pb)^[n] f)
decls.doc: … and so do its iterates.

decls.name: deviation_pair
decls.statement: theorem deviation_pair (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : deviation (pairKernel pb) (pairMeasure pb lam) n (Function.uncurry f) = Function.uncurry (edgeDeviation pb lam n f)
decls.doc: The function deviation of `K₂` on pairs is `edgeDeviation`, uncurried.

decls.name: l2norm_pair
decls.statement: theorem l2norm_pair (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) : l2norm (pairMeasure pb lam) (Function.uncurry f) = l2norm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) f
decls.doc: `‖f‖_{L²(λ₂)}` curried or uncurried.

decls.name: opNorm_pair
decls.statement: theorem opNorm_pair (pb : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : opNorm (pairMeasure pb lam) (deviation (pairKernel pb) (pairMeasure pb lam) n) = opNorm₂ (edgeMeasure pb lam) (edgeDeviation pb lam n)
decls.doc: `β̂_n` curried (`opNorm₂` of `Lift.lean`) is `β̂_n` uncurried.

decls.name: lift_mixing_dens
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_dens {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (n : ℕ) : opNorm (pairMeasure pb lam) (densDeviation (pairKernel pb) (pairMeasure pb lam) (n + 1)) = opNorm lam (densDeviation pb lam n)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing`** (`proofs.tex:560–562`, proof `proofs.tex:564–570`) **as the paper states it**, on a finite state space: with `β_n := ‖π_←^n − Π‖_{L²(λ)}` and `β̂_n := ‖K₂^n − Π₂‖_{L²(λ₂)}` the operator norms of the **density actions**, `β̂_n = β_{n−1}` for every `n ≥ 1` (written `n + 1`, `n`).

decls.name: condFwdPair
decls.statement: def condFwdPair (pf : V → V → ℝ) (h : V × V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The paper's `k_h(s) := ∫ h(s,z) π_→^λ(s → dz)` (`proofs.tex:580`), for `h` a function on pairs and `pf` the dual forward policy.

decls.name: pairMeasure_eq_reversal
decls.statement: theorem pairMeasure_eq_reversal {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (s z : V) : pairMeasure pb lam (s, z) = lam s * Core.reversal lam pb s z
decls.doc: `λ₂(s,z) = λ(s)·π_→^λ(s → z)` (`proofs.tex:580`, "`λ₂(ds dz) = λ(ds)π_→^λ(s → dz)`"), for the `λ`-reversal `π_→^λ = Core.reversal lam pb`.

decls.name: densAct_pair
decls.statement: theorem densAct_pair {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (h : V × V → ℝ) {q : V × V} (hq : pairMeasure pb lam q ≠ 0) : Core.densAct (pairMeasure pb lam) (pairKernel pb) h q = condFwdPair (Core.reversal lam pb) h q.2
decls.doc: **`P₂h = k_h ∘ pr₂`** (`proofs.tex:580`, from `eq:muK2_density`): the density action of `K₂` against `λ₂` at every pair carrying `λ₂`-mass.

decls.name: meanL2_pair
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_pair {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (h : V × V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 (pairMeasure pb lam) h = Graph.meanL2 lam (condFwdPair (Core.reversal lam pb) h)
decls.doc: **`Π₂h = Πk_h`** (`proofs.tex:580`, "`∫k_h dλ = ∫h dλ₂`").

decls.name: nrmL2_condFwdPair_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_condFwdPair_le {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (h : V × V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (condFwdPair (Core.reversal lam pb) h) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure pb lam) h
decls.doc: **Jensen, `‖k_h‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ‖h‖_{L²(λ₂)}`** (`proofs.tex:580`), against the probability measures `π_→^λ(s → ·)` — which the reversal is at every `s` carrying `λ`-mass.

decls.name: nrmL2_pair_snd
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_pair_snd {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (φ : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure pb lam) (fun q => φ q.2) = Graph.nrmL2 lam φ
decls.doc: `‖φ ∘ pr₂‖_{L²(λ₂)} = ‖φ‖_{L²(λ)}` (`proofs.tex:585`, "the second marginal of `λ₂` being `λ`").

decls.name: Aop_condFwdPair
decls.statement: theorem Aop_condFwdPair {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (h : V × V → ℝ) {s : V} (hs : lam s ≠ 0) : Aop pb lam (condFwdPair (Core.reversal lam pb) h) s = condFwdPair (Core.reversal lam pb) (Aop (pairKernel pb) (pairMeasure pb lam) h) s
decls.doc: **`k_v = (I − P)k_h` for `v := (I − P₂)h`**, in the library's sign convention `Aop K w h = Ph − h`: `A k_h = k_{A₂ h}` at every state carrying `λ`-mass (`proofs.tex:582`).

decls.name: lift_coercivity_finite
decls.statement: theorem lift_coercivity_finite {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hpb : Core.IsMarkov pb) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hcoer : ∀ φ : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam φ) ≤ C * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop pb lam φ)) (h : V × V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure pb lam) (perpL2 (pairMeasure pb lam) h) ≤ (1 + C) * Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure pb lam) (Aop (pairKernel pb) (pairMeasure pb lam) h)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_coercivity`** (`proofs.tex:572–577`, proof `proofs.tex:579–587`) on a finite state space: if `C ≥ 0` satisfies `‖φ − Πφ‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ C‖(I − P)φ‖_{L²(λ)}` for every `φ`, then `‖h − Π₂h‖_{L²(λ₂)} ≤ (1 + C)‖(I − P₂)h‖_{L²(λ₂)}` for every `h`, where `P` and `P₂` are the density actions of `π_←` against `λ` and of its edge lift `K₂` against `λ₂`.

decls.name: extSupp
decls.statement: noncomputable def extSupp (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : α → ℝ
decls.doc: Extension by `0` of a function on `{a // p a}`.

decls.name: extSupp_val
decls.statement: theorem extSupp_val (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) (e : {a // p a}) : extSupp f e.1 = f e

decls.name: sum_subtype_of_vanish
decls.statement: theorem sum_subtype_of_vanish (g : α → ℝ) (hg : ∀ a, ¬ p a → g a = 0) : ∑ e : {a // p a}, g e.1 = ∑ a, g a
decls.doc: A sum over `{a // p a}` of a function vanishing off `p` is the sum over `α`.

decls.name: nrmL2_restrict
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (G : α → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (fun e : {a // p a} => w e.1) (fun e => G e.1) = Graph.nrmL2 w G
decls.doc: `‖G ∘ val‖_{L²(w ∘ val)} = ‖G‖_{L²(w)}` when `w` vanishes off `p`.

decls.name: perpL2_restrict
decls.statement: theorem perpL2_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : perpL2 (fun e : {a // p a} => w e.1) f = fun e => perpL2 w (extSupp f) e.1
decls.doc: `h − Πh` restricts.

decls.name: Aop_restrict
decls.statement: theorem Aop_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (K : α → α → ℝ) (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : Aop (fun e e' : {a // p a} => K e.1 e'.1) (fun e => w e.1) f = fun e => Aop K w (extSupp f) e.1
decls.doc: `(P − I)h` restricts, the kernel read on the subtype.

decls.name: coercive_restrict
decls.statement: theorem coercive_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) {K : α → α → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hco : ∀ h : α → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 w (perpL2 w h) ≤ c * Graph.nrmL2 w (Aop K w h)) (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (fun e : {a // p a} => w e.1) (perpL2 (fun e => w e.1) f) ≤ c * Graph.nrmL2 (fun e => w e.1) (Aop (fun e e' : {a // p a} => K e.1 e'.1) (fun e => w e.1) f)
decls.doc: **Coercivity restricts to the support**, with the same constant.

decls.name: pairMeasure_eq_zero_off
decls.statement: theorem pairMeasure_eq_zero_off {pb : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (lam : V → ℝ) (q : V × V) (hq : ¬ 0 < pb q.2 q.1) : pairMeasure pb lam q = 0
decls.doc: `λ₂` vanishes off the edge set.

decls.name: lift_coercivity_edgeSupport
decls.statement: theorem lift_coercivity_edgeSupport {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hpb : Core.IsMarkov pb) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hcoer : ∀ φ : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam φ) ≤ C * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop pb lam φ)) (f : {q : V × V // 0 < pb q.2 q.1} → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (fun e : {q : V × V // 0 < pb q.2 q.1} => pairMeasure pb lam e.1) (perpL2 (fun e => pairMeasure pb lam e.1) f) ≤ (1 + C) * Graph.nrmL2 (fun e => pairMeasure pb lam e.1) (Aop (fun e e' : {q : V × V // 0 < pb q.2 q.1} => pairKernel pb e.1 e'.1) (fun e => pairMeasure pb lam e.1) f)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_coercivity` on the edge set `E = {(s,s') : π_←(s' → s) > 0}`**, the setting of the DB instance (`proofs.tex:666–668`): `K₂` and `λ₂` read on `E` — definitionally the objects `fun e => edgeMeasure pb lam e.1.1 e.1.2` and `fun e e' => edgeKernel pb e.1.1 e.1.2 e'.1.1 e'.1.2`.

decls.name: lift_coercivity_graph
decls.statement: theorem lift_coercivity_graph {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH : V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (h : V × V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure B.phat lam) (perpL2 (pairMeasure B.phat lam) h) ≤ (1 + BhatSigma G uH lam) * Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure B.phat lam) (Aop (pairKernel B.phat) (pairMeasure B.phat lam) h)
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_coercivity` on the loop closure of a finite marked graph, at `C := B̂_σ`** — the coercivity part of the detailed-balance half of `prop:morozov_rate`*(3)* (`proofs.tex:969`): `1 + B̂_σ` is a coercivity constant of `K₂` on `L²(λ₂)` over `V × V`, the hypothesis for `π̂_←` being `hcoer_of_graph`.

decls.name: twoStateK_isMarkov
decls.statement: theorem twoStateK_isMarkov : Core.IsMarkov twoStateK
decls.doc: `twoStateK` (uniform `1/2`) is a Markov kernel.

decls.name: twoStateLam_isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem twoStateLam_isInvariant : Core.IsInvariant twoStateLam twoStateK
decls.doc: `twoStateLam` is a non-negative `twoStateK`-invariant measure.

decls.name: lift_coercivity_twoState
decls.statement: theorem lift_coercivity_twoState (h : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure twoStateK twoStateLam) (perpL2 (pairMeasure twoStateK twoStateLam) h) ≤ (1 + 1) * Graph.nrmL2 (pairMeasure twoStateK twoStateLam) (Aop (pairKernel twoStateK) (pairMeasure twoStateK twoStateLam) h)
decls.doc: **`lift_coercivity_finite`'s hypotheses are inhabited, non-trivially**: on the uniform chain on two states, `C = 1` is a coercivity constant (`LocalEnergy.twoState_coercivity`, attained), and the lemma yields `2` for the edge lift on the four pairs.

decls.name: densOp_pow_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem densOp_pow_wtL2 {lam : α → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (K : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : α → ℝ) : (densOp lam K ^ n) (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam ((Core.densAct lam K)^[n] a)
decls.doc: `P^n` conjugated by the weighting.

decls.name: densDeviation_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem densDeviation_wtL2 {lam : α → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (K : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : α → ℝ) : (densOp lam K ^ n - meanOp lam) (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (densDeviation K lam n a)
decls.doc: `P^n − Π` conjugated by the weighting is `densDeviation`.

decls.name: opNorm_eq_norm
decls.statement: theorem opNorm_eq_norm {lam : α → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {A : (α → ℝ) → (α → ℝ)} {T : EuclideanSpace ℝ α →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ α} (hT : ∀ a, T (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (A a)) : opNorm lam A = ‖T‖
decls.doc: `opNorm` is the Mathlib operator norm of the conjugated operator: both are the infimum of the same set of bounds, `wtL2` being a norm-preserving bijection.

decls.name: opNorm_densDeviation_eq_beta
decls.statement: theorem opNorm_densDeviation_eq_beta {lam : α → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (K : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : opNorm lam (densDeviation K lam n) = Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n
decls.doc: **`opNorm` of the density deviation is `Core.Mixing.beta`**, on a positive weight.

decls.name: densAct_congr_supp
decls.statement: theorem densAct_congr_supp {w : α → ℝ} (K : α → α → ℝ) {u u' : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, w x ≠ 0 → u x = u' x) : Core.densAct w K u = Core.densAct w K u'
decls.doc: A kernel's density action does not see a change of its argument off the support of the weight (`w x = 0` kills the term).

decls.name: densAct_iterate_congr_supp
decls.statement: theorem densAct_iterate_congr_supp {w : α → ℝ} (K : α → α → ℝ) {u u' : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, w x ≠ 0 → u x = u' x) (n : ℕ) : ∀ x, w x ≠ 0 → (Core.densAct w K)^[n] u x = (Core.densAct w K)^[n] u' x
decls.doc: … and its iterates agree on the support.

decls.name: densAct_restrict
decls.statement: theorem densAct_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (K : α → α → ℝ) (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : Core.densAct (fun e : {a // p a} => w e.1) (fun e e' => K e.1 e'.1) f = fun e => Core.densAct w K (extSupp f) e.1
decls.doc: The density action restricts to the support.

decls.name: densAct_iterate_restrict
decls.statement: theorem densAct_iterate_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (K : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : (Core.densAct (fun e : {a // p a} => w e.1) (fun e e' => K e.1 e'.1))^[n] f = fun e => (Core.densAct w K)^[n] (extSupp f) e.1
decls.doc: … and so do its iterates, read on the support.

decls.name: densDeviation_restrict
decls.statement: theorem densDeviation_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (K : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : {a // p a} → ℝ) : densDeviation (fun e e' : {a // p a} => K e.1 e'.1) (fun e => w e.1) n f = fun e => densDeviation K w n (extSupp f) e.1
decls.doc: The density deviation restricts to the support.

decls.name: opNorm_densDeviation_restrict
decls.statement: theorem opNorm_densDeviation_restrict {w : α → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ a, ¬ p a → w a = 0) (K : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : opNorm (fun e : {a // p a} => w e.1) (densDeviation (fun e e' => K e.1 e'.1) (fun e => w e.1) n) = opNorm w (densDeviation K w n)
decls.doc: **`β_n` is unchanged by restriction to the support of the weight.**

decls.name: lift_mixing_beta
decls.statement: theorem lift_mixing_beta {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ pb x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, pb x y = 1) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hinv : Invariant pb lam) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (n : ℕ) : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp (fun e : {q : V × V // 0 < pb q.2 q.1} => pairMeasure pb lam e.1) (fun e e' => pairKernel pb e.1 e'.1)) (meanOp (fun e : {q : V × V // 0 < pb q.2 q.1} => pairMeasure pb lam e.1)) (n + 1) = Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam pb) (meanOp lam) n
decls.doc: **`lem:lift_mixing` in the norm `Core.Mixing` sums**: for `λ > 0`, on the edge set `E = {(s,s') : π_←(s' → s) > 0}` where `λ₂ > 0`, `β̂_{n+1} = ‖P₂^{n+1} − Π₂‖ = ‖P^n − Π‖ = β_n` as operator norms on `EuclideanSpace`, `P`, `P₂` the density actions conjugated by the weighting (`WeightedL2.densOp`).

decls.name: twoState_lift_beta_one
decls.statement: theorem twoState_lift_beta_one : opNorm (pairMeasure twoStateK twoStateLam) (densDeviation (pairKernel twoStateK) (pairMeasure twoStateK twoStateLam) 1) = 1
decls.doc: **`lift_mixing_dens` at `n = 0` on the two-state chain**: `β̂₁ = β₀ = 1`, the right-hand side being `WeightedL2Norm.twoState_beta_zero` read back through `opNorm_densDeviation_eq_beta`.

files.title: Steps 4 and 5 of the local convergence theorem, and its gradient-descent clause

decls.name: Cinf
decls.statement: noncomputable def Cinf (lamMin : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`C_∞ := (min λ)^{−1/2}`** (`proofs.tex:613`), with `λ_min` a parameter.

decls.name: epsW
decls.statement: noncomputable def epsW (a g2 wmin Kexp Bhat : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`ε := min(min(a,1)/4, ε₁)`** (`proofs.tex:643`), Step 4's window radius.

decls.name: eps0
decls.statement: noncomputable def eps0 (epsW Cinf C7 rhoL C6 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`ε₀ := min(ε/(2C_∞(2+C₇)), ϱ/(4C₆), 1)`** (`proofs.tex:643`), the basin radius.

decls.name: Lgd
decls.statement: noncomputable def Lgd (g2 wsup Kexp epsW : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: gamma0
decls.statement: noncomputable def gamma0 (g2 wmin Lgd : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: nonempty_of_total
decls.statement: theorem nonempty_of_total {lam : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : Nonempty V
decls.doc: The state space is non-empty as soon as `λ` is a probability.

decls.name: nrmL2_const
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_const {lam : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (c : ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun _ => c) = |c|
decls.doc: `‖c‖_{L²(λ)} = |c|` for a constant, `λ` being a probability.

decls.name: meanL2_sub_smul
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_sub_smul (lam a b : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => a x - c * b x) = Graph.meanL2 lam a - c * Graph.meanL2 lam b
decls.doc: `Π(a − cb) = Πa − cΠb`.

decls.name: perpL2_sub_smul
decls.statement: theorem perpL2_sub_smul (lam a b : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : perpL2 lam (fun x => a x - c * b x) = fun x => perpL2 lam a x - c * perpL2 lam b x

decls.name: sq_nrmL2_sub_smul
decls.statement: theorem sq_nrmL2_sub_smul {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a b : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => a x - c * b x) ^ 2 = Graph.nrmL2 lam a ^ 2 - 2 * c * Graph.ipL2 lam a b + c ^ 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam b ^ 2
decls.doc: `‖a − cb‖² = ‖a‖² − 2c⟪a∣b⟫ + c²‖b‖²`.

decls.name: ipL2_perpL2_right
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_perpL2_right {lam a : V → ℝ} (ha : Graph.meanL2 lam a = 0) (b : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam a (perpL2 lam b) = Graph.ipL2 lam a b

decls.name: one_le_Cinf
decls.statement: theorem one_le_Cinf {lam : V → ℝ} {lamMin : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : 1 ≤ Cinf lamMin
decls.doc: **`C_∞ ≥ 1`** — free, and used by Step 4 without being named: applying the sup bound to a constant gives `√λ_min ≤ 1`.

decls.name: Cinf_pos
decls.statement: theorem Cinf_pos {lamMin : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) : 0 < Cinf lamMin

decls.name: abs_le_Cinf_mul_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem abs_le_Cinf_mul_nrmL2 {lam : V → ℝ} {lamMin : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (f : V → ℝ) (x : V) : |f x| ≤ Cinf lamMin * Graph.nrmL2 lam f
decls.doc: **`‖f‖_{L^∞} ≤ C_∞‖f‖_{L²(λ)}`** (`proofs.tex:613`), the hypothesis Step 4 spends.

decls.name: abs_le_Cinf_mean_add_perp
decls.statement: theorem abs_le_Cinf_mean_add_perp {lam : V → ℝ} {lamMin : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (f : V → ℝ) (x : V) : |f x| ≤ Cinf lamMin * (|Graph.meanL2 lam f| + Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f))
decls.doc: **`‖f‖_{L^∞} ≤ C_∞(|Πf| + ‖f^⊥‖)`** — the split Step 4 reads the sup bound through.

decls.name: wsup_pos
decls.statement: theorem wsup_pos {wsup wmin wx : ℝ} (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : wmin ≤ wx) (hwsup : |wx| ≤ wsup) : 0 < wsup
decls.doc: `w_min > 0` forces `‖w‖_{L^∞} > 0`, read at one state — which a probability `λ` supplies through `nonempty_of_total`.

decls.name: Kexp_pos
decls.statement: theorem Kexp_pos {g2 a M3 wsup : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) : 0 < Kexp g2 a M3 wsup

decls.name: epsW_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem epsW_nonneg {a g2 wmin Kex Bhat : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hK0 : 0 ≤ Kex) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) : 0 ≤ epsW a g2 wmin Kex Bhat

decls.name: epsW_pos
decls.statement: theorem epsW_pos {a g2 wmin Kex Bhat : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hK0 : 0 < Kex) (hB0 : 0 < Bhat) : 0 < epsW a g2 wmin Kex Bhat

decls.name: epsW_le_window
decls.statement: theorem epsW_le_window (a g2 wmin Kex Bhat : ℝ) : epsW a g2 wmin Kex Bhat ≤ min a 1 / 4

decls.name: epsW_le_eps1
decls.statement: theorem epsW_le_eps1 (a g2 wmin Kex Bhat : ℝ) : epsW a g2 wmin Kex Bhat ≤ eps1 g2 wmin Kex Bhat

decls.name: C6_pos
decls.statement: theorem C6_pos {g2 a M3 wsup : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) : 0 < C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup

decls.name: C7_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem C7_nonneg {c6 g2 wmin : ℝ} (hc6 : 0 ≤ c6) (hgw : 0 ≤ g2 * wmin) : 0 ≤ C7 c6 g2 wmin

decls.name: rhoL_pos
decls.statement: theorem rhoL_pos {g2 wmin Bhat : ℝ} (hgw : 0 < g2 * wmin) (hB : 0 < Bhat) : 0 < rhoL g2 wmin Bhat

decls.name: eps0_le_one
decls.statement: theorem eps0_le_one (eW Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ) : eps0 eW Ci c7 rho c6 ≤ 1

decls.name: eps0_le_basin
decls.statement: theorem eps0_le_basin (eW Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ) : eps0 eW Ci c7 rho c6 ≤ eW / (2 * Ci * (2 + c7))

decls.name: eps0_le_drift
decls.statement: theorem eps0_le_drift (eW Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ) : eps0 eW Ci c7 rho c6 ≤ rho / (4 * c6)

decls.name: eps0_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem eps0_nonneg {eW Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ} (heW : 0 ≤ eW) (hCi : 0 < Ci) (hc7 : 0 ≤ c7) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hc6 : 0 ≤ c6) : 0 ≤ eps0 eW Ci c7 rho c6

decls.name: eps0_pos
decls.statement: theorem eps0_pos {eW Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ} (heW : 0 < eW) (hCi : 0 < Ci) (hc7 : 0 ≤ c7) (hrho : 0 < rho) (hc6 : 0 < c6) : 0 < eps0 eW Ci c7 rho c6

decls.name: sup_bootstrap_step
decls.statement: theorem sup_bootstrap_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin t : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) t, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) : ∀ x, |h t x| ≤ epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat / 2
decls.doc: **Step 4's inner estimate** (`proofs.tex:643`): on an interval where the window `‖h_s‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε` holds, `‖h_0‖ ≤ ε₀` gives `‖h_t‖_{L^∞} ≤ C_∞(|m_t| + ‖h_t^⊥‖) ≤ C_∞ε₀(2+C₇) ≤ ε/2`.

decls.name: sup_global
decls.statement: theorem sup_global {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, |h t x| ≤ epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat / 2
decls.doc: **Step 4** (`proofs.tex:643`): `‖h_0‖ ≤ ε₀` makes the window global — `‖h_t‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε/2` for every `t ≥ 0`, so Steps 1–3 hold on all of `ℝ₊`.

decls.name: tendsto_atTop_of_monotoneOn_Ici
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_atTop_of_monotoneOn_Ici {f : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hmono : MonotoneOn f (Set.Ici (0:ℝ))) (hbd : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → f τ ≤ C) : ∃ l : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds l)
decls.doc: A function that is monotone on `[0,∞)` and bounded above there converges at `+∞`.

decls.name: tendsto_atTop_of_deriv_dominated
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_atTop_of_deriv_dominated {A B b beta : ℝ → ℝ} {CA CB : ℝ} (hA : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → HasDerivAt A (b τ) τ) (hB : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → HasDerivAt B (beta τ) τ) (hdom : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → |beta τ| ≤ b τ) (hAbd : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → A τ ≤ CA) (hBbd : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → |B τ| ≤ CB) : ∃ l : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto B Filter.atTop (nhds l)
decls.doc: **The shape of Step 3's convergence argument, with the flow removed.** `A` grows, `B` drifts no faster than `A` grows, both are bounded on `[0,∞)`: then `B` converges at `+∞`, because `A ± B` are monotone and bounded and `B = ((A+B) − (A−B))/2`.

decls.name: mean_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem mean_tendsto {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hgw : 0 < g2 * wmin) (hrho : 0 < rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) : ∃ minf : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => Graph.meanL2 lam (h t)) Filter.atTop (nhds minf) ∧ |minf - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → |minf - Graph.meanL2 lam (h t)| ≤ 4 * C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup / rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * t)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **Step 5's first half** (`proofs.tex:641`, `:646`): under the global window, `m_t = Πh_t` converges to some `m_∞`, with `|m_∞ − m_0| ≤ C₇‖h_0^⊥‖²` and `|m_∞ − m_t| ≤ (4C₆/ϱ)e^{−ϱt}‖h_0^⊥‖²`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, Steps 4 and 5** (`proofs.tex:612–618`, proof `:643–652`): from `‖h_0‖ ≤ ε₀` the nonlinear gradient flow converges to a balanced flow `c_∞λ`, with `|c_∞ − 1 − Πh_0| ≤ C₇‖h_0^⊥‖²` and `‖h_t − (c_∞−1)‖ ≤ 2e^{−ϱt/2}‖h_0^⊥‖` for every `t ≥ 0`.

decls.name: nrmL2_lossGrad_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_lossGrad_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w u : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup eps : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |u x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + u z) ≤ Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) eps * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam u))
decls.doc: **`‖D‖ ≤ L‖Ah^⊥‖` with `L := 2g''(1)‖w‖_{L^∞} + Kε`** (`proofs.tex:654`), read off `eq:gradient_expansion`: the linear part contributes `‖A†‖·g''(1)‖w‖_{L^∞} ≤ 2g''(1)‖w‖_{L^∞}` and the error `Kε`.

decls.name: Lgd_le
decls.statement: theorem Lgd_le {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmw : wmin ≤ wsup) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) : Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) eps ≤ 5 / 2 * (g2 * wsup)
decls.doc: **`L ≤ (5/2)g''(1)‖w‖_{L^∞}`, sharper than the paper's `3g''(1)‖w‖_{L^∞}`** (`proofs.tex:654`).

decls.name: gamma_mul_Lsq_le
decls.statement: theorem gamma_mul_Lsq_le {g2 wmin L gam : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0 g2 wmin L) : gam * L ^ 2 ≤ g2 * wmin / 2
decls.doc: `γ ≤ γ₀` is `γL² ≤ g''(1)w_min/2`.

decls.name: gd_energy_step
decls.statement: theorem gd_energy_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w u v : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |u x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgamL : gam * Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) eps ^ 2 ≤ g2 * wmin / 2) (hv : v = fun x => u x - gam * (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + u z) x) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam v) ^ 2 + gam * (g2 * wmin / 2) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam u)) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam u) ^ 2
decls.doc: **The discrete energy inequality** (`proofs.tex:655`): one step of `h ↦ h − γD(h)` obeys `‖h^⊥_{k+1}‖² ≤ ‖h^⊥_k‖² − γ(g''(1)w_min − γL²)‖Ah^⊥_k‖² ≤ ‖h^⊥_k‖² − γ(g''(1)w_min/2)‖Ah^⊥_k‖²`.

decls.name: gamma_rho_le
decls.statement: theorem gamma_rho_le {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps gam : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmw : wmin ≤ wsup) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgamL : gam * Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) eps ^ 2 ≤ g2 * wmin / 2) : gam * rhoL g2 wmin Bhat / 2 ≤ 1 / 16
decls.doc: **`γϱ/2 ≤ 1/16` at `γ ≤ γ₀`** — the inequality that makes the square-root step of `proofs.tex:656` legitimate, and the only place `B̂ ≥ 1` and `w_min ≤ ‖w‖_{L^∞}` are spent.

decls.name: gd_contract_step
