decls.statement: theorem gd_contract_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w u v : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |u x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgamL : gam * Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) eps ^ 2 ≤ g2 * wmin / 2) (hv : v = fun x => u x - gam * (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + u z) x) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam v) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL g2 wmin Bhat / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam u)
decls.doc: **The per-step contraction** (`proofs.tex:656`): `‖h^⊥_{k+1}‖ ≤ (1 − γϱ/4)‖h^⊥_k‖`.

decls.name: gd_drift_step
decls.statement: theorem gd_drift_step {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w u v : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hgw : 0 < g2 * wmin) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |u x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgamL : gam * Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) eps ^ 2 ≤ g2 * wmin / 2) (hv : v = fun x => u x - gam * (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + u z) x) : |Graph.meanL2 lam v - Graph.meanL2 lam u| ≤ 2 * C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin * (Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam u) ^ 2 - Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam v) ^ 2)
decls.doc: **The discrete drift of the mass**, in the telescoping form the continuation needs: `|m_{k+1} − m_k| ≤ 2C₇(‖h^⊥_k‖² − ‖h^⊥_{k+1}‖²)`.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat))) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∀ k : ℕ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL g2 wmin Bhat / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the gradient-descent clause** (`proofs.tex:653–657`): with `h_{k+1} = h_k − γD(h_k)`, `γ ≤ γ₀` and `‖h_0‖ ≤ ε₀`, `‖h^⊥_k‖` contracts by `1 − γϱ/4` at **every** step.

files.title: The four clauses the local convergence theorem gained on 2026-09-13

decls.name: eps0_le_a_div
decls.statement: theorem eps0_le_a_div {a g2 wmin Kex Bhat Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hCi : 0 < Ci) (hc7 : 0 ≤ c7) : eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin Kex Bhat) Ci c7 rho c6 ≤ a / (16 * Ci)

decls.name: eps0_mem_Ioc
decls.statement: theorem eps0_mem_Ioc {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) : eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (a / (16 * Cinf lamMin))
decls.doc: **`ε₀ ∈ (0, a/(16C_∞)]`** (`proofs.tex:613`, chain at Step 4, `:643`), at the theorem's constants and under its hypotheses.

decls.name: one_le_max_C7
decls.statement: theorem one_le_max_C7 (c6 g2 wmin : ℝ) : 1 ≤ max 1 (C7 c6 g2 wmin)

decls.name: local_convergence_full_C
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_C {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ max 1 (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the flow clause with the printed `C := max(1, C₇)`** (`proofs.tex:612–618`, Step 5 at `:645`): `local_convergence_full` with `C₇` weakened to `max(1, C₇)` by `le_max_right`.

decls.name: gamma0_pos
decls.statement: theorem gamma0_pos {g2 wmin L : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hL : 0 < L) : 0 < gamma0 g2 wmin L
decls.doc: **`γ₀ > 0`** (`proofs.tex:617`, formula at Step 6, `:652`) as soon as `L > 0`.

decls.name: Lgd_pos
decls.statement: theorem Lgd_pos {g2 wsup Kex eps : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hK0 : 0 ≤ Kex) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) : 0 < Lgd g2 wsup Kex eps

decls.name: gamma0_pos_of_weights
decls.statement: theorem gamma0_pos_of_weights {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat : ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) : 0 < gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat))
decls.doc: **`γ₀ > 0`** at the theorem's constants and under its hypotheses; `‖w‖_{L^∞} > 0` is derived by `wsup_pos`, as `local_convergence_gd` does.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_window
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_window {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat))) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x : V, |hk k x| ≤ epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat ∧ 0 < 1 + hk k x
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, "the gradient descent … is well defined"** (`proofs.tex:617`, the invariant `eq:gd_invariant` of Step 6 at `:669–677`): under the hypotheses of `local_convergence_gd`, every iterate satisfies `‖h_k‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε`, hence `0 < 1 + h_k` — the density `(1 + h_k)λ` is positive along the whole iteration.

decls.name: abs_ratio_sub_one_le_two_a_div_three
decls.statement: theorem abs_ratio_sub_one_le_two_a_div_three {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam h : V → ℝ} {eps a : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : |ratio K lam (fun x => 1 + h x) y - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3

decls.name: hasDerivAt_loss_local
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_loss_local {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt g (gd (ratio K lam u x)) (ratio K lam u x)) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam nu (fun x => u x + t * d x) g) (∑ x, nu x * (gd (ratio K lam u x) * (dirPush K lam u d x - ratio K lam u x * dirDens u d x))) 0
decls.doc: **`FirstVariation.hasDerivAt_loss` with `g` differentiable only at the values `r` takes.** The proof is that lemma's, whose `hg` is consumed at `r(x)` and nowhere else; `r > 0` is then not needed either.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_loss_ipL2_local
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_loss_ipL2_local {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt g (gd (ratio K lam u x)) (ratio K lam u x)) (d : V → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam nu (fun x => u x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u (fun z => nu z / (lam z * u z)) gd) d) 0
decls.doc: **`theo:first_variation_full` at `ν_G = λ`, with `g` differentiable only at the values `r` takes**: `FirstVariation.hasDerivAt_loss_ipL2` under the local hypothesis.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_welldefined
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_welldefined {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| < a → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat))) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ x : V, 0 < 1 + hk k x) ∧ (∀ x : V, |ratio K lam (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ ∀ d : V → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (fun x => 1 + hk k x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + hk k z) d) 0
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, "the gradient descent … is well defined"**, all three parts (`proofs.tex:617`, proof `:662`): under the hypotheses of `local_convergence_gd`, with `0 < a` and `g` differentiable with derivative `gd` on the open window `|y − 1| < a`, every iterate satisfies * `0 < 1 + h_k` — the density of `(1 + h_k)λ` is positive; * `|r_k − 1| ≤ 2a/3`, `r_k` the ratio at `(1 + h_k)λ`; * `D_k = lossGrad(1 + h_k)` **is the gradient of `𝓛_{g,ν}`** at `(1 + h_k)λ`: for every direction `d`, `t ↦ 𝓛_{g,ν}((1 + h_k + t·d)λ)` has derivative `⟨D_k ∣ d⟩_λ` at `t = 0`.

files.title: The local convergence theorem at the paper's mixing sum `B̂`

decls.name: mixing_densOp_iff_summable
decls.statement: theorem mixing_densOp_iff_summable {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) ↔ Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densOp lam K ^ n - meanOp lam‖
decls.doc: **`Core.Mixing (P, Π)` is exactly summable mixing** at the paper's `(P, Π)`: the two structure fields `ΠP = Π` and `PΠ = Π` are theorems under `hK`, `hinv` and `λ > 0` (`meanOp_mul_densOp`, `densOp_mul_meanOp`), so the only content of `hmx` is `∑_{n≥0}‖Pⁿ − Π‖_{L²(λ)} < ∞`, the paper's hypothesis.

decls.name: meanOp_eq_of_densOp_eq
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_eq_of_densOp_eq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ V} (hu : densOp lam K u = u) : meanOp lam u = u
decls.doc: **Summable mixing implies ergodicity**, at the operator level: a `P`-fixed vector of `L²(λ)` is `Π`-fixed.

decls.name: eq_const_of_densAct_eq
decls.statement: theorem eq_const_of_densAct_eq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) {f : V → ℝ} (hf : Core.densAct lam K f = f) : f = fun _ => Graph.meanL2 lam f
decls.doc: **Summable mixing implies ergodicity** (the paper's "`T` ergodic", `proofs.tex:593`), on functions: a density fixed by the density action `P` is the constant `Πf = ∫f dλ`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_mixing
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_mixing [Nontrivial V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the flow clause, at the paper's `B̂`** (`proofs.tex:612–618`): `local_convergence_full` with `B̂ := ∑_{n≥0}‖Pⁿ − Π‖_{L²(λ)}` the mixing sum, under summable mixing `hmx`.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_mixing
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_mixing [Nontrivial V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))))) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∀ k : ℕ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the gradient-descent clause, at the paper's `B̂`** (`proofs.tex:617`, Step 6 at `:652–677`): `local_convergence_gd` with `B̂` the mixing sum, under summable mixing `hmx`; `hcoer` and `hB1` are discharged as in `local_convergence_full_mixing`.

decls.name: eps0_mem_Ioc_mixing
decls.statement: theorem eps0_mem_Ioc_mixing [Nontrivial V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin lamMin : ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) : eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (a / (16 * Cinf lamMin))
decls.doc: **`ε₀ ∈ (0, a/(16C_∞)]`** (`proofs.tex:613`, Step 4 at `:643`) at the paper's `B̂`: `eps0_mem_Ioc` with `hB1` discharged by `one_le_B_densOp`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_C_mixing
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_C_mixing [Nontrivial V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ max 1 (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the flow clause with the printed `C := max(1, C₇)`, at the paper's `B̂`** (`proofs.tex:612–618`, Step 5 at `:645`): `local_convergence_full_C` with `hB1` and `hcoer` discharged.

decls.name: gamma0_pos_of_weights_mixing
decls.statement: theorem gamma0_pos_of_weights_mixing {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin : ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) : 0 < gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))))
decls.doc: **`γ₀ > 0`** (`proofs.tex:617`, formula at Step 6, `:652`) at the paper's `B̂`: `gamma0_pos_of_weights`, whose only `B̂` hypothesis is `0 ≤ B̂`.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_welldefined_mixing
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_welldefined_mixing [Nontrivial V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha : 0 < a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| < a → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0 g2 wmin (Lgd g2 wsup (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))))) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam))) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) : ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ x : V, 0 < 1 + hk k x) ∧ (∀ x : V, |ratio K lam (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ ∀ d : V → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (fun x => 1 + hk k x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + hk k z) d) 0
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, "the gradient descent … is well defined", at the paper's `B̂`** (`proofs.tex:617`, proof `:662`): `local_convergence_gd_welldefined` with `hB1` and `hcoer` discharged.

files.title: Steps 2 and 3 of the local convergence theorem: the energy estimate, and the drift of the mass

decls.name: eps1
decls.statement: noncomputable def eps1 (g2 wmin Kexp Bhat : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: C6
decls.statement: noncomputable def C6 (Cg wsup : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: C7
decls.statement: noncomputable def C7 (C6 g2 wmin : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`C₇ := C₆/(g''(1)w_min)`** (`proofs.tex:641`).

decls.name: rhoL
decls.statement: noncomputable def rhoL (g2 wmin Bhat : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: Kexp_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem Kexp_nonneg {g2 a M3 wsup : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) : 0 ≤ Kexp g2 a M3 wsup

decls.name: rhoL_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem rhoL_nonneg {g2 wmin Bhat : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) : 0 ≤ rhoL g2 wmin Bhat

decls.name: Kexp_mul_eps_mul_Bhat_le
decls.statement: theorem Kexp_mul_eps_mul_Bhat_le {g2 wmin Bhat eps kap : ℝ} (hg2wmin : 0 ≤ g2 * wmin) (hkap : 0 ≤ kap) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin kap Bhat) : kap * eps * Bhat ≤ g2 * wmin / 2
decls.doc: **`Kεδ ≤ g''(1)w_min/2` at `ε ≤ ε₁`** — the arithmetic that names `ε₁`: it is *exactly* the threshold at which the expansion error eats half of the coercivity, no more and no less.

decls.name: energy_lower
decls.statement: theorem energy_lower {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w h : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) : g2 * wmin / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam h)) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.ipL2 lam (perpL2 lam h) (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + h z))
decls.doc: **Step 2's first inequality** (`proofs.tex:636–637`): at `‖h‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε ≤ ε₁`, `⟨h^⊥, D⟩ ≥ (g''(1)w_min/2)‖Ah^⊥‖²`.

decls.name: energy_lower_perp
decls.statement: theorem energy_lower_perp {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w h : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) : rhoL g2 wmin Bhat / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam h) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.ipL2 lam (perpL2 lam h) (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + h z))
decls.doc: **Step 2's second inequality** (`proofs.tex:637`): `⟨h^⊥, D⟩ ≥ (ϱ/2)‖h^⊥‖²`, the same estimate after `lem:sigma_mixing` replaces `‖Ah^⊥‖` by `‖h^⊥‖/B̂`.

decls.name: meanL2_perpL2
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_perpL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (f : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) = 0
decls.doc: **`Πh^⊥ = 0`** when `λ` is a probability: the mean-zero part has mean zero.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_flowDev
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_flowDev {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (x : V) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h s x) (-lossGrad K lam nu gd (fun z => 1 + h t z) x) t
decls.doc: **`ḣ_t = −D_t` state by state**: the gradient-flow ODE for `μ_t = (1+h_t)λ`, read on `h`.

decls.name: continuous_flowDev
decls.statement: theorem continuous_flowDev {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (x : V) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => h s x) t
decls.doc: `s ↦ h_s(x)` is continuous at every `t ≥ 0`, being differentiable there.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_mean
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_mean {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (h s)) (-Graph.meanL2 lam (lossGrad K lam nu gd fun z => 1 + h t z)) t
decls.doc: **`ṁ = −∫D dλ`** (`proofs.tex:641`) at `m_t = Πh_t`: `MassAscent.hasDerivAt_mass_flow` differentiates `∫u_t dλ`, and `Πh_t = ∫u_t dλ − 1` because `λ` is a probability.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_perp_sq
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_perp_sq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h s)) ^ 2) (-(2 * Graph.ipL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h t)) (lossGrad K lam nu gd fun z => 1 + h t z))) t
decls.doc: **`d/dt‖h^⊥_t‖² = −2⟨h^⊥_t, D_t⟩`** (`proofs.tex:636`), the quantity Grönwall is applied to.

decls.name: continuous_perp_flow
decls.statement: theorem continuous_perp_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (x : V) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => perpL2 lam (h s) x) t

decls.name: continuous_Aop_perp_flow
decls.statement: theorem continuous_Aop_perp_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (y : V) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => Aop K lam (perpL2 lam (h s)) y) t

decls.name: continuous_energy_flow
decls.statement: theorem continuous_energy_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam (h s))) ^ 2) t
decls.doc: **`s ↦ ‖Ah^⊥_s‖²` is continuous at every `t ≥ 0`**, hence interval-integrable on `ℝ₊` — the only integrability fact Steps 2 and 3 need.

decls.name: perp_decay_on
decls.statement: theorem perp_decay_on {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps T : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h t)) ≤ Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`‖h_t^⊥‖ ≤ e^{−ϱt/2}‖h_0^⊥‖` on the window** (`proofs.tex:639`).

decls.name: energy_integral_Icc
decls.statement: theorem energy_integral_Icc {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps T t₀ t₁ : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) (h0 : 0 ≤ t₀) (h01 : t₀ ≤ t₁) (h1T : t₁ ≤ T) : g2 * wmin * (∫ s in t₀..t₁, Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam (h s))) ^ 2) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h t₀)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`g''(1)w_min ∫_{t₀}^{t₁}‖Ah_s^⊥‖²ds ≤ ‖h_{t₀}^⊥‖²`** on any sub-interval of the window (`proofs.tex:639`, restarted at `t₀`).

decls.name: energy_integral_on
decls.statement: theorem energy_integral_on {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps T : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : g2 * wmin * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..T, Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam (h s))) ^ 2) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`g''(1)w_min ∫_0^T‖Ah_s^⊥‖²ds ≤ ‖h_0^⊥‖²`** (`proofs.tex:639`), the display as printed.

decls.name: energy_integral_Ioi
decls.statement: theorem energy_integral_Ioi {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hgw : 0 < g2 * wmin) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) : g2 * wmin * (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam (h s))) ^ 2) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`∫_0^∞‖Ah_s^⊥‖²ds ≤ ‖h_0^⊥‖²/(g''(1)w_min)`** (`proofs.tex:639`), the improper integral of the display, under the *global* window Step 4 supplies.

decls.name: abs_ratio_sub_one_mul_phi_sq_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_ratio_sub_one_mul_phi_sq_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w h : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup eps : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : |(ratio K lam (fun x => 1 + h x) y - 1) * (gd (ratio K lam (fun x => 1 + h x) y) * (w y / (1 + h y)))| ≤ 64 / 27 * (Cg g2 a M3 * wsup) * Aop K lam (perpL2 lam h) y ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|(r−1)φ| ≤ (64/27)C_g‖w‖_{L^∞}(Ah^⊥)²`** — Step 3's pointwise estimate, *quadratic* in `Ah^⊥` rather than the `ε|Ah^⊥|` of Step 1.

decls.name: abs_ratio_sub_one_mul_phi_sq_le_C6
decls.statement: theorem abs_ratio_sub_one_mul_phi_sq_le_C6 {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w h : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup eps : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : |(ratio K lam (fun x => 1 + h x) y - 1) * (gd (ratio K lam (fun x => 1 + h x) y) * (w y / (1 + h y)))| ≤ C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup * Aop K lam (perpL2 lam h) y ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|(r−1)φ| ≤ C₆(Ah^⊥)²` with the paper's `C₆ = 4C_g‖w‖_{L^∞}`** (`proofs.tex:641`), the same estimate with the printed constant.

decls.name: abs_deriv_mean_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_deriv_mean_le {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w h : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup eps : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hh : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ eps) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) : |Graph.meanL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + h z)| ≤ C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam h)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|ṁ| ≤ C₆‖Ah^⊥‖²`** (`proofs.tex:641`), Step 3's estimate on the drift of the mass.

decls.name: abs_mean_sub_le_energy_integral
decls.statement: theorem abs_mean_sub_le_energy_integral {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup eps T t₀ t₁ : ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) (h0 : 0 ≤ t₀) (h01 : t₀ ≤ t₁) (h1T : t₁ ≤ T) : |Graph.meanL2 lam (h t₁) - Graph.meanL2 lam (h t₀)| ≤ C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup * ∫ s in t₀..t₁, Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam (perpL2 lam (h s))) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|m_{t₁} − m_{t₀}| ≤ C₆∫_{t₀}^{t₁}‖Ah^⊥‖²`** — Step 3's pointwise bound integrated.

decls.name: mean_drift_on
decls.statement: theorem mean_drift_on {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps T t : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hgw : 0 < g2 * wmin) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ eps) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T) : |Graph.meanL2 lam (h t) - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|m_t − m_0| ≤ C₇‖h_0^⊥‖²`** (`proofs.tex:641`), with `C₇ = C₆/(g''(1)w_min)`.

decls.name: mean_cauchy_on_sharp
decls.statement: theorem mean_cauchy_on_sharp {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps T s t : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hgw : 0 < g2 * wmin) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h r x| ≤ eps) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (htT : t ≤ T) : |Graph.meanL2 lam (h t) - Graph.meanL2 lam (h s)| ≤ C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * s)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|m_t − m_s| ≤ C₇e^{−ϱs}‖h_0^⊥‖²` — sharper than the paper's Step 3.** `proofs.tex:641` states `|m_∞ − m_t| ≤ (4C₆/ϱ)e^{−ϱt}‖h_0^⊥‖²`, reached by bounding `‖Ah^⊥‖² ≤ 4‖h^⊥‖²` and integrating the exponential.

decls.name: mean_cauchy_on
decls.statement: theorem mean_cauchy_on {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat eps T s t : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hrho : 0 < rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps) (heps : eps ≤ min a 1 / 4) (heps1 : eps ≤ eps1 g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hwin : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ x, |h r x| ≤ eps) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (htT : t ≤ T) : |Graph.meanL2 lam (h t) - Graph.meanL2 lam (h s)| ≤ 4 * C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup / rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * Real.exp (-(rhoL g2 wmin Bhat * s)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|m_t − m_s| ≤ (4C₆/ϱ)e^{−ϱs}‖h_0^⊥‖²`** (`proofs.tex:641`), the paper's Step 3 Cauchy estimate, by the paper's route: `‖Ah^⊥‖² ≤ 4‖h^⊥‖²` and the exponential decay of `‖h^⊥‖` integrated over `[s,t]`.

decls.name: energyH
decls.statement: noncomputable def energyH : Fin 2 → ℝ

decls.name: energyH_abs_le
decls.statement: theorem energyH_abs_le : ∀ x, |energyH x| ≤ 1 / 40

decls.name: twoState_perpL2_energyH

decls.name: twoState_Aop_eq_neg_perp
decls.statement: theorem twoState_Aop_eq_neg_perp (f : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Aop twoStateK twoStateLam f = fun y => -(perpL2 twoStateLam f y)
decls.doc: **`Af = −f^⊥` on the two-state chain**: `P` is the `λ`-average, so `A` is minus the mean-zero projection.

decls.name: twoState_coercivity
decls.statement: theorem twoState_coercivity (f : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam f) ≤ 1 * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (Aop twoStateK twoStateLam f)
decls.doc: **`B̂ = 1` is exact here**: the coercivity hypothesis of Step 2, with equality.

decls.name: twoState_energy_lhs
decls.statement: theorem twoState_energy_lhs : (2 : ℝ) * 1 / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (Aop twoStateK twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam energyH)) ^ 2 = 1 / 1600
decls.doc: **`(g''(1)w_min/2)‖Ah^⊥‖² = 1/1600`** on this instance.

decls.name: twoState_energy_rhs
decls.statement: theorem twoState_energy_rhs : Graph.ipL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam energyH) (lossGrad twoStateK twoStateLam (fun z => twoStateLam z * 1) (fun z => 2 * (z - 1)) fun z => 1 + energyH z) = 5129600 / 4088324799
decls.doc: **`⟨h^⊥, D⟩ = 5129600/4088324799`** on this instance — the number computed by hand in the section preamble.

decls.name: twoState_energy_check
decls.statement: theorem twoState_energy_check : ((2 : ℝ) * 1 / 2 * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (Aop twoStateK twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam energyH)) ^ 2 = 1 / 1600) ∧ (Graph.ipL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam energyH) (lossGrad twoStateK twoStateLam (fun z => twoStateLam z * 1) (fun z => 2 * (z - 1)) fun z => 1 + energyH z) = 5129600 / 4088324799) ∧ (1 : ℝ) / 1600 ≤ 5129600 / 4088324799
decls.doc: **`energy_lower`, evaluated and checked against a hand computation.** Three things at once: both sides are the numbers computed by hand, the theorem's hypotheses are jointly satisfiable at `B̂ = 1`, `ε = 1/40 ≤ ε₁ = 3/80` (so nothing above is vacuous), and its conclusion holds on this instance with a factor `2.008` to spare.

files.title: A second-order Taylor bound on `g'` for `g = (log x)²`, near `x = 1`

decls.name: abs_log_sub_le_two_sq
decls.statement: theorem abs_log_sub_le_two_sq {y : ℝ} (hy : |y - 1| ≤ 1 / 2) : |Real.log y - (y - 1)| ≤ 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|log y − (y−1)| ≤ 2(y−1)²` for `|y − 1| ≤ 1/2`.** Both halves are one-sided logarithm bounds the library already has: `log y ≤ y − 1` is `Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos`, and `(y−1)/y ≤ log y` is `sub_one_le_mul_log` divided by `y`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv_taylor_twelve
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_taylor_twelve {y : ℝ} (hy : |y - 1| ≤ 1 / 2) : |logSqDeriv y - 2 * (y - 1)| ≤ 12 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **The sharper form of `logSqDeriv_taylor`, with `12` in place of `40`.** `g'(y) − 2(y−1) = 2(log y − (y−1) − (y−1)²)/y`, because `y(y−1) = (y−1) + (y−1)²`; the numerator is at most `3(y−1)²` in absolute value by `abs_log_sub_le_two_sq`, and `1/y ≤ 2`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv_taylor
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_taylor {y : ℝ} (hy : |y - 1| ≤ 1 / 2) : |logSqDeriv y - 2 * (y - 1)| ≤ 40 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`|g'(y) − 2(y−1)| ≤ 40(y−1)²` on `|y − 1| ≤ 1/2`, for `g = (log x)²`** — the second-order bound on `logSqDeriv` at `1`, with `g''(1) = 2` as the linear coefficient.

files.title: Coercivity off balance, and the Łojasiewicz inequality it delivers

decls.name: logSq
decls.statement: noncomputable def logSq (x : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`g = (log x)²`**, the paper's practical generator (`proofs.tex:792`).

decls.name: logSqDeriv
decls.statement: noncomputable def logSqDeriv (x : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`g'(x) = 2 log x / x`** for `g = (log x)²` (`proofs.tex:809`).

decls.name: logSq_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem logSq_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ logSq x

decls.name: logSqDeriv_strictlyUnimodal
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_strictlyUnimodal : StrictlyUnimodal logSqDeriv
decls.doc: `logSqDeriv` is `MassIdentity`'s `StrictlyUnimodal` hypothesis made concrete (`proofs.tex:788`).

decls.name: sub_one_le_mul_log
decls.statement: theorem sub_one_le_mul_log {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : x - 1 ≤ x * Real.log x
decls.doc: **`x − 1 ≤ x log x`** for `x > 0`, i.e.

decls.name: log_le_neg_of_le_one_sub
decls.statement: theorem log_le_neg_of_le_one_sub {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (h : x ≤ 1 - δ) : Real.log x ≤ -δ
decls.doc: **Bound 1 of 4** (`proofs.tex:809`): for `0 < x ≤ 1 − δ`, `log x ≤ −δ`, i.e.

decls.name: le_one_sub_div_of_le_one_sub
decls.statement: theorem le_one_sub_div_of_le_one_sub {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : x ≤ 1 - δ) : δ ≤ (1 - x) / x
decls.doc: **Bound 2 of 4** (`proofs.tex:809`): for `0 < x ≤ 1 − δ` and `δ > 0`, `(1 − x)/x ≥ δ`.

decls.name: le_sub_one_div_of_one_add_le
decls.statement: theorem le_sub_one_div_of_one_add_le {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : 1 + δ ≤ x) : δ / (1 + δ) ≤ (x - 1) / x
decls.doc: **Bound 4 of 4** (`proofs.tex:809`): for `1 + δ ≤ x` and `δ > 0`, `(x − 1)/x ≥ δ/(1 + δ)`.

decls.name: le_log_of_one_add_le
decls.statement: theorem le_log_of_one_add_le {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : 1 + δ ≤ x) : δ / (1 + δ) ≤ Real.log x
decls.doc: **Bound 3 of 4** (`proofs.tex:809`): for `1 + δ ≤ x` and `δ > 0`, `log x ≥ δ/(1 + δ)`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1/2) (h : δ ≤ |x - 1|) : logSqDeriv x * (1 - x) ≤ -(δ ^ 2 / 2)
decls.doc: **`g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ −δ²/2` whenever `|x − 1| ≥ δ ∈ (0, ½]`** (`proofs.tex:792`, proof `proofs.tex:809`), for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: le_abs_logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub
decls.statement: theorem le_abs_logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1/2) (h : δ ≤ |x - 1|) : δ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ |logSqDeriv x * (1 - x)|
decls.doc: **`|g'(x)(1 − x)| ≥ δ²/2` whenever `|x − 1| ≥ δ ∈ (0, ½]`** (`proofs.tex:792`) — the proposition's own wording, from the signed form.

decls.name: logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub_nonpos
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub_nonpos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : logSqDeriv x * (1 - x) ≤ 0
decls.doc: `g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ 0` for every `x > 0` — strict unimodality, unweighted (`proofs.tex:805`, `proofs.tex:809`).

decls.name: abs_mass_le_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem abs_mass_le_nrmL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (a : V → ℝ) : |∑ x, lam x * a x| ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam a
decls.doc: **`‖a‖_{L²(λ)} ≥ |∫ a dλ|`** (`proofs.tex:809`: "since `λ` is a probability measure"), Cauchy–Schwarz against `𝟏`.

decls.name: le_density_ratio
decls.statement: theorem le_density_ratio {lam u u0 wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hwmin : 0 ≤ wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hsph : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (x : V) : wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / Graph.nrmL2 lam u0 ≤ wf x / u x
decls.doc: **`u ≤ ‖u₀‖ λ_min^{−1/2}` on the sphere, hence `dν/dμ = w/u ≥ w_min √λ_min/‖u₀‖`** (`proofs.tex:809`, restated at `proofs.tex:897`).

decls.name: farSet
decls.statement: noncomputable def farSet (r : V → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) : Finset V
decls.doc: The set `{x : |r(x) − 1| ≥ δ}` whose `λ`-mass the display carries (`proofs.tex:794`).

decls.name: mem_farSet
decls.statement: theorem mem_farSet {r : V → ℝ} {δ : ℝ} {x : V} : x ∈ farSet r δ ↔ δ ≤ |r x - 1|

decls.name: no_distant_equilibrium_three_far
decls.statement: theorem no_distant_equilibrium_three_far {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u wnu : V → ℝ} {δ c₀ : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hwnu : ∀ x, c₀ ≤ wnu x) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1/2) (S : Finset V) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, δ ≤ |ratio K lam u x - 1|) : c₀ * (δ ^ 2 / 2) * (∑ x ∈ S, lam x) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u wnu logSqDeriv)
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*, the display, over any set of far ratios and with `dν/dμ` bounded below by an abstract `c₀`** (statement `proofs.tex:792–796`, proof `proofs.tex:809–811`).

decls.name: no_distant_equilibrium_three
decls.statement: theorem no_distant_equilibrium_three {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u u0 wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin δ : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hsph : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1/2) : wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / Graph.nrmL2 lam u0 * (δ ^ 2 / 2) * (∑ x ∈ farSet (ratio K lam u) δ, lam x) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u (fun x => wf x / u x) logSqDeriv)
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*'s display verbatim** (statement `proofs.tex:792–796`, proof `proofs.tex:809–811`): `‖∇^λ 𝓛_{g,ν}(μ)‖ ≥ (w_min λ_min^{1/2}/‖u₀‖)(δ²/2) λ(|r−1| ≥ δ)` for `g = (log x)²`, `ν = wλ` with `w ≥ w_min > 0`, on the sphere `‖u‖ = ‖u₀‖`.

decls.name: mul_abs_log_le
decls.statement: theorem mul_abs_log_le {x M : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hxe : x ≤ Real.exp M) : x * |Real.log x| ≤ 2 * M * |x - 1|
decls.doc: **`x|log x| ≤ 2M|x − 1|` on `(0, e^M]` for `M ≥ 1`** (`proofs.tex:888`).

decls.name: logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le_logSq_div
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le_logSq_div {x M : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hxe : x ≤ Real.exp M) : logSqDeriv x * (1 - x) ≤ -(logSq x / M)
decls.doc: **`g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ −g(x)/M` on `(0, e^M]` for `M ≥ 1`** (`proofs.tex:890`), for `g = (log x)²` — the corollary's pointwise step, in signed form.

decls.name: lossVal
decls.statement: noncomputable def lossVal (lam wf : V → ℝ) (gg : ℝ → ℝ) (r : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`𝓛_{g,ν}(μ) = ∫ g(r) dν = ∑_x λ(x) w(x) g(r(x))`** for `ν = wλ` (`proofs.tex:876`).

decls.name: lossVal_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem lossVal_nonneg {lam wf r : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wf x) : 0 ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq r

decls.name: logSq_le_of_loss
decls.statement: theorem logSq_le_of_loss {lam wf r : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (x : V) : lamMin * wmin * logSq (r x) ≤ lossVal lam wf logSq r
decls.doc: **`λ_min w_min g(r(x)) ≤ 𝓛`** (`proofs.tex:892`: "`g(r_t(x)) ≤ 𝓛(μ_t)/(w_min λ_min)`"), one term of a sum of nonnegative terms.

decls.name: ratio_le_exp
decls.statement: theorem ratio_le_exp {lam wf r : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin L0 : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hr : ∀ x, 0 < r x) (hL0 : lossVal lam wf logSq r ≤ L0) (x : V) : r x ≤ Real.exp (max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 / (wmin * lamMin))))
decls.doc: **`r(x) ≤ e^M`** (`proofs.tex:892`), for `M := max(1, √(L₀/(w_min λ_min)))` and any `L₀ ≥ 𝓛(μ)`.

decls.name: lojasiewicz_termwise
decls.statement: theorem lojasiewicz_termwise {c₀ M wsup wx g : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hM : 0 < M) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hg : 0 ≤ g) (hle : wx ≤ wsup) : c₀ / (M * wsup) * (wx * g) ≤ g / M * c₀
decls.doc: The arithmetic step inside the corollary's integrand: `𝓛 ≤ ‖w‖_{L^∞} ∫ g(r) dλ`, read one term at a time as `c₀/(M‖w‖_∞) · w(x) g ≤ (g/M) c₀` (`proofs.tex:895`).

decls.name: global_lojasiewicz_static
decls.statement: theorem global_lojasiewicz_static {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u u0 wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin wsup L0 : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hsph : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hL0 : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ L0) : wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / (Graph.nrmL2 lam u0 * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 / (wmin * lamMin)))) * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u (fun x => wf x / u x) logSqDeriv)
decls.doc: **`cor:global_lojasiewicz`, the static inequality** (statement `proofs.tex:875–886`, proof `proofs.tex:887–898`): `‖∇𝓛‖_{L²(λ)} ≥ κ 𝓛` with `κ = w_min λ_min^{1/2}/(‖u₀‖ ‖w‖_{L^∞} M)` and `M = max(1, √(L₀/(w_min λ_min)))`.

decls.name: global_lojasiewicz_sq
decls.statement: theorem global_lojasiewicz_sq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u u0 wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin wsup L0 : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hsph : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hL0 : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ≤ L0) : (wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / (Graph.nrmL2 lam u0 * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 / (wmin * lamMin))))) ^ 2 * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u (fun x => wf x / u x) logSqDeriv) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`cor:global_lojasiewicz`'s display, statically**: `κ²𝓛² ≤ ‖D‖²_{L²(λ)}`.

files.title: The mass is the Lyapunov function: monotone ascent on the sphere, and the entry time
variables: variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : MarkedGraph V} {B : BackwardPolicy G}
variables, where `ν = wλ`. This is the form `BoundaryBlowup.flow_pos_of_pos` consumes. -/

decls.name: rnWeight
decls.statement: noncomputable def rnWeight (lam nu u : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`dν/dμ = ν/(λu)`**, the Radon–Nikodym weight `Flow.lossGrad` substitutes for `w` — named here because the mass identity of `MassIdentity.lean` is stated in `w`, and the flow's `w` is this function of the flow.

decls.name: lossGrad_eq_lossGradDensity
decls.statement: theorem lossGrad_eq_lossGradDensity (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam nu : V → ℝ) (gd : ℝ → ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) : lossGrad K lam nu gd u = lossGradDensity K lam u (rnWeight lam nu u) gd

decls.name: rnWeight_pos
decls.statement: theorem rnWeight_pos {lam nu u : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (x : V) : 0 < rnWeight lam nu u x
decls.doc: `dν/dμ > 0` wherever `ν`, `λ` and `u` are.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_mass_flow
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_mass_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u s)) (-(gradMass K lam (u t) (rnWeight lam nu (u t)) gd)) t
decls.doc: **`d/dt μ_t(𝒮̂) = −∫ D dλ`** (`proofs.tex:807`): along the gradient flow the total mass moves at minus the mass of the gradient.

decls.name: mass_deriv_pos_off_balance
decls.statement: theorem mass_deriv_pos_off_balance {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hbal : ¬ Balanced K lam u) : 0 < -(gradMass K lam u (rnWeight lam nu u) gd)
decls.doc: **The mass strictly increases off balance** (`proofs.tex:791`, `:807`): its velocity `−∫ D dλ` is positive wherever `μ_t` is not balanced.

decls.name: mass_monotoneOn
decls.statement: theorem mass_monotoneOn {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {D : Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) (hD0 : ∀ s ∈ D, 0 ≤ s) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hupos : ∀ s ∈ D, ∀ x, 0 < u s x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) : MonotoneOn (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u s)) D
decls.doc: **The mass ascends, on any convex set of times where the trajectory is positive** (`proofs.tex:791`).

decls.name: mass_monotone_flow
decls.statement: theorem mass_monotone_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) : MonotoneOn (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u s)) (Set.Ici 0)
decls.doc: **The monotone ascent** (`proofs.tex:791`: "training is a monotone ascent of the mass"): along the gradient flow `t ↦ μ_t(𝒮̂)` is monotone on `[0,∞)`.

decls.name: ipL2_sub_mean
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_sub_mean {lam : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (v : V → ℝ) : ∑ x, lam x * (v x - Graph.meanL2 lam v) ^ 2 = Graph.ipL2 lam v v - Graph.meanL2 lam v ^ 2
decls.doc: **`∫(v − Πv)² dλ = ‖v‖²_{L²(λ)} − (Πv)²`**, the variance decomposition, on a probability `λ`.

decls.name: mean_le_nrmL2_iff_const
decls.statement: theorem mean_le_nrmL2_iff_const {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {v : V → ℝ} (hv : ∀ x, 0 ≤ v x) : Graph.meanL2 lam v ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam v ∧ (Graph.meanL2 lam v = Graph.nrmL2 lam v ↔ ∀ x, v x = Graph.meanL2 lam v)
decls.doc: **`∫ u dλ ≤ ‖u‖_{L²(λ)}`, with equality if and only if `u` is constant** (`proofs.tex:807`) — Cauchy–Schwarz against `𝟏` on the probability `λ`, and its equality case.

decls.name: balanced_const
decls.statement: theorem balanced_const {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (c : ℝ) : Balanced K lam (fun _ => c)
decls.doc: **A constant density is balanced**, on any kernel with an invariant `λ`: `μ = cλ` and `λK = λ` give `μK = μ`.

decls.name: mass_ascent_lyapunov
decls.statement: theorem mass_ascent_lyapunov {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) : (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (u t) = Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) ∧ MonotoneOn (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u s)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.meanL2 lam (u t) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.meanL2 lam (u t) = Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) → (∀ x, u t x = Graph.meanL2 lam (u t)) ∧ Balanced K lam (u t))
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(2)*, the Lyapunov half, for an abstract kernel.** Along the gradient flow: the sphere `‖u_t‖_{L²(λ)} = ‖u₀‖` is preserved, the mass ascends, it is bounded by `‖u₀‖`, and the bound is attained exactly at a constant density — which is balanced.

decls.name: const_of_balanced_graph
decls.statement: theorem const_of_balanced_graph (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam u : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hbal : Balanced B.phat lam u) (x : V) : u x = Graph.meanL2 lam u
decls.doc: **Balanced ⇒ constant, and this is ergodicity** (`proofs.tex:807`).

decls.name: mass_ascent_lyapunov_graph
decls.statement: theorem mass_ascent_lyapunov_graph (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam nu gd u) : MonotoneOn (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u s)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.meanL2 lam (u t) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ (Graph.meanL2 lam (u t) = Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ↔ Balanced B.phat lam (u t))
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(2)*, the Lyapunov half, in full** — on the backward chain of a finite path-connected marked graph, where the paper's ergodicity hypothesis is available.

decls.name: loss_antitoneOn
decls.statement: theorem loss_antitoneOn {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {D : Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) (hD0 : ∀ s ∈ D, 0 ≤ s) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hupos : ∀ s ∈ D, ∀ x, 0 < u s x) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) : AntitoneOn (fun s : ℝ => loss K lam nu (u s) g) D
decls.doc: **`𝓛` decreases along the flow, on any convex set of times where the trajectory is positive** (`proofs.tex:811`), from the flow identity `−𝓛̇ = ‖D‖² ≥ 0`.

decls.name: loss_antitone_flow
decls.statement: theorem loss_antitone_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) : AntitoneOn (fun s : ℝ => loss K lam nu (u s) g) (Set.Ici 0)
decls.doc: **`𝓛` decreases along the gradient flow** (`proofs.tex:811`): `loss_antitoneOn` at `D = [0,∞)`.

decls.name: lossVal_antitoneOn
decls.statement: theorem lossVal_antitoneOn {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {D : Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) (hD0 : ∀ s ∈ D, 0 ≤ s) (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hupos : ∀ s ∈ D, ∀ x, 0 < u s x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : AntitoneOn (fun s : ℝ => lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u s))) D
decls.doc: **`𝓛` decreases along the flow, for `g = (log x)²`, on any convex set of times where the trajectory is positive** (`proofs.tex:811`, `:813`) — `loss_antitoneOn` in `Lojasiewicz.lean`'s variables, where `ν = wλ`.

decls.name: lossVal_antitone_flow
decls.statement: theorem lossVal_antitone_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : AntitoneOn (fun s : ℝ => lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u s))) (Set.Ici 0)
decls.doc: The same on `[0,∞)`: `lossVal_antitoneOn` at `D = [0,∞)`.

decls.name: lossVal_eq_zero_iff_balanced
decls.statement: theorem lossVal_eq_zero_iff_balanced {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u wf : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < wf x) : lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam u) = 0 ↔ Balanced K lam u
decls.doc: **`𝓛_{g,ν}(μ) = 0` if and only if `μ` is balanced**, for `g = (log x)²` and a positive weight: `(log r)² = 0` state by state is `r ≡ 1`, which is `ratio_eq_one_iff_balanced`.

decls.name: lojasiewicz_integrated_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem lojasiewicz_integrated_nonneg {L L' : ℝ → ℝ} {kappa : ℝ} (hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt L (L' t) t) (hL0 : 0 ≤ L 0) (hineq : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → kappa ^ 2 * L t ^ 2 ≤ -L' t) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → L t ≤ ((L 0)⁻¹ + kappa ^ 2 * t)⁻¹
decls.doc: **`lojasiewicz_integrated` without its positivity hypothesis** (`proofs.tex:884`).

decls.name: global_lojasiewicz_flow'
decls.statement: theorem global_lojasiewicz_flow' {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin wsup : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u t)) ≤ ((lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)))⁻¹ + (wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)) / (wmin * lamMin))))) ^ 2 * t)⁻¹
decls.doc: **`cor:global_lojasiewicz`, both displays, with `L₀ = 𝓛(μ₀)` and no positivity hypothesis** (statement `proofs.tex:875–886`, proof `proofs.tex:887–898`).

decls.name: ratio_smul
decls.statement: theorem ratio_smul {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : ratio K lam (fun x => c * u x) = ratio K lam u
decls.doc: **`r(cμ) = r(μ)`**: the ratio is scale-invariant, for any `c ≠ 0` — the first words of the proof of item *(2)* (`proofs.tex:807`).

decls.name: lossGrad_smul
decls.statement: theorem lossGrad_smul {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : lossGrad K lam nu gd (fun x => c * u x) = fun x => c⁻¹ * lossGrad K lam nu gd u x
decls.doc: **`D(cμ) = c^{-1} D(μ)`**, the homogeneity of the gradient field (`proofs.tex:813`).

decls.name: flow_rescale
decls.statement: theorem flow_rescale {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {t₁ : ℝ} (ht₁ : 0 ≤ t₁) : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd (fun s x => c⁻¹ * u (t₁ + c ^ 2 * s) x)
decls.doc: **The rescaled flow is a flow, run at speed `c²`** (`proofs.tex:813`): if `t ↦ μ_t` solves `μ̇ = −∇𝓛`, so does `s ↦ μ_{t₁ + c²s}/c`.

decls.name: cDelta
decls.statement: noncomputable def cDelta (wmin lamMin u0nrm δ : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`c(δ) = w_min λ_min^{3/2} δ²/(2‖u₀‖)`** (`proofs.tex:813`), the off-band lower bound on `‖D‖` — an explicit formula, not an `∃ C`.

decls.name: entry_time
decls.statement: theorem entry_time {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin δ : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1/2) : ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)) / cDelta wmin lamMin (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) δ ^ 2), ∀ x, |ratio K lam (u t₁) x - 1| < δ
decls.doc: **The entry time** (`proofs.tex:813`: "after time at most `𝓛(μ₀)/c(δ)²` all ratios are within `δ` of `1`"): along the gradient flow of `𝓛_{g,ν}` with `g = (log x)²` and `ν = wλ`, `w ≥ w_min`, there is a time `t₁ ≤ 𝓛(μ₀)/c(δ)²` at which every ratio satisfies `|r(x) − 1| < δ`.

files.title: The mass identity: a strictly unimodal generator admits no distant equilibrium
variables: variable [DecidableEq V] {G : MarkedGraph V} {B : BackwardPolicy G}

decls.name: Invariant
decls.statement: def Invariant (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`λ` is invariant for the kernel `K`**: `λK = λ`, written as a finite sum.

decls.name: funAct
decls.statement: def funAct (K : V → V → ℝ) (φ : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **function action** of the kernel, `(Qφ)(x) = ∑_y K(x,y) φ(y)`.

decls.name: integral_funAct
decls.statement: theorem integral_funAct {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (h : Invariant K lam) (φ : V → ℝ) : ∑ x, lam x * funAct K φ x = ∑ x, lam x * φ x
decls.doc: **`∫ Qφ dλ = ∫ φ dλ`** — the paper's `∫ P†φ dλ = ⟨φ, P𝟏⟩ = ∫ φ dλ`.

decls.name: gradDensity
decls.statement: def gradDensity (K : V → V → ℝ) (r φ : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`D = Qφ − rφ`**, the gradient density of `prop:no_distant_equilibrium`'s proof (`proofs.tex:822`).

decls.name: integral_gradDensity
decls.statement: theorem integral_gradDensity {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (h : Invariant K lam) (r φ : V → ℝ) : ∑ x, lam x * gradDensity K r φ x = ∑ x, lam x * (φ x * (1 - r x))
decls.doc: **`∫ D dλ = ∫ φ(1 − r) dλ`** (`proofs.tex:824`), from `integral_funAct`.

decls.name: integral_gradDensity_potential
decls.statement: theorem integral_gradDensity_potential {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (h : Invariant K lam) (gd : ℝ → ℝ) (r w : V → ℝ) : ∑ x, lam x * gradDensity K r (fun y => gd (r y) * w y) x = ∑ x, lam x * (gd (r x) * (1 - r x) * w x)
decls.doc: **`∫ D dλ = ∫ g'(r)(1 − r)(dν/dμ) dλ`** (`proofs.tex:824`), the mass identity itself, at `φ = g'(r)·(dν/dμ)`.

decls.name: StrictlyUnimodal
decls.statement: def StrictlyUnimodal (gd : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **Strict unimodality** (`proofs.tex:809`): `sign g'(x) = sign(x − 1)` for `x ≠ 1`, on the domain `ℝ_+^*` of the generator.

decls.name: term_neg
decls.statement: theorem term_neg {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) {l rx wx : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hr : 0 < rx) (hw : 0 < wx) (hne : rx ≠ 1) : l * (gd rx * (1 - rx) * wx) < 0
decls.doc: **`g'(r)(1 − r) < 0` wherever `r ≠ 1`** (`proofs.tex:826`), weighted by `λ > 0` and `dν/dμ > 0`.

decls.name: term_nonpos
decls.statement: theorem term_nonpos {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) {l rx wx : ℝ} (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hr : 0 < rx) (hw : 0 < wx) : l * (gd rx * (1 - rx) * wx) ≤ 0
decls.doc: The integrand of the mass identity is nonpositive (`proofs.tex:826`).

decls.name: term_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem term_eq_zero_iff {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) {l rx wx : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hr : 0 < rx) (hw : 0 < wx) : l * (gd rx * (1 - rx) * wx) = 0 ↔ rx = 1
decls.doc: It vanishes exactly at `r = 1` (`proofs.tex:826`), where `λ > 0` and `dν/dμ > 0` are what turns "vanishes" into "`r = 1`".

decls.name: pushMass
decls.statement: def pushMass (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The measure `μT` as a vector against the counting structure: `y ↦ ∑_x λ(x) u(x) K(x,y)`, which is `d(μT)/dλ · λ` for `μ = uλ`.

decls.name: Balanced
decls.statement: def Balanced (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`μ` is balanced**: `μT = μ` (`proofs.tex:826`).

decls.name: ratio
decls.statement: noncomputable def ratio (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`r = d(μT)/dμ`** (`proofs.tex:448`, restated at `proofs.tex:842`) for `μ = uλ`.

decls.name: ratio_pos
decls.statement: theorem ratio_pos {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (y : V) : 0 < ratio K lam u y
decls.doc: **`r > 0` is derived, not hypothesised.** Invariance gives `∑_x λ(x)K(x,y) = λ(y) > 0`, so some `x` sends positive mass into `y`; `u > 0` then makes the numerator of `r(y)` positive.

decls.name: ratio_eq_one_iff_balanced
decls.statement: theorem ratio_eq_one_iff_balanced {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ y, 0 < lam y * u y) : (∀ y, ratio K lam u y = 1) ↔ Balanced K lam u
decls.doc: **`r ≡ 1` if and only if `μT = μ`** (`proofs.tex:826`: "`r = 1` […] `μ`-a.e., i.e.

decls.name: lossGradDensity
decls.statement: noncomputable def lossGradDensity (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u w : V → ℝ) (gd : ℝ → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The gradient density `D = Qφ − rφ` at `φ = g'(r)·(dν/dμ)`, with `r` the ratio of `μ = uλ` and `w = dν/dμ`.

decls.name: gradMass
decls.statement: noncomputable def gradMass (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam u w : V → ℝ) (gd : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The total mass of `∇^λ 𝓛_{g,ν}(μ)`**, `∫ D dλ`, on that same reading.

decls.name: no_distant_equilibrium_one
decls.statement: theorem no_distant_equilibrium_one {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) : gradMass K lam u w gd = ∑ x, lam x * (gd (ratio K lam u x) * (1 - ratio K lam u x) * w x) ∧ gradMass K lam u w gd ≤ 0 ∧ (gradMass K lam u w gd = 0 ↔ Balanced K lam u)
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(1)*, the mass identity** (statement `proofs.tex:810–811`, proof `proofs.tex:822–826`).

decls.name: balanced_of_critical
decls.statement: theorem balanced_of_critical {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hD : ∀ x, lossGradDensity K lam u w gd x = 0) : Balanced K lam u
decls.doc: **"Every critical point of `𝓛_{g,ν}` is therefore balanced"** (`proofs.tex:811`, proof `proofs.tex:826`: "at a critical point `D = 0`, so the mass vanishes and `μ` is balanced").

decls.name: global_dichotomy_full_one
decls.statement: theorem global_dichotomy_full_one {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) : gradMass K lam u w gd = ∑ x, lam x * (gd (ratio K lam u x) * (1 - ratio K lam u x) * w x) ∧ gradMass K lam u w gd ≤ 0 ∧ (gradMass K lam u w gd = 0 ↔ Balanced K lam u)
decls.doc: **`theo:global_dichotomy_full`*(1)*, the mass-identity half** (statement `proofs.tex:841–847`, item *(1)* at `:844`; proof `proofs.tex:849–851`).

decls.name: strictlyUnimodal_sqDeriv
decls.statement: theorem strictlyUnimodal_sqDeriv : StrictlyUnimodal fun x : ℝ => 2 * (x - 1)
decls.doc: `g = (x − 1)²`, so `g'(x) = 2(x − 1)`, is strictly unimodal (`proofs.tex:809`).

decls.name: strictlyUnimodal_logSqDeriv
decls.statement: theorem strictlyUnimodal_logSqDeriv : StrictlyUnimodal fun x : ℝ => 2 * Real.log x / x
decls.doc: `g = (log x)²`, so `g'(x) = 2 log x / x`, is strictly unimodal (`proofs.tex:809`) — the paper's practical generator.

decls.name: invariant_of_isInvProb
decls.statement: theorem invariant_of_isInvProb {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) : Invariant B.phat lam
decls.doc: `GFNBounds.Graph`'s `IsInvProb` supplies this file's `Invariant` verbatim: `IsInvProb.inv` is `∀ y, ∑ x, λ(x) π̂_←(x,y) = λ(y)`.

decls.name: no_distant_equilibrium_one_graph
decls.statement: theorem no_distant_equilibrium_one_graph {lam u w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) : gradMass B.phat lam u w gd = ∑ x, lam x * (gd (ratio B.phat lam u x) * (1 - ratio B.phat lam u x) * w x) ∧ gradMass B.phat lam u w gd ≤ 0 ∧ (gradMass B.phat lam u w gd = 0 ↔ Balanced B.phat lam u)
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(1)* and `theo:global_dichotomy_full`*(1)* on the backward chain of a finite path-connected marked graph**, the setting every downstream use is in.

decls.name: balanced_of_critical_graph
decls.statement: theorem balanced_of_critical_graph {lam u w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hD : ∀ x, lossGradDensity B.phat lam u w gd x = 0) : Balanced B.phat lam u
decls.doc: **Every critical point is balanced, on a finite marked graph** — on the reading of *critical* disclosed in the module SCOPE.

files.title: From the ratio variable to the density variable: the local-phase rescaling step
variables: variable, `∀ x, |r(x) − 1| < δ`. Step 4 of `theo:local_convergence_full` wants a radius in the

decls.name: Aop_eq_ratio_sub_one_mul
decls.statement: theorem Aop_eq_ratio_sub_one_mul {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {y : V} (hy : u y ≠ 0) : Aop K lam u y = (ratio K lam u y - 1) * u y
decls.doc: **`(P−I)u = (r−1)u` at a state** (`proofs.tex:813`): `Au y = (r(y) − 1)u(y)` whenever `u y ≠ 0`.

decls.name: Aop_eq_ratio_sub_one
decls.statement: theorem Aop_eq_ratio_sub_one {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} (hu : ∀ x, u x ≠ 0) : Aop K lam u = fun y => (ratio K lam u y - 1) * u y
decls.doc: **`(P−I)u = (r−1)u`**, unapplied, for a nowhere-vanishing density — the form a norm consumes.

decls.name: nrmL2_Aop_le_of_ratio_close
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_Aop_le_of_ratio_close {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {δ : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hu : ∀ x, u x ≠ 0) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hratio : ∀ x, |ratio K lam u x - 1| ≤ δ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam u) ≤ δ * Graph.nrmL2 lam u
decls.doc: **`‖(P−I)u‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ δ‖u‖_{L²(λ)}`** (`proofs.tex:813`): the ratios lying in the band `|r − 1| ≤ δ` dominate `Au` by `δ|u|` state by state, and `L2Toolkit.nrmL2_le_of_abs_le` lifts that to the norm.

decls.name: nrmL2_perpL2_le_of_ratio_close
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_perpL2_le_of_ratio_close {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {Bhat δ : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hu : ∀ x, u x ≠ 0) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hratio : ∀ x, |ratio K lam u x - 1| ≤ δ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam u) ≤ Bhat * δ * Graph.nrmL2 lam u
decls.doc: **`‖u − Πu‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ B̂δ‖u‖_{L²(λ)}`** (`proofs.tex:813`, "Lemma `lem:sigma_mixing` yields `‖u − Πu‖ ≤ B̂δ‖u₀‖`"): the coercivity read at `u` itself, composed with the previous bound.

decls.name: dev_eq_smul_perpL2
decls.statement: theorem dev_eq_smul_perpL2 {lam u : V → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hmdef : Graph.meanL2 lam u = m) : (fun x => u x / m - 1) = fun x => m⁻¹ * perpL2 lam u x
decls.doc: **`h = m^{-1}(u − Πu)`** (`proofs.tex:813`): the deviation of the rescaled density is the orthogonal part of `u` divided by the mass, because `Πu` **is** `m`.

decls.name: meanL2_dev_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_dev_eq_zero {lam u : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {m : ℝ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hmdef : Graph.meanL2 lam u = m) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => u x / m - 1) = 0
decls.doc: **`Πh = 0`** (`proofs.tex:813`, "`h := u/m_t − 1` is mean-zero"), on a probability `λ`.

decls.name: rescaled_dev_bound
decls.statement: theorem rescaled_dev_bound {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {Bhat δ m0 U0 : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, u x ≠ 0) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hratio : ∀ x, |ratio K lam u x - 1| ≤ δ) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hmass : m0 ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam u) (hu0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = U0) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => u x / Graph.meanL2 lam u - 1) = 0 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u x / Graph.meanL2 lam u - 1) ≤ Bhat * δ * U0 / m0
decls.doc: **The payoff sentence** (`proofs.tex:813`): with `m := Πu ≥ m₀ > 0` and `‖u‖ = U₀`, the rescaled deviation `h := u/m − 1` is mean-zero and satisfies `‖h‖ ≤ B̂δU₀/m₀`.

decls.name: delta0
decls.statement: noncomputable def delta0 (eps0 m0 Bhat U0 : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`δ₀ := ε₀m₀/(B̂‖u₀‖)`** (`proofs.tex:813`, `:927`) — an explicit formula, not an `∃ δ`.

decls.name: delta0_pos
decls.statement: theorem delta0_pos {eps0 m0 Bhat U0 : ℝ} (heps0 : 0 < eps0) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hB : 0 < Bhat) (hU0 : 0 < U0) : 0 < delta0 eps0 m0 Bhat U0

decls.name: mass_le_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem mass_le_nrmL2 {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {lam u : V → ℝ} {m0 U0 : ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) (hmass : m0 ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam u) (hu0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = U0) : m0 ≤ U0
decls.doc: **`m₀ ≤ ‖u₀‖`**, the hypothesis `delta0_le_eps0` needs, discharged from the flow's own data: `m₀ ≤ Πu` is the monotone ascent and `Πu ≤ ‖u‖` is Cauchy–Schwarz against `𝟏` (`MassAscent.mean_le_nrmL2_iff_const`, whose `u ≥ 0` is what a density has).

decls.name: delta0_le_eps0
decls.statement: theorem delta0_le_eps0 {eps0 m0 Bhat U0 : ℝ} (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps0) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hmU : m0 ≤ U0) : delta0 eps0 m0 Bhat U0 ≤ eps0
decls.doc: **`δ₀ ≤ ε₀`**, from `m₀ ≤ ‖u₀‖` (`mass_le_nrmL2`, i.e.

decls.name: delta0_le_half
decls.statement: theorem delta0_le_half {eps0 m0 Bhat U0 : ℝ} (heps0 : 0 ≤ eps0) (heps1 : eps0 ≤ 1/2) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hmU : m0 ≤ U0) : delta0 eps0 m0 Bhat U0 ≤ 1/2
decls.doc: **`δ₀ ≤ 1/2`**, the side condition `MassAscent.entry_time` requires of its `δ` and the paper never states.

decls.name: exists_delta_for_radius
decls.statement: theorem exists_delta_for_radius {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u : V → ℝ} {Bhat m0 U0 eps0 : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, u x ≠ 0) (hB : 0 < Bhat) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (heps0 : 0 < eps0) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hmass : m0 ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam u) (hu0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = U0) (hratio : ∀ x, |ratio K lam u x - 1| ≤ delta0 eps0 m0 Bhat U0) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => u x / Graph.meanL2 lam u - 1) = 0 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u x / Graph.meanL2 lam u - 1) ≤ eps0
decls.doc: **The inversion `theo:training_speed_full` quotes** (`proofs.tex:927`): at `δ = δ₀` the bound of `rescaled_dev_bound` is exactly `ε₀`, so the rescaled flow sits inside the `ε₀`-neighbourhood that `theo:local_convergence_full` asks for.

decls.name: twoState_ratio_close
decls.statement: theorem twoState_ratio_close : ∀ x, |ratio twoStateK twoStateLam twoStateU x - 1| ≤ 1/2
decls.doc: The band the two-state density sits in: `|r − 1| = (1/4, 1/2)`, so `δ = 1/2` is exact.

decls.name: twoState_meanL2
decls.statement: theorem twoState_meanL2 : Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam twoStateU = 3/2

decls.name: twoState_nrmL2_u
decls.statement: theorem twoState_nrmL2_u : Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam twoStateU = Real.sqrt (5/2)

decls.name: twoState_ratioBridge_check
decls.statement: theorem twoState_ratioBridge_check : Aop twoStateK twoStateLam twoStateU 0 = -(1/2) ∧ Aop twoStateK twoStateLam twoStateU 1 = 1/2 ∧ Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam twoStateU = 3/2 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam twoStateU = Real.sqrt (5/2) ∧ Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam (fun x => twoStateU x / Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam twoStateU - 1) = 0 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (fun x => twoStateU x / Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam twoStateU - 1) = 1/3 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (fun x => twoStateU x / Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam twoStateU - 1) ≤ 1 * (1/2) * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam twoStateU / (3/2) ∧ delta0 (1/2) (3/2) 1 (Real.sqrt (5/2)) ≤ 1/2
decls.doc: **The bridge evaluated on the two-state chain.** Every number was computed by hand first; the last clause is `rescaled_dev_bound` applied, not recomputed.

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : MarkedGraph V} {B : BackwardPolicy G}

decls.name: convex_deriv_ne_zero
