decls.statement: theorem convex_deriv_ne_zero {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) g) (hdiff : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hx1 : x ≠ 1) : deriv g x ≠ 0
decls.doc: **A convex admissible generator has `g' ≠ 0` off `1`.**

decls.name: convex_no_flat_band
decls.statement: theorem convex_no_flat_band {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) g) (hdiff : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hα : 0 < α) (hside : β < 1 ∨ 1 < α) : ¬ ∀ x ∈ Icc α β, deriv g x = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*, first sentence**: a convex admissible generator has no flat band `[α, β] ⊂ (0,1)` or `[α, β] ⊂ (1,∞)`.

decls.name: deriv_one_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem deriv_one_eq_zero {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g 1) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) : deriv g 1 = 0
decls.doc: `g'(1) = 0` for a differentiable admissible generator: `1` is a minimum.

decls.name: convex_small_deriv
decls.statement: theorem convex_small_deriv {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) g) (hdiff : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) : (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → deriv g x ≤ 0) ∧ ∀ {x₀ ε : ℝ}, 0 < x₀ → x₀ < 1 → |deriv g x₀| ≤ ε → ∀ x ∈ Icc x₀ 1, |deriv g x| ≤ ε ∧ g x ≤ ε * (1 - x₀)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*, second sentence**: a convex differentiable admissible generator has `g' ≤ 0` on `(0,1)`, and `|g'(x₀)| ≤ ε` at one `x₀ < 1` forces `|g'| ≤ ε` and `g ≤ ε(1 − x₀)` on `[x₀, 1]`.

decls.name: analytic_const_of_flat
decls.statement: theorem analytic_const_of_flat {g : ℝ → ℝ} (han : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ g (Ioi 0)) {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hflat : ∀ x ∈ Ioo p q, deriv g x = 0) : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → g x = g y
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*, third sentence**: a generator real-analytic on `(0,∞)` whose derivative vanishes on a non-degenerate interval `(p, q) ⊂ (0,∞)` is constant on `(0,∞)`.

decls.name: analytic_admissible_no_flat
decls.statement: theorem analytic_admissible_no_flat {g : ℝ → ℝ} (han : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ g (Ioi 0)) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) : ¬ ∀ x ∈ Ioo p q, deriv g x = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: real-analytic admissible generators cannot freeze exactly** — no admissible `g` real-analytic on `(0,∞)` has `g' ≡ 0` on a non-degenerate interval of `(0,∞)`.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_logSqDeriv
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_logSqDeriv {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : HasDerivAt logSqDeriv (2 * (1 - Real.log x) / x ^ 2) x
decls.doc: **`g''(x) = 2(1 − log x)/x²`** for `g = (log x)²`, as the derivative of `logSqDeriv`.

decls.name: deriv_deriv_logSq
decls.statement: theorem deriv_deriv_logSq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : deriv (deriv logSq) x = 2 * (1 - Real.log x) / x ^ 2
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: `g''(x) = 2(1 − log x)/x²`** for `g = (log x)²`, as the second derivative of `logSq` itself.

decls.name: deriv_deriv_logSq_neg
decls.statement: theorem deriv_deriv_logSq_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp 1 < x) : deriv (deriv logSq) x < 0
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: `g'' < 0` on `(e, ∞)`** for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: logSq_not_convexOn
decls.statement: theorem logSq_not_convexOn : ¬ ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) logSq
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: `(log x)²` is not convex** on `(0,∞)`: its derivative would be monotone, and `g'(e) = 2/e > 4/e² = g'(e²)` since `e > 2`.

decls.name: tendsto_logSqDeriv_atTop
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_logSqDeriv_atTop : Tendsto logSqDeriv atTop (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: `g' → 0` at `+∞`** for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: tendsto_abs_logSqDeriv_nhdsGT_zero
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_abs_logSqDeriv_nhdsGT_zero : Tendsto (fun x => |logSqDeriv x|) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: `|g'| → ∞` at `0⁺`** for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: logSq_critical_balanced
decls.statement: theorem logSq_critical_balanced {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hcrit : ∀ d : V → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam nu (fun x => u x + t * d x) logSq) 0 0) : Balanced K lam u
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(i)*: `(log x)²` has no spurious critical point** — it is strictly unimodal, so by `prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(1)* every flow at which every directional derivative of `𝓛_{(log x)², ν}` vanishes is balanced, for `ν` of positive density.

decls.name: deltaBands
decls.statement: noncomputable def deltaBands (δ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < δ) (h1 : δ < 1 / 4) : FreezingBands
decls.doc: **The bands of `rem:freezing`*(ii)***: `(a,b,c,d) = (1−2δ, 1−δ, 1+δ, 1+2δ)` for `δ ∈ (0, 1/4)`.

decls.name: etaVec
decls.statement: noncomputable def etaVec (s η : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ
decls.doc: The density `(s, s(1−η))` against `λ = (1/2,1/2)`: at `s = 2` the flow `μ = (1, 1−η)` of the remark, at `s = 1` the flow `(1+h)λ` with `h = (0, −η)`.

decls.name: etaVec_pos
decls.statement: theorem etaVec_pos {s η : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hη : η < 1) (x : Fin 2) : 0 < etaVec s η x

decls.name: ratio_etaVec_zero
decls.statement: theorem ratio_etaVec_zero {s η : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec s η) 0 = 1 - η / 2
decls.doc: `r(0) = 1 − η/2` on the two-state chain.

decls.name: ratio_etaVec_one
decls.statement: theorem ratio_etaVec_one {s η : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hη : η < 1) : ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec s η) 1 = (1 - η / 2) / (1 - η)
decls.doc: `r(1) = (1 − η/2)/(1 − η)` on the two-state chain.

decls.name: etaVec_mem_frozen
decls.statement: theorem etaVec_mem_frozen {δ η s : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < δ) (h1 : δ < 1 / 4) (hs : 0 < s) (hη1 : 2 * δ < η) (hη2 : η < 4 * δ / (1 + 4 * δ)) : etaVec s η ∈ frozen twoStateK twoStateLam (deltaBands δ h0 h1).bands
decls.doc: **The window of `rem:freezing`*(ii)***: for `2δ < η < 4δ/(1+4δ)` the two ratios lie in `U⁻ = (1−2δ, 1−δ)` and `U⁺ = (1+δ, 1+2δ)`.

decls.name: freezing_two_frozen
decls.statement: theorem freezing_two_frozen {δ η : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < δ) (h1 : δ < 1 / 4) (hη1 : 2 * δ < η) (hη2 : η < 4 * δ / (1 + 4 * δ)) : ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 η) 0 = 1 - η / 2 ∧ ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 η) 1 = (1 - η / 2) / (1 - η) ∧ etaVec 2 η ∈ frozen twoStateK twoStateLam (deltaBands δ h0 h1).bands ∧ (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℝ) (x : Fin 2), lossGradDensity twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 η) w (deriv (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g) x = 0) ∧ (∀ nu : Fin 2 → ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun u' => loss twoStateK twoStateLam nu u' (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g) (0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (etaVec 2 η)) ∧ (∀ (w : Fin 2 → ℝ) (eps : ℝ), (fun x => etaVec 2 η x - eps * lossGradDensity twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 η) w (deriv (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g) x) = etaVec 2 η) ∧ Balanced twoStateK twoStateLam (fun _ => 2) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (fun x => etaVec 2 η x - 2) = Real.sqrt 2 * η ∧ Real.sqrt 2 * η < 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * δ
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(ii)*, the frozen flows**: for `δ ∈ (0,1/4)` and `2δ < η < 4δ/(1+4δ)`, the flow `μ = (1, 1−η)` on the two-state chain (density `u = (2, 2(1−η))` against `λ`) has `r = (1 − η/2, (1−η/2)/(1−η)) ∈ U⁻ × U⁺`; so item *(1)* of `prop:nonlinear_freezing` freezes it for the generator of the bands `(1−2δ, 1−δ, 1+δ, 1+2δ)` — its gradient density vanishes for every training measure, the loss has Fréchet derivative `0` there for every `ν`, and every gradient-descent step fixes it — and it lies at `L²(λ)`-distance `√2·η < 4√2·δ` from the balanced flow `2·𝟙` of the balanced ray.

decls.name: freezing_two_example
decls.statement: theorem freezing_two_example : 2 * (1 / 10 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 ∧ (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 4 * (1 / 10) / (1 + 4 * (1 / 10)) ∧ ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 (1 / 4)) 0 = 0.875 ∧ ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 (1 / 4)) 1 = 7 / 6 ∧ |ratio twoStateK twoStateLam (etaVec 2 (1 / 4)) 1 - 1.1667| < 1 / 20000
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(ii)*, the numerical instance**: at `δ = 1/10`, `η = 1/4` lies in the window and gives `r = (0.875, 7/6)`, `7/6 = 1.1667` to four decimals.

decls.name: third_deriv_bound
decls.statement: theorem third_deriv_bound {g g1 g2 g3 : ℝ → ℝ} {δ M : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) (hd0 : HasDerivAt g (g1 1) 1) (hd1 : ∀ x ∈ Icc 1 (1 + δ), HasDerivWithinAt g1 (g2 x) (Icc 1 (1 + δ)) x) (hd2 : ∀ x ∈ Icc 1 (1 + δ), HasDerivWithinAt g2 (g3 x) (Icc 1 (1 + δ)) x) (hflat : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1 + δ) (1 + 2 * δ), g1 x = 0) (h2 : g2 1 = 2) (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc 1 (1 + δ), |g3 x| ≤ M) : 4 / δ ≤ M
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(ii)*, the third-derivative bound**: an admissible generator, differentiable at `1`, with `g''` and `g'''` on `[1, 1+δ]`, `g''(1) = 2` and `g' ≡ 0` on `[1+δ, 1+2δ]` has `|g'''| ≤ M` on `[1, 1+δ]` only for `M ≥ 4/δ`.

decls.name: third_deriv_sSup
decls.statement: theorem third_deriv_sSup {g g1 g2 g3 : ℝ → ℝ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) (hd0 : HasDerivAt g (g1 1) 1) (hd1 : ∀ x ∈ Icc 1 (1 + δ), HasDerivWithinAt g1 (g2 x) (Icc 1 (1 + δ)) x) (hd2 : ∀ x ∈ Icc 1 (1 + δ), HasDerivWithinAt g2 (g3 x) (Icc 1 (1 + δ)) x) (hflat : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1 + δ) (1 + 2 * δ), g1 x = 0) (h2 : g2 1 = 2) (hbdd : BddAbove ((fun x => |g3 x|) '' Icc 1 (1 + δ))) : 4 / δ ≤ sSup ((fun x => |g3 x|) '' Icc 1 (1 + δ))
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(ii)*: `sup_{[1,1+δ]} |g'''| ≥ 4/δ`**, the supremum form of `third_deriv_bound`, for a `|g'''|` bounded on `[1, 1+δ]`.

decls.name: deltaBands_third_deriv
decls.statement: theorem deltaBands_third_deriv {δ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < δ) (h1 : δ < 1 / 4) : 4 / δ ≤ sSup ((fun x => |deriv (deriv (deriv (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g)) x|) '' Icc 1 (1 + δ))
decls.doc: **The bound is met by the generator of the bands**: for `F = deltaBands δ`, the `C^∞` admissible generator of `prop:nonlinear_freezing` at `(1−2δ, 1−δ, 1+δ, 1+2δ)` has `sup_{[1,1+δ]} |g'''| ≥ 4/δ` — so the hypothesis bundle of `third_deriv_sSup` is inhabited, at every `δ ∈ (0, 1/4)`.

decls.name: frozen_near_balance
decls.statement: theorem frozen_near_balance {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ (δ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < δ) (h1 : δ < 1 / 4) (h : Fin 2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g ∧ deriv (deriv (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g) 1 = 2 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam h ≤ ε ∧ ¬ Balanced twoStateK twoStateLam (fun x => 1 + h x) ∧ ∀ nu : Fin 2 → ℝ, IsGradientFlow twoStateK twoStateLam nu (deriv (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g) (fun _ x => 1 + h x)
decls.doc: **Frozen flows arbitrarily close to balance, at `g''(1) = 2`**: for every `ε > 0` some `C^∞` admissible generator with `g''(1) = 2` (the generator of `deltaBands`) has, on the two-state chain — `β̂ₙ = 0` for `n ≥ 1`, `B̂ = 1` — a flow `(1+h)λ` with `‖h‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ε` which is not balanced and whose constant curve is a gradient flow for every training measure.

decls.name: radius_not_uniform_in_generator
decls.statement: theorem radius_not_uniform_in_generator : ¬ ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ (F : FreezingBands) (u : ℝ → Fin 2 → ℝ), IsGradientFlow twoStateK twoStateLam twoStateLam (deriv F.g) u → Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (fun x => u 0 x - 1) ≤ ε₀ → ∃ c : Fin 2 → ℝ, Balanced twoStateK twoStateLam c ∧ Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 c)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(ii)*, last clause: the radius `ε₀` of `theo:local_convergence_full` must depend on `g` beyond `g''(1)`.** On the two-state chain with `w ≡ 1` — so `B̂ = 1`, `C_∞ = √2`, `w_min = ‖w‖_∞ = 1`, all fixed — no single `ε₀ > 0` makes every gradient flow started within `ε₀` of `λ` in `L²(λ)` converge to a balanced flow, uniformly over the `C^∞` admissible generators with `g''(1) = 2` of `prop:nonlinear_freezing`.

decls.name: eps0C3_deltaBands_small
decls.statement: theorem eps0C3_deltaBands_small {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ (δ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < δ) (h1 : δ < 1 / 4), eps0C3 (deltaBands δ h0 h1).g (1 / 2) 1 1 1 (1 / 2) < ε
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(ii)*, last clause, on the certified radius itself**: the radius `ε₀ = eps0C3 g a w_min ‖w‖_∞ B̂ λ_min` of `C3Wrappers.local_convergence_full_C3`, evaluated on the two-state chain (`a = 1/2`, `w ≡ 1`, `B̂ = 1`, `λ_min = 1/2` — every argument but `g` fixed) at the `C^∞` admissible generators of `deltaBands` (all with `g''(1) = 2`), takes values below every `ε > 0`: a frozen flow within `ε` of `λ` is not balanced, so the theorem cannot apply to it.

decls.name: zeta
decls.statement: noncomputable def zeta (t : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `ζ := φ_{a,b} φ_{c,d}`, vanishing exactly on the closed bands.

decls.name: xi
decls.statement: noncomputable def xi (θ t : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `ξ := φ_{1−θ,1+θ}`, vanishing exactly on `[1−θ, 1+θ]`.

decls.name: mTheta
decls.statement: noncomputable def mTheta (θ t : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The multiplier of `rem:freezing`*(iii)***: `m := 2ζ/(ζ+ξ)`.

decls.name: gTheta
decls.statement: noncomputable def gTheta (θ x : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The generator of `rem:freezing`*(iii)***: `g(x) := ∫₁ˣ m(t)(t−1) dt`.

decls.name: ThetaOK
decls.statement: structure ThetaOK (θ : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: The standing hypothesis `0 < θ < min(1 − b, c − 1)`.

decls.name: zeta_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem zeta_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ zeta F t

decls.name: xi_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem xi_nonneg (θ t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ xi θ t

decls.name: zeta_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem zeta_eq_zero_iff {t : ℝ} : zeta F t = 0 ↔ t ∈ Icc F.a F.b ∪ Icc F.c F.d
decls.doc: **`ζ` vanishes exactly on `[a,b] ∪ [c,d]`.**

decls.name: xi_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem xi_eq_zero_iff {θ t : ℝ} : xi θ t = 0 ↔ t ∈ Icc (1 - θ) (1 + θ)
decls.doc: **`ξ` vanishes exactly on `[1−θ, 1+θ]`.**

decls.name: zeta_add_xi_pos
decls.statement: theorem zeta_add_xi_pos {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) (t : ℝ) : 0 < zeta F t + xi θ t
decls.doc: **The two zero sets are disjoint**, so `ζ + ξ > 0`.

decls.name: contDiff_zeta
decls.statement: theorem contDiff_zeta : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (zeta F)

decls.name: contDiff_mTheta
decls.statement: theorem contDiff_mTheta {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (mTheta F θ)

decls.name: continuous_mTheta
decls.statement: theorem continuous_mTheta {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : Continuous (mTheta F θ)

decls.name: mTheta_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem mTheta_nonneg {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ mTheta F θ t

decls.name: mTheta_le_two
decls.statement: theorem mTheta_le_two {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) (t : ℝ) : mTheta F θ t ≤ 2

decls.name: mTheta_eq_two
decls.statement: theorem mTheta_eq_two {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (1 - θ) (1 + θ)) : mTheta F θ t = 2

decls.name: mTheta_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem mTheta_eq_zero_iff {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {t : ℝ} : mTheta F θ t = 0 ↔ t ∈ Icc F.a F.b ∪ Icc F.c F.d
decls.doc: **`m` vanishes exactly on `[a,b] ∪ [c,d]`.**

decls.name: mTheta_pos_of_mem_Ioo
decls.statement: theorem mTheta_pos_of_mem_Ioo {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {t : ℝ} (h1 : F.b < t) (h2 : t < F.c) : 0 < mTheta F θ t

decls.name: continuous_integrandTheta
decls.statement: theorem continuous_integrandTheta {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : Continuous fun t => mTheta F θ t * (t - 1)

decls.name: gTheta_one
decls.statement: theorem gTheta_one (θ : ℝ) : gTheta F θ 1 = 0

decls.name: deriv_gTheta
decls.statement: theorem deriv_gTheta {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : deriv (gTheta F θ) = fun x => mTheta F θ x * (x - 1)

decls.name: differentiable_gTheta
decls.statement: theorem differentiable_gTheta {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : Differentiable ℝ (gTheta F θ)

decls.name: contDiff_gTheta
decls.statement: theorem contDiff_gTheta {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gTheta F θ)

decls.name: deriv_gTheta_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem deriv_gTheta_eq_zero {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ F.bands) : deriv (gTheta F θ) x = 0
decls.doc: **`g' ≡ 0` on the bands.**

decls.name: gTheta_pos
decls.statement: theorem gTheta_pos {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 1) : 0 < gTheta F θ x

decls.name: deriv_deriv_gTheta_one
decls.statement: theorem deriv_deriv_gTheta_one {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : deriv (deriv (gTheta F θ)) 1 = 2

decls.name: gTheta_eq_sq
decls.statement: theorem gTheta_eq_sq {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (1 - θ) (1 + θ)) : gTheta F θ x = (x - 1) ^ 2

decls.name: abs_gTheta_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_gTheta_le {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) (x : ℝ) : |gTheta F θ x| ≤ (x - 1) ^ 2

decls.name: freezing_three_multiplier
decls.statement: theorem freezing_three_multiplier {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (mTheta F θ) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ mTheta F θ t ∧ mTheta F θ t ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Icc (1 - θ) (1 + θ), mTheta F θ t = 2) ∧ (∀ t, mTheta F θ t = 0 ↔ t ∈ Icc F.a F.b ∪ Icc F.c F.d)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iii)*, the multiplier**: `m = 2ζ/(ζ+ξ)` is `C^∞` with values in `[0,2]`, equals `2` on `[1−θ, 1+θ]`, and vanishes exactly on `[a,b] ∪ [c,d]`.

decls.name: freezing_three_generator
decls.statement: theorem freezing_three_generator {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gTheta F θ) ∧ gTheta F θ 1 = 0 ∧ (∀ x ≠ (1:ℝ), 0 < gTheta F θ x) ∧ deriv (deriv (gTheta F θ)) 1 = 2 ∧ (∀ x, |gTheta F θ x| ≤ 2 * (1 + |x| ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ F.bands, deriv (gTheta F θ) x = 0) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Icc (1 - θ) (1 + θ), gTheta F θ x = (x - 1) ^ 2)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iii)*, the generator**: `g(x) := ∫₁ˣ m(t)(t−1) dt` is `C^∞` and admissible — `g(1) = 0`, `g > 0` elsewhere, `g''(1) = 2`, `|g(x)| ≤ 2(1 + |x|²)` — with `g' ≡ 0` on the bands, and it equals `(x − 1)²` on `[1−θ, 1+θ]`.

decls.name: freezing_three_item_one
decls.statement: theorem freezing_three_item_one {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hu : u ∈ frozen K lam F.bands) : (∀ w : V → ℝ, ∀ x, lossGradDensity K lam u w (deriv (gTheta F θ)) x = 0) ∧ (∀ nu' : V → ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun u' => loss K lam nu' u' (gTheta F θ)) (0 : (V → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) u) ∧ IsOpen (frozen K lam F.bands) ∧ (∀ᶠ u' in 𝓝 u, loss K lam nu u' (gTheta F θ) = loss K lam nu u (gTheta F θ)) ∧ 0 < loss K lam nu u (gTheta F θ)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iii)*: item *(1)* of `prop:nonlinear_freezing` applies to it** — on a finite state space a band-valued flow is critical for every training measure (`D ≡ 0`, and a Fréchet derivative `0`), the set of such flows is open, and the loss is locally constant and positive on it.

decls.name: freezing_three_invisible
decls.statement: theorem freezing_three_invisible {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ThetaOK F θ) {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u w : V → ℝ} (hr : ∀ x, ratio K lam u x ∈ Icc (1 - θ) (1 + θ)) : loss K lam nu u (gTheta F θ) = loss K lam nu u (fun z => (z - 1) ^ 2) ∧ lossGradDensity K lam u w (deriv (gTheta F θ)) = lossGradDensity K lam u w (fun z => 2 * (z - 1))
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iii)*: the freezing configurations are invisible to the linearization at balance** — wherever every ratio lies in `[1−θ, 1+θ]`, the loss and the gradient density of this freezing generator are those of `(x − 1)²`.

decls.name: freezing_g_ne_sq_near_one
decls.statement: theorem freezing_g_ne_sq_near_one (F : FreezingBands) : ¬ ∃ ε > 0, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (1 - ε) (1 + ε), F.g x = (x - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iii)*, last clause: the generator of `prop:nonlinear_freezing` equals `(x − 1)²` on no neighbourhood of `1`.** Near `1` its multiplier is `2e^{−1/(t−b)−1/(c−t)}/scale`, and `1/(t−b) + 1/(c−t)` takes its value at `1` only at `t = 1` and `t = b + c − 1`.

decls.name: freezing_four_critical
decls.statement: theorem freezing_four_critical {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu u : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt g (gd y) y) (hgd : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hcrit : ∀ d : V → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam nu (fun x => u x + t * d x) g) 0 0) : Balanced K lam u
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iv)*, first clause**: for a differentiable strictly unimodal generator, every flow at which every directional derivative of `𝓛_{g,ν}` vanishes is balanced, for `ν` of positive density (`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(1)*, through `theo:first_variation_full`).

decls.name: freezing_four_logSq_converges
decls.statement: theorem freezing_four_logSq_converges {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {wmin : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) {u0 : V → ℝ} (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) : ∃ u : ℝ → V → ℝ, u 0 = u0 ∧ IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) ∧ (∀ v : ℝ → V → ℝ, v 0 = u0 → IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv v → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → v t = u t) ∧ Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 fun _ => Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) ∧ Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => Graph.nrmL2 lam u0)
decls.doc: **`rem:freezing`*(iv)*, second clause, the `(log x)²` half**: on the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph, the `(log x)²` gradient flow from every `u₀ > 0` exists, is unique among positive solutions, and converges to the balanced flow of its sphere (`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*, `FlowExistence.no_distant_equilibrium_three_of_init`).

decls.name: ReachIn
decls.statement: def ReachIn (K : V → V → ℝ) : ℕ → V → V → Prop
decls.doc: **`n`-step accessibility** for a kernel: `ReachIn K n x y` iff some path `x = x₀, …, xₙ = y` has `K(xᵢ, xᵢ₊₁) ≠ 0` at every step.

decls.name: ReachIn.append
decls.statement: theorem ReachIn.append {K : V → V → ℝ} {m : ℕ} {x y : V} (hxy : ReachIn K m x y) : ∀ {n : ℕ} {z : V}, ReachIn K n y z → ReachIn K (m + n) x z | 0, z, h => by have h' : y = z

decls.name: PeriodicAt
decls.statement: def PeriodicAt (K : V → V → ℝ) (x₀ : V) (d : ℕ) : Prop
decls.doc: **Periodicity at a state**, read off its return times: `d ≥ 2` divides every `n` with a return `x₀ ⤳ x₀` in `n` steps.

decls.name: exists_cyclic_of_periodicAt
decls.statement: theorem exists_cyclic_of_periodicAt {K : V → V → ℝ} (hirr : ∀ x y, ∃ n, ReachIn K n x y) {x₀ : V} {d : ℕ} (hper : PeriodicAt K x₀ d) : ∃ c : V → ZMod d, ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1
decls.doc: **Cyclic classes from a period**, for an irreducible kernel: the class of `y` is the length of any path `x₀ ⤳ y`, modulo `d`; it is well defined because two such lengths differ by a multiple of `d`, and every transition raises it by `1`.

decls.name: classInd
decls.statement: noncomputable def classInd {d : ℕ} (c : V → ZMod d) (i : ZMod d) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The indicator of a cyclic class.

decls.name: densAct_classInd
decls.statement: theorem densAct_classInd (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {d : ℕ} {c : V → ZMod d} (hc : ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1) (i : ZMod d) : Core.densAct lam K (classInd c i) = classInd c (i + 1)
decls.doc: **The density action moves each cyclic class to the next**: `P 𝟙_{Cᵢ} = 𝟙_{Cᵢ₊₁}`.

decls.name: densOp_pow_classInd
decls.statement: theorem densOp_pow_classInd (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {d : ℕ} {c : V → ZMod d} (hc : ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1) (i : ZMod d) (n : ℕ) : (densOp lam K ^ n) (wtL2 lam (classInd c i)) = wtL2 lam (classInd c (i + n))

decls.name: densOp_pow_mul_meanOp'
decls.statement: theorem densOp_pow_mul_meanOp' (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (n : ℕ) : densOp lam K ^ n * meanOp lam = meanOp lam

decls.name: one_le_beta_of_fixed'
decls.statement: theorem one_le_beta_of_fixed' {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E} {v : E} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hPi : Pi v = 0) {n : ℕ} (hfix : (P ^ n) v = v) : 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta P Pi n
decls.doc: **A non-zero vector killed by `Π` and fixed by `Pⁿ` forces `β̂ₙ ≥ 1`.**

decls.name: beta_mul_ge_one_of_cyclic
decls.statement: theorem beta_mul_ge_one_of_cyclic (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {c : V → ZMod d} (hc : ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1) (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) (d * k)
decls.doc: **`β̂_{dk} ≥ 1` for every `k`** on a chain with `d ≥ 2` cyclic classes: the centred indicator of one class is fixed by `P^d` and killed by `Π`.

decls.name: mixing_fails_of_cyclic
decls.statement: theorem mixing_fails_of_cyclic (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {c : V → ZMod d} (hc : ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1) : (∀ k, 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) (d * k)) ∧ ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n) = ⊤ ∧ ¬ Summable (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) ∧ ¬ Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)
decls.doc: **Summable `L²` mixing fails on a chain with `d ≥ 2` cyclic classes**: `β̂_{dk} ≥ 1` for all `k`, so `∑ₙ β̂ₙ = +∞` (as an extended real), the sequence is not summable, and `Core.Mixing (P, Π)` — `lem:sigma_mixing`'s hypothesis — fails.

decls.name: mixing_fails_of_periodicAt
decls.statement: theorem mixing_fails_of_periodicAt (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hirr : ∀ x y, ∃ n, ReachIn K n x y) {x₀ : V} {d : ℕ} (hper : PeriodicAt K x₀ d) : (∀ k, 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) (d * k)) ∧ ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n) = ⊤ ∧ ¬ Summable (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) ∧ ¬ Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)
decls.doc: **The same, from the period**: on an irreducible chain periodic at some state, summable `L²` mixing fails.

decls.name: phat_isMarkov
decls.statement: theorem phat_isMarkov (B : BackwardPolicy G) : Core.IsMarkov B.phat

decls.name: phat_isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem phat_isInvariant {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) : Core.IsInvariant lam B.phat

decls.name: reachIn_of_breach
decls.statement: theorem reachIn_of_breach {x y : V} (h : B.BReach x y) : ∃ n, ReachIn B.phat n x y
decls.doc: Accessibility in the backward chain gives a path of some length.

decls.name: graphs_vs_L2_periodic
decls.statement: theorem graphs_vs_L2_periodic (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) {x₀ : V} {d : ℕ} (hper : PeriodicAt B.phat x₀ d) : (∀ k, 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) (d * k)) ∧ ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) n) = ⊤ ∧ ¬ Summable (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam)) ∧ ¬ Core.Mixing (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam)
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: summable mixing fails on every periodic loop closure.** On the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph with a backward policy positive on its edges, if the backward chain is periodic at some state — some `d ≥ 2` divides every return time there — then `β̂_{dk} ≥ 1` for every `k`: the coefficients are bounded below along a subsequence, `∑ₙ β̂ₙ = +∞`, and the summable-mixing hypothesis of `theo:universality_L2` at `p = 2` (`Core.Mixing (P, Π)`) fails.

decls.name: leveled_exists_nat
decls.statement: theorem leveled_exists_nat (hpc : G.PathConnected) (x : V) : ∃ n : ℕ, L.lvl x = n
decls.doc: On a path-connected leveled graph every height is a natural number.

decls.name: levNat
decls.statement: noncomputable def levNat (x : V) : ℕ
decls.doc: The height as a natural number.

decls.name: levNat_eq
decls.statement: theorem levNat_eq (hpc : G.PathConnected) (x : V) : (levNat L x : ℝ) = L.lvl x

decls.name: one_le_levNat_snk
decls.statement: theorem one_le_levNat_snk (hpc : G.PathConnected) : 1 ≤ levNat L G.snk
decls.doc: The sink is at height at least `1`: `s₀ ≠ s_f`.

decls.name: leveled_cyclic
decls.statement: theorem leveled_cyclic (hpc : G.PathConnected) (B : BackwardPolicy G) (x y : V) (hxy : B.phat x y ≠ 0) : (-(levNat L y : ZMod (levNat L G.snk + 1))) = -(levNat L x : ZMod (levNat L G.snk + 1)) + 1
decls.doc: **The cyclic classes of a leveled loop closure**: `c(x) := −ℓ(x)` modulo `t_m + 1`, with `t_m = ℓ(s_f)` — every backward step lowers the height by one, and the wrap `s₀ → s_f` raises it by `t_m ≡ −1`.

decls.name: leveled_mixing_fails
decls.statement: theorem leveled_mixing_fails (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) : (∀ k, 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) ((levNat L G.snk + 1) * k)) ∧ ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) n) = ⊤ ∧ ¬ Summable (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam)) ∧ ¬ Core.Mixing (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`, last assertion, and `rem:visit_ratio`'s witness: on a leveled graph the loop-closed chain is periodic and the mixing sum is `+∞`.** With `t_m := ℓ(s_f)`, the classes `−ℓ mod (t_m+1)` are cyclic for the backward chain, so `β̂_{(t_m+1)k} ≥ 1` for every `k`, `∑ₙ β̂ₙ = +∞`, and summable mixing fails — while `B̂_σ ≤ (t_m+1)√((2+t_m)/min N)` (`Morozov.Leveled.bsigma_le`).

decls.name: leveled_bsigma_finite_mixing_infinite
decls.statement: theorem leveled_bsigma_finite_mixing_infinite (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) : (∀ h : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - Graph.meanL2 lam h) ≤ sigmaStar G L.lvl * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar L.lvl) / minOver G (visits G g)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - B.pdens lam h x)) ∧ sigmaStar G L.lvl * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar L.lvl) / minOver G (visits G g)) ≤ (L.lvl G.snk + 1) * Real.sqrt ((2 + L.lvl G.snk) / minOver G (visits G g)) ∧ ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) n) = ⊤
decls.doc: **The leveled graph separates `B̂_σ` from `B̂`**: the coercivity of `prop:morozov_rate`*(2)* holds with `B̂_σ ≤ (t_m+1)√((2+t_m)/min N)` finite, while the mixing sum `∑ₙ β̂ₙ` is `+∞`.

decls.name: norm_S_le_of_coercive
decls.statement: theorem norm_S_le_of_coercive {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E} (hmx : Core.Mixing P Pi) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hco : ∀ v, ‖v - Pi v‖ ≤ C * ‖(1 - P) v‖) (hPi1 : ∀ v, ‖v - Pi v‖ ≤ ‖v‖) : ‖Core.Mixing.S P Pi‖ ≤ C
decls.doc: **The coercivity constant bounds the mixing-sum operator**: if `‖v − Πv‖ ≤ C‖(1 − P)v‖` for every `v` and `‖1 − Π‖ ≤ 1`, then under summable mixing `‖S‖ ≤ C`.

decls.name: coercivity_morozov_op
decls.statement: theorem coercivity_morozov_op (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : ‖v - meanOp lam v‖ ≤ sigmaStar G u * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar u) / minOver G (visits G g)) * ‖(1 - densOp lam B.phat) v‖
decls.doc: `prop:morozov_rate`*(2)* read on the bundled `L²(λ)`: `‖v − Πv‖ ≤ B̂_σ‖(1 − P)v‖`.

decls.name: visit_ratio_norm_S_le
decls.statement: theorem visit_ratio_norm_S_le (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam)) : ‖Core.Mixing.S (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam)‖ ≤ sigmaStar G u * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar u) / minOver G (visits G g))
decls.doc: **`rem:visit_ratio`: `B̂_σ ≥ ‖S‖` wherever `S` is defined** — under summable mixing, the operator `S = ∑ₙ(Pⁿ − Π)` of `lem:sigma_mixing` has operator norm at most the hitting-time constant `B̂_σ = σ_*√((2+σ̄)/min N)` of `prop:morozov_rate`.

decls.name: visit_ratio_mass_lower
decls.statement: theorem visit_ratio_mass_lower (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g σ u w : V → ℝ} {wmin δ : ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hσ : B.IsHitExp σ) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 / 2) (U : Finset V) (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, δ ≤ |ratio B.phat lam u x - 1|) : wmin / maxOver G u * (δ ^ 2 / 2) * ∑ x ∈ U, visits G g x / (2 + B.sigmaBar σ) ≤ ∑ x ∈ U, lam x * (|logSqDeriv (ratio B.phat lam u x) * (1 - ratio B.phat lam u x)| * (w x / u x)) ∧ ∑ x ∈ U, lam x * (|logSqDeriv (ratio B.phat lam u x) * (1 - ratio B.phat lam u x)| * (w x / u x)) ≤ |gradMass B.phat lam u (fun x => w x / u x) logSqDeriv|
decls.doc: **`rem:visit_ratio`, the displayed lower bound**: in the setting of `theo:training_speed_full` — `g = (log x)²`, `ν = wλ` with `w ≥ w_min ≥ 0`, on the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph — at any `μ = uλ ∼ λ`, with `u_max := max u`, the contribution to the gradient mass of a set `U` of states on which `|r − 1| ≥ δ`, `δ ∈ (0, 1/2]`, is `∫_U |g'(r)(1−r)| (dν/dμ) dλ ≥ (w_min/u_max)(δ²/2) ∑_{x∈U} N(x)/(2+σ̄)`, and it is at most the whole gradient mass `|∫ D dλ|`.

decls.name: kpow
decls.statement: def kpow (K : V → V → ℝ) : ℕ → V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **The `n`-step kernel** `Kⁿ(x, y)`.

decls.name: kpow_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem kpow_nonneg (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) : ∀ n x y, 0 ≤ kpow K n x y | 0, x, y => by simp only [kpow] split_ifs · exact zero_le_one · exact le_rfl | n + 1, x, y => Finset.sum_nonneg fun z _ => mul_nonneg (kpow_nonneg hK n x z) (hK z y)

decls.name: kpow_row_sum
decls.statement: theorem kpow_row_sum (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) : ∀ n x, ∑ y, kpow K n x y = 1 | 0, x => by simp only [kpow, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true] | n + 1, x => by simp only [kpow] rw [Finset.sum_comm] simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, hK.row_sum, mul_one] exact kpow_row_sum hK n x

decls.name: kpow_inv
decls.statement: theorem kpow_inv (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) : ∀ n y, ∑ x, lam x * kpow K n x y = lam y | 0, y => by simp only [kpow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true] | n + 1, y => by simp only [kpow, Finset.mul_sum] rw [Finset.sum_comm] have h : ∀ z, ∑ x, lam x * (kpow K n x z * K z y) = lam z * K z y

decls.name: kpow_pos_of_reachIn
decls.statement: theorem kpow_pos_of_reachIn (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x y : V}, ReachIn K n x y → 0 < kpow K n x y | 0, x, y, h => by have h' : x = y

decls.name: densOp_pow_wtL2_kpow
decls.statement: theorem densOp_pow_wtL2_kpow (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (n : ℕ) (a : V → ℝ) : (densOp lam K ^ n) (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (fun y => (∑ x, lam x * kpow K n x y * a x) / lam y)
decls.doc: `Pⁿ` on densities is `a ↦ (∑ₓ λ(x)Kⁿ(x,·)a(x))/λ`.

decls.name: exists_kpow_pos
decls.statement: theorem exists_kpow_pos (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hirr : ∀ x y, ∃ n, ReachIn K n x y) {x₀ : V} (hap : ¬ ∃ d, PeriodicAt K x₀ d) : ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ ∀ x y, 0 < kpow K N x y
decls.doc: **Aperiodicity plus irreducibility make some power of the kernel positive** (Schur's theorem on numerical semigroups, `Nat.exists_mem_closure_of_ge`).

decls.name: variance_contract'
decls.statement: theorem variance_contract' {R : V → V → ℝ} {l h : V → ℝ} {δ : ℝ} (hrow : ∀ y, ∑ x, R y x = 1) (hinv : ∀ x, ∑ y, l y * R y x = l x) (hl : ∀ x, 0 ≤ l x) (hlsum : ∑ x, l x = 1) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hmin : ∀ y x, δ * l x ≤ R y x) (hmean : ∑ x, l x * h x = 0) : ∑ y, l y * (∑ x, R y x * h x) ^ 2 ≤ (1 - δ) * ∑ x, l x * h x ^ 2
decls.doc: **The variance inequality**: a row-stochastic `R ≥ 0` with `λR = λ` and `R(y,x) ≥ δλ(x)` contracts the `λ`-mean-zero functions in `L²(λ)` by `1 − δ`.

decls.name: norm_wtL2_sq'
decls.statement: theorem norm_wtL2_sq' (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : ‖wtL2 lam a‖ ^ 2 = Graph.ipL2 lam a a

decls.name: sum_sq_sub_mean'
decls.statement: theorem sum_sq_sub_mean' {a : V → ℝ} (hlsum : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : ∑ x, lam x * (a x - ∑ z, lam z * a z) ^ 2 = ∑ x, lam x * a x ^ 2 - (∑ z, lam z * a z) ^ 2

decls.name: norm_pow_sub_meanOp_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_pow_sub_meanOp_le (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {N : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hfloor : ∀ x y, ε ≤ kpow K N x y) : ε ≤ 1 ∧ ‖densOp lam K ^ N - meanOp lam‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - ε)
decls.doc: **The `L²(λ)` Doeblin step**: if `Kᴺ(x, y) ≥ ε` everywhere then `‖Pᴺ − Π‖ ≤ √(1 − ε)`.

decls.name: meanOp_mul_densOp_pow'
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_mul_densOp_pow' (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (n : ℕ) : meanOp lam * densOp lam K ^ n = meanOp lam

decls.name: beta_add_le
decls.statement: theorem beta_add_le (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (N n : ℕ) : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) (n + N) ≤ ‖densOp lam K ^ N - meanOp lam‖ * Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n

decls.name: beta_le_two
decls.statement: theorem beta_le_two (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (n : ℕ) : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n ≤ 2
decls.doc: `β̂ₙ ≤ 2`: `P` and `Π` are contractions of `L²(λ)`.

decls.name: beta_le_geometric_of_floor
decls.statement: theorem beta_le_geometric_of_floor (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) {N : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N) (hε : 0 < ε) (hfloor : ∀ x y, ε ≤ kpow K N x y) (n : ℕ) : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n ≤ 2 / (1 - ε / (2 * N)) ^ (N - 1) * (1 - ε / (2 * N)) ^ n
decls.doc: **Geometric decay of the mixing coefficients from a Doeblin floor**: if `Kᴺ ≥ ε > 0` entrywise, then `β̂ₙ ≤ (2/r^{N−1}) rⁿ` with the explicit rate `r = 1 − ε/(2N) < 1`.

decls.name: mixing_of_aperiodic
decls.statement: theorem mixing_of_aperiodic (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hirr : ∀ x y, ∃ n, ReachIn K n x y) {x₀ : V} (hap : ¬ ∃ d, PeriodicAt K x₀ d) : ∃ (N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < N ∧ 0 < ε ∧ (∀ x y, ε ≤ kpow K N x y) ∧ (∀ n, Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) n ≤ 2 / (1 - ε / (2 * N)) ^ (N - 1) * (1 - ε / (2 * N)) ^ n) ∧ 1 - ε / (2 * N) < 1 ∧ Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: a finite irreducible aperiodic chain has summable `L²` mixing, at a geometric rate.** For `K` Markov with an invariant probability `λ > 0`, irreducible, and aperiodic at some state — no `d ≥ 2` divides all its return times — some `N ≥ 1` has `Kᴺ ≥ ε > 0` entrywise, `β̂ₙ ≤ (2/r^{N−1}) rⁿ` with `r = 1 − ε/(2N) < 1`, and `Core.Mixing (P, Π)` holds.

decls.name: periodicAt_iff_setGcd
decls.statement: theorem periodicAt_iff_setGcd {x₀ : V} : (∃ d, PeriodicAt K x₀ d) ↔ Nat.setGcd {n | ReachIn K n x₀ x₀} ≠ 1
decls.doc: **Periodicity is the return-time gcd**: `x₀` is periodic in the sense of `PeriodicAt` for some `d` if and only if the gcd of its return times, `Nat.setGcd {n | x₀ ⤳ x₀ in n steps}`, is not `1`.

decls.name: cyclic_reachIn
decls.statement: theorem cyclic_reachIn {K : V → V → ℝ} {d : ℕ} {c : V → ZMod d} (hc : ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1) : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x y : V}, ReachIn K n x y → c y = c x + n | 0, x, y, h => by have h' : x = y
decls.doc: Cyclic classes force every path length to be read off the classes: `c(y) = c(x) + n`.

decls.name: periodicAt_of_cyclic
decls.statement: theorem periodicAt_of_cyclic {K : V → V → ℝ} {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {c : V → ZMod d} (hc : ∀ x y, K x y ≠ 0 → c y = c x + 1) (x₀ : V) : PeriodicAt K x₀ d
decls.doc: **Cyclic classes make every state periodic**: with `d ≥ 2` cyclic classes, `d` divides every return time.

decls.name: graphs_vs_L2_aperiodic
decls.statement: theorem graphs_vs_L2_aperiodic (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) {x₀ : V} (hap : ¬ ∃ d, PeriodicAt B.phat x₀ d) : Core.Mixing (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) ∧ 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) ∧ ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop B.phat lam f)
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: a finite irreducible aperiodic loop closure has summable `L²` mixing, `B̂ ≥ 1`, and `B̂` is a coercivity constant.**

decls.name: graphs_vs_L2_rate
decls.statement: theorem graphs_vs_L2_rate (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) {x₀ : V} (hap : ¬ ∃ d, PeriodicAt B.phat x₀ d) {w : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin wsup eps : ℝ} {h : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hwsup : ∀ x, w x ≤ wsup) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hepsL : eps * (4 * g2 * wsup) ≤ 1) (hstep : ∀ k x, h (k + 1) x = h k x - eps * linHess B.phat lam w g2 (h k) x) : (∀ k, Graph.meanL2 lam (h k) = Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)) ∧ ∀ k, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h k)) ≤ (1 - eps * (g2 * wmin / Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam B.phat) (meanOp lam) ^ 2)) ^ k * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: on an aperiodic loop closure, `theo:db_stable_frozen_full` gives the rate `g''(1)w_min/B̂²` of the linearized gradient descent toward the balanced ray** — `Πhₖ` is conserved and `‖hₖ^⊥‖ ≤ (1 − εϱ)ᵏ‖h₀^⊥‖` with `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²`, `B̂ = ∑ₙ β̂ₙ`, for every step `ε ≤ (4g''(1)‖w‖_∞)⁻¹`.

decls.name: graphs_vs_L2_rate_sigma
decls.statement: theorem graphs_vs_L2_rate_sigma (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam gr uH : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen gr) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) {w : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin wsup eps : ℝ} {h : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hwsup : ∀ x, w x ≤ wsup) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hepsL : eps * (4 * g2 * wsup) ≤ 1) (hstep : ∀ k x, h (k + 1) x = h k x - eps * linHess B.phat lam w g2 (h k) x) : (∀ k, Graph.meanL2 lam (h k) = Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)) ∧ ∀ k, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h k)) ≤ (1 - eps * (g2 * wmin * minOver G (visits G gr) / (sigmaStar G uH ^ 2 * (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)))) ^ k * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: `prop:morozov_rate` removes the aperiodicity**: the same contraction holds on every loop closure, periodic or not, at `B̂_σ` in place of `B̂` (`MorozovConsume.stable_frozen_discrete_sigma`).

decls.name: graphs_vs_L2_balanced_ray
decls.statement: theorem graphs_vs_L2_balanced_ray (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) {u : V → ℝ} (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) : Balanced B.phat lam u ↔ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ u = fun _ => c
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: the balanced locus is one-dimensional** — a positive density is balanced if and only if it is constant, i.e.

decls.name: graphs_vs_L2_mass_monotone
decls.statement: theorem graphs_vs_L2_mass_monotone (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) (hg : StrictlyUnimodal gd) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam nu gd u) : MonotoneOn (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (u s)) (Ici 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:graphs_vs_L2`: the total mass increases along the nonlinear gradient flow of a strictly unimodal generator** (`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(2)*, `MassAscent.mass_monotone_flow`), on every positive trajectory of the flow on the loop closure.

decls.name: pathGraph
decls.statement: def pathGraph (n : ℕ) : MarkedGraph (Fin (n + 2))
decls.doc: **The directed path** `0 → 1 → ⋯ → n+1` on `Fin (n+2)`, source `0`, sink `n+1`.

decls.name: pathPolicy
decls.statement: noncomputable def pathPolicy (n : ℕ) : BackwardPolicy (pathGraph n)
decls.doc: The only backward policy on the path: one step back.

decls.name: pathGraph_pathConnected
decls.statement: theorem pathGraph_pathConnected (n : ℕ) : (pathGraph n).PathConnected

decls.name: pathPolicy_positiveOnEdges
decls.statement: theorem pathPolicy_positiveOnEdges (n : ℕ) : (pathPolicy n).PositiveOnEdges

decls.name: pathPolicy_phat
decls.statement: theorem pathPolicy_phat (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin (n + 2)) : (pathPolicy n).phat x y = if x = y + 1 then 1 else 0
decls.doc: **The loop closure of a directed path is a directed cycle**: the backward chain moves `y + 1 ↦ y` deterministically, indices modulo `n + 2`, the wrap `0 ↦ n+1` included.

decls.name: pathPolicy_invProb
decls.statement: theorem pathPolicy_invProb (n : ℕ) : (pathPolicy n).IsInvProb (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2))
decls.doc: The uniform invariant probability of the directed cycle.

decls.name: pathLeveled
decls.statement: def pathLeveled (n : ℕ) : Leveled (pathGraph n)
decls.doc: The path is leveled by its index.

decls.name: path_witness
decls.statement: theorem path_witness (n : ℕ) : (∀ x₀, PeriodicAt (pathPolicy n).phat x₀ (n + 2)) ∧ ∑' k, ENNReal.ofReal (Core.Mixing.beta (densOp (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) (pathPolicy n).phat) (meanOp (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) k) = ⊤ ∧ ¬ Core.Mixing (densOp (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) (pathPolicy n).phat) (meanOp (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) ∧ ∃ gr : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ, (pathPolicy n).IsGreen gr ∧ ∀ h : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) (fun x => h x - Graph.meanL2 (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) h) ≤ sigmaStar (pathGraph n) (pathLeveled n).lvl * Real.sqrt ((2 + (pathPolicy n).sigmaBar (pathLeveled n).lvl) / minOver (pathGraph n) (visits (pathGraph n) gr)) * Graph.nrmL2 (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) (fun x => h x - (pathPolicy n).pdens (fun _ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) h x)
decls.doc: **The witness of `rem:graphs_vs_L2` and `rem:visit_ratio`, inhabited**: on the directed path with `n + 2` vertices, the loop closure is periodic at every state with period `n + 2`, the mixing sum is `+∞`, and `B̂_σ ≤ (n+2)√((n+3)/min N)` is finite with the coercivity of `prop:morozov_rate`*(2)*.

decls.name: triGraph
decls.statement: def triGraph : MarkedGraph (Fin 3)
decls.doc: **An aperiodic marked graph**: `s₀ → x → s_f` and `s₀ → s_f` on `Fin 3` (`s₀ = 0`, `x = 1`, `s_f = 2`); its loop closure has returns to `s₀` of lengths `2` and `3`.

decls.name: triPb
decls.statement: noncomputable def triPb (s s' : Fin 3) : ℝ
decls.doc: The triangle's backward policy: `π_←(x → s₀) = 1`, `π_←(s_f → x) = π_←(s_f → s₀) = 1/2`.

decls.name: triPolicy
decls.statement: noncomputable def triPolicy : BackwardPolicy triGraph

decls.name: triGraph_pathConnected
decls.statement: theorem triGraph_pathConnected : triGraph.PathConnected

decls.name: triPolicy_positiveOnEdges
decls.statement: theorem triPolicy_positiveOnEdges : triPolicy.PositiveOnEdges

decls.name: triPolicy_aperiodic
decls.statement: theorem triPolicy_aperiodic : ¬ ∃ d, PeriodicAt triPolicy.phat 0 d
decls.doc: **The triangle's loop closure is aperiodic at `s₀`**: returns of lengths `2` and `3`.

decls.name: triangle_witness
decls.statement: theorem triangle_witness : ∃ lam gr uH : Fin 3 → ℝ, triPolicy.IsInvProb lam ∧ triPolicy.IsGreen gr ∧ triPolicy.IsHitExp uH ∧ Core.Mixing (densOp lam triPolicy.phat) (meanOp lam) ∧ 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam triPolicy.phat) (meanOp lam) ∧ ‖Core.Mixing.S (densOp lam triPolicy.phat) (meanOp lam)‖ ≤ sigmaStar triGraph uH * Real.sqrt ((2 + triPolicy.sigmaBar uH) / minOver triGraph (visits triGraph gr))
decls.doc: **The aperiodic witness, inhabited**: on the triangle, for its invariant probability, summable `L²` mixing holds, and `rem:visit_ratio`'s `‖S‖ ≤ B̂_σ` applies.

decls.name: sq_admissible
decls.statement: theorem sq_admissible : (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) x
decls.doc: `(x − 1)²` is admissible in the sense used by `rem:freezing`*(i)*: `g(1) = 0`, `g > 0` off `1`.

decls.name: sq_convexOn
decls.statement: theorem sq_convexOn : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **The convex hypothesis bundle of `rem:freezing`*(i)* is inhabited** by `(x − 1)²`.

decls.name: sq_convex_small_deriv
decls.statement: theorem sq_convex_small_deriv : (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → deriv (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) x ≤ 0) ∧ ∀ {x₀ ε : ℝ}, 0 < x₀ → x₀ < 1 → |deriv (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) x₀| ≤ ε → ∀ x ∈ Icc x₀ 1, |deriv (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) x| ≤ ε ∧ (x - 1) ^ 2 ≤ ε * (1 - x₀)

decls.name: sq_analyticOnNhd
decls.statement: theorem sq_analyticOnNhd : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) (Ioi 0)
decls.doc: **The analytic hypothesis bundle of `rem:freezing`*(i)* is inhabited** by `(x − 1)²`.

decls.name: sq_no_flat
decls.statement: theorem sq_no_flat (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) : ¬ ∀ x ∈ Ioo p q, deriv (fun x : ℝ => (x - 1) ^ 2) x = 0

decls.name: thetaOK_twoStateBands
decls.statement: theorem thetaOK_twoStateBands : ThetaOK twoStateBands (1 / 16)
decls.doc: **`ThetaOK` is inhabited**: the bands `(5/8, 7/8)`, `(11/8, 13/8)` of `prop:nonlinear_freezing`*(2)* with `θ = 1/16`.

files.title: The generator `(x − 1)²` is coercive off balance, and item *(3)*'s display holds for it

decls.name: sqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le_sharp
decls.statement: theorem sqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le_sharp {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (h : δ ≤ |x - 1|) : 2 * (x - 1) * (1 - x) ≤ -(2 * δ ^ 2)
decls.doc: **`g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ −2δ²` whenever `0 ≤ δ ≤ |x − 1|`**, for `g = (x − 1)²` — the sharp form, the paper's `2(x−1)² ≥ 2δ²` (`proofs.tex:830`).

decls.name: sqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem sqDeriv_mul_one_sub_le {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (h : δ ≤ |x - 1|) : 2 * (x - 1) * (1 - x) ≤ -(δ ^ 2 / 2)
decls.doc: **`g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ −δ²/2` whenever `0 ≤ δ ≤ |x − 1|`**, for `g = (x − 1)²` (`proofs.tex:813`, proof `proofs.tex:830`: `2δ² ≥ δ²/2`).

decls.name: le_abs_sqDeriv_mul_one_sub
decls.statement: theorem le_abs_sqDeriv_mul_one_sub {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (h : δ ≤ |x - 1|) : δ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ |2 * (x - 1) * (1 - x)|
decls.doc: **`|g'(x)(1 − x)| ≥ δ²/2` whenever `0 ≤ δ ≤ |x − 1|`**, for `g = (x − 1)²` (`proofs.tex:813`) — the proposition's own wording, from the signed form.

decls.name: sqDeriv_mul_one_sub_nonpos
decls.statement: theorem sqDeriv_mul_one_sub_nonpos (x : ℝ) : 2 * (x - 1) * (1 - x) ≤ 0
decls.doc: **`g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ 0` for every `x`**, for `g = (x − 1)²` — strict unimodality, unweighted (`proofs.tex:826`).

decls.name: no_distant_equilibrium_three_far_of
decls.statement: theorem no_distant_equilibrium_three_far_of {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u wnu : V → ℝ} {δ c₀ : ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c₀) (hwnu : ∀ x, c₀ ≤ wnu x) (hnp : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → gd x * (1 - x) ≤ 0) (hfar : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → δ ≤ |x - 1| → gd x * (1 - x) ≤ -(δ ^ 2 / 2)) (S : Finset V) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, δ ≤ |ratio K lam u x - 1|) : c₀ * (δ ^ 2 / 2) * (∑ x ∈ S, lam x) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u wnu gd)
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*, the display, for any `g'` with the two pointwise facts it consumes** (statement `proofs.tex:813–817`, proof `proofs.tex:830–833`): over any set `S` of far ratios and with `dν/dμ ≥ c₀`, `c₀ (δ²/2) λ(S) ≤ ‖D‖_{L²(λ)}` whenever `g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ 0` on `x > 0` (`hnp`) and `g'(x)(1 − x) ≤ −δ²/2` on `x > 0` with `|x − 1| ≥ δ` (`hfar`).

decls.name: no_distant_equilibrium_three_sq
decls.statement: theorem no_distant_equilibrium_three_sq {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam u u0 wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin δ : ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hsph : Graph.nrmL2 lam u = Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hu0 : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) : wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / Graph.nrmL2 lam u0 * (δ ^ 2 / 2) * (∑ x ∈ farSet (ratio K lam u) δ, lam x) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGradDensity K lam u (fun x => wf x / u x) fun x => 2 * (x - 1))
decls.doc: **`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*'s display for `g = (x − 1)²`** (statement `proofs.tex:813–817`, proof `proofs.tex:830–833`): `‖∇^λ 𝓛_{g,ν}(μ)‖ ≥ (w_min λ_min^{1/2}/‖u₀‖)(δ²/2) λ(|r−1| ≥ δ)` for `g' = 2(x − 1)`, `ν = wλ` with `w ≥ w_min > 0`, on the sphere `‖u‖ = ‖u₀‖`, for every `δ ≥ 0` (the paper's `δ ∈ (0, ½]` included; see the module SCOPE).

files.title: The training-speed theorem, assembled: two phases, and every constant in `σ_*`, `σ̄`, `N_min`

decls.name: BhatSigma
decls.statement: noncomputable def BhatSigma (G : Graph.MarkedGraph V) (uH lam : V → ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: BhatSigma_eq
decls.statement: theorem BhatSigma_eq (G : Graph.MarkedGraph V) (uH lam : V → ℝ) : BhatSigma G uH lam = Graph.sigmaStar G uH / Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam)

decls.name: rhoSigma
decls.statement: noncomputable def rhoSigma (g2 wmin lamMin sigmaStar : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`ϱ_σ := g''(1) w_min λ_min/σ_*²`** (`proofs.tex:919`).

decls.name: T0
decls.statement: noncomputable def T0 (L0 cDel : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`T₀ := 𝓛(μ₀)/c(δ₀)²`** (`proofs.tex:929`).

decls.name: minOver_div_const
decls.statement: theorem minOver_div_const {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {f h : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hfh : ∀ x, f x = h x / c) : Graph.minOver G f = Graph.minOver G h / c
decls.doc: Dividing a function by a positive constant divides its minimum by it.

decls.name: minOver_lam_eq
decls.statement: theorem minOver_lam_eq {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam g uH : V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) : Graph.minOver G lam = Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G g) / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)
decls.doc: **`λ_min = N_min/(2+σ̄)`** (`proofs.tex:906`), from `prop:morozov_rate`*(1)*.

decls.name: one_le_sigmaStar
decls.statement: theorem one_le_sigmaStar {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {uH : V → ℝ} (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) : 1 ≤ Graph.sigmaStar G uH
decls.doc: `1 ≤ σ_*`: the hitting time of `s₀` from `s_f` is `1 + Qσ ≥ 1`, and `σ_*` is a maximum.

decls.name: minOver_le_one
decls.statement: theorem minOver_le_one {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : Graph.minOver G lam ≤ 1
decls.doc: `λ_min ≤ 1` on a probability `λ`.

decls.name: one_le_BhatSigma
decls.statement: theorem one_le_BhatSigma {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH : V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) : 1 ≤ BhatSigma G uH lam
decls.doc: **`1 ≤ B̂_σ`** — derived, not assumed: `σ_* ≥ 1` and `λ_min ≤ 1`, so `√λ_min ≤ 1 ≤ σ_*`.

decls.name: BhatSigma_pos
decls.statement: theorem BhatSigma_pos {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH : V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) : 0 < BhatSigma G uH lam

decls.name: hcoer_of_graph
decls.statement: theorem hcoer_of_graph {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH : V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (f : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ BhatSigma G uH lam * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop B.phat lam f)
decls.doc: **`hcoer` at `B̂ := B̂_σ`**, from `prop:morozov_rate`*(2)* in its `σ_*/√λ_min` form.

decls.name: rhoL_eq_rhoSigma
decls.statement: theorem rhoL_eq_rhoSigma {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {uH lam : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < Graph.minOver G lam) : rhoL g2 wmin (BhatSigma G uH lam) = rhoSigma g2 wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.sigmaStar G uH)

decls.name: rhoSigma_eq_visits
decls.statement: theorem rhoSigma_eq_visits {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam g uH : V → ℝ} {wmin : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) : rhoSigma 2 wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.sigmaStar G uH) = 2 * wmin * Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G g) / (Graph.sigmaStar G uH ^ 2 * (2 + B.sigmaBar uH))

decls.name: T0_eq
decls.statement: theorem T0_eq {L0 wmin lamMin U0 eps0 m0 sigStar : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (heps0 : 0 < eps0) (hm0 : 0 < m0) (hsig : 0 < sigStar) : T0 L0 (cDelta wmin lamMin U0 (delta0 eps0 m0 (sigStar / Real.sqrt lamMin) U0)) = 4 * L0 * U0 ^ 6 * sigStar ^ 4 / (wmin ^ 2 * eps0 ^ 4 * m0 ^ 4 * lamMin ^ 5)
decls.doc: **`T₀ = 4𝓛(μ₀)‖u₀‖⁶σ_*⁴/(w_min²ε₀⁴m₀⁴λ_min⁵)`** (`proofs.tex:929`), exact.

decls.name: flow_translate
decls.statement: theorem flow_translate {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₁ : 0 ≤ t₁) : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd (fun s x => u (t₁ + s) x)
decls.doc: **Time translation**: `s ↦ u_{t₁+s}` is again a gradient flow.

decls.name: flow_unit_mass
decls.statement: theorem flow_unit_mass {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₁ : 0 ≤ t₁) : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd (fun s x => u (t₁ + m ^ 2 * s) x / m)
decls.doc: **The rescaling to unit mass** (`proofs.tex:813`, `:930`): dividing the state by `m` and dilating time by `m²` again solves the ODE. `MassAscent.flow_rescale` at `c = m`.

decls.name: eps0Sq
decls.statement: noncomputable def eps0Sq (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`ε₀` of `theo:local_convergence_full`, instantiated at `g = (log x)²`**: `a = 1/2`, `g''(1) = 2`, `M₃ = 24` (the sharper of the two constants `LogSqTaylor` supplies).

decls.name: eps0_le_half
decls.statement: theorem eps0_le_half {eW Ci c7 rho c6 : ℝ} (heW : eW ≤ 1/4) (hCi : 1 ≤ Ci) (hc7 : 0 ≤ c7) : eps0 eW Ci c7 rho c6 ≤ 1/2
decls.doc: **`ε₀ ≤ 1/2`** for any basin radius of Step 4 whose window is `≤ 1/4`: `ε₀ ≤ ε/(2C_∞(2+C₇))` with `ε ≤ 1/4`, `C_∞ ≥ 1` and `C₇ ≥ 0`, so in fact `ε₀ ≤ 1/16`.

decls.name: eps0Sq_le_half
decls.statement: theorem eps0Sq_le_half {lam : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin wsup Bhat : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) : eps0Sq wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ≤ 1/2
decls.doc: **`ε₀ ≤ 1/2` at `g = (log x)²`** — the side condition `MassAscent.entry_time` needs of `δ₀` and the paper never states, discharged rather than assumed.

decls.name: eps0Sq_pos
decls.statement: theorem eps0Sq_pos {lamMin wmin wsup Bhat : ℝ} (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hB : 0 < Bhat) : 0 < eps0Sq wmin wsup Bhat lamMin

decls.name: delta0Sq_le_half
decls.statement: theorem delta0Sq_le_half {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH u0 : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hwsup : 0 < wsup) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) : delta0 (eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam u0) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) ≤ 1/2
decls.doc: **`δ₀ ≤ 1/2`** — the side condition `MassAscent.entry_time` imposes on its `δ` and which `proofs.tex:927` reads `entry_time` at `δ₀` without checking.

decls.name: entry_and_rescale
decls.statement: theorem entry_and_rescale {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin eps0 : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (heps0 : 0 < eps0) (heps1 : eps0 ≤ 1/2) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (T0 (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0))) (cDelta wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (delta0 eps0 (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))))), (∀ x, |ratio B.phat lam (u t₁) x - 1| < delta0 eps0 (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ 0 < Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ∧ IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv (fun s x => u (t₁ + Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ^ 2 * s) x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁)) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - 1) = 0 ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - 1) ≤ eps0
decls.doc: **`proofs.tex:927–930` in one statement**: at a crossover time `t₁ ≤ T₀` every ratio is within `δ₀` of `1`, the mass has risen to `m₁ ∈ [m₀, ‖u₀‖]`, and the curve `s ↦ u_{t₁+m₁²s}/m₁` is again a gradient flow whose deviation from `1` starts inside the `ε₀`-ball of `theo:local_convergence_full`.

decls.name: logSqDeriv_taylor_half
decls.statement: theorem logSqDeriv_taylor_half (y : ℝ) (hy : |y - 1| ≤ 1/2) : |logSqDeriv y - 2 * (y - 1)| ≤ 24 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`htaylor` at `a = 1/2`, `g''(1) = 2`, `M₃ = 24`** — the `C³` hypothesis of `theo:local_convergence_full` as the Taylor bound it is used through, for `g = (log x)²`.

decls.name: training_speed_full
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_full {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam gr uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen gr) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : (∀ x, lam x = Graph.visits G gr x / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)) ∧ Graph.minOver G lam = Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G gr) / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u t)) ≤ ((lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)))⁻¹ + (wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam) / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)) / (wmin * Graph.minOver G lam))))) ^ 2 * t)⁻¹) ∧ ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (T0 (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0))) (cDelta wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (delta0 (eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))))), Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - 1) ≤ eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam) ∧ ∃ cinf : ℝ, Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => cinf) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t₁ ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - cinf) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoSigma 2 wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.sigmaStar G uH) * (t - t₁)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`** (`proofs.tex:900–920`, proof `:922–934`), assembled.

decls.name: training_speed_full_of_pos
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_full_of_pos {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam gr uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup pmin : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen gr) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hpmin0 : 0 < pmin) (hpmin1 : pmin ≤ 1) (hpmin : ∀ y z : V, 0 < B.phat y z → pmin ≤ B.phat y z) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : (∀ x, lam x = Graph.visits G gr x / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)) ∧ Graph.minOver G lam = Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G gr) / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u t)) ≤ ((lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)))⁻¹ + (wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam) / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)) / (wmin * Graph.minOver G lam))))) ^ 2 * t)⁻¹) ∧ ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (T0 (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0))) (cDelta wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (delta0 (eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))))), Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - 1) ≤ eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam) ∧ ∃ cinf : ℝ, Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => cinf) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t₁ ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - cinf)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full` from a positive initialization alone** — the paper's own "from *every* initialization `μ₀ ∼ λ`" (`proofs.tex:906`), with no hypothesis on the trajectory at any later time.

decls.name: cycle_minOver_lam
decls.statement: theorem cycle_minOver_lam {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Graph.minOver cyc (lam p) = (1 - p) / (5 - 2 * p)
decls.doc: `λ_min = (1−p)/(5−2p)` on the five-vertex cycle, attained at `s₀` and `s_f`.

decls.name: cycle_training_speed_check
decls.statement: theorem cycle_training_speed_check {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Graph.minOver cyc (lam p) = (1 - p) / (5 - 2 * p) ∧ Graph.minOver cyc (lam p) = Graph.minOver cyc (Graph.visits cyc (green p)) / (2 + (pol hp0 hp1).sigmaBar (hitExp p)) ∧ 1 ≤ BhatSigma cyc (hitExp p) (lam p) ∧ rhoSigma 2 1 (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) (Graph.sigmaStar cyc (hitExp p)) = 2 * (1 - p) ^ 3 / ((5 - 2 * p) * (4 - p) ^ 2) ∧ 0 < rhoSigma 2 1 (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) (Graph.sigmaStar cyc (hitExp p))
decls.doc: **The graph half of `theo:training_speed_full` on the cycle**, in closed form in `p`: `λ_min = N_min/(2+σ̄)`, `B̂_σ ≥ 1`, and `ϱ_σ = 2(1−p)³/((5−2p)(4−p)²) > 0` at `w_min = 1`.

decls.name: cycle_training_speed_check_half
decls.statement: theorem cycle_training_speed_check_half : Graph.minOver cyc (lam (1/2)) = 1/8 ∧ Graph.sigmaStar cyc (hitExp (1/2)) = 7 ∧ Graph.minOver cyc (Graph.visits cyc (green (1/2))) = 1 ∧ BhatSigma cyc (hitExp (1/2)) (lam (1/2)) = 14 * Real.sqrt 2 ∧ rhoSigma 2 1 (1/8) 7 = 1/196 ∧ T0 1 (cDelta 1 (1/8) 1 (delta0 (1/100) 1 (7 / Real.sqrt (1/8)) 1)) = 31470387200000000
decls.doc: **The constants at `p = 1/2`, and `T₀` on a concrete instance.** With `w_min = 1`, `𝓛(μ₀) = 1`, `‖u₀‖ = 1`, `m₀ = 1` and `ε₀ = 1/100` the crossover time is `T₀ = 4·7⁴·10⁸·8⁵ = 3.147…×10¹⁶` — finite, positive, and an honest picture of how loose the bound is.

decls.name: training_speed_full_of_init
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_full_of_init {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam gr uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin wsup : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen gr) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u 0 x) (hflow : IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : (∀ x, lam x = Graph.visits G gr x / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)) ∧ Graph.minOver G lam = Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G gr) / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u t)) ≤ ((lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)))⁻¹ + (wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam) / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0)) / (wmin * Graph.minOver G lam))))) ^ 2 * t)⁻¹) ∧ ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (T0 (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u 0))) (cDelta wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0)) (delta0 (eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam)) (Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0)) (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0))))), Graph.meanL2 lam (u 0) ≤ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ∧ Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - 1) ≤ eps0Sq wmin wsup (BhatSigma G uH lam) (Graph.minOver G lam) ∧ ∃ cinf : ℝ, Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => cinf) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t₁ ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => u t x / Graph.meanL2 lam (u t₁) - cinf) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoSigma 2 wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.sigmaStar G uH) * (t - t₁)
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full` with no hypothesis the paper does not have.** What remains is the paper's own setting: a finite path-connected marked graph, a backward policy positive on its edges, `λ` its invariant probability, `ν = wλ` with `w ≥ w_min > 0`, and an initialization `μ₀ ∼ λ` — the theorem's own *"from **every** initialization `μ₀ ∼ λ`"*.

files.title: Theorem 10 under `C³` on the closed window, with its flow constructed; items 1 and 2 of the training-speed theorem as printed, from `u₀` alone

decls.name: winC3
decls.statement: abbrev winC3 (a : ℝ) : Set ℝ
decls.doc: The closed window `[1 − a, 1 + a]`.

decls.name: Gamma3W
decls.statement: noncomputable def Gamma3W (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`Γ₃ := sup_{[1−a,1+a]} |g'''|`, with `g'''` the third derivative within the closed window** (one-sided at `1 ± a`).

decls.name: uniqueDiffOn_winC3
decls.statement: theorem uniqueDiffOn_winC3 {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (winC3 a)

decls.name: bddAbove_abs_g3W
decls.statement: theorem bddAbove_abs_g3W {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) : BddAbove ((fun y => |iteratedDerivWithin 3 g (winC3 a) y|) '' winC3 a)

decls.name: abs_g3W_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_g3W_le {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ winC3 a) : |iteratedDerivWithin 3 g (winC3 a) y| ≤ Gamma3W g a

decls.name: one_mem_winC3
decls.statement: theorem one_mem_winC3 {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (1 : ℝ) ∈ winC3 a

decls.name: Gamma3W_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem Gamma3W_nonneg {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) : 0 ≤ Gamma3W g a

decls.name: abs_le_quadratic_of_deriv_Ico
decls.statement: theorem abs_le_quadratic_of_deriv_Ico {e e' : ℝ → ℝ} {M b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : ContinuousOn e (Icc 0 b)) (he : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 b, HasDerivAt e (e' s) s) (h0 : e 0 = 0) (hbound : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 b, |e' s| ≤ M * s) : |e b| ≤ M / 2 * b ^ 2
decls.doc: A quadratic fence with the derivative asked on `[0,b)` only and continuity on `[0,b]`.

decls.name: hasDerivWithinAt_iteratedDerivWithin_winC3
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivWithinAt_iteratedDerivWithin_winC3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < 3) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ winC3 a) : HasDerivWithinAt (iteratedDerivWithin m g (winC3 a)) (iteratedDerivWithin (m + 1) g (winC3 a) y) (winC3 a) y
decls.doc: The first and second derivatives within the window, as within-derivatives on it.

decls.name: mem_nhds_winC3
decls.statement: theorem mem_nhds_winC3 {a y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Ioo (1 - a) (1 + a)) : winC3 a ∈ 𝓝 y

decls.name: abs_g2W_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_g2W_sub_le {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ winC3 a) : |iteratedDerivWithin 2 g (winC3 a) t - iteratedDerivWithin 2 g (winC3 a) 1| ≤ Gamma3W g a * |t - 1|
decls.doc: **`|g''(t) − g''(1)| ≤ Γ₃|t − 1|`** on the closed window, derivatives within it.

decls.name: taylor_of_C3On
decls.statement: theorem taylor_of_C3On {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : gd 1 = 0) : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - iteratedDerivWithin 2 g (winC3 a) 1 * (y - 1)| ≤ Gamma3W g a / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the `C³` hypothesis on the closed window read as the Taylor bound Step 1 uses** (Taylor's formula in `theo:gd_diffusion_full`'s proof): for any `g'` of `g` on `[1−a,1+a]` (one-sided at the ends) with `g'(1) = 0`, `|g'(y) − g''(1)(y−1)| ≤ (Γ₃/2)(y−1)²` for `|y − 1| ≤ a`.

decls.name: deriv_one_eq_of_C3On
decls.statement: theorem deriv_one_eq_of_C3On {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) : deriv g 1 = gd 1 ∧ deriv (deriv g) 1 = iteratedDerivWithin 2 g (winC3 a) 1
decls.doc: At the interior point `1`, the derivatives within the window are the classical ones: `g'(1) = gd 1` and `g''(1) = iteratedDerivWithin 2 g [1−a,1+a] 1`.

decls.name: C3On_of_C3
decls.statement: theorem C3On_of_C3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a) ∧ (∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (deriv g y) (winC3 a) y) ∧ Gamma3W g a = Gamma3 g a
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the two-sided reading of `C³` is a special case**: `C³` at every point of the closed window gives `C³` on it, `g' = deriv g` a derivative within it, and the same `Γ₃`.

decls.name: hasDerivWithinAt_derivWithin_of_C3On
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivWithinAt_derivWithin_of_C3On {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (derivWithin g (winC3 a) y) (winC3 a) y
decls.doc: **The derivative hypothesis is always dischargeable**: under `C³` on the window, the within-derivative `derivWithin g [1−a,1+a]` is a derivative of `g` there, one-sided at the ends.

decls.name: Gamma3W_logSq
decls.statement: theorem Gamma3W_logSq : Gamma3W logSq (1/2) = 48 + 32 * Real.log 2
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full` item 2, `Γ₃ = 48 + 32 log 2` for `g = (log x)²` at `a = 1/2`**, in the within-window reading.

decls.name: eps0W
decls.statement: noncomputable def eps0W (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `ε₀` of `theo:local_convergence_full` at `g''(1)` and `Γ₃ = Gamma3W g a`.

decls.name: CW
decls.statement: noncomputable def CW (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a wmin wsup : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `C := max(1, C₇)` at `g''(1)`, `Γ₃ = Gamma3W g a`.

decls.name: gamma0W
decls.statement: noncomputable def gamma0W (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a wmin wsup Bhat : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `γ₀` at `g''(1)`, `Γ₃ = Gamma3W g a`.

decls.name: constW_congr
decls.statement: theorem constW_congr {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (h2 : deriv (deriv g) 1 = deriv (deriv g') 1) (h3 : Gamma3W g a = Gamma3W g' a) (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin = eps0W g' a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ∧ CW g a wmin wsup = CW g' a wmin wsup ∧ gamma0W g a wmin wsup Bhat = gamma0W g' a wmin wsup Bhat
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, "depending only on `g''(1)`, `sup_{[1−a,1+a]}|g'''|`, `a`, `w_min`, `‖w‖_{L^∞}`, `B̂`, `C_∞`"**, as a congruence.

decls.name: constW_eq_constC3
decls.statement: theorem constW_eq_constC3 {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1 - a) (1 + a), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g y) (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin = eps0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ∧ CW g a wmin wsup = CC3 g a wmin wsup ∧ gamma0W g a wmin wsup Bhat = gamma0C3 g a wmin wsup Bhat
decls.doc: Under the two-sided reading the constants are `C3Wrappers`'.

decls.name: eps0W_logSq
decls.statement: theorem eps0W_logSq (wmin wsup Bhat lamMin : ℝ) : eps0W logSq (1/2) wmin wsup Bhat lamMin = eps0Gamma3 wmin wsup Bhat lamMin
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full` item 2, `ε₀`**: Theorem 10's radius for `g = (log x)²` at `a = 1/2` is `C3Wrappers.eps0Gamma3`.

decls.name: taylor_bundle_of_C3On
decls.statement: theorem taylor_bundle_of_C3On {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - deriv (deriv g) 1 * (y - 1)| ≤ Gamma3W g a / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2
decls.doc: The `C³`-on-the-window hypotheses, turned into the Taylor bound the library consumes, at `gd` and at the classical `g''(1)`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_C3On
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_C3On {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun s x => 1 + h s x) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∃ cinf : ℝ, |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)| ≤ CW g a wmin wsup * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the flow clause, under `C³` on the closed window**: every gradient flow driven by a derivative `gd` of `g` on `[1−a,1+a]` (one-sided at the ends), from `‖h₀‖ ≤ ε₀`, converges to `c_∞λ` with the printed `C` and rate.

decls.name: constW_bounds
decls.statement: theorem constW_bounds {lam w : V → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) : eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (a / (16 * Cinf lamMin)) ∧ 1 ≤ CW g a wmin wsup ∧ 0 < gamma0W g a wmin wsup Bhat
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the constants, under `C³` on the closed window**: `ε₀ ∈ (0, a/(16C_∞)]`, `C ≥ 1`, `γ₀ > 0`.

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_C3On
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_C3On {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → V → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun x => hk k x - gam * lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0W g a wmin wsup Bhat) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (hk 0) ≤ eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∀ k : ℕ, ((∀ x : V, 0 < 1 + hk k x) ∧ (∀ x : V, |ratio K lam (fun z => 1 + hk k z) x - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ ∀ d : V → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) (fun x => 1 + hk k x + t * d x) g) (Graph.ipL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + hk k z) d) 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (hk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the gradient-descent clause, under `C³` on the closed window**: the descent driven by `gd` is well defined at every step and contracts by `1 − γϱ/4`.

decls.name: contDiffAt_lossGrad_local
decls.statement: theorem contDiffAt_lossGrad_local {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hu : ∀ x, 0 < u x) (hgd : ∀ y, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 gd (ratio K lam u y)) : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun v : V → ℝ => lossGrad K lam nu gd v) u
decls.doc: **`D(u)` is `C¹` in `u` at a positive `u` whose ratios all sit where `g'` is `C¹`** (`FlowExistence.contDiffAt_lossGrad`, with `g'` asked `C¹` only at the values the ratio takes).

decls.name: contDiffAt_gd_of_C3On
decls.statement: theorem contDiffAt_gd_of_C3On {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Ioo (1 - a) (1 + a)) : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 gd y
decls.doc: **`g'` is `C¹` at every interior point of the window**: it agrees near such a point with the within-derivative, which is `C²` on the closed window.

decls.name: pos_of_mem_box
decls.statement: theorem pos_of_mem_box {e : ℝ} (he : e ≤ 1 / 4) {v : V → ℝ} (hv : v ∈ densityBox V (1 - e) (1 + e)) (x : V) : 0 < v x
decls.doc: On the box `[1−e, 1+e]^V`, `e ≤ 1/4`, the density is positive.

decls.name: abs_ratio_le_of_mem_box
decls.statement: theorem abs_ratio_le_of_mem_box {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {a e : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (he : e ≤ min a 1 / 4) {v : V → ℝ} (hv : v ∈ densityBox V (1 - e) (1 + e)) (y : V) : |ratio K lam v y - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3
decls.doc: On the box `[1−e, 1+e]^V`, `e ≤ min(a,1)/4`, every ratio lies in `[1 − 2a/3, 1 + 2a/3]`.

decls.name: exists_lipschitzOnWith_lossGrad_box
