decls.statement: theorem exists_lipschitzOnWith_lossGrad_box {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a e : ℝ} (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (he : e ≤ min a 1 / 4) : ∃ L, LipschitzOnWith L (fun v : V → ℝ => lossGrad K lam nu gd v) (densityBox V (1 - e) (1 + e))
decls.doc: **`D` is Lipschitz on the box `[1−e, 1+e]^V`**, `e ≤ min(a,1)/4`, for `g` `C³` on the window.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_mean_of_at
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_mean_of_at {lam : V → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {Dv : V → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h s x) (-Dv x) t) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Graph.meanL2 lam (h s)) (-Graph.meanL2 lam Dv) t
decls.doc: `ḣ = −D` at one time gives `ṁ = −ΠD` there.

decls.name: hasDerivAt_perp_sq_of_at
decls.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_perp_sq_of_at {lam : V → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {Dv : V → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h s x) (-Dv x) t) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h s)) ^ 2) (-(2 * Graph.ipL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h t)) Dv)) t
decls.doc: `ḣ = −D` at one time gives `d/dt‖h^⊥‖² = −2⟨h^⊥, D⟩` there (`LocalEnergy.hasDerivAt_perp_sq` with the ODE asked at that time only).

decls.name: sup_bootstrap_step_on
decls.statement: theorem sup_bootstrap_step_on {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} {g2 a M3 wsup wmin Bhat lamMin t : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hg2 : 0 < g2) (hM3 : 0 ≤ M3) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (htaylor : ∀ y : ℝ, |y - 1| ≤ a → |gd y - g2 * (y - 1)| ≤ M3 / 2 * (y - 1) ^ 2) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam (h 0) ≤ eps0 (epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) (Cinf lamMin) (C7 (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup) g2 wmin) (rhoL g2 wmin Bhat) (C6 (Cg g2 a M3) wsup)) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (hode : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) t, ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => h r x) (-lossGrad K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + h s z) x) s) (hwin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) t, ∀ x, |h s x| ≤ epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat) : ∀ x, |h t x| ≤ epsW a g2 wmin (Kexp g2 a M3 wsup) Bhat / 2
decls.doc: **Step 4's inner estimate with the ODE asked on `[0,t]` only** (`LocalConvergence.sup_bootstrap_step` on a curve that solves the gradient-flow ODE on `[0,t]` and nowhere else): on the window `‖h_s‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε`, `s ∈ [0,t]`, `‖h_0‖ ≤ ε₀` gives `‖h_t‖_{L^∞} ≤ ε/2`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_exists
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_exists {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkovOn lam K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) {h0 : V → ℝ} (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 lam h0 ≤ eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∃ h : ℝ → V → ℝ, h 0 = h0 ∧ IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun s x => 1 + h s x) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < 1 + h t x ∧ |ratio K lam (fun z => 1 + h t z) x - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ (∀ h' : ℝ → V → ℝ, h' 0 = h0 → IsGradientFlow K lam (fun z => lam z * w z) gd (fun s x => 1 + h' s x) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → h' t = h t) ∧ ∃ cinf : ℝ, Balanced K lam (fun _ => cinf) ∧ |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 lam h0| ≤ CW g a wmin wsup * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam h0) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => h t x - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat * t / 2)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam h0)
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full`, the flow clause with existence, under `C³` on the closed window** (`proofs.tex:666–672`): from every `h₀` with `‖h₀‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ε₀`, the nonlinear gradient flow `μ̇ = −∇^λ𝓛_{g,ν}(μ)` from `μ₀ = (1+h₀)λ`, driven by a derivative `gd` of `g` on `[1−a,1+a]`, **exists**; it stays positive with every ratio within `2a/3` of `1`; it is **unique** among all solutions of the flow predicate from `μ₀`; and it converges to a balanced flow `c_∞λ` with `|c_∞ − 1 − Πh₀| ≤ C‖h₀ − Πh₀‖²` and `‖h_t − (c_∞−1)‖ ≤ 2e^{−ϱt/2}‖h₀ − Πh₀‖`.

decls.name: global_phase_exact
decls.statement: theorem global_phase_exact {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam wf : V → ℝ} {lamMin wmin wsup : ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hu : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) (hlmin : ∀ x, lamMin ≤ lam x) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) (hwsup : ∀ x, wf x ≤ wsup) (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u) : (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt (fun s => lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u s))) (-(Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv (u t)) ^ 2)) t ∧ (wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)) / (wmin * lamMin))))) ^ 2 * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u t)) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad K lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv (u t)) ^ 2) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u t))) ≤ ((ENNReal.ofReal (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0))))⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal ((wmin * Real.sqrt lamMin / (Graph.nrmL2 lam (u 0) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)) / (wmin * lamMin))))) ^ 2 * t))⁻¹) ∧ (Balanced K lam (u 0) ↔ (ENNReal.ofReal (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0))))⁻¹ = ⊤) ∧ (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)) = 0 → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u t)) = 0) ∧ (0 < lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u 0)) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio K lam (u t))
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, item 1, as printed** (`proofs.tex:1005–1011`): along the `(log x)²` gradient flow, at every `t ≥ 0`, * `t ↦ 𝓛(μ_t)` is differentiable with `−(d/dt)𝓛(μ_t) = ‖∇𝓛(μ_t)‖²`, and `κ²𝓛(μ_t)² ≤ ‖∇𝓛(μ_t)‖²` — the Łojasiewicz inequality `−𝓛̇ ≥ κ²𝓛²`; * `𝓛(μ_t) ≤ (𝓛(μ₀)⁻¹ + κ²t)⁻¹` read in `[0,∞]`, where `0⁻¹ = ∞` and `∞⁻¹ = 0` — the paper's convention `𝓛(μ₀)⁻¹ := +∞` exactly, and `(𝓛(μ₀))⁻¹ = ∞` holds iff `μ₀` is balanced; * and, unfolded in `ℝ`: at a balanced start `𝓛(μ_t) = 0` for every `t ≥ 0`, otherwise the real display.

decls.name: training_speed_full_paper
decls.statement: theorem training_speed_full_paper {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V} {B : Graph.BackwardPolicy G} {lam gr uH wf : V → ℝ} {wmin : ℝ} (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen gr) (hhit : B.IsHitExp uH) (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) {u0 : V → ℝ} (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) : (∀ x, lam x = Graph.visits G gr x / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)) ∧ Graph.minOver G lam = Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G gr) / (2 + B.sigmaBar uH) ∧ rhoSigma (deriv (deriv logSq) 1) wmin (Graph.minOver G lam) (Graph.sigmaStar G uH) = 2 * wmin * Graph.minOver G (Graph.visits G gr) / (Graph.sigmaStar G uH ^ 2 * (2 + B.sigmaBar uH)) ∧ ∃ u : ℝ → V → ℝ, u 0 = u0 ∧ IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv u ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) ∧ (∀ v : ℝ → V → ℝ, v 0 = u0 → IsGradientFlow B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv v → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → v t = u t) ∧ Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 fun _ => Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) ∧ Balanced B.phat lam (fun _ => Graph.nrmL2 lam u0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt (fun s => lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u s))) (-(Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv (u t)) ^ 2)) t ∧ (wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver G lam) / (Graph.nrmL2 lam u0 * Graph.maxOver G wf * max 1 (Real.sqrt (lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam u0) / (wmin * Graph.minOver G lam))))) ^ 2 * lossVal lam wf logSq (ratio B.phat lam (u t)) ^ 2 ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam (lossGrad B.phat lam (fun x => lam x * wf x) logSqDeriv (u t))
decls.doc: **`theo:training_speed_full`, the preamble and items 1 and 2, as printed** (`proofs.tex:999–1021`), from the paper's hypotheses only — a finite path-connected marked graph, a backward policy positive on the edges of its loop closure, `λ` its invariant probability, `g = (log x)²`, `ν = wλ` with `w ≥ w_min > 0`, and an initialization `μ₀ = u₀λ ∼ λ`.

decls.name: local_convergence_full_DB_exists
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_full_DB_exists {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {w : EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin : ℝ} (hpb : Core.IsMarkovOn lam pb) (hinvpb : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ e, lamMin ≤ edgeMeasureE pb lam e) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ e, |w e| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ e, wmin ≤ w e) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : EdgeSet pb → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (Aop (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f)) {h0 : EdgeSet pb → ℝ} (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) h0 ≤ eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∃ h : ℝ → EdgeSet pb → ℝ, h 0 = h0 ∧ IsGradientFlow (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun e => edgeMeasureE pb lam e * w e) gd (fun s e => 1 + h s e) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ e, 0 < 1 + h t e ∧ |ratio (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => 1 + h t z) e - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ (∀ h' : ℝ → EdgeSet pb → ℝ, h' 0 = h0 → IsGradientFlow (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun e => edgeMeasureE pb lam e * w e) gd (fun s e => 1 + h' s e) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → h' t = h t) ∧ ∃ cinf : ℝ, Balanced (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun _ => cinf) ∧ |cinf - 1 - Graph.meanL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) h0| ≤ CW g a wmin wsup * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) h0) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun e => h t e - (cinf - 1)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat * t / 2))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full` for the DB loss, flow clause with existence, under `C³` on the closed window**: `local_convergence_full_exists` on `(E, K₂, λ₂)`, the kernel, invariance, positivity and total mass of `λ₂` proved from the backward policy (`C3Wrappers`).

decls.name: local_convergence_gd_DB_C3On
decls.statement: theorem local_convergence_gd_DB_C3On {pb : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {w : EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {g gd : ℝ → ℝ} {hk : ℕ → EdgeSet pb → ℝ} {a wsup wmin Bhat lamMin gam : ℝ} (hpb : Core.IsMarkovOn lam pb) (hinvpb : Core.IsInvariant lam pb) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hlmin0 : 0 < lamMin) (hlmin : ∀ e, lamMin ≤ edgeMeasureE pb lam e) (ha : 0 < a) (hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (winC3 a)) (hgd : ∀ y ∈ winC3 a, HasDerivWithinAt g (gd y) (winC3 a) y) (hg1 : deriv g 1 = 0) (hg2 : 0 < deriv (deriv g) 1) (hwsup : ∀ e, |w e| ≤ wsup) (hwmin0 : 0 < wmin) (hwmin : ∀ e, wmin ≤ w e) (hB1 : 1 ≤ Bhat) (hcoer : ∀ f : EdgeSet pb → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (Aop (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) f)) (hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, hk (k + 1) = fun e => hk k e - gam * lossGrad (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => edgeMeasureE pb lam z * w z) gd (fun z => 1 + hk k z) e) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hgam : gam ≤ gamma0W g a wmin wsup Bhat) (hnorm0 : Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (hk 0) ≤ eps0W g a wmin wsup Bhat lamMin) : ∀ k : ℕ, ((∀ e, 0 < 1 + hk k e) ∧ (∀ e, |ratio (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => 1 + hk k z) e - 1| ≤ 2 * a / 3) ∧ ∀ d : EdgeSet pb → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => edgeMeasureE pb lam z * w z) (fun e => 1 + hk k e + t * d e) g) (Graph.ipL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (lossGrad (edgeKernelE pb) (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (fun z => edgeMeasureE pb lam z * w z) gd fun z => 1 + hk k z) d) 0) ∧ Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (hk (k + 1))) ≤ (1 - gam * rhoL (deriv (deriv g) 1) wmin Bhat / 4) * Graph.nrmL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (perpL2 (edgeMeasureE pb lam) (hk k))
decls.doc: **`theo:local_convergence_full` for the DB loss, gradient-descent clause, under `C³` on the closed window.**

decls.name: logSq_C3On_bundle
decls.statement: theorem logSq_C3On_bundle : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 logSq (winC3 (1/2)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ winC3 (1/2), HasDerivWithinAt logSq (logSqDeriv y) (winC3 (1/2)) y) ∧ deriv logSq 1 = 0 ∧ 0 < deriv (deriv logSq) 1
decls.doc: **The `C³`-on-the-window bundle is inhabited by `g = (log x)²`** at `a = 1/2`, `gd = 2 log x/x`.

decls.name: kinkGen
decls.statement: noncomputable def kinkGen (y : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: A generator that is `C³` on `[1/2, 3/2]` only from inside: `(y−1)²` plus a kink at `3/2`.

decls.name: kinkGen_C3On_not_C3
decls.statement: theorem kinkGen_C3On_not_C3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 kinkGen (winC3 (1/2)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ winC3 (1/2), HasDerivWithinAt kinkGen (2 * (y - 1)) (winC3 (1/2)) y) ∧ deriv kinkGen 1 = 0 ∧ 0 < deriv (deriv kinkGen) 1 ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ kinkGen (3/2)
decls.doc: **The widening is real**: `kinkGen` meets the `C³`-on-the-window bundle at `a = 1/2` with `gd = 2(y−1)`, and is not differentiable at the endpoint `3/2`, so the two-sided reading of `C3Wrappers` does not cover it.

decls.name: twoState_exists_check
decls.statement: theorem twoState_exists_check : ∃ h : ℝ → Fin 2 → ℝ, IsGradientFlow twoStateK twoStateLam (fun z => twoStateLam z * 1) logSqDeriv (fun s x => 1 + h s x) ∧ ¬ Balanced twoStateK twoStateLam (fun x => 1 + h 0 x)
decls.doc: **The existence clause is inhabited off balance**: on the two-state chain, `g = (log x)²`, `a = 1/2`, `w ≡ 1`, `λ_min = 1/2`, `B̂ = 1`, from `h₀ = (ε₀/2, −ε₀/2)` — a non-balanced start inside the basin — `local_convergence_full_exists` produces a solution of the flow predicate.

decls.name: cycle_training_speed_paper_check
decls.statement: theorem cycle_training_speed_paper_check : ∃ u : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, u 0 = uInfl 2 ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol (p := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (lam (1 / 2)) (fun x => lam (1 / 2) x * 1) logSqDeriv u ∧ ¬ Balanced (pol (p := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (lam (1 / 2)) (u 0) ∧ ∃ t₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ t₁ ∧ Graph.nrmL2 (lam (1 / 2)) (fun x => u t₁ x / Graph.meanL2 (lam (1 / 2)) (u t₁) - 1) ≤ eps0W logSq (1/2) 1 (Graph.maxOver cyc fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (BhatSigma cyc (hitExp (1 / 2)) (lam (1 / 2))) (Graph.minOver cyc (lam (1 / 2)))
decls.doc: **`training_speed_full_paper` applies, with no flow hypothesised**, on the five-vertex cycle of `rem:cycle_no_stalemate` at `p = 1/2`, `w ≡ 1`, from the over-inflated `uInfl 2`: a flow exists, starts off balance, and enters the paper's neighbourhood at some `t₁ ≥ 0`.

files.title: Weighted `L²(λ)` as an inner-product space, and the contraction at `H = g''(1)A^†M_wA`

decls.name: wtL2
decls.statement: noncomputable def wtL2 (lam a : V → ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: `w_λ a := (√λ(x)·a(x))_x`, read into `EuclideanSpace ℝ V`.

decls.name: wtL2_apply
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem wtL2_apply (lam a : V → ℝ) (x : V) : wtL2 lam a x = Real.sqrt (lam x) * a x

decls.name: unwtL2
decls.statement: noncomputable def unwtL2 (lam : V → ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The inverse weighting, `v ↦ (v(x)/√λ(x))_x`.

decls.name: unwtL2_apply
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem unwtL2_apply (lam : V → ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) (x : V) : unwtL2 lam v x = v x / Real.sqrt (lam x)

decls.name: unwtL2_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem unwtL2_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : unwtL2 lam (wtL2 lam a) = a

decls.name: wtL2_unwtL2
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_unwtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : wtL2 lam (unwtL2 lam v) = v

decls.name: exists_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem exists_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : ∃ a : V → ℝ, wtL2 lam a = v

decls.name: inner_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem inner_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a b : V → ℝ) : ⟪wtL2 lam a, wtL2 lam b⟫ = Graph.ipL2 lam a b

decls.name: norm_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem norm_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : ‖wtL2 lam a‖ = Graph.nrmL2 lam a

decls.name: funAct_add
decls.statement: theorem funAct_add (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) : funAct K (fun y => a y + b y) = fun x => funAct K a x + funAct K b x

decls.name: Adj_add
decls.statement: theorem Adj_add (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Adj K (fun y => a y + b y) x = Adj K a x + Adj K b x

decls.name: densAct_add
decls.statement: theorem densAct_add (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) (y : V) : Core.densAct lam K (fun x => a x + b x) y = Core.densAct lam K a y + Core.densAct lam K b y
decls.doc: `P(a + b) = Pa + Pb`, at every state and with no hypothesis.

decls.name: Aop_add
decls.statement: theorem Aop_add (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) (y : V) : Aop K lam (fun x => a x + b x) y = Aop K lam a y + Aop K lam b y
decls.doc: `A(a + b) = Aa + Ab`.

decls.name: meanL2_add
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_add (lam a b : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun x => a x + b x) = Graph.meanL2 lam a + Graph.meanL2 lam b
decls.doc: `Π(a + b) = Πa + Πb`.

decls.name: linHess_add
decls.statement: theorem linHess_add (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) : linHess K lam w g2 (fun x => a x + b x) = fun x => linHess K lam w g2 a x + linHess K lam w g2 b x
decls.doc: `H(a + b) = Ha + Hb`.

decls.name: linHess_smul
decls.statement: theorem linHess_smul (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 c : ℝ) (a : V → ℝ) : linHess K lam w g2 (fun x => c * a x) = fun x => c * linHess K lam w g2 a x
decls.doc: `H(c·a) = c·Ha`.

decls.name: wtL2_add
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_add (lam a b : V → ℝ) : wtL2 lam (fun x => a x + b x) = wtL2 lam a + wtL2 lam b

decls.name: wtL2_smul
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_smul (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (a : V → ℝ) : wtL2 lam (fun x => c * a x) = c • wtL2 lam a

decls.name: wtL2_sub
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_sub (lam a b : V → ℝ) : wtL2 lam (fun x => a x - b x) = wtL2 lam a - wtL2 lam b

decls.name: wtL2_neg
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_neg (lam a : V → ℝ) : wtL2 lam (fun x => -a x) = -wtL2 lam a

decls.name: unwtL2_add
decls.statement: theorem unwtL2_add (lam : V → ℝ) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : unwtL2 lam (u + v) = fun x => unwtL2 lam u x + unwtL2 lam v x

decls.name: unwtL2_smul
decls.statement: theorem unwtL2_smul (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : unwtL2 lam (c • v) = fun x => c * unwtL2 lam v x

decls.name: hessLin
decls.statement: noncomputable def hessLin (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: The paper's `H = g''(1)A^†M_wA`, conjugated by the weighting, as a linear map.

decls.name: hessOp
decls.statement: noncomputable def hessOp (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: The paper's `H`, bundled: continuity is free in finite dimension.

decls.name: hessOp_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem hessOp_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (K : V → V → ℝ) (w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (a : V → ℝ) : hessOp K lam w g2 (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (linHess K lam w g2 a)

decls.name: meanLin
decls.statement: noncomputable def meanLin (lam : V → ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: The mean projection `Π h = (∫ h dλ)·𝟙`, conjugated by the weighting, as a linear map.

decls.name: meanOp
decls.statement: noncomputable def meanOp (lam : V → ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: `Π`, bundled.

decls.name: meanOp_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : meanOp lam (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (fun _ => Graph.meanL2 lam a)

decls.name: ipL2_const_left
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_const_left (lam b : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam (fun _ => c) b = c * Graph.meanL2 lam b

decls.name: meanL2_const
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_const {lam : V → ℝ} (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (c : ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (fun _ => c) = c
decls.doc: `Π(c·𝟙) = c` when `λ` is a probability.

decls.name: wtL2_zero
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_zero (lam : V → ℝ) : wtL2 lam (fun _ => 0) = 0

decls.name: wtL2_injective
decls.statement: theorem wtL2_injective {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : Function.Injective (wtL2 lam)

decls.name: inner_hessOp
decls.statement: theorem inner_hessOp {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (K : V → V → ℝ) (w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (a b : V → ℝ) : ⟪wtL2 lam a, hessOp K lam w g2 (wtL2 lam b)⟫ = Graph.ipL2 lam a (linHess K lam w g2 b)
decls.doc: `⟪a ∣ Hb⟫_λ` read through the weighting.

decls.name: meanOp_selfAdjoint
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_selfAdjoint {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : ⟪meanOp lam u, v⟫ = ⟪u, meanOp lam v⟫
decls.doc: **`Π` is self-adjoint** for `⟪·∣·⟫_λ` — `stable_frozen_discrete`'s `hPisa`.

decls.name: meanOp_idem
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_idem {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : meanOp lam (meanOp lam u) = meanOp lam u
decls.doc: **`Π² = Π`** — `stable_frozen_discrete`'s `hPiPi`.

decls.name: hessOp_selfAdjoint
decls.statement: theorem hessOp_selfAdjoint {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : ⟪hessOp K lam w g2 u, v⟫ = ⟪u, hessOp K lam w g2 v⟫
decls.doc: **`H` is self-adjoint** — `stable_frozen_discrete`'s `hHsa`, from `Expansion.linHess_symm`.

decls.name: meanOp_hessOp
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_hessOp {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (w : V → ℝ) (g2 : ℝ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : meanOp lam (hessOp K lam w g2 u) = 0
decls.doc: **`ΠH = 0`** — `stable_frozen_discrete`'s `hPiH`, from `Expansion.meanL2_linHess`.

decls.name: sub_meanOp_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem sub_meanOp_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : wtL2 lam a - meanOp lam (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (perpL2 lam a)
decls.doc: **`u − Πu` is the weighting of `h^⊥`.**

decls.name: hessOp_upper
decls.statement: theorem hessOp_upper {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {w : V → ℝ} {g2 wsup : ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, w x ≤ wsup) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : ⟪u, hessOp K lam w g2 u⟫ ≤ 4 * g2 * wsup * ‖u‖ ^ 2
decls.doc: **`⟪u ∣ Hu⟫ ≤ 4g''(1)‖w‖_∞‖u‖²`** — `stable_frozen_discrete`'s `hup`, from `Expansion.linHess_upper`.

decls.name: hessOp_coercive
decls.statement: theorem hessOp_coercive {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {w : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin Bhat : ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hBhat : 0 < Bhat) (hmix : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ V) : g2 * wmin / Bhat ^ 2 * ‖u - meanOp lam u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, hessOp K lam w g2 u⟫
decls.doc: **`(g''(1)w_min/B̂²)‖u − Πu‖² ≤ ⟪u ∣ Hu⟫`** — `stable_frozen_discrete`'s `hcoer`, from `Expansion.linHess_coercive` composed with the mixing coercivity `‖h^⊥‖ ≤ B̂‖Ah‖` (`lem:sigma_mixing`, hypothesised here in its finite-state form).

decls.name: meanL2_densAct
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_densAct {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 lam (Core.densAct lam K a) = Graph.meanL2 lam a
decls.doc: `Π P = Π`: the density action preserves `λ`-integrals.

decls.name: densLin
decls.statement: noncomputable def densLin (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: The density action `P`, conjugated by the weighting, as a linear map.

decls.name: densOp
decls.statement: noncomputable def densOp (lam : V → ℝ) (K : V → V → ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: `P`, bundled.

decls.name: densOp_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem densOp_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (K : V → V → ℝ) (a : V → ℝ) : densOp lam K (wtL2 lam a) = wtL2 lam (Core.densAct lam K a)

decls.name: meanOp_mul_densOp
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_mul_densOp {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : meanOp lam * densOp lam K = meanOp lam
decls.doc: **`ΠP = Π`** — `Core.Mixing`'s `proj_left`.

decls.name: densOp_mul_meanOp
decls.statement: theorem densOp_mul_meanOp {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : densOp lam K * meanOp lam = meanOp lam
decls.doc: **`PΠ = Π`** — `Core.Mixing`'s `proj_right`; `P` fixes the constants, `λ` being invariant.

decls.name: one_sub_densOp_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem one_sub_densOp_wtL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (K : V → V → ℝ) (f : V → ℝ) : (1 - densOp lam K) (wtL2 lam f) = -wtL2 lam (Aop K lam f)

decls.name: mixing_coercivity_finite
decls.statement: theorem mixing_coercivity_finite {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (f : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing` on a finite state space**: `‖h^⊥‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ B̂‖Ah‖_{L²(λ)}` with `B̂ = ∑_{n≥0}‖P^n − Π‖` the paper's mixing sum, read off `GFNBounds.Core.Mixing.coercivity` through the weighting.

decls.name: stable_frozen_discrete_finite
decls.statement: theorem stable_frozen_discrete_finite {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin wsup Bhat eps : ℝ} {h : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hwsup : ∀ x, w x ≤ wsup) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hBhat : 0 < Bhat) (hmix : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hepsL : eps * (4 * g2 * wsup) ≤ 1) (hrho : eps * (g2 * wmin / Bhat ^ 2) ≤ 1) (hstep : ∀ k x, h (k + 1) x = h k x - eps * linHess K lam w g2 (h k) x) : (∀ k, Graph.meanL2 lam (h k) = Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)) ∧ ∀ k, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h k)) ≤ (1 - eps * (g2 * wmin / Bhat ^ 2)) ^ k * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:db_stable_frozen_full`, the discrete half, at `H = g''(1)A^†M_wA` on a finite state space** (statement `proofs.tex:592–602`, proof `proofs.tex:604–610`).

decls.name: stable_frozen_discrete_mixing
decls.statement: theorem stable_frozen_discrete_mixing {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin wsup eps : ℝ} {h : ℕ → V → ℝ} (hK : Core.IsMarkov K) (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hwsup : ∀ x, w x ≤ wsup) (hwsup0 : 0 ≤ wsup) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (hBpos : 0 < Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hepsL : eps * (4 * g2 * wsup) ≤ 1) (hrho : eps * (g2 * wmin / Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) ^ 2) ≤ 1) (hstep : ∀ k x, h (k + 1) x = h k x - eps * linHess K lam w g2 (h k) x) : (∀ k, Graph.meanL2 lam (h k) = Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)) ∧ ∀ k, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h k)) ≤ (1 - eps * (g2 * wmin / Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) ^ 2)) ^ k * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:db_stable_frozen_full`, the discrete half, with `B̂` the paper's mixing sum.** `stable_frozen_discrete_finite` with its one remaining abstract input discharged: `hmix` comes from `GFNBounds.Core.Mixing` at the conjugated density action, so `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²` with `B̂ = ∑_{n≥0}‖P^n − Π‖` exactly as the theorem defines it.

decls.name: wtLin
decls.statement: noncomputable def wtLin (lam : V → ℝ) : (V → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: The weighting as a linear map, so that a curve's derivative transports through it.

decls.name: wtCLM
decls.statement: noncomputable def wtCLM (lam : V → ℝ) : (V → ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V
decls.doc: The weighting as a bounded operator; continuity is free in finite dimension.

decls.name: wtCLM_apply
decls.statement: theorem wtCLM_apply (lam a : V → ℝ) : wtCLM lam a = wtL2 lam a

decls.name: stable_frozen_decay_finite
decls.statement: theorem stable_frozen_decay_finite {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam w : V → ℝ} {g2 wmin Bhat : ℝ} {h : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hinv : Core.IsInvariant lam K) (hKnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) (hwmin0 : 0 ≤ wmin) (hwmin : ∀ x, wmin ≤ w x) (hBhat : 0 < Bhat) (hmix : ∀ f : V → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam f) ≤ Bhat * Graph.nrmL2 lam (Aop K lam f)) (hflow : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h (fun x => -(linHess K lam w g2 (h t) x)) t) : (∀ t : ℝ, Graph.meanL2 lam (h t) = Graph.meanL2 lam (h 0)) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h t)) ≤ Real.exp (-(g2 * wmin / Bhat ^ 2 * t)) * Graph.nrmL2 lam (perpL2 lam (h 0))
decls.doc: **`theo:db_stable_frozen_full`, the continuous half, at `H = g''(1)A^†M_wA` on a finite state space** (statement `proofs.tex:592–602`, proof `proofs.tex:604–610`).

decls.name: twoStateSeq
decls.statement: noncomputable def twoStateSeq (k : ℕ) : Fin 2 → ℝ
decls.doc: `h_k = (3/4)^k·h + 𝟙` on the two-state chain: mean `1`, perpendicular part `(3/4)^k h`.

decls.name: twoState_meanL2_seq
decls.statement: theorem twoState_meanL2_seq (k : ℕ) : Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq k) = 1
decls.doc: `Πh_k = 1`: the conserved component is not zero.

decls.name: twoState_perp_seq
decls.statement: theorem twoState_perp_seq (k : ℕ) : perpL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq k) = fun x => (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k * expH x

decls.name: twoState_nrm_perp_seq
decls.statement: theorem twoState_nrm_perp_seq (k : ℕ) : Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq k)) = (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 / 5)

decls.name: twoState_Aop_eq_neg_perp
decls.statement: theorem twoState_Aop_eq_neg_perp (f : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Aop twoStateK twoStateLam f = fun y => -perpL2 twoStateLam f y
decls.doc: **`B̂ = 1` on this chain, exactly**: `Af = −f^⊥` at every `f`, `P` being the `λ`-average.

decls.name: twoState_mixing
decls.statement: theorem twoState_mixing (f : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam f) ≤ 1 * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (Aop twoStateK twoStateLam f)

decls.name: twoState_step
decls.statement: theorem twoState_step (k : ℕ) (x : Fin 2) : twoStateSeq (k + 1) x = twoStateSeq k x - 1 / 8 * linHess twoStateK twoStateLam (fun _ => 1) 2 (twoStateSeq k) x
decls.doc: `Hh_k = 2·(3/4)^k h`: the descent recursion of the theorem, evaluated.

decls.name: twoState_contraction_check
decls.statement: theorem twoState_contraction_check : (∀ k : ℕ, Graph.meanL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq k) = 1) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq k)) ≤ (1 - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * (2 * 1 / (1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ k * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq 0))) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq k)) = (1 - (1 / 8 : ℝ) * (2 * 1 / (1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) ^ k * Graph.nrmL2 twoStateLam (perpL2 twoStateLam (twoStateSeq 0)))
decls.doc: **The contraction, evaluated, attained, and with a non-zero conserved component.** *(1)* and *(2)* are proved **through** `stable_frozen_discrete_finite`, discharging each of its fifteen hypotheses at `g''(1) = 2`, `w ≡ 1` (so `w_min = ‖w‖_{L^∞} = 1`), `B̂ = 1`, `ϱ = 2` and `ε = 1/8` — the step condition at equality.

files.title: The mean projection is orthogonal on `L²(λ)`, so `β̂₀ = ‖I − Π‖ = 1` exactly

decls.name: one_sub_meanOp_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem one_sub_meanOp_ne_zero [Nontrivial V] {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V) - meanOp lam ≠ 0
decls.doc: **`I − Π ≠ 0`** as soon as there are two states: the weighting of the indicator of `x₀` is not `Π`-invariant, since a constant cannot be `1` at `x₀` and `0` at `x₁ ≠ x₀`.

decls.name: norm_one_sub_meanOp
decls.statement: theorem norm_one_sub_meanOp [Nontrivial V] {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) : ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ V →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ V) - meanOp lam‖ = 1
decls.doc: **`‖I − Π‖ = 1`** on `L²(λ)`, `Π` the mean projection.

decls.name: beta_zero_densOp_meanOp
decls.statement: theorem beta_zero_densOp_meanOp [Nontrivial V] {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (K : V → V → ℝ) : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) 0 = 1
decls.doc: **`β̂₀ = 1`** — the normalization in `lem:sigma_mixing`'s hypothesis (`proofs.tex:582`), for the paper's `Π` on `L²(λ)`.

decls.name: one_le_B_densOp
decls.statement: theorem one_le_B_densOp [Nontrivial V] {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) : 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)
decls.doc: **`1 ≤ B̂`** for summable mixing at the paper's `(P, Π)`: the hypothesis `LocalConvergence.lean` and `RatioBridge.lean` carry as `hB1`, once their `B̂` is the mixing sum.

decls.name: rho_densOp_le
decls.statement: theorem rho_densOp_le [Nontrivial V] {lam : V → ℝ} {K : V → V → ℝ} {g2 wmin : ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hmx : Core.Mixing (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam)) (h0 : 0 ≤ g2 * wmin) : g2 * wmin / Core.Mixing.B (densOp lam K) (meanOp lam) ^ 2 ≤ g2 * wmin
decls.doc: **`ϱ ≤ g''(1)w_min`** (`proofs.tex:652`, "since `B̂ ≥ β̂₀ = 1`"): the rate `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²` of `theo:db_stable_frozen_full`, with `B̂` the mixing sum at the paper's `(P, Π)`, never exceeds `g''(1)w_min`.

decls.name: twoStateLam_sum
decls.statement: theorem twoStateLam_sum : ∑ x, twoStateLam x = 1

decls.name: twoState_densOp_eq_meanOp
decls.statement: theorem twoState_densOp_eq_meanOp : densOp twoStateLam twoStateK = meanOp twoStateLam
decls.doc: **`P = Π` on the two-state chain** (`proofs.tex:799`), as bounded operators on `L²(λ)`.

decls.name: twoState_meanOp_idem
decls.statement: theorem twoState_meanOp_idem : meanOp twoStateLam * meanOp twoStateLam = meanOp twoStateLam

decls.name: twoState_mixing_densOp
decls.statement: theorem twoState_mixing_densOp : Core.Mixing (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam)
decls.doc: **Summable mixing at `(P, Π)`, exhibited**: on the two-state chain `P = Π` is idempotent, so `Pⁿ − Π = 0` for `n ≥ 1` and the sum is finite.

decls.name: twoState_beta_succ
decls.statement: theorem twoState_beta_succ (n : ℕ) : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) (n + 1) = 0
decls.doc: `β̂ₙ = 0` for `n ≥ 1` on the two-state chain.

decls.name: twoState_beta_zero
decls.statement: theorem twoState_beta_zero : Core.Mixing.beta (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) 0 = 1
decls.doc: `β̂₀ = 1` on the two-state chain.

decls.name: twoState_B_densOp
decls.statement: theorem twoState_B_densOp : Core.Mixing.B (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) = 1
decls.doc: `B̂ = 1` on the two-state chain.

decls.name: twoState_mixing_coefficients
decls.statement: theorem twoState_mixing_coefficients : (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → Core.Mixing.beta (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) n = 0) ∧ Core.Mixing.B (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) = Core.Mixing.beta (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) 0 ∧ Core.Mixing.beta (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) 0 = 1
decls.doc: **`prop:nonlinear_freezing`*(2)*, the parenthesis on the mixing coefficients** (`proofs.tex:784`, proof `:799`): on the two-state chain `β̂ₙ = 0` for all `n ≥ 1` and `B̂ = β̂₀ = 1`, with `B̂` the paper's `∑_{n≥0}‖Pⁿ − Π‖` on `L²(λ)`.

decls.name: twoState_rho_eq
decls.statement: theorem twoState_rho_eq (g2 wmin : ℝ) : g2 * wmin / Core.Mixing.B (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) ^ 2 = g2 * wmin
decls.doc: **`ϱ = g''(1)w_min`** on the two-state chain (`proofs.tex:799`): the rate `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²` of `theo:db_stable_frozen_full`, with `B̂` the mixing sum, loses nothing to mixing.

decls.name: twoState_rho_freezing
decls.statement: theorem twoState_rho_freezing (F : FreezingBands) (wmin : ℝ) : deriv (deriv F.g) 1 * wmin / Core.Mixing.B (densOp twoStateLam twoStateK) (meanOp twoStateLam) ^ 2 = 2 * wmin
decls.doc: **`ϱ = 2w_min`** — `prop:nonlinear_freezing`*(2)* (`proofs.tex:784`, proof `:799`) at the proposition's own generator: `g''(1) = deriv (deriv F.g) 1 = 2` for every `F : FreezingBands` (`FreezingBands.deriv_deriv_g_one`), and `B̂ = 1` on the two-state chain.

files.title: The `λ`-reversal of a Markov kernel, and the `L²(λ)`-adjointness it carries
variables: variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : Graph.MarkedGraph V}

decls.name: IsMarkov
decls.statement: structure IsMarkov (A : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: A **Markov kernel** on the finite state space `V`: non-negative, with every row summing to `1`.

decls.name: IsMarkovOn
decls.statement: structure IsMarkovOn (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: A **`λ`-almost-everywhere Markov kernel**: non-negative, with the row at `x` summing to `1` whenever `λ(x) ≠ 0`.

decls.name: IsInvariant
decls.statement: structure IsInvariant (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: A **non-negative invariant measure** `λ`: `λ ≥ 0` and `λT = λ` (`proofs.tex:403`).

decls.name: IsMarkov.toIsMarkovOn
decls.statement: theorem IsMarkov.toIsMarkovOn {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsMarkov A) (lam : V → ℝ) : IsMarkovOn lam A

decls.name: IsMarkovOn.toIsMarkov
decls.statement: theorem IsMarkovOn.toIsMarkov {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsMarkovOn lam A) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : IsMarkov A

decls.name: IsInvariant.mul_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem IsInvariant.mul_eq_zero {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) {y : V} (hy : lam y = 0) (x : V) : lam x * A x y = 0
decls.doc: **A `λ`-null state is unreachable**: if `λ(y) = 0` then every term of `λT(y) = 0` vanishes.

decls.name: IsInvariant.eq_zero_of_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem IsInvariant.eq_zero_of_ne_zero {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) {x y : V} (hx : lam x ≠ 0) (hy : lam y = 0) : A x y = 0
decls.doc: **No transition from a `λ`-charged state to a `λ`-null one**: `λ(x) ≠ 0 = λ(y)` forces `T(x → y) = 0`.

decls.name: reversal
decls.statement: noncomputable def reversal (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*, the `λ`-reversal `T^λ`** (`proofs.tex:405`, entrywise form at `proofs.tex:408`): `T^λ(x → y) = λ(y) T(y → x)/λ(x)`, the disintegration of `T ⊗ λ` over its first marginal `λ`, done by division on a finite space.

decls.name: reversal_apply
decls.statement: theorem reversal_apply (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) (x y : V) : reversal lam A x y = lam y * A y x / lam x

decls.name: reversal_of_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem reversal_of_eq_zero {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} {x : V} (hx : lam x = 0) (y : V) : reversal lam A x y = 0
decls.doc: Off the support of `λ` the reversal is the zero row — the `λ`-negligible set of `proofs.tex:405`, made visible.

decls.name: reversal_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem reversal_nonneg {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) (x y : V) : 0 ≤ reversal lam A x y

decls.name: IsReversalPair
decls.statement: def IsReversalPair (lam : V → ℝ) (A R : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*, the characterizing identity** `λ ⊗ R = A ⊗ λ` (`proofs.tex:405`), read entrywise on a finite space: `(λ ⊗ R)(x,y) = λ(x)R(x→y)` and `(A ⊗ λ)(x,y) = A(y→x)λ(y)` (`proofs.tex:412`).

decls.name: IsReversalPair.symm
decls.statement: theorem IsReversalPair.symm {lam : V → ℝ} {A R : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsReversalPair lam A R) : IsReversalPair lam R A
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(2)*, the flip identity `eq:reversal_flip`** (`proofs.tex:418`): `T^λ ⊗ λ = λ ⊗ T`.

decls.name: isReversalPair_comm
decls.statement: theorem isReversalPair_comm {lam : V → ℝ} {A R : V → V → ℝ} : IsReversalPair lam A R ↔ IsReversalPair lam R A

decls.name: IsInvariant.isReversalPair_reversal
decls.statement: theorem IsInvariant.isReversalPair_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) : IsReversalPair lam A (reversal lam A)
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*, existence**: the reversal satisfies the characterizing identity — at *every* state, including where `λ` vanishes, because there invariance kills both sides.

decls.name: IsReversalPair.eq_reversal
decls.statement: theorem IsReversalPair.eq_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} {A R : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsReversalPair lam A R) {x : V} (hx : lam x ≠ 0) (y : V) : R x y = reversal lam A x y
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*, `λ`-a.e.

decls.name: IsReversalPair.eq_of_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem IsReversalPair.eq_of_ne_zero {lam : V → ℝ} {A R R' : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsReversalPair lam A R) (h' : IsReversalPair lam A R') {x : V} (hx : lam x ≠ 0) (y : V) : R x y = R' x y
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*, `λ`-a.e.

decls.name: IsInvariant.isMarkovOn_reversal
decls.statement: theorem IsInvariant.isMarkovOn_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) : IsMarkovOn lam (reversal lam A)
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*, the reversal is a Markov kernel** — `λ`-almost everywhere, its rows summing to `1` by stationarity of `λ` exactly where `λ` does not vanish.

decls.name: IsReversalPair.isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem IsReversalPair.isInvariant {lam : V → ℝ} {A R : V → V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hA : IsMarkov A) (h : IsReversalPair lam A R) : IsInvariant lam R
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(2)*, `λ` is `T^λ`-invariant** (`proofs.tex:416`): `λT^λ` is the second marginal of `λ ⊗ T^λ = T ⊗ λ`, which is `λ`.

decls.name: reversal_reversal
decls.statement: theorem reversal_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) {x : V} (hx : lam x ≠ 0) (y : V) : reversal lam (reversal lam A) x y = A x y
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(2)*, reversal is an involution `λ`-almost everywhere** (`proofs.tex:406`): `(T^λ)^λ = T` at every state carrying `λ`-mass.

decls.name: funAct
decls.statement: def funAct (A : V → V → ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **function action** `(Au)(x) = ∑_y A(x→y)u(y)` of a kernel on `L²(λ)` — the paper's `Af` of `proofs.tex:422`, and `Graph.BackwardPolicy.qact` for `π̂_←`.

decls.name: funAct_apply
decls.statement: theorem funAct_apply (A : V → V → ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : funAct A u x = ∑ y, A x y * u y

decls.name: densAct
decls.statement: noncomputable def densAct (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **density action** `μ ↦ μA` of a kernel on `𝓜²(λ)`, read on densities: `(d(μA)/dλ)(y) = (∑_x λ(x)A(x→y)u(x))/λ(y)` for `u = dμ/dλ`.

decls.name: densAct_apply
decls.statement: theorem densAct_apply (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) (y : V) : densAct lam A u y = (∑ x, lam x * A x y * u x) / lam y

decls.name: densAct_eq_funAct_reversal
decls.statement: theorem densAct_eq_funAct_reversal (lam : V → ℝ) (A : V → V → ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) : densAct lam A u = funAct (reversal lam A) u
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, half of "the density action of each is the function action of the other"** (`proofs.tex:407`): `d(μT)/dλ = T^λ u`.

decls.name: funAct_eq_densAct_reversal
decls.statement: theorem funAct_eq_densAct_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} {A R : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsReversalPair lam A R) (u : V → ℝ) {y : V} (hy : lam y ≠ 0) : densAct lam R u y = funAct A u y
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the other half** (`proofs.tex:442`, "exchanging the roles of `T` and `T^λ`, legitimate by `eq:reversal_flip`"): `d(μT^λ)/dλ = Tu`, `λ`-almost everywhere.

decls.name: ipL2_congr_right
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_congr_right {lam : V → ℝ} {a b b' : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, lam x ≠ 0 → b x = b' x) : Graph.ipL2 lam a b = Graph.ipL2 lam a b'
decls.doc: `⟪a ∣ ·⟫_λ` does not see a change off the support of `λ`.

decls.name: ipL2_congr_left
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_congr_left {lam : V → ℝ} {a a' b : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, lam x ≠ 0 → a x = a' x) : Graph.ipL2 lam a b = Graph.ipL2 lam a' b
decls.doc: `⟪· ∣ b⟫_λ` does not see a change off the support of `λ`.

decls.name: nrmL2_congr
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_congr {lam : V → ℝ} {a a' : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, lam x ≠ 0 → a x = a' x) : Graph.nrmL2 lam a = Graph.nrmL2 lam a'

decls.name: ipL2_densAct_funAct
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_densAct_funAct {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) (u v : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam (densAct lam A u) v = Graph.ipL2 lam u (funAct A v)
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the adjointness identity in density/function form** (`proofs.tex:433–441`): `⟪μT ∣ ν⟫_λ = ∫ v · (Tv-side) dλ`, here `⟪d(μT)/dλ ∣ v⟫_λ = ⟪u ∣ Tv⟫_λ`.

decls.name: ipL2_densAct_densAct
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_densAct_densAct {lam : V → ℝ} {A R : V → V → ℝ} (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hA : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ A x y) (hR : IsReversalPair lam A R) (u v : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam (densAct lam A u) v = Graph.ipL2 lam u (densAct lam R v)
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the adjointness of the two density actions** (`proofs.tex:407`): `⟪μT ∣ ν⟫_λ = ⟪μ ∣ νT^λ⟫_λ` for `μ, ν ∈ 𝓜²(λ)`, carried by their densities `u, v`.

decls.name: funAct_mul_self_le
decls.statement: theorem funAct_mul_self_le {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkovOn lam A) {x : V} (hx : lam x ≠ 0) (u : V → ℝ) : funAct A u x * funAct A u x ≤ ∑ y, A x y * (u y * u y)
decls.doc: **`eq:reversal_contraction` pointwise** (`proofs.tex:424`): `(Au)(x)² ≤ A(u²)(x)`, Jensen at one state, for a row that is a probability distribution.

decls.name: ipL2_funAct_self_le
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_funAct_self_le {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkovOn lam A) (h : IsInvariant lam A) (u : V → ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 lam (funAct A u) (funAct A u) ≤ Graph.ipL2 lam u u
decls.doc: **`eq:reversal_contraction`** (`proofs.tex:424–425`): the function action of a kernel leaving `λ` invariant is a contraction of `L²(λ)`.

decls.name: nrmL2_funAct_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_funAct_le {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkovOn lam A) (h : IsInvariant lam A) (u : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (funAct A u) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam u
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the function action is a contraction of `L²(λ)`**.

decls.name: nrmL2_densAct_le
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_densAct_le {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkov A) (h : IsInvariant lam A) (u : V → ℝ) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (densAct lam A u) ≤ Graph.nrmL2 lam u
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the density action is a contraction of `𝓜²(λ)`** — the paper's own route, through `d(μT)/dλ = T^λ u` and the contraction of the reversal's function action.

decls.name: nrmL2_one_pos
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_one_pos {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (hne : ∃ x, 0 < lam x) : 0 < Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
decls.doc: `‖λ‖_{𝓜²(λ)} > 0`: `λ` is non-zero and finite, so its own density `1` has positive norm.

decls.name: isLeast_opNorm_funAct
decls.statement: theorem isLeast_opNorm_funAct {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkovOn lam A) (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hne : ∃ x, 0 < lam x) : IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ u, Graph.nrmL2 lam (funAct A u) ≤ c * Graph.nrmL2 lam u} 1
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the function action has operator norm exactly `1`**: `1` is the least constant `c` with `‖Au‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ c‖u‖_{L²(λ)}` for every `u`.

decls.name: isLeast_opNorm_densAct
decls.statement: theorem isLeast_opNorm_densAct {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkov A) (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hne : ∃ x, 0 < lam x) : IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ u, Graph.nrmL2 lam (densAct lam A u) ≤ c * Graph.nrmL2 lam u} 1
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(3)*, the density action has operator norm exactly `1`**.

decls.name: adjoint_finite
decls.statement: theorem adjoint_finite {lam : V → ℝ} {A : V → V → ℝ} (hA : IsMarkov A) (h : IsInvariant lam A) (hne : ∃ x, 0 < lam x) : (IsMarkovOn lam (reversal lam A) ∧ IsReversalPair lam A (reversal lam A)) ∧ (∀ R, IsReversalPair lam A R → ∀ x, lam x ≠ 0 → ∀ y, R x y = reversal lam A x y) ∧ (IsInvariant lam (reversal lam A) ∧ IsReversalPair lam (reversal lam A) A ∧ ∀ x, lam x ≠ 0 → ∀ y, reversal lam (reversal lam A) x y = A x y) ∧ (∀ u v, Graph.ipL2 lam (densAct lam A u) v = Graph.ipL2 lam u (densAct lam (reversal lam A) v)) ∧ (densAct lam A = funAct (reversal lam A) ∧ ∀ u x, lam x ≠ 0 → densAct lam (reversal lam A) u x = funAct A u x) ∧ IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ u, Graph.nrmL2 lam (densAct lam A u) ≤ c * Graph.nrmL2 lam u} 1
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(1)*–*(3)* on a finite state space** (`proofs.tex:402–410`), with the paper's `λ`-almost-everywhere qualifications read as "at every state carrying `λ`-mass".

decls.name: phat_isMarkov
decls.statement: theorem phat_isMarkov : IsMarkov B.phat
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(4)*, `T = π̂_←`**: the loop closure is a Markov kernel on `𝒱` (`proofs.tex:408`, "which on a finite marked graph is the loop closure `π̂_←` […] and not `π_←` itself").

decls.name: isInvariant_of_isInvProb
decls.statement: theorem isInvariant_of_isInvProb {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) : IsInvariant lam B.phat
decls.doc: An invariant probability of the backward chain is an invariant measure in the sense of this file.

decls.name: graph_reversal_eq
decls.statement: theorem graph_reversal_eq (lam : V → ℝ) : B.reversal lam = reversal lam B.phat
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(4)*, the entrywise formula** (`proofs.tex:408`): `π_→^λ(s → s') = λ(s') π̂_←(s' → s)/λ(s)` is the general finite `λ`-reversal of `π̂_←`, so `theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*'s `Graph.BackwardPolicy.reversal` **is** `reversal`.

decls.name: graph_pdens_eq
decls.statement: theorem graph_pdens_eq (lam : V → ℝ) : B.pdens lam = densAct lam B.phat
decls.doc: `Graph.BackwardPolicy.pdens`, the density action of `prop:morozov_rate`, is `densAct` of `π̂_←`.

decls.name: graph_qact_eq
decls.statement: theorem graph_qact_eq : B.qact = funAct B.phat
decls.doc: `Graph.BackwardPolicy.qact`, the function action of `prop:morozov_rate`, is `funAct` of `π̂_←`.

decls.name: reversal_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem reversal_hatEdge {lam : V → ℝ} {u v : V} (h : reversal lam B.phat u v ≠ 0) : G.hatEdge u v
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(4)*, the support** (`proofs.tex:444`, "it is positive only where `π̂_←(s'→s) > 0`, hence only on edges `s → s'` of `Ĝ`").

decls.name: reversal_snk_src
decls.statement: theorem reversal_snk_src {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) : reversal lam B.phat G.snk G.src = 1
decls.doc: **`lem:adjoint`*(4)*, the wrap edge** (`proofs.tex:444`): `π_→^λ(s_f → s₀) = 1`, so `s_f` is not terminal for the forward policy.

files.title: Universality of an arbitrary family of generative flows, and targets without full support
variables: variable {ν : Measure α} {θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)} {f_init f_term : α → ℝ}
variable {ν : Measure α} {θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)} {f_init f_term : α → ℝ} {p r : ℝ≥0∞}
variable {θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)} {f_init f_term : α → ℝ}
variable {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)]
variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : MarkedGraph V}

decls.name: IsGenerativeFlow
decls.statement: structure IsGenerativeFlow (ν : Measure α) (θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, the objects**: a generative flow `(π⋆, f_out⋆)` on `(𝒮, ν_B)` (`proofs.tex:16`) — `π⋆` a Markov kernel and `f_out⋆ : 𝒮 → ℝ₊` integrable.

decls.name: IsFlowFamily
decls.statement: def IsFlowFamily (ν : Measure α) (Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`**: `Θ` is a family of generative flows.

decls.name: defectFn
decls.statement: noncomputable def defectFn (ν : Measure α) (θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)) (f_init f_term : α → ℝ) : α → ℝ
decls.doc: **The flow-matching defect** `D = F_init + F⋆_out π⋆ − F⋆_out − F_term`, as a `ν`-density (`proofs.tex:45–51`, `proofs.tex:79`).

decls.name: resInitFn
decls.statement: noncomputable def resInitFn (ν : Measure α) (θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)) (f_init f_term : α → ℝ) : α → ℝ
decls.doc: **`δf_init = D⁻`**.

decls.name: resTermFn
decls.statement: noncomputable def resTermFn (ν : Measure α) (θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)) (f_init f_term : α → ℝ) : α → ℝ
decls.doc: **`δf_term = D⁺`**.

decls.name: residual
decls.statement: noncomputable def residual (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (θ : Kernel α α × (α → ℝ)) (f_init f_term : α → ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, the quantity infimized**: `‖δf_init‖_{L^p(ν)} + ‖δf_term‖_{L^p(ν)}`, in `[0, ∞]`.

decls.name: IsAdmissiblePair
decls.statement: structure IsAdmissiblePair (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (f_init f_term : α → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, the pairs**: densities of distributions `F_init, F_term ≪ ν`, in `L^p(ν)`, of equal total mass.

decls.name: IsBoundedPolicy
decls.statement: def IsBoundedPolicy (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (κ : Kernel α α) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, the boundedness requirement**: `f ↦ f π⋆` is bounded on `L^p(ν)` — `(f ν) π⋆` has a density (`ν π⋆ ≪ ν`) and it is bounded in `L^p`.

decls.name: WeaklyUniversal
decls.statement: def WeaklyUniversal (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, weak form, for an arbitrary family `Θ`.**

decls.name: StronglyUniversal
decls.statement: def StronglyUniversal (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, strong form, for an arbitrary family `Θ`**: the zero infimum is realized at every admissible pair.

decls.name: iInf_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem iInf_eq_zero_iff {ι : Type*} (s : Set ι) (r : ι → ℝ≥0∞) : (⨅ i ∈ s, r i) = 0 ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ i ∈ s, r i < ENNReal.ofReal ε
decls.doc: An infimum in `[0, ∞]` over a set vanishes iff it is approached by elements of the set.

decls.name: StronglyUniversal.weaklyUniversal
decls.statement: theorem StronglyUniversal.weaklyUniversal {ν : Measure α} {p : ℝ≥0∞} {Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))} (h : StronglyUniversal ν p Θ) : WeaklyUniversal ν p Θ
decls.doc: **`def:universality`**: strong universality implies weak universality.

decls.name: aestronglyMeasurable_defectFn
decls.statement: theorem aestronglyMeasurable_defectFn (hθ : AEStronglyMeasurable θ.2 ν) (hi : AEStronglyMeasurable f_init ν) (ht : AEStronglyMeasurable f_term ν) : AEStronglyMeasurable (defectFn ν θ f_init f_term) ν

decls.name: aestronglyMeasurable_resInitFn
decls.statement: theorem aestronglyMeasurable_resInitFn (hθ : AEStronglyMeasurable θ.2 ν) (hi : AEStronglyMeasurable f_init ν) (ht : AEStronglyMeasurable f_term ν) : AEStronglyMeasurable (resInitFn ν θ f_init f_term) ν

decls.name: aestronglyMeasurable_resTermFn
decls.statement: theorem aestronglyMeasurable_resTermFn (hθ : AEStronglyMeasurable θ.2 ν) (hi : AEStronglyMeasurable f_init ν) (ht : AEStronglyMeasurable f_term ν) : AEStronglyMeasurable (resTermFn ν θ f_init f_term) ν

decls.name: defectFn_eq_sub
decls.statement: theorem defectFn_eq_sub (x : α) : defectFn ν θ f_init f_term x = resTermFn ν θ f_init f_term x - resInitFn ν θ f_init f_term x
decls.doc: `D = δf_term − δf_init`, pointwise.

decls.name: ae_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem ae_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero (hp : p ≠ 0) (hθ : AEStronglyMeasurable θ.2 ν) (hi : AEStronglyMeasurable f_init ν) (ht : AEStronglyMeasurable f_term ν) (h : residual ν p θ f_init f_term = 0) : resInitFn ν θ f_init f_term =ᵐ[ν] 0 ∧ resTermFn ν θ f_init f_term =ᵐ[ν] 0
decls.doc: A flow realizing the zero infimum for a pair has almost-everywhere-zero residuals.

decls.name: residual_eq_zero_of_ae
decls.statement: theorem residual_eq_zero_of_ae (h : resInitFn ν θ f_init f_term =ᵐ[ν] 0 ∧ resTermFn ν θ f_init f_term =ᵐ[ν] 0) (r : ℝ≥0∞) : residual ν r θ f_init f_term = 0
decls.doc: Almost-everywhere-zero residuals have zero norm at every exponent.

decls.name: IsAdmissiblePair.mono
decls.statement: theorem IsAdmissiblePair.mono [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (h : IsAdmissiblePair ν p f_init f_term) (hrp : r ≤ p) : IsAdmissiblePair ν r f_init f_term
decls.doc: On a finite measure an `L^p`-admissible pair is `L^r`-admissible for `r ≤ p`.

decls.name: realizes_of_le
decls.statement: theorem realizes_of_le [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hθ : IsGenerativeFlow ν θ) (hpair : IsAdmissiblePair ν p f_init f_term) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (h : residual ν p θ f_init f_term = 0) (hrp : r ≤ p) : IsAdmissiblePair ν r f_init f_term ∧ residual ν r θ f_init f_term = 0
decls.doc: **`def:universality`'s parenthetical** (ruling R6): a flow realizing the zero infimum for an `L^p`-admissible pair realizes it for that pair at every `r ∈ [1, p]`.

decls.name: StronglyUniversal.realizes_of_le
decls.statement: theorem StronglyUniversal.realizes_of_le [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))} (h : StronglyUniversal ν p Θ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hrp : r ≤ p) (hpair : IsAdmissiblePair ν p f_init f_term) : ∃ θ ∈ Θ, IsAdmissiblePair ν r f_init f_term ∧ residual ν r θ f_init f_term = 0
decls.doc: The same at family level, pair by pair.

decls.name: bind_withDensity_ac
decls.statement: theorem bind_withDensity_ac (κ : Kernel α α) (hac : ν.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : (ν.withDensity f).bind ⇑κ ≪ ν

decls.name: lintegral_bindDensity_of_ac
decls.statement: theorem lintegral_bindDensity_of_ac (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hac : ν.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ∫⁻ x, bindDensity κ ν f x ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂ν

decls.name: integrable_toReal_bindDensity_of_ac
decls.statement: theorem integrable_toReal_bindDensity_of_ac (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hac : ν.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : Integrable (fun x => (bindDensity κ ν (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y)) x).toReal) ν

decls.name: integral_toReal_bindDensity_of_ac
decls.statement: theorem integral_toReal_bindDensity_of_ac (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hac : ν.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∫ x, (bindDensity κ ν (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y)) x).toReal ∂ν = (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂ν).toReal

decls.name: integrable_densityAction_of_ac
decls.statement: theorem integrable_densityAction_of_ac (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hac : ν.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : Integrable (densityAction κ ν f) ν
decls.doc: `P⋆ f` is integrable, with no invariance: absolute continuity `ν π⋆ ≪ ν` suffices.

decls.name: integral_densityAction_of_ac
decls.statement: theorem integral_densityAction_of_ac (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hac : ν.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∫ x, densityAction κ ν f x ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂ν
decls.doc: `∫ P⋆ f dν = ∫ f dν`, from stochasticity and `ν π⋆ ≪ ν`, with no invariance.

decls.name: integral_defectFn
decls.statement: theorem integral_defectFn [SigmaFinite ν] (hθ : IsGenerativeFlow ν θ) (hac : ν.bind ⇑θ.1 ≪ ν) (hi : Integrable f_init ν) (ht : Integrable f_term ν) : ∫ x, defectFn ν θ f_init f_term x ∂ν = ∫ x, f_init x ∂ν - ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν
decls.doc: **The defect integrates to `F_init(𝒮) − F_term(𝒮)`** (`universality.tex:11`).

decls.name: ofReal_abs_mass_le_residual_one
decls.statement: theorem ofReal_abs_mass_le_residual_one [SigmaFinite ν] (hθ : IsGenerativeFlow ν θ) (hac : ν.bind ⇑θ.1 ≪ ν) (hi : Integrable f_init ν) (ht : Integrable f_term ν) : ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x, f_init x ∂ν - ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν| ≤ residual ν 1 θ f_init f_term
decls.doc: The mass gap is bounded by the `L¹` residuals.

decls.name: ofReal_abs_mass_le_residual
decls.statement: theorem ofReal_abs_mass_le_residual [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hθ : IsGenerativeFlow ν θ) (hac : ν.bind ⇑θ.1 ≪ ν) (hi : Integrable f_init ν) (ht : Integrable f_term ν) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x, f_init x ∂ν - ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν| ≤ residual ν p θ f_init f_term * ν Set.univ ^ (1 - 1 / p.toReal)
decls.doc: **Unequal masses floor the residuals away from `0`**, at every exponent `p ≥ 1`, with the explicit constant `ν(𝒮)^{1 − 1/p}`.

decls.name: mass_gap_div_le_iInf
decls.statement: theorem mass_gap_div_le_iInf [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))} (hfam : IsFlowFamily ν Θ) (hac : ∀ θ ∈ Θ, ν.bind ⇑θ.1 ≪ ν) (hi : Integrable f_init ν) (ht : Integrable f_term ν) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x, f_init x ∂ν - ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν| / ν Set.univ ^ (1 - 1 / p.toReal) ≤ ⨅ θ ∈ Θ, residual ν p θ f_init f_term
decls.doc: **`def:universality`'s first parenthetical, at family level**: the infimum is at least `|F_init(𝒮) − F_term(𝒮)| / ν(𝒮)^{1 − 1/p}`.

decls.name: iInf_pos_of_mass_ne
decls.statement: theorem iInf_pos_of_mass_ne [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {Θ : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))} (hfam : IsFlowFamily ν Θ) (hac : ∀ θ ∈ Θ, ν.bind ⇑θ.1 ≪ ν) (hi : Integrable f_init ν) (ht : Integrable f_term ν) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hmass : ∫ x, f_init x ∂ν ≠ ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν) : 0 < ⨅ θ ∈ Θ, residual ν p θ f_init f_term
decls.doc: Unequal masses: the infimum is not `0`.

decls.name: fixedPolicyFamily
decls.statement: def fixedPolicyFamily (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (κ : Kernel α α) : Set (Kernel α α × (α → ℝ))
decls.doc: **The family `Θ := {π⋆} × L^p_+(𝒮, ν_B)` of `theo:universality_L2_full`**: one policy, and a free non-negative outflow in `L^p(ν)`.

decls.name: coeFn_negPart_Lp
decls.statement: theorem coeFn_negPart_Lp (a : Lp ℝ p ν) : ⇑(a⁻) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => (a x)⁻

decls.name: coeFn_posPart_Lp
decls.statement: theorem coeFn_posPart_Lp (a : Lp ℝ p ν) : ⇑(a⁺) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => (a x)⁺

decls.name: eLpNorm_eq_ofReal_norm
decls.statement: theorem eLpNorm_eq_ofReal_norm {g : α → ℝ} {a : Lp ℝ p ν} (h : g =ᵐ[ν] ⇑a) : eLpNorm g p ν = ENNReal.ofReal ‖a‖

decls.name: residual_eq_ofReal
decls.statement: theorem residual_eq_ofReal (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) {fout θL : Lp ℝ p ν} {g f_init f_term : α → ℝ} (hg : g =ᵐ[ν] ⇑fout) (hθ : (fun x => f_term x - f_init x) =ᵐ[ν] ⇑θL) : residual ν p (κ, g) f_init f_term = ENNReal.ofReal (‖resInit (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) θL fout‖ + ‖resTerm (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) θL fout‖)
decls.doc: **The family residual is the library's**, for a member of the fixed-policy family whose outflow represents `f_out ∈ L^p(ν)` and a pair whose difference represents `θ`.

decls.name: isFlowFamily_fixedPolicyFamily
decls.statement: theorem isFlowFamily_fixedPolicyFamily (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : IsFlowFamily ν (fixedPolicyFamily ν p κ)
decls.doc: Members of the fixed-policy family are generative flows.

decls.name: isBoundedPolicy_of_inv
decls.statement: theorem isBoundedPolicy_of_inv {κ : Kernel α α} {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : IsBoundedPolicy ν p κ
decls.doc: Under invariance, the paper's boundedness requirement is `IsBoundedDensityAction`.

decls.name: integral_eq_zero_of_meanProj
decls.statement: theorem integral_eq_zero_of_meanProj {θL : Lp ℝ p ν} (h : meanProj ν p θL = 0) : ∫ x, θL x ∂ν = 0
decls.doc: A mean-zero `L^p` element has zero integral.

decls.name: isAdmissiblePair_parts
decls.statement: theorem isAdmissiblePair_parts {θL : Lp ℝ p ν} (h : meanProj ν p θL = 0) : IsAdmissiblePair ν p (fun x => max (-θL x) 0) (fun x => max (θL x) 0)
decls.doc: The admissible pair `(θ⁻, θ⁺)` of a mean-zero element.

decls.name: parts_sub_eq
decls.statement: theorem parts_sub_eq (θL : Lp ℝ p ν) : (fun x => max (θL x) 0 - max (-θL x) 0) =ᵐ[ν] ⇑θL
decls.doc: The pair `(θ⁻, θ⁺)` has difference `θ`.

decls.name: pair_sub_eq
decls.statement: theorem pair_sub_eq {f_init f_term : α → ℝ} (h : IsAdmissiblePair ν p f_init f_term) : (fun x => f_term x - f_init x) =ᵐ[ν] ⇑(h.memLp_term.toLp f_term - h.memLp_init.toLp f_init)
decls.doc: A pair's densities, read in `L^p(ν)`, give the library's `θ = f_term − f_init`.

decls.name: meanProj_pair_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_pair_eq_zero {f_init f_term : α → ℝ} (h : IsAdmissiblePair ν p f_init f_term) : meanProj ν p (h.memLp_term.toLp f_term - h.memLp_init.toLp f_init) = 0

decls.name: nonneg_rep
decls.statement: theorem nonneg_rep {fout : Lp ℝ p ν} (h : 0 ≤ fout) : (fun x => max (fout x) 0) =ᵐ[ν] ⇑fout
decls.doc: An a.e.-non-negative `L^p` element has a pointwise non-negative representative.

decls.name: weaklyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_iff
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_iff (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : WeaklyUniversal ν p (fixedPolicyFamily ν p κ) ↔ GFNBounds.Core.WeaklyUniversal (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) (meanProj ν p)
decls.doc: **`def:universality` and the library agree on the fixed-policy family, weak form.** `WeaklyUniversal ν p ({π⋆} × L^p_+)` — the paper's definition, for an arbitrary family, read at the family of `theo:universality_L2_full` — holds iff the library's `Core.WeaklyUniversal` holds for the density action of `π⋆` and the mean projection.

decls.name: stronglyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_iff
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_iff (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : StronglyUniversal ν p (fixedPolicyFamily ν p κ) ↔ GFNBounds.Core.StronglyUniversal (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) (meanProj ν p)
decls.doc: **`def:universality` and the library agree on the fixed-policy family, strong form.**

decls.name: weaklyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_of_kernel
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_of_kernel (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) ^ n - meanProj ν p‖) (hp : p ≠ ⊤) : WeaklyUniversal ν p (fixedPolicyFamily ν p κ)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_L2_full`, weak half, in `def:universality`'s own terms**: the family `{π⋆} × L^p_+(ν)` is weakly `L^p`-universal for `p < ∞`.

decls.name: stronglyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_top
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversal_fixedPolicyFamily_top (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν ⊤ C) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM κ ν ⊤ hinv hb) ^ n - meanProj ν ⊤‖) : StronglyUniversal ν ⊤ (fixedPolicyFamily ν ⊤ κ)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_L2_full`, `p = +∞` clause, in `def:universality`'s own terms.**

decls.name: coe_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem coe_const_kernel : ⇑(Kernel.const α ν) = fun _ => ν

decls.name: bind_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem bind_const_kernel : ν.bind ⇑(Kernel.const α ν) = ν
decls.doc: The i.i.d.

decls.name: bindDensity_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_const_kernel {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : ∫⁻ x, g x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) : bindDensity (Kernel.const α ν) ν g =ᵐ[ν] fun _ => ∫⁻ x, g x ∂ν

decls.name: densityAction_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_const_kernel {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : densityAction (Kernel.const α ν) ν f =ᵐ[ν] fun _ => ∫ x, f x ∂ν
decls.doc: The density action of the resampling policy is the mean: `P⋆ f = ∫ f dν`, a.e.

decls.name: isBoundedDensityAction_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem isBoundedDensityAction_const_kernel {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : IsBoundedDensityAction (Kernel.const α ν) ν p 1
decls.doc: The resampling policy is bounded on every `L^p(ν)`, `p ≥ 1`, with constant `1`.

decls.name: densityActionCLM_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem densityActionCLM_const_kernel {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : densityActionCLM (Kernel.const α ν) ν p bind_const_kernel (isBoundedDensityAction_const_kernel Fact.out) = meanProj ν p
decls.doc: On `L^p(ν)` the density action of the resampling policy **is** the mean projection.

decls.name: summable_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem summable_const_kernel {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM (Kernel.const α ν) ν p bind_const_kernel (isBoundedDensityAction_const_kernel Fact.out)) ^ n - meanProj ν p‖
decls.doc: The mixing coefficients of the resampling policy vanish from `n = 1` on.

decls.name: weaklyUniversal_const_kernel
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversal_const_kernel {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (hp : p ≠ ⊤) : WeaklyUniversal ν p (fixedPolicyFamily ν p (Kernel.const α ν))
decls.doc: **Inhabitation of `def:universality`'s weak predicate**: on any probability space the family `{π⋆} × L^p_+(ν)` of the i.i.d.

decls.name: stronglyUniversal_const_kernel_top
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversal_const_kernel_top : StronglyUniversal ν ⊤ (fixedPolicyFamily ν ⊤ (Kernel.const α ν))
decls.doc: **Inhabitation of `def:universality`'s strong predicate**: the same family at `p = +∞` is strongly universal — every pair of bounded densities of equal mass is joined exactly.

decls.name: IsTarget
decls.statement: structure IsTarget (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: A **target** on the terminating states of `G`: `R ≥ 0`, charging only states `x` with an edge `x → s_f`.

decls.name: InSub
decls.statement: def InSub (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) (v : V) : Prop
decls.doc: The vertex set of `G'`: `s₀`, `s_f`, and the states from which a directed path of `G` reaches `supp R`, `supp R` included.

decls.name: subVerts
decls.statement: noncomputable def subVerts (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) : Finset V
decls.doc: `InSub` as a `Finset`.

decls.name: mem_subVerts
decls.statement: theorem mem_subVerts {R : V → ℝ} {v : V} : v ∈ subVerts G R ↔ InSub G R v

decls.name: src_mem_subVerts
decls.statement: theorem src_mem_subVerts (R : V → ℝ) : G.src ∈ subVerts G R

decls.name: snk_mem_subVerts
decls.statement: theorem snk_mem_subVerts (R : V → ℝ) : G.snk ∈ subVerts G R

decls.name: subGraph
decls.statement: def subGraph (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) : MarkedGraph {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}
decls.doc: **`G'`** (`rem:partial_support`): the marked subgraph of `G` induced on `subVerts G R`, with the terminating edges `y → s_f`, `R(y) = 0`, deleted.

decls.name: eq_snk_of_reach_snk
decls.statement: theorem eq_snk_of_reach_snk {b : V} (h : G.Reach G.snk b) : b = G.snk

decls.name: sub_reach
decls.statement: theorem sub_reach {R : V → ℝ} {a b : V} (hab : G.Reach a b) (hb : b ≠ G.snk) (hbR : ∃ y, R y ≠ 0 ∧ G.Reach b y) : ∃ (ha' : a ∈ subVerts G R) (hb' : b ∈ subVerts G R), (subGraph G R).Reach ⟨a, ha'⟩ ⟨b, hb'⟩
decls.doc: A walk of `G` ending at a state that reaches `supp R` and is not `s_f` is a walk of `G'`.

decls.name: ne_snk_of_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem ne_snk_of_ne_zero {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) {y : V} (hy : R y ≠ 0) : y ≠ G.snk

decls.name: subGraph_pathConnected
decls.statement: theorem subGraph_pathConnected (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hne : ∃ y, R y ≠ 0) : (subGraph G R).PathConnected
decls.doc: **`G'` is again path-connected** (`rem:partial_support`), as soon as the target is not `0`.

decls.name: sum_subtype_eq
decls.statement: theorem sum_subtype_eq {R : V → ℝ} (f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ v, v ∉ subVerts G R → f v = 0) : ∑ v : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}, f v.1 = ∑ v, f v
decls.doc: A sum over `V` of a function vanishing off `subVerts G R` is a sum over the subtype.

decls.name: IsSinkRow
decls.statement: structure IsSinkRow (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) (q : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: A **sink row for `G'`**: a probability on the in-neighbours of `s_f` in `G'`, positive on each of them.

decls.name: mem_subVerts_of_edge
decls.statement: theorem mem_subVerts_of_edge {R : V → ℝ} {s s' : V} (hs : s ∈ subVerts G R) (hsrc : s ≠ G.src) (hsnk : s ≠ G.snk) (he : G.Edge s' s) : s' ∈ subVerts G R
decls.doc: A predecessor of a state of `G'` other than a mark is a state of `G'`.

decls.name: restrictWith
decls.statement: noncomputable def restrictWith (B : BackwardPolicy G) {R : V → ℝ} (q : V → ℝ) (hq : IsSinkRow G R q) : BackwardPolicy (subGraph G R)
decls.doc: **The restriction of `π_←` to `G'`**, with sink row `q`: every row but the sink's is `π_←`'s, read on `G'`.

decls.name: restrictWith_pb_of_ne_snk
decls.statement: theorem restrictWith_pb_of_ne_snk (B : BackwardPolicy G) {R q : V → ℝ} (hq : IsSinkRow G R q) {s s' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}} (hs : s ≠ (subGraph G R).snk) : (restrictWith B q hq).pb s s' = B.pb s.1 s'.1

decls.name: restrictWith_pb_snk
decls.statement: theorem restrictWith_pb_snk (B : BackwardPolicy G) {R q : V → ℝ} (hq : IsSinkRow G R q) (s' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}) : (restrictWith B q hq).pb (subGraph G R).snk s' = q s'.1

decls.name: restrictWith_positiveOnEdges
decls.statement: theorem restrictWith_positiveOnEdges (B : BackwardPolicy G) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R q : V → ℝ} (hq : IsSinkRow G R q) : (restrictWith B q hq).PositiveOnEdges
decls.doc: The restriction is positive on every edge of `G'`.

decls.name: sinkMass
decls.statement: noncomputable def sinkMass (B : BackwardPolicy G) (R : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: The normalizer of the renormalized sink row: `π_←`'s sink row summed over the in-neighbours of `s_f` in `G'`.

decls.name: renormRow
decls.statement: noncomputable def renormRow (B : BackwardPolicy G) (R : V → ℝ) (y : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`π_←`'s sink row, restricted to `G'` and renormalized.**

decls.name: sinkMass_pos
decls.statement: theorem sinkMass_pos (B : BackwardPolicy G) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hne : ∃ y, R y ≠ 0) : 0 < sinkMass B R

decls.name: isSinkRow_renormRow
decls.statement: theorem isSinkRow_renormRow (B : BackwardPolicy G) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hne : ∃ y, R y ≠ 0) : IsSinkRow G R (renormRow B R)

decls.name: restrict_policy
decls.statement: theorem restrict_policy (B : BackwardPolicy G) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hne : ∃ y, R y ≠ 0) : ∃ B' : BackwardPolicy (subGraph G R), B'.PositiveOnEdges ∧ (∀ s s', s ≠ (subGraph G R).snk → B'.pb s s' = B.pb s.1 s'.1) ∧ (∀ s', B'.pb (subGraph G R).snk s' = renormRow B R s'.1)
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, the restriction claim**: a backward policy on `G` positive on its edges restricts to one on `G'` positive on the edges of `G'`, with only its sink row renormalized — every other row is `π_←`'s.

decls.name: outStar
decls.statement: noncomputable def outStar (G : MarkedGraph V) (e : V → V → ℝ) (u : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: The star outflow of an edge flow `e`: the flow out of `u` along every edge but the terminating one.

decls.name: fwdStarE
decls.statement: noncomputable def fwdStarE (G : MarkedGraph V) (e : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: The star forward policy of an edge flow, `e(u → v)/f_out⋆(u)`.

decls.name: fmDefectE
decls.statement: noncomputable def fmDefectE (G : MarkedGraph V) (e : V → V → ℝ) (T : V → ℝ) (v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`equ:FM_const` on `𝒮 = 𝒱 ∖ {s₀, s_f}` for an edge flow `e` and a terminal flow `T`**: `F_init(v) + ((f_out⋆ μ) π⋆)(v) − T(v) − f_out⋆(v)`, with `F_init(v) = e(s₀ → v)`.

decls.name: fmDefect_eq_fmDefectE
decls.statement: theorem fmDefect_eq_fmDefectE (B : BackwardPolicy G) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) (v : V) : B.fmDefect lam c v = fmDefectE G (B.edgeFlow lam c) (B.termFlow lam c) v
decls.doc: On the flow of `theo:universality_graphs`(3), `fmDefectE` **is** the library's `fmDefect`.

decls.name: outStar_mul_fwdStarE
decls.statement: theorem outStar_mul_fwdStarE {e : V → V → ℝ} (he : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ e u v) (u : V) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ G.snk) : outStar G e u * fwdStarE G e u v = e u v

decls.name: fmDefectE_eq
decls.statement: theorem fmDefectE_eq {e : V → V → ℝ} (he : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ e u v) (T : V → ℝ) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ G.internal) : fmDefectE G e T v = (∑ u, e u v) - (∑ w, e v w) - e G.snk v + e v G.snk - T v
decls.doc: For a non-negative edge flow, the defect at an internal state is conservation plus the terminal mismatch: `D(v) = (in − out)(v) − e(s_f → v) + e(v → s_f) − T(v)`.

decls.name: extend
decls.statement: noncomputable def extend (e' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: Extension by zero of an edge flow of `G'` to `G`.

decls.name: extend_of_mem
decls.statement: theorem extend_of_mem {e' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ} (u v : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}) : extend e' u.1 v.1 = e' u v

decls.name: extend_of_not_mem_left
decls.statement: theorem extend_of_not_mem_left {e' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ} {u : V} (hu : u ∉ subVerts G R) (v : V) : extend e' u v = 0

decls.name: extend_of_not_mem_right
decls.statement: theorem extend_of_not_mem_right {e' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ} (u : V) {v : V} (hv : v ∉ subVerts G R) : extend e' u v = 0

decls.name: sum_extend_in
decls.statement: theorem sum_extend_in (e' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ) (v : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}) : ∑ u, extend e' u v.1 = ∑ u, e' u v

decls.name: sum_extend_out
decls.statement: theorem sum_extend_out (e' : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ) (u : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R}) : ∑ v, extend e' u.1 v = ∑ v, e' u v

decls.name: partial_support_exact
decls.statement: theorem partial_support_exact (hpc : G.PathConnected) (B : BackwardPolicy G) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) (hR : IsTarget G R) (hZ : 0 < ∑ y, R y) : ∃ hq : IsSinkRow G R (fun y => R y / ∑ z, R z), (restrictWith B _ hq).PositiveOnEdges ∧ (subGraph G R).PathConnected ∧ (∃ lam, (restrictWith B _ hq).IsInvProb lam) ∧ ∀ lam : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ, (restrictWith B _ hq).IsInvProb lam → let c
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, claim (a).** Let `G` be path-connected, `π_←` a backward policy on `G` positive on its edges, and `R` a target of mass `Z > 0` on the terminating states.

decls.name: FrozenUnion
decls.statement: def FrozenUnion (G : MarkedGraph V) : Set ((V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ))
decls.doc: **The union of the frozen-backward families of `G`**, one for each backward policy positive on its edges: pairs `(π_→, f_out)` with `π_→` a Markov kernel, `f_out ≥ 0`, and `(f_out μ) ⊗ π_→ = π̂_← ⊗ (f_out μ)` for some such `π_←` (`theo:universality_graphs`(2)).

decls.name: memberFlow
decls.statement: def memberFlow (θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: The edge flow of a pair: `e(u → v) = f_out(u) π_→(u → v)`.

decls.name: member_dichotomy
decls.statement: theorem member_dichotomy (hpc : G.PathConnected) {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) : θ.2 = 0 ∨ ∃ B : BackwardPolicy G, B.PositiveOnEdges ∧ 0 < θ.2 G.snk ∧ (∀ x, memberFlow θ x G.snk = θ.2 G.snk * B.pb G.snk x) ∧ ∀ x, G.Edge x G.snk → 0 < memberFlow θ x G.snk
decls.doc: **Every element of the union is the trivial element or has terminal flow `Z' π_←(s_f → ·)`, `Z' > 0`, positive on every terminating state** (`rem:partial_support`, last clause).

decls.name: fmDefectE_member
decls.statement: theorem fmDefectE_member {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) (R : V → ℝ) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ G.internal) : fmDefectE G (memberFlow θ) R v = memberFlow θ v G.snk - R v
decls.doc: **The defect of an element of the union against a target `R`** is its terminal mismatch: `D(v) = f_out(v) π_→(v → s_f) − R(v)` at every internal state.

decls.name: exists_terminating
decls.statement: theorem exists_terminating (hpc : G.PathConnected) : ∃ y, G.Edge y G.snk
decls.doc: A path-connected marked graph has a terminating state.

decls.name: exists_positive_policy
decls.statement: theorem exists_positive_policy (hpc : G.PathConnected) : ∃ B : BackwardPolicy G, B.PositiveOnEdges
decls.doc: **A backward policy positive on the edges exists** on a path-connected marked graph: the uniform law on the in-neighbours.

decls.name: withSinkRow
decls.statement: noncomputable def withSinkRow (B : BackwardPolicy G) (q : V → ℝ) (hnn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ q y) (hsum : ∑ y, q y = 1) (hsupp : ∀ ⦃y⦄, q y ≠ 0 → G.Edge y G.snk) : BackwardPolicy G
