decls.doc: A backward policy with its sink row replaced by a probability `q` on the in-neighbours of `s_f`.

decls.name: unif
decls.statement: noncomputable def unif (G : MarkedGraph V) (y : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: `unif`: the uniform probability on the terminating states `{y | y → s_f}`.

decls.name: epsTarget
decls.statement: noncomputable def epsTarget (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (y : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The full-support targets** `R_ε := (1 − ε) R + ε Z unif` of `rem:partial_support`, with `Z = ∑ R`.

decls.name: unif_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem unif_nonneg (y : V) : 0 ≤ unif G y

decls.name: unif_le_one
decls.statement: theorem unif_le_one (y : V) : unif G y ≤ 1

decls.name: unif_pos
decls.statement: theorem unif_pos {y : V} (hy : G.Edge y G.snk) : 0 < unif G y

decls.name: sum_unif
decls.statement: theorem sum_unif (hpc : G.PathConnected) : ∑ y, unif G y = 1

decls.name: unif_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem unif_eq_zero {y : V} (hy : ¬ G.Edge y G.snk) : unif G y = 0

decls.name: isTarget_epsTarget
decls.statement: theorem isTarget_epsTarget {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) : IsTarget G (epsTarget G R ε)
decls.doc: `R_ε` is a target: non-negative and carried by the terminating states.

decls.name: epsTarget_pos
decls.statement: theorem epsTarget_pos {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hZ : 0 < ∑ z, R z) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) {y : V} (hy : G.Edge y G.snk) : 0 < epsTarget G R ε y
decls.doc: `R_ε` has full support on the terminating states, for `ε ∈ (0, 1]` and `Z > 0`.

decls.name: sum_epsTarget
decls.statement: theorem sum_epsTarget (hpc : G.PathConnected) (R : V → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) : ∑ y, epsTarget G R ε y = ∑ y, R y
decls.doc: `R_ε` has the mass `Z` of `R`.

decls.name: member_epsTarget
decls.statement: theorem member_epsTarget (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hZ : 0 < ∑ y, R y) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) : ∃ θ ∈ FrozenUnion G, (∀ v ∈ G.internal, fmDefectE G (memberFlow θ) (epsTarget G R ε) v = 0) ∧ ∀ v ∈ G.internal, |fmDefectE G (memberFlow θ) R v| ≤ ε * ∑ y, R y
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, claim (b): `R_ε` is exactly matched in the union, within `εZ` of `R`.** For `ε ∈ (0, 1]`, the balanced flow of `theo:universality_graphs` for the backward policy whose sink row is `R_ε/Z` lies in the union of the frozen-backward families of `G`, is exactly matched to `R_ε`, and its defect against `R` is at most `εZ` at every internal state.

decls.name: exists_member_close
decls.statement: theorem exists_member_close (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hZ : 0 < ∑ y, R y) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ θ ∈ FrozenUnion G, ∀ v ∈ G.internal, |fmDefectE G (memberFlow θ) R v| ≤ δ
decls.doc: The vanishing half with a prescribed accuracy `δ`: take `ε = min 1 (δ/Z)`.

decls.name: not_attained
decls.statement: theorem not_attained (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hne : ∃ x ∈ G.internal, R x ≠ 0) (hvan : ∃ y ∈ G.internal, G.Edge y G.snk ∧ R y = 0) {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) : ∃ v ∈ G.internal, fmDefectE G (memberFlow θ) R v ≠ 0
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, claim (b), the non-attainment half.** If `R` is non-zero at some internal state and vanishes at some terminating state — an internal state with an edge to `s_f` — then no element of the union is exactly matched to `R`: some internal state carries a non-zero defect.

decls.name: mem_internal_of_edge_snk
decls.statement: theorem mem_internal_of_edge_snk (hsrc : ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk) {x : V} (hx : G.Edge x G.snk) : x ∈ G.internal
decls.doc: Without an edge `s₀ → s_f`, every state with an edge to `s_f` is internal.

decls.name: not_attained_of_not_edge_src_snk
decls.statement: theorem not_attained_of_not_edge_src_snk (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hsrc : ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk) (hne : ∃ x, R x ≠ 0) (hvan : ∃ y, G.Edge y G.snk ∧ R y = 0) {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) : ∃ v ∈ G.internal, fmDefectE G (memberFlow θ) R v ≠ 0
decls.doc: `not_attained` with unrestricted witnesses, under `¬ (s₀ → s_f)`: a corollary.

decls.name: not_memberFlow
decls.statement: theorem not_memberFlow (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hvan : ∃ y, G.Edge y G.snk ∧ R y = 0) {e : V → V → ℝ} (hterm : ∀ x, e x G.snk = R x) (hmass : 0 < ∑ v, e G.src v) {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) : memberFlow θ ≠ e
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, "not to that of `G`"**: an edge flow with positive initial mass whose terminal flow is `R`, where `R` vanishes on some terminating state, is the edge flow of no element of the union of the frozen-backward families of `G`.

decls.name: partial_support_not_in_G
decls.statement: theorem partial_support_not_in_G (hpc : G.PathConnected) (B : BackwardPolicy G) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hZ : 0 < ∑ y, R y) (hvan : ∃ y, G.Edge y G.snk ∧ R y = 0) : ∃ hq : IsSinkRow G R (fun y => R y / ∑ z, R z), ∀ lam : {v // v ∈ subVerts G R} → ℝ, (restrictWith B _ hq).IsInvProb lam → ∀ θ ∈ FrozenUnion G, memberFlow θ ≠ extend ((restrictWith B _ hq).edgeFlow lam ((∑ y, R y) / lam (subGraph G R).src))
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, claim (a), "not to that of `G`"**: when `R` vanishes on a terminating state, the flow of `partial_support_exact`, extended by zero, is the edge flow of no element of the union of the frozen-backward families of `G`.

decls.name: graphResidual
decls.statement: noncomputable def graphResidual (G : MarkedGraph V) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (e : V → V → ℝ) (T : V → ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: **The universality residual on a graph**: `‖δf_init‖_{L^p(μ)} + ‖δf_term‖_{L^p(μ)}`, `μ` the counting measure on the internal state space `𝒮`, with `δf_init = D⁻`, `δf_term = D⁺` for the defect `D = fmDefectE G e T` of `equ:FM_const`.

decls.name: graphResidual_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem graphResidual_eq_zero_iff {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : p ≠ 0) (e : V → V → ℝ) (T : V → ℝ) : graphResidual G p e T = 0 ↔ ∀ v ∈ G.internal, fmDefectE G e T v = 0
decls.doc: The residual vanishes, at any `p ≠ 0`, iff the flow-matching constraint holds exactly.

decls.name: graphResidual_le
decls.statement: theorem graphResidual_le {p : ℝ≥0∞} {e : V → V → ℝ} {T : V → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC0 : 0 ≤ C) (hC : ∀ v ∈ G.internal, |fmDefectE G e T v| ≤ C) : graphResidual G p e T ≤ 2 * ((Measure.count (Set.univ : Set V)) ^ p.toReal⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal C)
decls.doc: A uniform bound on the defect bounds the residual, at every `p`.

decls.name: iInf_graphResidual_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem iInf_graphResidual_eq_zero (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hZ : 0 < ∑ y, R y) (p : ℝ≥0∞) : ⨅ θ ∈ FrozenUnion G, graphResidual G p (memberFlow θ) R = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, claim (b), in `L^p`**: the universality infimum over the union of the frozen-backward families of `G` vanishes, at every `p`.

decls.name: graphResidual_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem graphResidual_ne_zero (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hne : ∃ x ∈ G.internal, R x ≠ 0) (hvan : ∃ y ∈ G.internal, G.Edge y G.snk ∧ R y = 0) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : p ≠ 0) {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) : graphResidual G p (memberFlow θ) R ≠ 0
decls.doc: **`rem:partial_support`, claim (b), in `L^p`**: the infimum is not attained, at any `p ≠ 0`, for `R` non-zero at an internal state and vanishing at an internal terminating state.

decls.name: graphResidual_ne_zero_of_not_edge_src_snk
decls.statement: theorem graphResidual_ne_zero_of_not_edge_src_snk (hpc : G.PathConnected) {R : V → ℝ} (hR : IsTarget G R) (hsrc : ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk) (hne : ∃ x, R x ≠ 0) (hvan : ∃ y, G.Edge y G.snk ∧ R y = 0) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : p ≠ 0) {θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)} (hθ : θ ∈ FrozenUnion G) : graphResidual G p (memberFlow θ) R ≠ 0
decls.doc: `graphResidual_ne_zero` with unrestricted witnesses, under `¬ (s₀ → s_f)`: a corollary.

decls.name: diamond
decls.statement: def diamond : MarkedGraph (Fin 4)
decls.doc: The diamond `s₀ = 0 → 1, 2 → 3 = s_f`.

decls.name: diamondTarget
decls.statement: noncomputable def diamondTarget : Fin 4 → ℝ
decls.doc: The target `δ₁`, which vanishes on the terminating state `2`.

decls.name: diamond_check
decls.statement: theorem diamond_check : diamond.PathConnected ∧ IsTarget diamond diamondTarget ∧ ¬ diamond.Edge diamond.src diamond.snk ∧ (∃ x, diamondTarget x ≠ 0) ∧ (∃ y, diamond.Edge y diamond.snk ∧ diamondTarget y = 0) ∧ 0 < ∑ y, diamondTarget y
decls.doc: **The hypotheses of claims (a) and (b) are inhabited**, on the diamond with target `δ₁`: path-connected, a target of positive mass on the terminating states, vanishing on the terminating state `2`, and no edge `s₀ → s_f`.

decls.name: diamond_partial_support
decls.statement: theorem diamond_partial_support (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : p ≠ 0) : (⨅ θ ∈ FrozenUnion diamond, graphResidual diamond p (memberFlow θ) diamondTarget = 0) ∧ ∀ θ ∈ FrozenUnion diamond, graphResidual diamond p (memberFlow θ) diamondTarget ≠ 0
decls.doc: On the diamond, claim (b) in `L^p` holds non-vacuously: the infimum is `0` and every element of the union has a non-zero residual.

decls.name: triangle
decls.statement: def triangle : MarkedGraph (Fin 3)
decls.doc: The triangle `s₀ = 0 → 1 → 2 = s_f` with the extra edge `s₀ → s_f`.

decls.name: triangleTarget
decls.statement: noncomputable def triangleTarget : Fin 3 → ℝ
decls.doc: The target `δ₁`: it vanishes at `s₀`, which has an edge to `s_f` but is not internal.

decls.name: triangle_attained
decls.statement: theorem triangle_attained : triangle.PathConnected ∧ IsTarget triangle triangleTarget ∧ triangle.Edge triangle.src triangle.snk ∧ (∃ x, triangleTarget x ≠ 0) ∧ (∃ y, triangle.Edge y triangle.snk ∧ triangleTarget y = 0) ∧ ∃ θ ∈ FrozenUnion triangle, ∀ p : ℝ≥0∞, graphResidual triangle p (memberFlow θ) triangleTarget = 0
decls.doc: **The reading of "terminating state" matters — not a refutation of `rem:partial_support`.** On the triangle, *if* `s₀` is counted as a terminating state (it has an edge to `s_f`), `δ₁` "vanishes on a terminating state", and yet an element of the union of the frozen-backward families is exactly matched to it on `𝒮 = {1}`: its residual is `0` at every `p`, the mass sent along `s₀ → s_f` being invisible to `equ:FM_const`, which lives on `𝒮`.

files.title: The mean projection, and the two identities `Core.Mixing` assumes
variables: variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
variable {P : Lp ℝ p ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ p ν}

decls.name: integrable_of_Lp
decls.statement: theorem integrable_of_Lp (f : Lp ℝ p ν) : Integrable (⇑f) ν
decls.doc: An element of `L^p(ν)` is `ν`-integrable: `ν` is finite and `1 ≤ p`, so `L^p(ν) ⊆ L^1(ν)`.

decls.name: integralLM
decls.statement: noncomputable def integralLM (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : Lp ℝ p ν →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ
decls.doc: The mean functional `f ↦ ∫ f dν`, as a linear map on `L^p(ν)`.

decls.name: norm_integral_le_holder
decls.statement: theorem norm_integral_le_holder (f : Lp ℝ p ν) : ‖∫ x, f x ∂ν‖ ≤ (ν Set.univ).toReal ^ (1 - 1 / p.toReal) * ‖f‖
decls.doc: **Hölder against `𝟏`**: `|∫ f dν| ≤ ν(𝒮)^{1 − 1/p} ‖f‖_{L^p(ν)}`.

decls.name: integralCLM
decls.statement: noncomputable def integralCLM (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : Lp ℝ p ν →L[ℝ] ℝ
decls.doc: The mean functional `f ↦ ∫ f dν` as a **continuous** linear map on `L^p(ν)`, with the explicit operator-norm bound `ν(𝒮)^{1 − 1/p}` of `norm_integral_le_holder`.

decls.name: integralCLM_apply
decls.statement: theorem integralCLM_apply (f : Lp ℝ p ν) : integralCLM ν p f = ∫ x, f x ∂ν

decls.name: norm_integralCLM_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_integralCLM_le : ‖integralCLM ν p‖ ≤ (ν Set.univ).toReal ^ (1 - 1 / p.toReal)
decls.doc: `‖∫ · dν‖ ≤ ν(𝒮)^{1 − 1/p}`: the constant of `norm_integral_le_holder` bounds the operator norm, which is rule 3's explicit formula rather than a bare existential.

decls.name: integral_constOne
decls.statement: theorem integral_constOne : ∫ x, (constOne ν p) x ∂ν = (ν Set.univ).toReal

decls.name: meanProj
decls.statement: noncomputable def meanProj (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : Lp ℝ p ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ p ν
decls.doc: **The mean projection of `proofs.tex:22`**, `Π f = (∫ f dν / ν(𝒮)) • 𝟏`, as a continuous linear map on `L^p(ν)`.

decls.name: meanProj_apply
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_apply (f : Lp ℝ p ν) : meanProj ν p f = ((∫ x, f x ∂ν) / (ν Set.univ).toReal) • constOne ν p

decls.name: meanProj_constOne
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_constOne (hν : ν Set.univ ≠ 0) : meanProj ν p (constOne ν p) = constOne ν p
decls.doc: `Π 𝟏 = 𝟏`: the constants are fixed by the mean projection.

decls.name: meanProj_idem
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_idem (hν : ν Set.univ ≠ 0) : meanProj ν p * meanProj ν p = meanProj ν p
decls.doc: `Π` is idempotent — it is a projection.

decls.name: meanProj_comp_left
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_comp_left (hint : ∀ f : Lp ℝ p ν, ∫ x, (P f) x ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂ν) : meanProj ν p * P = meanProj ν p
decls.doc: **`Mixing.proj_left`, derived**: `Π P = Π`, from mass preservation alone.

decls.name: comp_meanProj
decls.statement: theorem comp_meanProj (hone : P (constOne ν p) = constOne ν p) : P * meanProj ν p = meanProj ν p
decls.doc: **`Mixing.proj_right`, derived**: `P Π = Π`, from `P 𝟏 = 𝟏` and linearity.

decls.name: meanProj_sub_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_sub_eq_zero {f_init f_term : Lp ℝ p ν} (hmass : ∫ x, f_init x ∂ν = ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν) : meanProj ν p (f_term - f_init) = 0
decls.doc: **`Π θ = 0` for a pair of equal total mass** — the paper's "`F_init` and `F_term` are both probability distributions, so `∫ θ dν_B = 0`, that is `Π θ = 0`" (`proofs.tex:95`).

decls.name: mixing_of_massPreserving
decls.statement: theorem mixing_of_massPreserving (hone : P (constOne ν p) = constOne ν p) (hint : ∀ f : Lp ℝ p ν, ∫ x, (P f) x ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖P ^ n - meanProj ν p‖) : Mixing P (meanProj ν p)
decls.doc: **The `Mixing` bundle, with only its summability half assumed.** `Core.Mixing` hypothesizes `Pi * P = Pi` and `P * Pi = Pi`; here they are the two theorems above, and `Pi` is pinned to the paper's mean projection rather than left arbitrary.

decls.name: weaklyUniversal_of_massPreserving
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversal_of_massPreserving (hone : P (constOne ν p) = constOne ν p) (hint : ∀ f : Lp ℝ p ν, ∫ x, (P f) x ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖P ^ n - meanProj ν p‖) (hp : p ≠ ⊤) : WeaklyUniversal P (meanProj ν p)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_L2_full` at `p < ∞`, on the paper's own hypotheses about `P`.** This is `Core.UniversalityLp.weaklyUniversal_Lp` with `Mixing P Pi` replaced by what the paper derives it from: `P` fixes the constants (`ν_B π⋆ = ν_B`), `P` preserves `ν_B`-integrals (`π⋆` is a Markov kernel), and the mixing coefficients against the mean projection are summable.

decls.name: weaklyUniversalAt_of_equalMass
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversalAt_of_equalMass (hone : P (constOne ν p) = constOne ν p) (hint : ∀ f : Lp ℝ p ν, ∫ x, (P f) x ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖P ^ n - meanProj ν p‖) (hp : p ≠ ⊤) {f_init f_term : Lp ℝ p ν} (hmass : ∫ x, f_init x ∂ν = ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν) : WeaklyUniversalAt P (f_term - f_init)
decls.doc: **The same, at one admissible pair**, in the paper's own terms: two densities in `L^p(ν)` of equal total mass are joined to arbitrary accuracy by a non-negative outflow.

decls.name: eq_meanProj_of_invariant
decls.statement: theorem eq_meanProj_of_invariant (h : Mixing P (meanProj ν p)) {g : Lp ℝ p ν} (hg : P g = g) : g = ((∫ x, g x ∂ν) / (ν Set.univ).toReal) • constOne ν p
decls.doc: **Summable mixing against the mean projection is an ergodicity hypothesis.** The paper's `Π` is the projection onto the invariant densities and coincides with the mean projection because `π⋆` is ergodic.

files.title: The KL-weak-FM loss has the target's self-entropy as its floor, and controls the sampling error

decls.name: selfEntropy
decls.statement: noncomputable def selfEntropy (ν : Measure α) (k : α → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The self-entropy `𝓗` of `proofs.tex:264–266`**, the floor of the loss: `𝓗 := −∫ k(s) log k(s) dν_B(s)` for a probability `κ = k·ν_B`.

decls.name: klD
decls.statement: noncomputable def klD (ν : Measure α) (k g : α → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The Kullback–Leibler divergence of `proofs.tex:302`, read between densities**: `KL(k·ν ‖ g·ν) = ∫ k log(k/g) dν`.

decls.name: lqNormD
decls.statement: noncomputable def lqNormD (νT : Measure α) (q : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: The `L^q(ν_T)` norm of a density, at a real exponent: `‖f‖_{L^q(ν_T)} = (∫|f|^q dν_T)^{1/q}`.

decls.name: lqNormD_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem lqNormD_nonneg (νT : Measure α) (q : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) : 0 ≤ lqNormD νT q f

decls.name: stableLoss_eq_lqNormD
decls.statement: theorem stableLoss_eq_lqNormD (νT : Measure α) (q : ℝ) (e k : α → ℝ) : stableLoss νT q e k = lqNormD νT q (fun x => e x - k x)
decls.doc: The `L^q` norm of this file and the loss of `StableBound` are the same object: the file that proves `theo:RL_CV_bound_full` measures `e − k`, this one measures `δf_init = e⁻`.

decls.name: wklfmLoss
decls.statement: noncomputable def wklfmLoss (ν νT : Measure α) (q b : ℝ) (k e : α → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The KL-weak-FM loss `equ:weakFM`** (`introduction.tex:122`), in densities: `𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} = b‖δf_init‖_{L^q(ν_T)} − 𝔼_{s∼κ} log f̂_term(s)`, with `δf_init = e⁻` and `f̂_term = e⁺`.

decls.name: sub_le_mul_log_div
decls.statement: theorem sub_le_mul_log_div {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hac : y = 0 → x = 0) : x - y ≤ x * Real.log (x / y)
decls.doc: The pointwise inequality behind `klD_nonneg`: `x − y ≤ x log(x/y)` for `x, y ≥ 0`, provided `y = 0` forces `x = 0`.

decls.name: klD_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem klD_nonneg {ν : Measure α} {k g : α → ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hg : Integrable g ν) (hint : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x / g x)) ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hg0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] g) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, g x = 0 → k x = 0) (hmass : ∫ x, g x ∂ν ≤ ∫ x, k x ∂ν) : 0 ≤ klD ν k g
decls.doc: **Gibbs' inequality, in the form `proofs.tex:322` uses it**: `KL(κ ‖ κ̂/κ̂(𝒮)) ≥ 0`.

decls.name: il_mass_identity
decls.statement: theorem il_mass_identity {ν : Measure α} {e : α → ℝ} (he : Integrable e ν) (he1 : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = 1) : ∫ x, max (e x) 0 ∂ν = 1 + ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν
decls.doc: **`equ:il_mass_identity`** (`proofs.tex:292–297`): `E⁺` and `E⁻` having disjoint supports and `E(𝒮) = F_init(𝒮) = 1`, the corrected terminal flow has mass `κ̂(𝒮) = 1 + δ ≥ 1`.

decls.name: klD_integrand_eq
decls.statement: theorem klD_integrand_eq {ν : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {zhat : ℝ} (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hzh0 : 0 < zhat) : (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x / (max (e x) 0 / zhat))) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => k x * Real.log (k x) - k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0) + k x * Real.log zhat
decls.doc: The pointwise identity behind `wklfmLoss_decomposition`: on `{k > 0}`, where absolute continuity makes `e⁺ > 0`, `log(k/(e⁺/ẑ)) = log k − log e⁺ + log ẑ`; on `{k = 0}` both sides vanish.

decls.name: wklfmLoss_decomposition
decls.statement: theorem wklfmLoss_decomposition {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hzh0 : 0 < zhat) : wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e = klD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) + b * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0) - Real.log zhat + selfEntropy ν k
decls.doc: **`eq:wFM_strong_bound`** (`proofs.tex:311–314`): decomposing the cross-entropy of the target against `f̂_term` as forward KL plus self-entropy plus normalization, `𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} = KL(κ ‖ κ̂/κ̂(𝒮)) + b‖δf_init‖_{L^q(ν_T)} − log κ̂(𝒮) + 𝓗` .

decls.name: klD_integrable
decls.statement: theorem klD_integrable {ν : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hzh0 : 0 < zhat) : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x / (max (e x) 0 / zhat))) ν
decls.doc: The integrand of `klD ν k (κ̂/κ̂(𝒮))` is integrable as soon as the two integrands of the decomposition are: it is their difference plus a multiple of `k`, off a null set.

decls.name: penalty_ge
decls.statement: theorem penalty_ge {b N D δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hHolder : δ ≤ N * D) : D ≤ b * D - Real.log (1 + δ)
decls.doc: **`eq:lp_delta`** (`proofs.tex:315–318`): `b‖δf_init‖ − log(1+δ) ≥ ‖δf_init‖ ≥ 0`, by `log(1+δ) ≤ δ` and the Hölder estimate `δ ≤ N‖δf_init‖` with `b ≥ 1 + N`.

decls.name: loss_sub_selfEntropy_ge
decls.statement: theorem loss_sub_selfEntropy_ge {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b N δ zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hHolder : δ ≤ N * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0)) : klD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) + lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0) ≤ wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e - selfEntropy ν k
decls.doc: **`proofs.tex:320–334` in one inequality**: the loss exceeds the floor by at least the KL term and the `L^q` penalty together, `KL(κ ‖ κ̂/κ̂(𝒮)) + ‖δf_init‖_{L^q(ν_T)} ≤ 𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} − 𝓗` .

decls.name: klD_normalized_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem klD_normalized_nonneg {ν : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {δ zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (he : Integrable e ν) (he1 : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = 1) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) : 0 ≤ klD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat)
decls.doc: **Gibbs at the normalized corrected terminal density** (`proofs.tex:322`): `KL(κ ‖ κ̂/κ̂(𝒮)) ≥ 0`.

decls.name: loss_ge_selfEntropy
decls.statement: theorem loss_ge_selfEntropy {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b N δ zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (he : Integrable e ν) (he1 : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = 1) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hHolder : δ ≤ N * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0)) : selfEntropy ν k ≤ wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e
decls.doc: **The floor of the loss**, the first half of the first bullet (`proofs.tex:325`): `𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} ≥ 𝓗`.

decls.name: klD_le_loss_sub_selfEntropy
decls.statement: theorem klD_le_loss_sub_selfEntropy {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b N δ zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hHolder : δ ≤ N * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0)) : klD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) ≤ wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e - selfEntropy ν k
decls.doc: **The KL term is at most the excess of the loss over its floor** (`proofs.tex:322`), the inequality Pinsker is applied to.

decls.name: lqNormD_le_loss_sub_selfEntropy
decls.statement: theorem lqNormD_le_loss_sub_selfEntropy {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b N δ zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (he : Integrable e ν) (he1 : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = 1) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hHolder : δ ≤ N * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0)) : lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0) ≤ wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e - selfEntropy ν k
decls.doc: **`proofs.tex:332–334`**: `𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} − 𝓗 ≥ ‖δf_init‖_{L^q(ν_T)}`, the inequality that turns the loss into a bound on the initial defect, hence on `δ` through `equ:il_holder`.

decls.name: il_holder
decls.statement: theorem il_holder {ν νT : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] [SigmaFinite νT] {e : α → ℝ} {q qstar : ℝ} (hqq : qstar.HolderConjugate q) (hac : ν ≪ νT) (hr : MemLp (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv νT x).toReal) (ENNReal.ofReal qstar) νT) (hf : MemLp (fun x => max (-e x) 0) (ENNReal.ofReal q) νT) : ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν ≤ lqNormD νT qstar (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv νT x).toReal) * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0)
decls.doc: **`equ:il_holder`** (`proofs.tex:305–310`): `ν_B ≪ ν_T` gives `δ = ∫ δf_init (dν_B/dν_T) dν_T ≤ ‖dν_B/dν_T‖_{L^{q*}(ν_T)} ‖δf_init‖_{L^q(ν_T)}`, by Hölder with the conjugate exponents `q*` and `q`.

decls.name: negMass_ratio_le_min
decls.statement: theorem negMass_ratio_le_min {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) : δ / (1 + δ) ≤ min 1 δ
decls.doc: The first term of `equ:il_tv_split` (`proofs.tex:299–303`): `δ/κ̂(𝒮) = δ/(1+δ) ≤ min(1, δ)`, by the mass identity.

decls.name: il_tv_bound
decls.statement: theorem il_tv_bound {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b N δ zhat tv tvNC : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (he : Integrable e ν) (he1 : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = 1) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) (hN0 : 0 ≤ N) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hHolder : δ ≤ N * lqNormD νT q (fun x => max (-e x) 0)) (hNC : tvNC ≤ δ / zhat) (hPins : tvD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt (klD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat))) (htri : tv ≤ tvNC + tvD ν k (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat)) : tv ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt (wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e - selfEntropy ν k) + min 1 (N * (wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e - selfEntropy ν k))
decls.doc: **`equ:il_tv_explicit`** (`proofs.tex:274–276`), the second display of the first bullet of **`theo:IL_CV_bound`**: `TV(s_τ ‖ κ) ≤ (1/√2)√(𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} − 𝓗) + min(1, ‖dν_B/dν_T‖_{L^{q*}(ν_T)}(𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} − 𝓗))` .

decls.name: loss_le_of_domination
decls.statement: theorem loss_le_of_domination {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b ε : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hTac : νT ≪ ν) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hdom : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, (1 - ε) * k x ≤ e x) : wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e ≤ selfEntropy ν k + Real.log (1 / (1 - ε))
decls.doc: **`equ:il_domination` bounds the loss above** (`proofs.tex:344–354`): if `F_init + F⋆_out π⋆ − F⋆_out ≥ (1−ε)κ` as measures, then `δf_init = 0`, `f̂_term = e` and `𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} ≤ 𝓗 + log(1/(1−ε))` .

decls.name: eq_of_domination_zero
decls.statement: theorem eq_of_domination_zero {ν : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (he : Integrable e ν) (hdom : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, k x ≤ e x) (hmass : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = ∫ x, k x ∂ν) : e =ᵐ[ν] k
decls.doc: **The `ε = 0` case of `equ:il_domination` is `equ:FM_const`** (`proofs.tex:359–362`): a non-negative defect `E − κ` between measures of equal total mass is zero.

decls.name: loss_eq_selfEntropy_of_domination_zero
decls.statement: theorem loss_eq_selfEntropy_of_domination_zero {ν νT : Measure α} {k e : α → ℝ} {q b N δ zhat : ℝ} (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk1 : ∫ x, k x ∂ν = 1) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (he : Integrable e ν) (he1 : ∫ x, e x ∂ν = 1) (hklog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (k x)) ν) (helog : Integrable (fun x => k x * Real.log (max (e x) 0)) ν) (hac : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, max (e x) 0 = 0 → k x = 0) (hδ : δ = ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = 1 + δ) (hN0 : 0 ≤ N) (hb : 1 + N ≤ b) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hTac : νT ≪ ν) (hdom : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, k x ≤ e x) : wklfmLoss ν νT q b k e = selfEntropy ν k
decls.doc: **Attainment at `ε = 0`** (`proofs.tex:364–365`): a flow satisfying `equ:il_domination` with `ε = 0` — equivalently, satisfying the flow-matching constraint `equ:FM_const` for the pair `(F_init, κ)` — has `𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} = 𝓗`, the floor.

decls.name: isGLB_of_domination
decls.statement: theorem isGLB_of_domination (L : Set ℝ) (H : ℝ) (hlb : ∀ x ∈ L, H ≤ x) (hub : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∃ x ∈ L, x ≤ H + Real.log (1 / (1 - ε))) : IsGLB L H
decls.doc: **`inf_Θ 𝓛^q_{KL-wFM} = 𝓗`** (`proofs.tex:356–359`), on the set of achievable loss values: a set of reals bounded below by `𝓗` that comes within `log(1/(1−ε))` of it for every `ε ∈ (0,1)` has `𝓗` for greatest lower bound.

files.title: The density action of a Markov kernel, and the two conditions `Core.Flow` assumes

decls.name: bind_absolutelyContinuous_bind
decls.statement: theorem bind_absolutelyContinuous_bind (κ : Kernel α α) {μ ν : Measure α} (h : μ ≪ ν) : μ.bind ⇑κ ≪ ν.bind ⇑κ
decls.doc: **A kernel push preserves domination**: `μ ≪ ν` implies `μ π⋆ ≪ ν π⋆`.

decls.name: bind_add_measure
decls.statement: theorem bind_add_measure (κ : Kernel α α) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure α) : (μ₁ + μ₂).bind ⇑κ = μ₁.bind ⇑κ + μ₂.bind ⇑κ
decls.doc: `bind` is additive in the measure: `(μ₁ + μ₂) π⋆ = μ₁ π⋆ + μ₂ π⋆`.

decls.name: bind_withDensity_absolutelyContinuous
decls.statement: theorem bind_withDensity_absolutelyContinuous (κ : Kernel α α) {ν : Measure α} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : (ν.withDensity f).bind ⇑κ ≪ ν
decls.doc: **`(f ν) π⋆ ≪ ν`, from invariance alone.** This is the main text's "invariance makes the density action `P⋆ f := d((f ν_B) π⋆)/dν_B` well defined on `L¹(ν_B)`" (`universality.tex:26–27`), and it is a theorem, not a hypothesis.

decls.name: bind_withDensity_univ
decls.statement: theorem bind_withDensity_univ (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ((ν.withDensity f).bind ⇑κ) Set.univ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂ν
decls.doc: **The mass of `(f ν) π⋆` is the mass of `f ν`** — stochasticity of the kernel, and not invariance of the measure.

decls.name: isFiniteMeasure_bind_withDensity
decls.statement: theorem isFiniteMeasure_bind_withDensity (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∫⁻ x, f x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) : IsFiniteMeasure ((ν.withDensity f).bind ⇑κ)
decls.doc: `(f ν) π⋆` is a finite measure as soon as `f` has finite `ν`-integral.

decls.name: bindDensity
decls.statement: noncomputable def bindDensity (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : α → ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: **The density action `T f := d((f ν) π⋆)/dν`** of the main text (`universality.tex:26–27`), on non-negative densities.

decls.name: bindDensity_congr
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_congr (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) {f g : α → ℝ≥0∞} (h : f =ᵐ[ν] g) : bindDensity κ ν f = bindDensity κ ν g
decls.doc: `T` depends on `f` only through its `ν`-a.e.

decls.name: measurable_bindDensity
decls.statement: theorem measurable_bindDensity (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : Measurable (bindDensity κ ν f)
decls.doc: `T f` is measurable, with no hypothesis on `f`: a Radon–Nikodym derivative always is.

decls.name: withDensity_bindDensity
decls.statement: theorem withDensity_bindDensity (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ν.withDensity (bindDensity κ ν f) = (ν.withDensity f).bind ⇑κ
decls.doc: **`T f` is a genuine density for `(f ν) π⋆`.** This is the well-definedness assertion of `universality.tex:26–27`.

decls.name: lintegral_bindDensity
decls.statement: theorem lintegral_bindDensity (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ∫⁻ x, bindDensity κ ν f x ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂ν
decls.doc: **`∫ T f dν = ∫ f dν`** — the non-negative half of `hint`.

decls.name: bindDensity_one
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_one (κ : Kernel α α) {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) : bindDensity κ ν 1 =ᵐ[ν] 1
decls.doc: **`T 𝟏 = 𝟏`** — the non-negative half of `hone`, and pure invariance: `𝟏 ν = ν`, so `(𝟏 ν) π⋆ = ν π⋆ = ν` and `dν/dν = 𝟏`.

decls.name: bindDensity_zero
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_zero (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) : bindDensity κ ν 0 =ᵐ[ν] 0
decls.doc: `T 0 = 0`: the zero density pushes to the zero measure.

decls.name: bindDensity_add
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_add (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] {f g : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) (hfi : ∫⁻ x, f x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) (hgi : ∫⁻ x, g x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) : bindDensity κ ν (f + g) =ᵐ[ν] bindDensity κ ν f + bindDensity κ ν g
decls.doc: **`T` is additive**, `ν`-a.e., on densities of finite integral.

decls.name: bindDensity_smul
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_smul (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ ⊤) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) (hfi : ∫⁻ x, f x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) : bindDensity κ ν (c • f) =ᵐ[ν] c • bindDensity κ ν f
decls.doc: **`T` is positively homogeneous**, `ν`-a.e., for a finite scalar.

decls.name: densityAction
decls.statement: noncomputable def densityAction (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) : α → ℝ
decls.doc: **The density action `P⋆ f := d((f ν) π⋆)/dν` on signed densities.** A signed density is split into its positive and negative parts, each pushed by `T = bindDensity`, and the two densities subtracted.

decls.name: densityAction_congr
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_congr (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) {f g : α → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[ν] g) : densityAction κ ν f = densityAction κ ν g
decls.doc: `P⋆` depends on `f` only through its `ν`-a.e.

decls.name: measurable_densityAction
decls.statement: theorem measurable_densityAction (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) : Measurable (densityAction κ ν f)
decls.doc: `P⋆ f` is measurable, with no hypothesis on `f`.

decls.name: lintegral_ofReal_ne_top
decls.statement: theorem lintegral_ofReal_ne_top {ν : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂ν ≠ ⊤
decls.doc: The positive part of an integrable function has finite `ν`-integral.

decls.name: bindDensity_ofReal_lt_top
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_ofReal_lt_top (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, bindDensity κ ν (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y)) x < ⊤
decls.doc: `T f⁺` has finite `ν`-integral, hence is a.e.

decls.name: integrable_toReal_bindDensity
decls.statement: theorem integrable_toReal_bindDensity (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : Integrable (fun x => (bindDensity κ ν (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y)) x).toReal) ν
decls.doc: `(T f⁺).toReal` is `ν`-integrable, with `∫ (T f⁺).toReal dν = ∫ f⁺ dν`.

decls.name: integral_toReal_bindDensity
decls.statement: theorem integral_toReal_bindDensity (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∫ x, (bindDensity κ ν (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y)) x).toReal ∂ν = (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂ν).toReal

decls.name: integral_densityAction
decls.statement: theorem integral_densityAction (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∫ x, densityAction κ ν f x ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂ν
decls.doc: **`hint`, in the paper's own terms**: `∫ P⋆ f dν = ∫ f dν` for every `ν`-integrable `f`.

decls.name: densityAction_one
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_one (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) : densityAction κ ν 1 =ᵐ[ν] 1

decls.name: max_add_aux
decls.statement: theorem max_add_aux (u v : ℝ) : max (u + v) 0 + max (-u) 0 + max (-v) 0 = max (-(u + v)) 0 + max u 0 + max v 0
decls.doc: The real identity behind additivity of `P⋆`: `(u+v)⁺ + u⁻ + v⁻ = (u+v)⁻ + u⁺ + v⁺`.

decls.name: ofReal_add_aux
decls.statement: theorem ofReal_add_aux (u v : ℝ) : ENNReal.ofReal (u + v) + ENNReal.ofReal (-u) + ENNReal.ofReal (-v) = ENNReal.ofReal (-(u + v)) + ENNReal.ofReal u + ENNReal.ofReal v
decls.doc: The same identity in `ℝ≥0∞`, which is where `T` consumes it.

decls.name: lintegral_add_ne_top
decls.statement: theorem lintegral_add_ne_top {ν : Measure α} {u v : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hu : AEMeasurable u ν) (hun : ∫⁻ x, u x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) (hvn : ∫⁻ x, v x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) : ∫⁻ x, (u + v) x ∂ν ≠ ⊤
decls.doc: `∫ (u + v) dν` is finite when both summands are.

decls.name: bindDensity_add₃
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_add₃ (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] {u v w : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hu : AEMeasurable u ν) (hv : AEMeasurable v ν) (hun : ∫⁻ x, u x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) (hvn : ∫⁻ x, v x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) (hwn : ∫⁻ x, w x ∂ν ≠ ⊤) : bindDensity κ ν (u + v + w) =ᵐ[ν] bindDensity κ ν u + bindDensity κ ν v + bindDensity κ ν w
decls.doc: `T` on a sum of three densities of finite integral.

decls.name: aemeasurable_ofReal
decls.statement: theorem aemeasurable_ofReal {ν : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : AEMeasurable (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y)) ν
decls.doc: The positive part of an integrable function is `ν`-a.e.

decls.name: densityAction_add
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_add (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f g : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) (hg : Integrable g ν) : densityAction κ ν (fun x => f x + g x) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => densityAction κ ν f x + densityAction κ ν g x
decls.doc: **`P⋆` is additive**, `ν`-a.e., on `ν`-integrable densities.

decls.name: densityAction_neg
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_neg (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) : densityAction κ ν (fun x => -f x) = fun x => -densityAction κ ν f x
decls.doc: `P⋆(-f) = -P⋆ f`, by definition: negation swaps the positive and negative parts.

decls.name: densityAction_smul_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_smul_nonneg (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : densityAction κ ν (fun x => r * f x) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => r * densityAction κ ν f x
decls.doc: `P⋆` is homogeneous under a non-negative scalar.

decls.name: densityAction_smul
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_smul (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (r : ℝ) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : densityAction κ ν (fun x => r * f x) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => r * densityAction κ ν f x
decls.doc: **`P⋆` is homogeneous**, `ν`-a.e., under every real scalar.

decls.name: IsBoundedDensityAction
decls.statement: structure IsBoundedDensityAction (κ : Kernel α α) (ν : Measure α) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **The paper's boundedness hypothesis on the parameterization**, and the only hypothesis of `theo:universality_L2_full` that this file assumes rather than derives.

decls.name: densityActionLM
decls.statement: noncomputable def densityActionLM (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : Lp ℝ p ν →ₗ[ℝ] Lp ℝ p ν
decls.doc: `P⋆` as a linear map on `L^p(ν)`.

decls.name: densityActionCLM
decls.statement: noncomputable def densityActionCLM (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : Lp ℝ p ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ p ν
decls.doc: **`P⋆` as a `ContinuousLinearMap` on `L^p(ν)`**, with the paper's own operator-norm bound `C` as the continuity constant.

decls.name: norm_densityActionCLM_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_densityActionCLM_le (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : ‖densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb‖ ≤ C
decls.doc: `‖P⋆‖_{L^p→L^p} ≤ C`: the paper's constant bounds the operator norm, as rule 3 asks.

decls.name: coeFn_densityActionCLM
decls.statement: theorem coeFn_densityActionCLM (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) (F : Lp ℝ p ν) : ⇑(densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb F) =ᵐ[ν] densityAction κ ν ⇑F
decls.doc: The `L^p` operator applied to `F` is represented by `P⋆` applied to any representative.

decls.name: densityActionCLM_constOne
decls.statement: theorem densityActionCLM_constOne (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) : densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb (constOne ν p) = constOne ν p
decls.doc: **`hone` on `L^p(ν)`**: `P⋆ 𝟏 = 𝟏`, the paper's `(Id − P⋆) 𝟏 = 0` (`proofs.tex:100`).

decls.name: integral_densityActionCLM
decls.statement: theorem integral_densityActionCLM (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) (F : Lp ℝ p ν) : ∫ x, (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb F) x ∂ν = ∫ x, F x ∂ν
decls.doc: **`hint` on `L^p(ν)`**: `∫ P⋆ f dν = ∫ f dν`.

decls.name: weaklyUniversal_of_kernel
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversal_of_kernel (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) ^ n - meanProj ν p‖) (hp : p ≠ ⊤) : WeaklyUniversal (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) (meanProj ν p)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_L2_full`'s weak half, from the paper's own hypotheses about the kernel.** `π⋆` is a Markov kernel, `ν` is finite and `π⋆`-invariant, `P⋆` is bounded on `L^p(ν)` with constant `C` — the paper's requirement on the parameterization — and the mixing coefficients `β_n = ‖P⋆^n − Π‖` are summable.

decls.name: weaklyUniversalAt_of_kernel
decls.statement: theorem weaklyUniversalAt_of_kernel (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν p C) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) ^ n - meanProj ν p‖) (hp : p ≠ ⊤) {f_init f_term : Lp ℝ p ν} (hmass : ∫ x, f_init x ∂ν = ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν) : WeaklyUniversalAt (densityActionCLM κ ν p hinv hb) (f_term - f_init)
decls.doc: **The same, at one admissible pair**: two densities in `L^p(ν)` of equal total mass are joined to arbitrary accuracy by a non-negative outflow against the kernel `π⋆`.

decls.name: bind_id
decls.statement: theorem bind_id (ν : Measure α) : ν.bind ⇑(Kernel.id : Kernel α α) = ν
decls.doc: Every measure is invariant under the identity kernel.

decls.name: bindDensity_id
decls.statement: theorem bindDensity_id (ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite ν] {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) : bindDensity (Kernel.id : Kernel α α) ν f =ᵐ[ν] f
decls.doc: The identity kernel has the identity density action on non-negative densities.

decls.name: densityAction_id
decls.statement: theorem densityAction_id (ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite ν] {f : α → ℝ} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) : densityAction (Kernel.id : Kernel α α) ν f =ᵐ[ν] f
decls.doc: The identity kernel has the identity density action.

decls.name: isBoundedDensityAction_id
decls.statement: theorem isBoundedDensityAction_id (ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite ν] (p : ℝ≥0∞) : IsBoundedDensityAction (Kernel.id : Kernel α α) ν p 1
decls.doc: **`IsBoundedDensityAction` is satisfiable**, so `weaklyUniversal_of_kernel` is not vacuous: the identity kernel is Markov, every measure is invariant under it (`bind_id`), and its density action is the identity, of operator norm `1`.

files.title: The mixing sum, and the Poisson equation it solves
variables: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E}

decls.name: Mixing
decls.statement: structure Mixing {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) : Prop
decls.doc: The hypothesis shared by `lem:sigma_mixing` and Step 1 of `theo:universality_L2_full`: a bounded operator `P` and a projection `Pi` onto its invariant vectors, whose mixing coefficients `n ↦ ‖P ^ n - Pi‖` are summable.

decls.name: beta
decls.statement: noncomputable def beta (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
decls.doc: The mixing coefficients `β_n = ‖P ^ n - Pi‖` of `equ:mixing_coefficients`.

decls.name: B
decls.statement: noncomputable def B (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) : ℝ
decls.doc: The mixing sum `B = ∑_{n ≥ 0} β_n` of `equ:mixing_coefficients`; the appendix writes it `B̂` at `p = 2`.

decls.name: summable_beta
decls.statement: theorem summable_beta (h : Mixing P Pi) : Summable (beta P Pi)

decls.name: beta_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem beta_nonneg (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ beta P Pi n

decls.name: B_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem B_nonneg (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) : 0 ≤ B P Pi

decls.name: summable_terms
decls.statement: theorem summable_terms [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : Summable fun n : ℕ => P ^ n - Pi
decls.doc: The family `n ↦ P ^ n - Pi` is summable: absolutely so, by hypothesis.

decls.name: S
decls.statement: noncomputable def S (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) : E →L[ℝ] E
decls.doc: The **mixing sum operator** `S = ∑_{n ≥ 0} (P^n - Pi)` of `equ:poisson`.

decls.name: tendsto_partialSum
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_partialSum [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : Tendsto (partialSum P Pi) atTop (𝓝 (S P Pi))
decls.doc: `S` is the limit of `GFNBounds.Doubling.partialSum`, which is the hypothesis every result of `Doubling/Operator.lean` consumes.

decls.name: tendsto_pow
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_pow [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => P ^ n) atTop (𝓝 Pi)
decls.doc: Summable mixing forces `P ^ n → Pi` in operator norm — the appendix's `‖P^{N+1} - Π‖ = β_{N+1} → 0`.

decls.name: proj_idem
decls.statement: theorem proj_idem [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : Pi * Pi = Pi
decls.doc: `Pi` is idempotent: `P ^ n → Pi` while `P ^ (n+1) Pi = Pi` throughout.

decls.name: norm_S_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_S_le [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : ‖S P Pi‖ ≤ B P Pi
decls.doc: `‖S‖ ≤ B`: the operator-norm bound behind `theo:universality_L2_full`'s `‖Sθ‖ ≤ B_p ‖θ‖`.

decls.name: norm_S_apply_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_S_apply_le [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (θ : E) : ‖S P Pi θ‖ ≤ B P Pi * ‖θ‖
decls.doc: `‖S θ‖ ≤ B ‖θ‖`, which is how `theo:universality_L2_full` states the bound.

decls.name: poisson_right
decls.statement: theorem poisson_right [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : S P Pi * (1 - P) = 1 - Pi
decls.doc: **The Poisson equation, right form**: `S (1 - P) = 1 - Pi`.

decls.name: poisson_left
decls.statement: theorem poisson_left [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) : (1 - P) * S P Pi = 1 - Pi
decls.doc: **The Poisson equation, left form**: `(1 - P) S = 1 - Pi`.

decls.name: poisson_right_apply
decls.statement: theorem poisson_right_apply [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (θ : E) : S P Pi ((1 - P) θ) = θ - Pi θ
decls.doc: The Poisson equation, applied: `S ((1 - P) θ) = θ - Pi θ`.

decls.name: poisson_left_apply
decls.statement: theorem poisson_left_apply [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (θ : E) : (1 - P) (S P Pi θ) = θ - Pi θ
decls.doc: The Poisson equation, applied on the other side: `(1 - P) (S θ) = θ - Pi θ`.

decls.name: poisson_solved
decls.statement: theorem poisson_solved [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) {θ : E} (hθ : Pi θ = 0) : (1 - P) (S P Pi θ) = θ
decls.doc: **The Poisson equation solves exactly on mean-zero data**, the form Step 2 consumes: if `Pi θ = 0` then `(1 - P) (S θ) = θ`.

decls.name: coercivity
decls.statement: theorem coercivity [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (x : E) : ‖x - Pi x‖ ≤ B P Pi * ‖(1 - P) x‖
decls.doc: **Mixing controls coercivity** — the "consequently" of `lem:sigma_mixing`, and the only part of it the paper's downstream consumers use (`proofs.tex:872`).

decls.name: coercivity_div
decls.statement: theorem coercivity_div [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (hB : 0 < B P Pi) (x : E) : ‖x - Pi x‖ / B P Pi ≤ ‖(1 - P) x‖
decls.doc: The quotient form of `lem:sigma_mixing`'s display.

files.title: The base coefficient of the mixing sum: `β̂₀ = ‖I − Π‖ ≥ 1`, hence `B̂ ≥ 1`
variables: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E}

decls.name: one_le_norm_of_isIdempotentElem
decls.statement: theorem one_le_norm_of_isIdempotentElem {R : Type*} [NormedRing R] {a : R} (ha : IsIdempotentElem a) (h0 : a ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ ‖a‖

decls.name: beta_zero
decls.statement: theorem beta_zero (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) : beta P Pi 0 = ‖(1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi‖
decls.doc: `β₀ = ‖I − Π‖`: the paper's `β̂₀`, unfolded.

decls.name: one_sub_ne_zero_iff
decls.statement: theorem one_sub_ne_zero_iff : (1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x, Pi x ≠ x
decls.doc: The side condition, read on vectors: `I − Π ≠ 0` says exactly that some vector is not `Π`-invariant.

decls.name: one_le_norm_one_sub_proj
decls.statement: theorem one_le_norm_one_sub_proj (hPi : Pi * Pi = Pi) (hQ : (1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ ‖(1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi‖
decls.doc: **`1 ≤ ‖I − Π‖`** whenever `Π` is an idempotent short of the identity.

decls.name: one_le_beta_zero
decls.statement: theorem one_le_beta_zero [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (hQ : (1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ beta P Pi 0
decls.doc: **`1 ≤ β̂₀`** for a summably mixing pair: `Mixing.proj_idem` supplies the idempotence, `hQ` the non-degeneracy.

decls.name: one_le_B
decls.statement: theorem one_le_B [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (hQ : (1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ B P Pi
decls.doc: **`1 ≤ B̂`** — the hypothesis `LocalConvergence.lean`, `RatioBridge.lean` and `WeightedL2.lean` each carry as `hB1`, here derived from `Mixing` and `Π ≠ I`.

decls.name: B_pos
decls.statement: theorem B_pos [CompleteSpace E] (h : Mixing P Pi) (hQ : (1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi ≠ 0) : 0 < B P Pi
decls.doc: `0 < B̂`, the form `coercivity_div` and every `ϱ := c/B̂²` consume.

decls.name: of_idem
decls.statement: theorem of_idem {Q : E →L[ℝ] E} (hQ : Q * Q = Q) : Mixing Q Q
decls.doc: An idempotent operator is its own mixing pair.

decls.name: B_of_idem
decls.statement: theorem B_of_idem {Q : E →L[ℝ] E} (hQ : Q * Q = Q) : B Q Q = ‖(1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Q‖
decls.doc: For an idempotent `Q`, the mixing sum collapses to its base coefficient `‖1 - Q‖`.

decls.name: orthoPi
decls.statement: def orthoPi : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)
decls.doc: The coordinate projection `(a,b) ↦ (a,0)` on `ℝ × ℝ`.

decls.name: orthoPi_apply
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem orthoPi_apply (x : ℝ × ℝ) : orthoPi x = (x.1, 0)

decls.name: orthoPi_idem
decls.statement: theorem orthoPi_idem : orthoPi * orthoPi = orthoPi

decls.name: norm_one_sub_orthoPi
decls.statement: theorem norm_one_sub_orthoPi : ‖(1 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) - orthoPi‖ = 1
decls.doc: `1 − orthoPi` is the complementary coordinate projection, of norm exactly `1`.

decls.name: obliquePi
decls.statement: def obliquePi : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)
decls.doc: The oblique idempotent `(a,b) ↦ (−b,b)`.

decls.name: obliquePi_apply
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem obliquePi_apply (x : ℝ × ℝ) : obliquePi x = (-x.2, x.2)

decls.name: obliquePi_idem
decls.statement: theorem obliquePi_idem : obliquePi * obliquePi = obliquePi

decls.name: norm_one_sub_obliquePi
decls.statement: theorem norm_one_sub_obliquePi : ‖(1 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) - obliquePi‖ = 2
decls.doc: `‖1 − obliquePi‖ = 2`: the complement `(a,b) ↦ (a+b,0)` doubles `(1,1)`.

decls.name: orthoMixing
decls.statement: theorem orthoMixing : Mixing orthoPi orthoPi
decls.doc: `Mixing orthoPi orthoPi` holds: the hypothesis bundle is non-vacuous.

decls.name: one_sub_orthoPi_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem one_sub_orthoPi_ne_zero : (1 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) - orthoPi ≠ 0
decls.doc: The side condition holds for `orthoPi`: `orthoPi ≠ 1`, i.e.

decls.name: B_orthoPi
decls.statement: theorem B_orthoPi : Mixing.B orthoPi orthoPi = 1
decls.doc: **The numeric check.** `Mixing orthoPi orthoPi` holds, `orthoPi ≠ 1`, and `B̂ = 1` *exactly* — the paper's normalization, attained.

decls.name: one_le_B_orthoPi
decls.statement: theorem one_le_B_orthoPi : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Mixing.B orthoPi orthoPi
decls.doc: `one_le_B` evaluated on that witness: `1 ≤ B̂` with `B̂ = 1`.

decls.name: obliqueMixing
decls.statement: theorem obliqueMixing : Mixing obliquePi obliquePi
decls.doc: `Mixing obliquePi obliquePi` holds too, and `obliquePi ≠ 1`.

decls.name: B_obliquePi
decls.statement: theorem B_obliquePi : Mixing.B obliquePi obliquePi = 2
decls.doc: **The counterexample to the equality.** `B̂ = β̂₀ = 2` on a legitimate `Mixing` pair.

decls.name: not_forall_beta_zero_eq_one
decls.statement: theorem not_forall_beta_zero_eq_one : ¬ ∀ (E : Type) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup E) (_ : NormedSpace ℝ E) (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E), Mixing P Pi → (1 : E →L[ℝ] E) - Pi ≠ 0 → Mixing.beta P Pi 0 = 1
decls.doc: Restated as the refutation it is: summable mixing with `Π ≠ I` does **not** force `β̂₀ = 1`.

files.title: Mixing controls coercivity, for the density action of a Markov kernel on `L²(λ)`
variables: variable (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]

decls.name: two_mul_le_sq_add_sq_ennreal
decls.statement: theorem two_mul_le_sq_add_sq_ennreal (a b : ℝ≥0∞) : 2 * a * b ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
decls.doc: `2ab ≤ a² + b²` in `ℝ≥0∞` — including at `∞`, where both sides are `∞` unless a factor on the left vanishes.

decls.name: lintegral_bindDensity_mul
decls.statement: theorem lintegral_bindDensity_mul (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) {h : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hh : Measurable h) : ∫⁻ x, bindDensity κ ν f x * h x ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, f x * ∫⁻ y, h y ∂κ x ∂ν
decls.doc: **Duality for the density action**: `∫ (Tf)·h dλ = ∫ f(x) (∫ h dT(x)) dλ(x)`, for a non-negative density `f` and a measurable test function `h`.

decls.name: two_mul_lintegral_bindDensity_mul_le
decls.statement: theorem two_mul_lintegral_bindDensity_mul_le (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) {h : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hh : Measurable h) : 2 * ∫⁻ x, bindDensity κ ν f x * h x ∂ν ≤ ∫⁻ x, f x ^ 2 ∂ν + ∫⁻ x, h x ^ 2 ∂ν
decls.doc: `2 ∫ (Tf)·h dλ ≤ ∫ f² dλ + ∫ h² dλ`: `2f(x)h(y) ≤ f(x)² + h(y)²` integrated against `λ(dx) T(x,dy)`, whose first marginal is `λ` (`T` Markov) and second `λT = λ` (invariance).

decls.name: lintegral_bindDensity_sq_le
decls.statement: theorem lintegral_bindDensity_sq_le (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) : ∫⁻ x, bindDensity κ ν f x ^ 2 ∂ν ≤ ∫⁻ x, f x ^ 2 ∂ν
decls.doc: **`∫ (Tf)² dλ ≤ ∫ f² dλ`** for every non-negative density `f`, with no integrability assumed.

decls.name: eLpNorm_bindDensity_two_le
decls.statement: theorem eLpNorm_bindDensity_two_le (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) : eLpNorm (bindDensity κ ν f) 2 ν ≤ eLpNorm f 2 ν
decls.doc: `‖Tf‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ‖f‖_{L²(λ)}` for a non-negative density, in `eLpNorm` form.

decls.name: ofReal_add_ofReal_neg
decls.statement: theorem ofReal_add_ofReal_neg (r : ℝ) : ENNReal.ofReal r + ENNReal.ofReal (-r) = ‖r‖ₑ

decls.name: enorm_densityAction_le
decls.statement: theorem enorm_densityAction_le (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ‖densityAction κ ν f x‖ₑ ≤ bindDensity κ ν (fun y => ‖f y‖ₑ) x
decls.doc: `|P f| ≤ T |f|`, `λ`-a.e., for an integrable signed density: `|Tf⁺ − Tf⁻| ≤ Tf⁺ + Tf⁻`, and `T` is additive.

decls.name: isBoundedDensityAction_two
decls.statement: theorem isBoundedDensityAction_two (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν 2 1
decls.doc: **The density action of a Markov kernel is a contraction of `L²(λ)`** whenever `λ` is finite and invariant: `IsBoundedDensityAction κ λ 2 1`.

decls.name: inner_constOne_two
decls.statement: theorem inner_constOne_two (u : Lp ℝ 2 ν) : inner ℝ u (constOne ν 2) = ∫ x, u x ∂ν

decls.name: norm_sub_meanProj_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_sub_meanProj_le (f : Lp ℝ 2 ν) : ‖f - meanProj ν 2 f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
decls.doc: **`Π` is an orthogonal projection**, read as `‖h − Πh‖ ≤ ‖h‖`: `h − Πh` has mean zero, hence is orthogonal to the constant `Πh`, and Pythagoras concludes.

decls.name: norm_one_sub_meanProj_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_one_sub_meanProj_le : ‖(1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν) - meanProj ν 2‖ ≤ 1
decls.doc: `‖I − Π‖ ≤ 1` on `L²(λ)`, for every finite `λ`.

decls.name: meanProj_indicator_ne
decls.statement: theorem meanProj_indicator_ne {X : Set α} (hX : MeasurableSet X) (hX0 : 0 < ν X) (hX1 : ν X < ν Set.univ) : meanProj ν 2 (indicatorConstLp 2 hX (measure_ne_top ν X) (1 : ℝ)) ≠ indicatorConstLp 2 hX (measure_ne_top ν X) (1 : ℝ)
decls.doc: **`𝟏_X − Π𝟏_X ≠ 0`** — the paper's "`𝟏_X` is not `λ`-a.e.

decls.name: norm_one_sub_meanProj_eq_one
decls.statement: theorem norm_one_sub_meanProj_eq_one {X : Set α} (hX : MeasurableSet X) (hX0 : 0 < ν X) (hX1 : ν X < ν Set.univ) : ‖(1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν) - meanProj ν 2‖ = 1
decls.doc: **`‖I − Π‖_{L²(λ)} = 1`** as soon as `λ` charges a measurable `X` with `0 < λ(X) < λ(𝒮)`: `≤ 1` by orthogonality, `≥ 1` because `I − Π` is a non-zero idempotent (`Mixing.one_le_norm_one_sub_proj`).

decls.name: exists_measurableSet_of_ne_smul_dirac
decls.statement: theorem exists_measurableSet_of_ne_smul_dirac [StandardBorelSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [NeZero ν] (h : ∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (x : α), ν ≠ c • Measure.dirac x) : ∃ X, MeasurableSet X ∧ 0 < ν X ∧ ν X < ν Set.univ
decls.doc: **The paper's Polish step**: a non-zero finite measure on a standard Borel space that is not a multiple of a Dirac mass charges a measurable `X` with `0 < λ(X) < λ(𝒮)`.

decls.name: ne_smul_dirac_of_two_pos
decls.statement: theorem ne_smul_dirac_of_two_pos [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {ν : Measure α} {x y : α} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : 0 < ν {x}) (hy : 0 < ν {y}) : ∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (z : α), ν ≠ c • Measure.dirac z
decls.doc: Two distinct points of positive mass: `λ` is not a multiple of a Dirac mass.

decls.name: exists_measurableSet_of_two_pos
decls.statement: theorem exists_measurableSet_of_two_pos [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {x y : α} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : 0 < ν {x}) (hy : 0 < ν {y}) : ∃ X, MeasurableSet X ∧ 0 < ν X ∧ ν X < ν Set.univ
decls.doc: Two distinct points of positive mass: `X := {x}` has `0 < λ(X) < λ(𝒮)`.

decls.name: densityActionL2
decls.statement: noncomputable def densityActionL2 (κ : Kernel α α) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν
decls.doc: **The paper's `P` of `lem:sigma_mixing`**: the density action `h ↦ d((hλ)T)/dλ` of a Markov kernel on `L²(λ)`, a bounded operator by `isBoundedDensityAction_two` rather than by hypothesis.

decls.name: norm_densityActionL2_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_densityActionL2_le (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) : ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv‖ ≤ 1

decls.name: mixing_densityActionL2
decls.statement: theorem mixing_densityActionL2 (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) : Mixing (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)
decls.doc: The `Mixing` bundle at `(P, Π)`, with only summability assumed: `ΠP = PΠ = Π` is derived.

decls.name: sigma_mixing
decls.statement: theorem sigma_mixing (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) : Tendsto (GFNBounds.Doubling.partialSum (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)) atTop (𝓝 (Mixing.S (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2))) ∧ Mixing.S (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) * (1 - densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) = 1 - meanProj ν 2 ∧ ∀ h : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖h - meanProj ν 2 h‖ ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) * ‖(1 - densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) h‖
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing`, first sentence**, at the kernel level: for `T` Markov and `λ` finite and invariant, summable `L²`-mixing makes `S = ∑(Pⁿ − Π)` converge in operator norm, with `S(I−P) = I − Π` and `‖h − Πh‖ ≤ B̂ ‖(I−P)h‖`.

decls.name: sigma_mixing_beta_zero_of_set
decls.statement: theorem sigma_mixing_beta_zero_of_set (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) {X : Set α} (hX : MeasurableSet X) (hX0 : 0 < ν X) (hX1 : ν X < ν Set.univ) : Mixing.beta (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) 0 = 1
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing`, `β̂₀ = 1`**, from a measurable `X` with `0 < λ(X) < λ(𝒮)`.

decls.name: sigma_mixing_one_le_B_of_set
decls.statement: theorem sigma_mixing_one_le_B_of_set (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) {X : Set α} (hX : MeasurableSet X) (hX0 : 0 < ν X) (hX1 : ν X < ν Set.univ) : 1 ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing`, `B̂ ≥ 1`**, from summability and the same `X`: `B̂ ≥ β̂₀ = 1`.

decls.name: lem_sigma_mixing
decls.statement: theorem lem_sigma_mixing [StandardBorelSpace α] [NeZero ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) : (Tendsto (GFNBounds.Doubling.partialSum (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)) atTop (𝓝 (Mixing.S (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2))) ∧ Mixing.S (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) * (1 - densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) = 1 - meanProj ν 2 ∧ ∀ h : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖h - meanProj ν 2 h‖ ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) * ‖(1 - densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) h‖) ∧ ((∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (x : α), ν ≠ c • Measure.dirac x) → Mixing.beta (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) 0 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2))
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing`, whole.** `T` a Markov kernel on a standard Borel space leaving a non-zero finite `λ` invariant, `P` its density action on `L²(λ)`, `Π` the `λ`-mean projection, `B̂ = ∑‖Pⁿ − Π‖ < ∞`: then `S` converges in operator norm, `S(I−P) = I − Π`, `‖h − Πh‖ ≤ B̂ ‖(I−P)h‖` for every `h ∈ L²(λ)`; and if moreover `λ` is not a multiple of a Dirac mass, `β̂₀ = 1` and `B̂ ≥ 1`.

decls.name: lem_sigma_mixing_polish
decls.statement: theorem lem_sigma_mixing_polish [TopologicalSpace α] [PolishSpace α] [BorelSpace α] [NeZero ν] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) : (Tendsto (GFNBounds.Doubling.partialSum (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)) atTop (𝓝 (Mixing.S (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2))) ∧ Mixing.S (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) * (1 - densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) = 1 - meanProj ν 2 ∧ ∀ h : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖h - meanProj ν 2 h‖ ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) * ‖(1 - densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) h‖) ∧ ((∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (x : α), ν ≠ c • Measure.dirac x) → Mixing.beta (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) 0 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2))
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing`, whole, on a Polish space with its Borel σ-algebra** — the paper's literal hypothesis; `lem_sigma_mixing` through `standardBorel_of_polish`.

decls.name: sigma_mixing_two_states
decls.statement: theorem sigma_mixing_two_states [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) {x y : α} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : 0 < ν {x}) (hy : 0 < ν {y}) : (∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (z : α), ν ≠ c • Measure.dirac z) ∧ Mixing.beta (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) 0 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)
decls.doc: The "in particular" of `lem:sigma_mixing`, in the weaker form its proof uses: two distinct points of positive mass make `λ` not a multiple of a Dirac mass, and give `β̂₀ = 1`, `B̂ ≥ 1`.

decls.name: sigma_mixing_finite
decls.statement: theorem sigma_mixing_finite [Finite α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [Nontrivial α] (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < ν {x}) (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 κ ν hinv ^ n - meanProj ν 2‖) : (∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (z : α), ν ≠ c • Measure.dirac z) ∧ Mixing.beta (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2) 0 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 κ ν hinv) (meanProj ν 2)
decls.doc: **`lem:sigma_mixing`, "in particular if `𝒮` is finite with `#𝒮 ≥ 2` and `λ > 0` everywhere"**: then `λ` is not a multiple of a Dirac mass, `β̂₀ = 1` and `B̂ ≥ 1`.

decls.name: boolUniform
decls.statement: noncomputable def boolUniform : Measure Bool
decls.doc: The uniform law `λ = (1/2, 1/2)` on the two-point space.

decls.statement: instance : IsProbabilityMeasure boolUniform

decls.name: boolUniform_singleton_pos
decls.statement: theorem boolUniform_singleton_pos (b : Bool) : 0 < boolUniform {b}

decls.name: sigma_mixing_witness
decls.statement: theorem sigma_mixing_witness : boolUniform.bind ⇑(Kernel.const Bool boolUniform) = boolUniform ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (x : Bool), boolUniform ≠ c • Measure.dirac x) ∧ Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖densityActionL2 (Kernel.const Bool boolUniform) boolUniform Family.bind_const_kernel ^ n - meanProj boolUniform 2‖) ∧ Mixing.beta (densityActionL2 (Kernel.const Bool boolUniform) boolUniform Family.bind_const_kernel) (meanProj boolUniform 2) 0 = 1 ∧ Mixing.B (densityActionL2 (Kernel.const Bool boolUniform) boolUniform Family.bind_const_kernel) (meanProj boolUniform 2) = 1
decls.doc: **Inhabitation of `lem_sigma_mixing`'s whole hypothesis bundle** (`kb/entries/0025`), on the two-state chain `T(i → j) = 1/2`, `λ = (1/2, 1/2)` of `prop:nonlinear_freezing`(2), realised as `Kernel.const Bool λ` on the standard Borel space `Bool`: `λ` is invariant, non-zero and not a multiple of a Dirac mass, the mixing coefficients are summable, the lemma applies, and `B̂ = 1` exactly — so `B̂ ≥ 1` is sharp.

files.title: A stable `L^q` flow-matching loss controls the sampling error and the initial-mass defect
variables: variable {ν : Measure α} {e k : α → ℝ}

decls.name: tvD
decls.statement: noncomputable def tvD (ν : Measure α) (f g : α → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The ½-convention total variation of `app:notation`**, read between two densities against a common dominating measure: `TV(f·ν ‖ g·ν) = ½ ∫ |f − g| dν`.

decls.name: tvD_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem tvD_nonneg (ν : Measure α) (f g : α → ℝ) : 0 ≤ tvD ν f g

decls.name: tvD_comm
decls.statement: theorem tvD_comm (ν : Measure α) (f g : α → ℝ) : tvD ν f g = tvD ν g f

decls.name: tvD_triangle
decls.statement: theorem tvD_triangle {ν : Measure α} {f₁ f₂ f₃ : α → ℝ} (h₁ : Integrable (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) ν) (h₂ : Integrable (fun x => f₂ x - f₃ x) ν) : tvD ν f₁ f₃ ≤ tvD ν f₁ f₂ + tvD ν f₂ f₃
decls.doc: **The triangle inequality Step 2 opens with** (`proofs.tex:209–212`), for densities against a common measure.

decls.name: tvD_normalization
decls.statement: theorem tvD_normalization {ν : Measure α} {f g : α → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) (hg : Integrable g ν) (hg0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] g) (hb : b = ∫ x, g x ∂ν) (ha0 : 0 < a) (hb0 : 0 < b) : tvD ν (fun x => f x / a) (fun x => g x / b) ≤ ((∫ x, |f x - g x| ∂ν) + |a - b|) / (2 * a)
decls.doc: **`equ:normalization_lemma`, first inequality** (`proofs.tex:217–220`): for `α = f·ν` and `β = g·ν` non-negative and finite with masses `a, b > 0`, `TV(α/a ‖ β/b) ≤ (‖α − β‖_{L¹} + |a − b|)/(2a)`, by the paper's own splitting `β/b − α/a = (β − α)/a + β(1/b − 1/a)`.

decls.name: tvD_normalization_le
decls.statement: theorem tvD_normalization_le {ν : Measure α} {f g : α → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) (hg : Integrable g ν) (hg0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] g) (ha : a = ∫ x, f x ∂ν) (hb : b = ∫ x, g x ∂ν) (ha0 : 0 < a) (hb0 : 0 < b) : tvD ν (fun x => f x / a) (fun x => g x / b) ≤ (∫ x, |f x - g x| ∂ν) / a
decls.doc: **`equ:normalization_lemma`, second inequality** (`proofs.tex:217–220`): `TV(α/a ‖ β/b) ≤ ‖α − β‖_{L¹}/a`, by `|a − b| ≤ ‖α − β‖_{L¹}`.

decls.name: negPart_le_abs_sub
decls.statement: theorem negPart_le_abs_sub {x y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) : max (-x) 0 ≤ |x - y|
decls.doc: **Step 1's first pointwise inequality** (`proofs.tex:204`): `k ≥ 0` gives `e⁻ ≤ |e − k|`, because on `{e < 0}` one has `|e − k| = k − e ≥ −e`.

decls.name: abs_sub_posPart_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_sub_posPart_le {x y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) : |y - max x 0| ≤ |x - y|
decls.doc: **Step 1's second pointwise inequality** (`proofs.tex:204`): `x ↦ x⁺` is `1`-Lipschitz and `k⁺ = k`, so `|e⁺ − k| ≤ |e − k|`.

decls.name: posPart_mass
decls.statement: theorem posPart_mass (he : Integrable e ν) : ∫ x, max (e x) 0 ∂ν = (∫ x, e x ∂ν) + ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν
decls.doc: **`equ:mass_identity`, Step 0** (`proofs.tex:200–202`): `E⁺` and `E⁻` having disjoint supports and `E(𝒮) = z`, the corrected terminal flow has mass `κ̂(𝒮) = z + E⁻(𝒮) ≥ z`.

decls.name: negMass_le
decls.statement: theorem negMass_le (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) : ∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν ≤ ∫ x, |e x - k x| ∂ν
decls.doc: **`equ:two_dominations`, first half** (`proofs.tex:205–207`): `δF_init(𝒮) = E⁻(𝒮) ≤ Δ`.

decls.name: hatDist_le
decls.statement: theorem hatDist_le (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) : ∫ x, |k x - max (e x) 0| ∂ν ≤ ∫ x, |e x - k x| ∂ν
decls.doc: **`equ:two_dominations`, second half** (`proofs.tex:205–207`): `‖κ̂ − κ‖_{L¹(ν_B)} ≤ Δ`.

decls.name: mass_defect_le
decls.statement: theorem mass_defect_le (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) : |(∫ x, e x ∂ν) - ∫ x, k x ∂ν| ≤ ∫ x, |e x - k x| ∂ν
decls.doc: **`equ:mass_defect`** (`proofs.tex:226–228`): `|z − t| = |∫(e − k) dν_B| ≤ Δ`.

decls.name: normalization_bound
decls.statement: theorem normalization_bound (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) {t zhat : ℝ} (ht : t = ∫ x, k x ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = ∫ x, max (e x) 0 ∂ν) (ht0 : 0 < t) (hzh0 : 0 < zhat) : tvD ν (fun x => k x / t) (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) ≤ (∫ x, |e x - k x| ∂ν) / t
decls.doc: **Term (ii) of Step 2** (`proofs.tex:217–221`): `TV(κ/t ‖ κ̂/κ̂(𝒮)) ≤ Δ/t`, by `equ:normalization_lemma` at `α = κ`, `β = κ̂` and `equ:two_dominations`.

decls.name: tv_le_two_fmL1
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_two_fmL1 (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) {z t zhat tv tvNC : ℝ} (hz : z = ∫ x, e x ∂ν) (ht : t = ∫ x, k x ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = ∫ x, max (e x) 0 ∂ν) (hz0 : 0 < z) (ht0 : 0 < t) (hNC : tvNC ≤ (∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) / zhat) (htri : tv ≤ tvNC + tvD ν (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) (fun x => k x / t)) : tv ≤ 2 * (∫ x, |e x - k x| ∂ν) / t
decls.doc: **`equ:tv_chain` closed at `2Δ/t`, Step 2 in full** (`proofs.tex:209–232`): `TV(s_τ ‖ κ/t) ≤ Δ/(z + Δ) + Δ/t ≤ 2Δ/t`, with `Δ := ‖e − k‖_{L¹(ν_B)}`.

decls.name: integral_le_measure_rpow_mul
decls.statement: theorem integral_le_measure_rpow_mul {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {h : α → ℝ} (hh0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] h) (hmem : MemLp h (ENNReal.ofReal q) ν) : ∫ x, h x ∂ν ≤ ν.real Set.univ ^ (1 - 1 / q) * (∫ x, h x ^ q ∂ν) ^ (1 / q)
decls.doc: **Step 3, first Hölder** (`proofs.tex:236`): on a finite measure, `∫ h dν ≤ ν(𝒮)^{1−1/q} ‖h‖_{L^q(ν)}` for `h ≥ 0` and `1 ≤ q < ∞`, by Hölder against the constant `1` with the conjugate exponents `q` and `q/(q−1)`.

decls.name: integral_le_of_le_smul
decls.statement: theorem integral_le_of_le_smul {νT : Measure α} {M : ℝ≥0} (hdom : ν ≤ (M : ℝ≥0∞) • νT) {f : α → ℝ} (hf0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[νT] f) (hint : Integrable f νT) : ∫ x, f x ∂ν ≤ (M : ℝ) * ∫ x, f x ∂νT
decls.doc: **Step 3, the change of measure** (`proofs.tex:237`): with `ν_B ≤ M ν_T`, an integral of a non-negative function against `ν_B` is at most `M` times its integral against `ν_T`.

decls.name: holderConst
decls.statement: noncomputable def holderConst (ν : Measure α) (M : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`equ:stable_constants`, `C₀`** (`proofs.tex:152–156`): `C₀ = ν_B(𝒮)^{1−1/q} ‖dν_B/dν_T‖^{1/q}_{L^∞(ν_T)}`, with the `L^∞` norm carried by `M`.

decls.name: stableConst
decls.statement: noncomputable def stableConst (ν : Measure α) (M : ℝ≥0) (q t : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`equ:stable_constants`, `C`** (`proofs.tex:152–156`): `C = 2C₀/κ(𝒮)`.

decls.name: stableLoss
decls.statement: noncomputable def stableLoss (νT : Measure α) (q : ℝ) (e k : α → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The stable loss `𝓛` of `equ:FMloss`** as `proofs.tex:193` reads it, `𝓛 = ‖e − k‖_{L^q(ν_T)}`, at `q < ∞`.

decls.name: fmL1_le_holderConst_mul_loss
decls.statement: theorem fmL1_le_holderConst_mul_loss {νT : Measure α} {M : ℝ≥0} {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hdom : ν ≤ (M : ℝ≥0∞) • νT) (hmem : MemLp (fun x => e x - k x) (ENNReal.ofReal q) νT) : ∫ x, |e x - k x| ∂ν ≤ holderConst ν M q * stableLoss νT q e k
decls.doc: **Step 3 in full** (`proofs.tex:234–239`): `Δ ≤ C₀ 𝓛`, the two Hölder applications composed.

decls.name: mass_floor
decls.statement: theorem mass_floor {νT : Measure α} {M : ℝ≥0} {q z t : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hdom : ν ≤ (M : ℝ≥0∞) • νT) (hmem : MemLp (fun x => e x - k x) (ENNReal.ofReal q) νT) (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) (hz : z = ∫ x, e x ∂ν) (ht : t = ∫ x, k x ∂ν) : |z - t| ≤ holderConst ν M q * stableLoss νT q e k
decls.doc: **`equ:mass_floor`** (`proofs.tex:164–166`), the second display of item (1) of **`theo:RL_CV_bound_full`**: `|F_init(𝒮) − κ(𝒮)| ≤ C₀ 𝓛` .

decls.name: stable_bound
decls.statement: theorem stable_bound {νT : Measure α} {M : ℝ≥0} {q z t zhat tv tvNC : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hdom : ν ≤ (M : ℝ≥0∞) • νT) (hmem : MemLp (fun x => e x - k x) (ENNReal.ofReal q) νT) (he : Integrable e ν) (hk : Integrable k ν) (hk0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] k) (hz : z = ∫ x, e x ∂ν) (ht : t = ∫ x, k x ∂ν) (hzh : zhat = ∫ x, max (e x) 0 ∂ν) (hz0 : 0 < z) (ht0 : 0 < t) (hNC : tvNC ≤ (∫ x, max (-e x) 0 ∂ν) / zhat) (htri : tv ≤ tvNC + tvD ν (fun x => max (e x) 0 / zhat) (fun x => k x / t)) : tv ≤ stableConst ν M q t * stableLoss νT q e k
decls.doc: **`equ:stable_bound`** (`proofs.tex:160–162`), the first display of item (1) of **`theo:RL_CV_bound_full`**: `TV(s_τ ‖ κ/t) ≤ C 𝓛`, `C = 2C₀/t` .

files.title: Strong universality at `p = +∞`, and the transfer of the realized outflow to every `L^r`
variables: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [Lattice E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
variable {r : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ r)] {P : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ ⊤ ν}

decls.name: ae_le_norm_top
decls.statement: theorem ae_le_norm_top (g : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, g x ≤ ‖g‖
decls.doc: **`g ≤ ‖g‖` a.e., on `L^∞(ν)`.** The essential supremum dominates a.e., and on `L^∞` it is finite, so the `ℝ≥0∞` inequality `‖g x‖ₑ ≤ eLpNormEssSup g ν` may be read in `ℝ`.

decls.name: le_norm_smul_constOne
decls.statement: theorem le_norm_smul_constOne (g : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) : g ≤ ‖g‖ • constOne ν ⊤
decls.doc: **The order hypothesis of `stronglyUniversalAt_of_le`, discharged at `p = +∞`**: `g ≤ ‖g‖ • 𝟏` in the `L^∞(ν)` order.

decls.name: stronglyUniversalAt_top
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversalAt_top {P Pi : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} {θ : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} (h : Mixing P Pi) (hone : P (constOne ν ⊤) = constOne ν ⊤) (hθ : Pi θ = 0) : StronglyUniversalAt P θ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_L2_full`'s `p = +∞` clause, at one admissible pair.** "Taking `η := ‖Sθ‖_{L^∞(ν_B)}` gives `δf_init = δf_term = 0`, and the flow-matching constraint holds exactly" (`proofs.tex:73`).

decls.name: StronglyUniversal
decls.statement: def StronglyUniversal (P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:universality`, strong form, with its pair quantifier closed**: the family `Θ = {P} × E⁺` is strongly universal when *every* admissible pair is realized exactly — not merely approached.

decls.name: StronglyUniversal.weaklyUniversal
decls.statement: theorem StronglyUniversal.weaklyUniversal [HasSolidNorm E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] {P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E} (h : StronglyUniversal P Pi) : WeaklyUniversal P Pi

decls.name: stronglyUniversal_top
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversal_top {P Pi : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} (h : Mixing P Pi) (hone : P (constOne ν ⊤) = constOne ν ⊤) : StronglyUniversal P Pi
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_L2_full`'s `p = +∞` clause, for the family**: under summable `L^∞`-mixing and with `P` fixing the constants, `Θ = {P} × L^∞_+(ν)` is strongly universal.

decls.name: stronglyUniversal_of_kernel_top
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversal_of_kernel_top (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α α) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν ⊤ C) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM κ ν ⊤ hinv hb) ^ n - meanProj ν ⊤‖) : StronglyUniversal (densityActionCLM κ ν ⊤ hinv hb) (meanProj ν ⊤)
decls.doc: **Strong universality at `p = +∞`, from the paper's hypotheses on the kernel.** `π⋆` a Markov kernel, `ν` finite and `π⋆`-invariant, the density action bounded on `L^∞(ν)`, the mixing coefficients summable there.

decls.name: stronglyUniversalAt_of_kernel_top
decls.statement: theorem stronglyUniversalAt_of_kernel_top (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α α) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {C : ℝ} (hinv : ν.bind ⇑κ = ν) (hb : IsBoundedDensityAction κ ν ⊤ C) (hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(densityActionCLM κ ν ⊤ hinv hb) ^ n - meanProj ν ⊤‖) {f_init f_term : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} (hmass : ∫ x, f_init x ∂ν = ∫ x, f_term x ∂ν) : StronglyUniversalAt (densityActionCLM κ ν ⊤ hinv hb) (f_term - f_init)
decls.doc: **The same at one admissible pair**, in the paper's own terms: two densities in `L^∞(ν)` of equal total mass are joined *exactly* — not approximately — by a non-negative outflow.

decls.name: inclTop
decls.statement: noncomputable def inclTop (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (r : ℝ≥0∞) (f : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) : Lp ℝ r ν
decls.doc: **The inclusion `L^∞(ν) ↪ L^r(ν)`**, `ν` finite.

decls.name: memLp_of_top
decls.statement: theorem memLp_of_top (r : ℝ≥0∞) (f : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) : MemLp (⇑f) r ν
decls.doc: An `L^∞(ν)` function is in every `L^r(ν)`: finiteness of `ν` and nothing else.

decls.name: coeFn_inclTop
decls.statement: theorem coeFn_inclTop (r : ℝ≥0∞) (f : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) : ⇑(inclTop ν r f) =ᵐ[ν] ⇑f

decls.name: inclTop_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem inclTop_nonneg {r : ℝ≥0∞} {f : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} (hf : 0 ≤ f) : 0 ≤ inclTop ν r f
decls.doc: The inclusion is order-preserving, the `Lp` order being the a.e.

decls.name: coeFn_defect
decls.statement: theorem coeFn_defect {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (P : Lp ℝ p ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ p ν) (θ fout : Lp ℝ p ν) : ⇑(defect P θ fout) =ᵐ[ν] fun x => (P fout) x - fout x - θ x
decls.doc: The defect, read pointwise: `D = P f_out − f_out − θ` a.e.

decls.name: exists_outflow_memLp_of_top
decls.statement: theorem exists_outflow_memLp_of_top {P Pi : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} {θ : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν} (h : Mixing P Pi) (hone : P (constOne ν ⊤) = constOne ν ⊤) (hθ : Pi θ = 0) : ∃ fout : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν, 0 ≤ fout ∧ (∀ r : ℝ≥0∞, MemLp (⇑fout) r ν) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, (P fout) x = fout x + θ x
decls.doc: **The transfer, in the form that assumes nothing at `r`.** The `p = +∞` construction produces a non-negative outflow that lies in *every* `L^r(ν)` and satisfies the flow-matching constraint as an a.e.

decls.name: CompatibleAcrossTop
decls.statement: def CompatibleAcrossTop (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (r : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ r)] (P : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) (Q : Lp ℝ r ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ r ν) : Prop
decls.doc: **The compatibility an operator-level transfer consumes**: `Q` on `L^r(ν)` and `P` on `L^∞(ν)` agree a.e.

decls.name: coeFn_defect_inclTop
decls.statement: theorem coeFn_defect_inclTop (hc : CompatibleAcrossTop ν r P Q) (θ fout : Lp ℝ ⊤ ν) : ⇑(defect Q (inclTop ν r θ) (inclTop ν r fout)) =ᵐ[ν] ⇑(defect P θ fout)
decls.doc: The two defects are the same function: `D` at `r` computed on the included data agrees a.e.

decls.name: defect_inclTop_eq_zero
