decls.statement: theorem bG_nonneg {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (j : Fin (M + 2)) : 0 ≤ bG t j

decls.name: den_pos_and_ratio_pos
decls.statement: theorem den_pos_and_ratio_pos {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (j : Fin (M + 2)) : 0 < extT M t (xC M j) + ∑ v ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, Fk M k (xC M j) v ∧ 0 < fmRatio (cycGraph M) (extT M t) (Fk M k) (xC M j)
decls.doc: **"`𝓛(F_k)` is defined for `k ≥ 1`"**: the denominator `target + f_→` of the ratio is positive at every internal state, and the ratio lies in `(0,∞)`, the domain of `g`.

decls.name: abs_aC_sub_bG_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_aC_sub_bG_le {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) (j : Fin (M + 2)) : |aC M j - bG t j| ≤ 1

decls.name: abs_fmRatio_Fk_sub_one
decls.statement: theorem abs_fmRatio_Fk_sub_one {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i : Fin (M + 2)) : |fmRatio (cycGraph M) (extT M t) (Fk M k) (xC M i) - 1| = |aC M i - bG t i| / (bG t i + k) ∧ |aC M i - bG t i| / (bG t i + k) ≤ (Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun j => |aC M j - bG t j|) / k ∧ (Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun j => |aC M j - bG t j|) / k ≤ 1 / k
decls.doc: **The display of `proofs.tex:396`**, with the constant made explicit: `|ρ_{F_k}(xᵢ) − 1| = |aᵢ − bᵢ|/(bᵢ + k) ≤ max_j |a_j − b_j|/k ≤ 1/k` for `k ≥ 1`.

decls.name: fmLossTarget_Fk_tendsto_zero_gen
decls.statement: theorem fmLossTarget_Fk_tendsto_zero_gen (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgc : ContinuousAt g 1) (nu : cycV M → ℝ) (t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) (Fk M k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`𝓛(F_k) → 0` as `k → ∞` through the integers**, for every target and every training measure, when `g` is continuous at `1` with `g(1) = 0`.

decls.name: force_eq
decls.statement: theorem force_eq {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : |logSqDeriv r * r| = 2 * |Real.log r|
decls.doc: `|g'(r)r| = 2|log r|` for `g = (log x)²` and `r > 0`.

decls.name: ratio_x3_bounds
decls.statement: theorem ratio_x3_bounds {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 1 < M) : 1 / M < ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 3 ∧ ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 3 < 1

decls.name: inflation_force_max_mono
decls.statement: theorem inflation_force_max_mono {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : (∀ M : ℝ, 1 < M → ∀ x : Fin 5, |logSqDeriv (ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) x) * ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) x| = 2 * |Real.log (ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) x)|) ∧ (∀ M : ℝ, 1 < M → |logSqDeriv (ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0) * ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0| = 2 * Real.log M) ∧ (∀ M : ℝ, 1 < M → ∀ x : Fin 5, x ≠ 0 → |logSqDeriv (ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) x) * ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) x| < |logSqDeriv (ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0) * ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0|) ∧ StrictMonoOn (fun M : ℝ => |logSqDeriv (ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0) * ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0|) (Set.Ioi 1)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the inflation force**: for `g = (log x)²` and `M > 1`, the force `|g'(r)r| = 2|log r|` equals `2 log M` at the starved source `s₀`, is **strictly** smaller at every other state — so it is largest at `s₀` — and, at `s₀`, strictly increases with `M` on `(1, ∞)`.

decls.name: not_critical
decls.statement: theorem not_critical {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 1 < M) {nu : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) : ¬ ∀ d : Fin 5 → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) nu (fun x => uInfl M x + t * d x) logSq) 0 0
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, "the configuration is not a critical point of `𝓛_{g,ν}` for any `ν` of positive density"**, on the Fréchet reading (kb 0035): the directional derivatives of the loss at the over-inflated density do not all vanish.

decls.name: isGradientFlow_scale
decls.statement: theorem isGradientFlow_scale {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd (fun t x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x)
decls.doc: **`t ↦ α μ_{t/α²}` is a gradient flow** whenever `t ↦ μ_t` is (`Balance.flow_rescale` at `c = α⁻¹`, `t₁ = 0`).

decls.name: rescaled_flow
decls.statement: theorem rescaled_flow {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam nu : V → ℝ} {gd : ℝ → ℝ} (hinv : Invariant K lam) (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hgd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 gd y) {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} (hflow : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd u) (hpos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) : IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd (fun t x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < α * u (t / α ^ 2) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → V → ℝ, v 0 = (fun x => α * u 0 x) → IsGradientFlow K lam nu gd v → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → v t = fun x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the rescaled flow, on any finite chain**: for a positive gradient flow `(μ_t)_{t≥0}` and `α > 0`, the curve `t ↦ αμ_{t/α²}` is a positive gradient flow started at `αμ₀`, and every positive gradient flow started at `αμ₀` is that curve on `[0,∞)`.

decls.name: entryTimes
decls.statement: def entryTimes (K : V → V → ℝ) (lam : V → ℝ) (u : ℝ → V → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) : Set ℝ
decls.doc: The times at which every ratio lies within `δ` of `1`.

decls.name: entryTimes_scale
decls.statement: theorem entryTimes_scale {K : V → V → ℝ} {lam : V → ℝ} {u : ℝ → V → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (δ : ℝ) : entryTimes K lam (fun t x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x) δ = α ^ 2 • entryTimes K lam u δ ∧ sInf (entryTimes K lam (fun t x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x) δ) = α ^ 2 * sInf (entryTimes K lam u δ)
decls.doc: **"A trajectory started at norm `αM` runs `α²` times slower"**: the rescaled flow reaches the band `|r − 1| < δ` exactly at the times `α²t`, `t` a time the original one does, and its first such time is `α²` times the original one — the ratios being scale-invariant.

decls.name: cycle_rescaled_flow
decls.statement: theorem cycle_rescaled_flow {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) {wf : Fin 5 → ℝ} {wmin : ℝ} (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) {u0 : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) : (∃ u : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, u 0 = u0 ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) logSqDeriv u ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) ∧ (∃ v : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, v 0 = (fun x => α * u0 x) ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) logSqDeriv v ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) ∧ ∀ u v : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, u 0 = u0 → v 0 = (fun x => α * u0 x) → IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) logSqDeriv u → IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) logSqDeriv v → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → v t = fun x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, sInf (entryTimes (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) v δ) = α ^ 2 * sInf (entryTimes (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) u δ)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the rescaled flow, on the five-vertex cycle** for `g = (log x)²` and `ν = wλ`, `w ≥ w_min > 0`: from any `μ₀ ∼ λ` and any `α > 0` the gradient flows from `μ₀` and from `αμ₀` exist (`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)*, `existsUnique_flow_logSq_graph`), and for any two such positive flows `u`, `v`, `v_t = αu_{t/α²}` on `[0,∞)`; the first entry time into `|r − 1| < δ` of the second is `α²` times that of the first.

decls.name: norm_pow_apply_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_pow_apply_le {P : E →L[ℝ] E} (hP : ∀ w, ‖P w‖ ≤ ‖w‖) (n : ℕ) (w : E) : ‖(P ^ n) w‖ ≤ ‖w‖
decls.doc: A contraction's powers are contractions.

decls.name: norm_pow_mul_apply_sub_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_pow_mul_apply_sub_le {P : E →L[ℝ] E} (hP : ∀ w, ‖P w‖ ≤ ‖w‖) (m k : ℕ) (v : E) : ‖(P ^ (m * k)) v - v‖ ≤ k * ‖(P ^ m) v - v‖
decls.doc: `‖P^{mk}v − v‖ ≤ k‖P^m v − v‖` for a contraction `P`.

decls.name: pow_mul_apply_eq_self
decls.statement: theorem pow_mul_apply_eq_self {P : E →L[ℝ] E} {m : ℕ} {v : E} (h : (P ^ m) v = v) (k : ℕ) : (P ^ (m * k)) v = v
decls.doc: A fixed point of `P^m` is a fixed point of every `P^{mk}`.

decls.name: norm_pow_apply_le_beta
decls.statement: theorem norm_pow_apply_le_beta {P Pi : E →L[ℝ] E} {v : E} (hPi : Pi v = 0) (n : ℕ) : ‖(P ^ n) v‖ ≤ Core.Mixing.beta P Pi n * ‖v‖
decls.doc: `‖P^n v‖ ≤ β̂_n ‖v‖` for `v` killed by the projection.

decls.name: sum_range_mul_le
decls.statement: theorem sum_range_mul_le {β : ℕ → ℝ} (hβ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ β n) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (K : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, β (m * k) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m * K), β n
decls.doc: A sub-sum along the multiples of `m` bounds the partial sum of a non-negative sequence.

decls.name: betaCyc
decls.statement: noncomputable def betaCyc (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`β̂_n = ‖Pⁿ − Π‖_{L²(λ)}`** for the loop-closed backward chain of the remark at `p`, `P` its density action and `Π` the `λ`-mean projection — `Core.Mixing.beta` of the library's `densOp`, `meanOp`, at the kernel `kern p` and the measure `lam p`.

decls.name: betaCyc_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_nonneg (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ betaCyc p n

decls.name: kern_isMarkov
decls.statement: theorem kern_isMarkov {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) : Core.IsMarkov (kern p)
decls.doc: The loop-closed kernel is Markov on `[0,1]`.

decls.name: lam_isInvariant
decls.statement: theorem lam_isInvariant {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p ≤ 1) : Core.IsInvariant (lam p) (kern p)
decls.doc: `lam p` is invariant for `kern p` on `[0,1]`, endpoints included.

decls.name: invProb_endpoint_unique
decls.statement: theorem invProb_endpoint_unique {p : ℝ} (hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1) {m : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hinv : ∀ y, ∑ x, m x * kern p x y = m y) (hsum : ∑ x, m x = 1) : m = lam p
decls.doc: **At `p ∈ {0,1}`, `lam p` is the only invariant probability of `kern p`**: the mixing sum there is read against the right measure.

decls.name: shiftK
decls.statement: noncomputable def shiftK (p : ℝ) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: The density action of `kern p` for `p < 1`, in closed form: a shift along `s₀ ← x₁ ← x₂ ← x₃ ← {x₁ (p), s_f (1−p)}`, `s_f ← s₀`.

decls.name: densAct_kern
decls.statement: theorem densAct_kern {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : Core.densAct (lam p) (kern p) a = shiftK p a

decls.name: densOp_pow_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem densOp_pow_wtL2 {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : (densOp (lam p) (kern p) ^ n) (wtL2 (lam p) a) = wtL2 (lam p) ((shiftK p)^[n] a)

decls.name: densOp_contraction
decls.statement: theorem densOp_contraction {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 5)) : ‖densOp (lam p) (kern p) w‖ ≤ ‖w‖
decls.doc: The density action is an `L²(λ)`-contraction for `p ∈ [0,1)`.

decls.name: testA
decls.statement: def testA : Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: The test density `𝟙_{x₁} − 𝟙_{x₂}`, of `λ`-mean zero.

decls.name: meanL2_testA
decls.statement: theorem meanL2_testA (p : ℝ) : Graph.meanL2 (lam p) testA = 0

decls.name: ipL2_testA
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_testA (p : ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 (lam p) testA testA = 2 / (5 - 2 * p)

decls.name: meanOp_testA
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_testA {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) : meanOp (lam p) (wtL2 (lam p) testA) = 0

decls.name: norm_wtL2_sq
decls.statement: theorem norm_wtL2_sq {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : ‖wtL2 (lam p) a‖ ^ 2 = Graph.ipL2 (lam p) a a

decls.name: delta3
decls.statement: def delta3 (p : ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: Three steps of the shift move `𝟙_{x₁} − 𝟙_{x₂}` by `δ₃ = (0, p−1, 1−p, 1−p, −1)`.

decls.name: shiftK_three_sub
decls.statement: theorem shiftK_three_sub (p : ℝ) : (fun x => (shiftK p)^[3] testA x - testA x) = delta3 p

decls.name: ipL2_delta3
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_delta3 (p : ℝ) : Graph.ipL2 (lam p) (delta3 p) (delta3 p) = (1 - p) * (4 - 3 * p) / (5 - 2 * p)

decls.name: three_step_defect
decls.statement: theorem three_step_defect {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) : ‖(densOp (lam p) (kern p) ^ 3) (wtL2 (lam p) testA) - wtL2 (lam p) testA‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 - p) * ‖wtL2 (lam p) testA‖ ^ 2
decls.doc: **The three-step defect is `O(√(1−p))`**: `‖P³v − v‖² ≤ 2(1−p)‖v‖²` for `v = 𝟙_{x₁} − 𝟙_{x₂}` in `L²(λ)`, on `[0,1)`.

decls.name: betaCyc_three_mul_ge_half
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_three_mul_ge_half {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) {K : ℕ} (hK : 8 * (K : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 - p) ≤ 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ K) : 1 / 2 ≤ betaCyc p (3 * k)

decls.name: betaCyc_partial_sum_ge
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_partial_sum_ge {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) {K : ℕ} (hK : 8 * (K : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 - p) ≤ 1) : (K : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (3 * K), betaCyc p n

decls.name: blowK
decls.statement: noncomputable def blowK (C : ℝ) : ℕ
decls.doc: The explicit number of blocks `K(C) := ⌊2|C|⌋₊ + 1`.

decls.name: mixing_sum_gt
decls.statement: theorem mixing_sum_gt {C p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hpδ : 1 - 1 / (8 * (blowK C : ℝ) ^ 2) < p) : C < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (3 * blowK C), betaCyc p n
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the mixing sum tends to `+∞` as `p → 1`, with an explicit threshold**: if `1 − 1/(8K(C)²) < p < 1` (and `p ≥ 0`), then the partial sum of `β̂_n` over `n < 3K(C)` exceeds `C`.

decls.name: eventually_mixing_threshold
decls.statement: theorem eventually_mixing_threshold (C : ℝ) : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), 0 ≤ p ∧ p < 1 ∧ 1 - 1 / (8 * (blowK C : ℝ) ^ 2) < p

decls.name: mixing_sum_eventually_gt
decls.statement: theorem mixing_sum_eventually_gt (C : ℝ) : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, C < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, betaCyc p n
decls.doc: **The mixing sum tends to `+∞` as `p → 1⁻`**, partial-sum form (kb 0031): for every `C` the partial sums eventually exceed `C`.

decls.name: mixing_sum_tendsto_top
decls.statement: theorem mixing_sum_tendsto_top : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (betaCyc p n)) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 ⊤)
decls.doc: **The mixing sum `∑ₙ β̂ₙ`, read in `[0,∞]`, tends to `+∞` as `p → 1⁻`.**

decls.name: rho_mixing_ennreal_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem rho_mixing_ennreal_tendsto (c : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal c / (∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (betaCyc p n)) ^ 2) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **The rate `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²` read at the mixing sum tends to `0` as `p → 1⁻`**, in `[0,∞]`, where `c/∞ = 0`: no summability is assumed.

decls.name: not_summable_of_one_le
decls.statement: theorem not_summable_of_one_le {β : ℕ → ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (h : ∀ k, 1 ≤ β (m * k)) : ¬ Summable β

decls.name: tsum_ofReal_eq_top_of_one_le
decls.statement: theorem tsum_ofReal_eq_top_of_one_le {β : ℕ → ℝ} (hβ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ β n) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (h : ∀ k, 1 ≤ β (m * k)) : ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (β n) = ⊤

decls.name: ipL2_testA_pos
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_testA_pos {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p ≤ 1) : 0 < ‖wtL2 (lam p) testA‖

decls.name: one_le_beta_of_fixed
decls.statement: theorem one_le_beta_of_fixed {P Pi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 5) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 5)} {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 5)} (hv : 0 < ‖v‖) (hPi : Pi v = 0) {n : ℕ} (hfix : (P ^ n) v = v) : 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.beta P Pi n

decls.name: betaCyc_zero_ge
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_zero_ge (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ betaCyc 0 (5 * k)
decls.doc: **At `p = 0` the chain is the deterministic `5`-cycle**: `β̂_{5k} ≥ 1` for every `k`.

decls.name: shift1
decls.statement: def shift1 (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: The density action of `kern 1` in closed form: on `λ = (0, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3, 0)` the two marks carry no mass and the cycle is a deterministic rotation.

decls.name: cutA
decls.statement: def cutA (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: `a` cut to the support of `lam 1`.

decls.name: unwt_wt_one
decls.statement: theorem unwt_wt_one (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : unwtL2 (lam 1) (wtL2 (lam 1) a) = cutA a

decls.name: densOp_one_wtL2
decls.statement: theorem densOp_one_wtL2 (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : densOp (lam 1) (kern 1) (wtL2 (lam 1) a) = wtL2 (lam 1) (shift1 a)

decls.name: meanOp_one_testA
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_one_testA : meanOp (lam 1) (wtL2 (lam 1) testA) = 0

decls.name: betaCyc_one_ge
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_one_ge (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ betaCyc 1 (3 * k)
decls.doc: **At `p = 1` the cycle `x₁ → x₃ → x₂ → x₁` closes**: `β̂_{3k} ≥ 1` for every `k`.

decls.name: mixing_sum_endpoints
decls.statement: theorem mixing_sum_endpoints : kern 1 1 0 = 0 ∧ kern 0 1 3 = 0 ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p = 0 ∨ p = 1 → Core.IsMarkov (kern p) ∧ Core.IsInvariant (lam p) (kern p) ∧ ∑ x, lam p x = 1 ∧ (∀ m : Fin 5 → ℝ, (∀ y, ∑ x, m x * kern p x y = m y) → ∑ x, m x = 1 → m = lam p) ∧ ¬ Summable (betaCyc p) ∧ ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (betaCyc p n) = ⊤
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the endpoints**: at `p = 1` the edge `s₀ → x₁` carries no backward probability, at `p = 0` the edge `x₃ → x₁` carries none; at both, `kern p` is Markov, `lam p` is its invariant probability and the only one, and the mixing sum `∑ₙ β̂ₙ` is `+∞` — the coefficients are not summable, and their sum in `[0,∞]` is `⊤`.

decls.name: Qm
decls.statement: def Qm (p : ℝ) : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: The forward (reversed) transition matrix: `shiftK p a = Q *ᵥ a`.

decls.name: Qmat
decls.statement: def Qmat (p : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ
decls.doc: `Q` as a matrix.

decls.name: shiftK_eq_mulVec
decls.statement: theorem shiftK_eq_mulVec (p : ℝ) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : shiftK p a = (Qmat p).mulVec a

decls.name: shiftK_iterate_eq
decls.statement: theorem shiftK_iterate_eq (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) : (shiftK p)^[n] a = (Qmat p ^ n).mulVec a

decls.name: Qmat_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem Qmat_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (y x : Fin 5) : 0 ≤ Qmat p y x

decls.name: Qmat_pow_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem Qmat_pow_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (y x : Fin 5) : 0 ≤ (Qmat p ^ n) y x

decls.name: Qmat_row
decls.statement: theorem Qmat_row (p : ℝ) (y : Fin 5) : ∑ x, Qmat p y x = 1

decls.name: Qmat_pow_row
decls.statement: theorem Qmat_pow_row (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (y : Fin 5) : ∑ x, (Qmat p ^ n) y x = 1

decls.name: Qmat_inv
decls.statement: theorem Qmat_inv (p : ℝ) (x : Fin 5) : ∑ y, lam p y * Qmat p y x = lam p x

decls.name: Qmat_pow_inv
decls.statement: theorem Qmat_pow_inv (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin 5) : ∑ y, lam p y * (Qmat p ^ n) y x = lam p x

decls.name: epsQ
decls.statement: noncomputable def epsQ (p : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `ε = min(p, 1−p)`.

decls.name: QLb
decls.statement: def QLb (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (y x : Fin 5) : Prop
decls.doc: `εⁿ ≤ Qⁿ(y,x)`.

decls.name: QLb_chain
decls.statement: theorem QLb_chain {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) {a b : ℕ} {y z x : Fin 5} (h1 : QLb p a y z) (h2 : QLb p b z x) : QLb p (a + b) y x

decls.name: QLb_edge
decls.statement: theorem QLb_edge {p : ℝ} {y x : Fin 5} (h : epsQ p ≤ Qm p y x) : QLb p 1 y x

decls.name: eps_le_one
decls.statement: theorem eps_le_one (p : ℝ) : epsQ p ≤ 1

decls.name: QLb_01
decls.statement: theorem QLb_01 {p : ℝ} : QLb p 1 0 1

decls.name: QLb_12
decls.statement: theorem QLb_12 {p : ℝ} : QLb p 1 1 2

decls.name: QLb_23
decls.statement: theorem QLb_23 {p : ℝ} : QLb p 1 2 3

decls.name: QLb_31
decls.statement: theorem QLb_31 {p : ℝ} : QLb p 1 3 1

decls.name: QLb_34
decls.statement: theorem QLb_34 {p : ℝ} : QLb p 1 3 4

decls.name: QLb_40
decls.statement: theorem QLb_40 {p : ℝ} : QLb p 1 4 0

decls.name: QLb_refl
decls.statement: theorem QLb_refl {p : ℝ} (y : Fin 5) : QLb p 0 y y

decls.name: dTo3
decls.statement: def dTo3 : Fin 5 → ℕ
decls.doc: Steps from `y` to `x₃`.

decls.name: eFrom3
decls.statement: def eFrom3 : Fin 5 → ℕ
decls.doc: Steps from `x₃` to `x`.

decls.name: QLb_to3
decls.statement: theorem QLb_to3 {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (y : Fin 5) : QLb p (dTo3 y) y 3

decls.name: QLb_from3
decls.statement: theorem QLb_from3 {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (x : Fin 5) : QLb p (eFrom3 x) 3 x

decls.name: QLb_c3
decls.statement: theorem QLb_c3 {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : QLb p 3 3 3

decls.name: QLb_c5
decls.statement: theorem QLb_c5 {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : QLb p 5 3 3

decls.name: QLb_mid
decls.statement: theorem QLb_mid {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (m : ℕ) (h1 : 10 ≤ m) (h2 : m ≤ 16) : QLb p m 3 3

decls.name: QLb_16
decls.statement: theorem QLb_16 {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (y x : Fin 5) : QLb p 16 y x
decls.doc: **The Doeblin minorization**: `Q¹⁶(y,x) ≥ min(p,1−p)¹⁶` at every pair of states.

decls.name: variance_contract
decls.statement: theorem variance_contract {R : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ} {l h : Fin 5 → ℝ} {δ : ℝ} (hrow : ∀ y, ∑ x, R y x = 1) (hinv : ∀ x, ∑ y, l y * R y x = l x) (hl : ∀ x, 0 ≤ l x) (hlsum : ∑ x, l x = 1) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hmin : ∀ y x, δ * l x ≤ R y x) (hmean : ∑ x, l x * h x = 0) : ∑ y, l y * (∑ x, R y x * h x) ^ 2 ≤ (1 - δ) * ∑ x, l x * h x ^ 2
decls.doc: **The variance inequality**: a row-stochastic `R ≥ 0` with `λR = λ` and `R(y,x) ≥ δλ(x)` contracts the `λ`-mean-zero functions in `L²(λ)` by `1 − δ`.

decls.name: lam_sum
decls.statement: theorem lam_sum (p : ℝ) (hp1 : p < 1) : ∑ x, lam p x = 1

decls.name: sum_sq_sub_mean
decls.statement: theorem sum_sq_sub_mean {l a : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hlsum : ∑ x, l x = 1) : ∑ x, l x * (a x - ∑ z, l z * a z) ^ 2 = ∑ x, l x * a x ^ 2 - (∑ z, l z * a z) ^ 2
decls.doc: `∑ λ(a − m)² = ∑ λa² − m²` for `m = ∑ λa`, `λ` a probability.

decls.name: meanOp_norm_apply_le
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_norm_apply_le {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 5)) : ‖meanOp (lam p) w‖ ≤ ‖w‖

decls.name: norm_pow16_sub_meanOp_le
decls.statement: theorem norm_pow16_sub_meanOp_le {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : ‖densOp (lam p) (kern p) ^ 16 - meanOp (lam p)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - epsQ p ^ 16)
decls.doc: **The `L²(λ)` Doeblin step**: `‖P¹⁶ − Π‖ ≤ √(1 − min(p,1−p)¹⁶)` on `(0,1)`.

decls.name: densOp_pow_mul_meanOp
decls.statement: theorem densOp_pow_mul_meanOp {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) : densOp (lam p) (kern p) ^ n * meanOp (lam p) = meanOp (lam p)

decls.name: meanOp_mul_densOp_pow
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_mul_densOp_pow {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) : meanOp (lam p) * densOp (lam p) (kern p) ^ n = meanOp (lam p)

decls.name: meanOp_mul_self
decls.statement: theorem meanOp_mul_self {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) : meanOp (lam p) * meanOp (lam p) = meanOp (lam p)

decls.name: betaCyc_add16_le
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_add16_le {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) : betaCyc p (n + 16) ≤ ‖densOp (lam p) (kern p) ^ 16 - meanOp (lam p)‖ * betaCyc p n
decls.doc: `Pⁿ⁺¹⁶ − Π = (P¹⁶ − Π)(Pⁿ − Π)`, hence `β̂_{n+16} ≤ ‖P¹⁶ − Π‖ β̂_n`.

decls.name: betaCyc_le_two
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_le_two {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) : betaCyc p n ≤ 2

decls.name: rateQ
decls.statement: noncomputable def rateQ (p : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: The geometric rate `r(p) := 1 − min(p,1−p)¹⁶/32`.

decls.name: betaCyc_le_geometric
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_le_geometric {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) : betaCyc p n ≤ 2 / rateQ p ^ 15 * rateQ p ^ n
decls.doc: **`β̂_n ≤ (2/r¹⁵) rⁿ`** with the explicit `r = 1 − min(p,1−p)¹⁶/32 < 1`, on `(0,1)`.

decls.name: betaCyc_summable
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_summable {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Summable (betaCyc p)
decls.doc: **Summable mixing on `(0,1)`**: the paper's `B̂ = ∑ₙ β̂ₙ` is finite at every `p ∈ (0,1)`.

decls.name: mixing_cycle
decls.statement: theorem mixing_cycle {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Core.Mixing (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p))
decls.doc: **`Core.Mixing` holds on the remark's chain at every `p ∈ (0,1)`**: the hypothesis bundle of `lem:sigma_mixing` and of `LocalConvergenceMixing`, inhabited on a chain whose density action is not a projection.

decls.name: rhoSigma_cycle_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem rhoSigma_cycle_tendsto {g2 W : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) {wmin : ℝ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), 0 ≤ wmin p ∧ wmin p ≤ W) : Tendsto (fun p => rhoL g2 (wmin p) (BhatSigma cyc (hitExp p) (lam p))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun p => rhoSigma g2 (wmin p) (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) (Graph.sigmaStar cyc (hitExp p))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, `ϱ_σ → 0` as `p → 1⁻`**: the rate of `prop:morozov_rate`*(3)*, `ϱ_σ = g''(1)w_min/B̂_σ² = g''(1)w_min λ_min/σ_*²`, in both library forms, for `g''(1) ≥ 0` and any `w_min(p)` eventually in `[0, W]`.

decls.name: kappa_cycle_tendsto_gen
decls.statement: theorem kappa_cycle_tendsto_gen {wmin wsup L0 : ℝ → ℝ} {u0 : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ} {n0 : ℝ} (hn0 : 0 < n0) (hev : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), 0 < wmin p ∧ wmin p ≤ wsup p ∧ n0 ≤ Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) (u0 p)) : Tendsto (fun p => wmin p * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) / (Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) (u0 p) * wsup p * max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 p / (wmin p * Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)))))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the constant of `cor:global_lojasiewicz` tends to `0` as `p → 1⁻`**: `κ = w_min λ_min^{1/2}/(‖u₀‖_{L²(λ)} ‖w‖_∞ M)`, `M = max(1, √(𝓛(μ₀)/(w_min λ_min)))`, for families `w_min(p) ≤ ‖w‖_∞(p)`, `u₀(p)`, `𝓛(μ₀)(p)` whose only constraint is that `‖u₀(p)‖_{L²(λ_p)}` stays eventually above some `n₀ > 0`.

decls.name: kappa_cycle_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem kappa_cycle_tendsto {wmin wsup : ℝ} (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hws : wmin ≤ wsup) {u0 : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) (L0 : ℝ → ℝ) : Tendsto (fun p => wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) / (Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) u0 * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 p / (wmin * Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)))))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`κ → 0` at a fixed positive `u₀`** and fixed `0 < w_min ≤ ‖w‖_∞`: `‖u₀‖_{L²(λ_p)} ≥ u₀(x₁)/√5`.

decls.name: kappa_cycle_tendsto_fixed_measure
decls.statement: theorem kappa_cycle_tendsto_fixed_measure {wmin wsup : ℝ} (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hws : wmin ≤ wsup) {mu0 : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hmu0 : ∀ x, 0 < mu0 x) (L0 : ℝ → ℝ) : Tendsto (fun p => wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) / (Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) (fun x => mu0 x / lam p x) * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 p / (wmin * Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)))))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`κ → 0` at a fixed initial measure `μ₀ = u₀λ_p`**, `μ₀ > 0` fixed: `u₀(p) = μ₀/λ_p` and `‖u₀(p)‖_{L²(λ_p)} ≥ μ₀(x₁)√3`.

decls.name: mixing_B_coercive
decls.statement: theorem mixing_B_coercive {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p)) ∧ ∀ f : Fin 5 → ℝ, Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) (perpL2 (lam p) f) ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p)) * Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) (Aop (kern p) (lam p) f)
decls.doc: **At every `p ∈ (0,1)` the mixing sum `B̂ = ∑ₙ β̂ₙ` is a coercivity constant `≥ 1`** — the hypothesis `eq:coercivity` of `theo:db_stable_frozen_full` — so `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²` is that theorem's rate.

decls.name: mixing_B_tendsto_atTop
decls.statement: theorem mixing_B_tendsto_atTop : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p))) (𝓝[<] 1) atTop
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, "the mixing sum tends to `+∞`"**, in `ℝ`: the (finite) mixing sum `B̂(p) = ∑ₙ β̂ₙ(p)` tends to `+∞` as `p → 1⁻`.

decls.name: rho_mixing_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem rho_mixing_tendsto {g2 W : ℝ} (hg2 : 0 ≤ g2) {wmin : ℝ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), 0 ≤ wmin p ∧ wmin p ≤ W) : Tendsto (fun p => rhoL g2 (wmin p) (Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p)))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, "the rate `ϱ` of `theo:db_stable_frozen_full` read at the mixing sum tends to `0`"**, in `ℝ` at the genuine (summable) mixing sum: `g''(1) ≥ 0`, `w_min(p)` eventually in `[0, W]`.

decls.name: cycle_rescaled_flow_sq
decls.statement: theorem cycle_rescaled_flow_sq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) {wf : Fin 5 → ℝ} {wmin : ℝ} (hwmin : 0 < wmin) (hw : ∀ x, wmin ≤ wf x) {u0 : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 < u0 x) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) : (∃ u : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, u 0 = u0 ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) (fun x => 2 * (x - 1)) u ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) ∧ (∃ v : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, v 0 = (fun x => α * u0 x) ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) (fun x => 2 * (x - 1)) v ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) ∧ ∀ u v : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, u 0 = u0 → v 0 = (fun x => α * u0 x) → IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) (fun x => 2 * (x - 1)) u → IsGradientFlow (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (fun x => lam p x * wf x) (fun x => 2 * (x - 1)) v → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < u t x) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, 0 < v t x) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → v t = fun x => α * u (t / α ^ 2) x) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, sInf (entryTimes (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) v δ) = α ^ 2 * sInf (entryTimes (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) u δ)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the rescaled flow, on the five-vertex cycle, for `g = (x − 1)²`** — the other generator `prop:no_distant_equilibrium`*(3)* names.

decls.name: nrmL2_scale
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_scale {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (lam u0 : V → ℝ) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) : Graph.nrmL2 lam (fun x => α * u0 x) = α * Graph.nrmL2 lam u0
decls.doc: **The start is at norm `α‖u₀‖`**: `‖αu₀‖_{L²(λ)} = α‖u₀‖_{L²(λ)}`, so "started at norm `Θ(M)`" is `α = Θ(M)` in `cycle_rescaled_flow`.

decls.name: cycle_rescaled_flow_check
decls.statement: theorem cycle_rescaled_flow_check : ∃ u v : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ, u 0 = uInfl 2 ∧ v 0 = (fun x => 3 * uInfl 2 x) ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol (p := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (lam (1 / 2)) (fun x => lam (1 / 2) x * 1) logSqDeriv u ∧ IsGradientFlow (pol (p := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (lam (1 / 2)) (fun x => lam (1 / 2) x * 1) logSqDeriv v ∧ ¬ Balanced (pol (p := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).phat (lam (1 / 2)) (u 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → v t = fun x => 3 * u (t / 3 ^ 2) x
decls.doc: **Inhabitation (kb 0025) of `cycle_rescaled_flow`'s flow hypotheses off balance**: at `p = 1/2`, `w ≡ 1`, from the over-inflated `uInfl 2` (`r(s₀) = 2 ≠ 1`) and at `α = 3`, both flows exist and the second is the first rescaled.

decls.name: cycle_counterexample
decls.statement: theorem cycle_counterexample (M : ℕ) : (∀ k : ℕ, (∀ u v, 0 ≤ Fk M k u v) ∧ (∀ u v, Fk M k u v ≠ 0 → (cycGraph M).Edge u v) ∧ (∀ i, Fk M k (srcC M) (xC M i) + ∑ j, Fk M k (xC M j) (xC M i) = Fk M k (xC M i) (snkC M) + ∑ j, Fk M k (xC M i) (xC M j)) ∧ (∀ i, Fk M k (srcC M) (xC M i) = if i = 0 then 1 else 0) ∧ (∀ i, Fk M k (xC M i) (snkC M) = if i = 1 then 1 else 0) ∧ (∀ x, termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k) x = if x = xC M 1 then 1 else 0) ∧ ∀ t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) → ∑ i, t i = 1 → tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k)) (extT M t) = 1 - t 1) ∧ ∀ t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) → ∑ i, t i = 1 → ∀ (nu : cycV M → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), g 1 = 0 → ContinuousAt g 1 → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ i, 0 < extT M t (xC M i) + ∑ v ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, Fk M k (xC M i) v ∧ 0 < fmRatio (cycGraph M) (extT M t) (Fk M k) (xC M i) ∧ |fmRatio (cycGraph M) (extT M t) (Fk M k) (xC M i) - 1| ≤ 1 / k) ∧ Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) (Fk M k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`lem:cycle_counterexample`** (`proofs.tex:385–404`), items *(1)* and *(2)* on `𝒞_N`, `N = M + 2`, for every integer `k ≥ 0`, every probability target `t` on `{x₁,…,x_N}` and every training weight `ν`, the sampler clause excepted (SCOPE).

decls.name: cycle_counterexample_check
decls.statement: theorem cycle_counterexample_check : (∀ k : ℕ, tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph 0) (Fk 0 k)) (extT 0 fun _ => 1 / 2) = 1 / 2) ∧ Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => fmLossTarget (cycGraph 0) (fun x => (x - 1) ^ 2) (fun _ => 1) (extT 0 fun _ => 1 / 2) (Fk 0 k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **Inhabitation of `cycle_counterexample`'s hypotheses** at `N = 2`: the uniform target `(1/2, 1/2)` is a probability, `g = (x − 1)²` is continuous at `1` and vanishes there, and the loss of `F_k` against the uniform weight tends to `0` while its terminal law stays at total variation `1/2`.

decls.name: betaCyc_eq
decls.statement: theorem betaCyc_eq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) : betaCyc p n = Core.Mixing.beta (densOp (lam p) (pol hp0 hp1).phat) (meanOp (lam p)) n
decls.doc: On `(0,1)` the kernel `kern p` of `betaCyc` **is** the loop closure of the remark's frozen policy, and `lam p` its unique invariant probability (`CycleExample.phat_eq`, `invProb_eq`).

decls.name: cycle_no_stalemate_limits
decls.statement: theorem cycle_no_stalemate_limits : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => 3 / (1 - p)) (𝓝[<] 1) atTop ∧ (∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → p < 1 → Summable (betaCyc p) ∧ 1 ≤ Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p))) ∧ Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p))) (𝓝[<] 1) atTop ∧ Tendsto (fun p => BhatSigma cyc (hitExp p) (lam p)) (𝓝[<] 1) atTop ∧ (∀ g2 wmin : ℝ, 0 ≤ g2 → 0 ≤ wmin → Tendsto (fun p => rhoL g2 wmin (Core.Mixing.B (densOp (lam p) (kern p)) (meanOp (lam p)))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun p => rhoL g2 wmin (BhatSigma cyc (hitExp p) (lam p))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)) ∧ ∀ wmin wsup : ℝ, 0 < wmin → wmin ≤ wsup → ∀ u0 : Fin 5 → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 < u0 x) → ∀ L0 : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto (fun p => wmin * Real.sqrt (Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)) / (Graph.nrmL2 (lam p) u0 * wsup * max 1 (Real.sqrt (L0 p / (wmin * Graph.minOver cyc (lam p)))))) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, the closing sentence** (`proofs.tex:911`), as `p → 1⁻`: the expected backward-trajectory length `σ̄ = 3/(1−p)`, the mixing sum `B̂ = ∑ₙ β̂ₙ` — finite on `(0,1)` and a coercivity constant there — and `B̂_σ` tend to `+∞`, while the rate `ϱ = g''(1)w_min/B̂²` of `theo:db_stable_frozen_full` read at the mixing sum, the rate `ϱ_σ = g''(1)w_min/B̂_σ²` and the constant `κ` of `cor:global_lojasiewicz` tend to `0` (here `g''(1) ≥ 0`, `w_min`, `‖w‖_∞` and `u₀` held fixed; `rho_mixing_tendsto`, `rhoSigma_cycle_tendsto` and `kappa_cycle_tendsto_gen` let them move).

files.title: Freezing the backward policy does not restore stability, and the loop closure is what makes the frozen family nonempty

decls.name: edgeInflow
decls.statement: def edgeInflow (F : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the inflow of an edgeflow** (`proofs.tex:673`): `μ_F(v) := ∑_u F(u → v)`.

decls.name: edgeOutflow
decls.statement: def edgeOutflow (F : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The outflow of an edgeflow, `∑_v F(u → v)`.

decls.name: IsCirculation
decls.statement: def IsCirculation (F : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **A circulation**: an edgeflow that neither creates nor destroys mass at any vertex.

decls.name: MarkedCirculation
decls.statement: structure MarkedCirculation (G : MarkedGraph V)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the unit circulation `1_γ`** (`proofs.tex:663`), as the hypothesis bundle its proof consumes: a non-negative circulation, not identically zero, with zero inflow at both marks.

decls.name: exists_apply_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem exists_apply_ne_zero {c : V → V → ℝ} (hne : c ≠ 0) : ∃ u v, c u v ≠ 0
decls.doc: A non-zero edgeflow is non-zero at some transition, in the form the sums below want.

decls.name: MarkedCirculation.exists_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem MarkedCirculation.exists_ne_zero {G : MarkedGraph V} (γ : MarkedCirculation G) : ∃ u v, γ.circ u v ≠ 0
decls.doc: `1_γ` is somewhere non-zero.

decls.name: epsCirc
decls.statement: def epsCirc (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the `0`-flow `F₀ := ε 1_γ`** (`proofs.tex:665`).

decls.name: epsCirc_apply
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_apply (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V) : epsCirc eps c u v = eps * c u v
decls.doc: `ε 1_γ`, evaluated.

decls.name: epsCirc_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_nonneg {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 ≤ eps) {c : V → V → ℝ} (hc : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ c u v) (u v : V) : 0 ≤ epsCirc eps c u v
decls.doc: `F₀ = ε 1_γ ≥ 0` for `ε ≥ 0` — the first conjunct of the proposition's display.

decls.name: edgeInflow_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_epsCirc (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (v : V) : edgeInflow (epsCirc eps c) v = eps * edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: The inflow of `ε 1_γ` is `ε ∂γ`.

decls.name: edgeOutflow_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem edgeOutflow_epsCirc (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (u : V) : edgeOutflow (epsCirc eps c) u = eps * edgeOutflow c u
decls.doc: The outflow of `ε 1_γ` is `ε` times that of `1_γ`.

decls.name: isCirculation_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem isCirculation_epsCirc (eps : ℝ) {c : V → V → ℝ} (hc : IsCirculation c) : IsCirculation (epsCirc eps c)
decls.doc: **`F₀ = ε1_γ` is a `0`-flow**: scaling a circulation gives a circulation.

decls.name: sum_edgeInflow_pos
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeInflow_pos {c : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ c u v) (hne : c ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ v, edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: **`∂γ ≠ 0`** in the only form the proof of `𝓛_{g,ν}(F) > 0` needs: the total mass of the inflow of a non-negative, non-zero edgeflow is positive.

decls.name: stateRatio
decls.statement: noncomputable def stateRatio (mu : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the ratio `r = d(μ π̂_←)/dμ`** (`proofs.tex:673`), in the coordinates of `GFNBounds.Balance`: `μ = u λ` at `λ := μ` and `u := 1`, so that `ratio π̂_← μ 1 = (μ π̂_←)/μ`.

decls.name: stateRatio_apply
decls.statement: theorem stateRatio_apply (mu : V → ℝ) (y : V) : B.stateRatio mu y = (∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y) / mu y

decls.name: balanced_iff
decls.statement: theorem balanced_iff (mu : V → ℝ) : Balance.Balanced B.phat mu 1 ↔ ∀ y, ∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y = mu y
decls.doc: `GFNBounds.Balance`'s `Balanced` at these coordinates is invariance of the state flow.

decls.name: stateRatio_eq_one_iff
decls.statement: theorem stateRatio_eq_one_iff {mu : V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ y, 0 < mu y) : (∀ y, B.stateRatio mu y = 1) ↔ ∀ y, ∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y = mu y
decls.doc: **`r ≡ 1` if and only if the state flow is `π̂_←`-invariant** — `ratio_eq_one_iff_balanced` of `GFNBounds.Balance`, read here.

decls.name: fmLoss
decls.statement: noncomputable def fmLoss (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nu mu : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the FM loss with a frozen backward policy** (`proofs.tex:673`): `𝓛_{g,ν}(μ) = ∫ g(r) dν = ∑_x ν(x) g(r(x))`, a function of the state flow alone.

decls.name: exists_phat_pos_into
decls.statement: theorem exists_phat_pos_into {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (y : V) : ∃ x, 0 < B.phat x y
decls.doc: Every state receives mass from somewhere under `π̂_←`: an invariant probability that is positive somewhere is positive at `y`, so some term of `∑_x λ(x) π̂_←(x → y) = λ(y) > 0` is.

decls.name: stateRatio_pos
decls.statement: theorem stateRatio_pos {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {mu : V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ x, 0 < mu x) (y : V) : 0 < B.stateRatio mu y
decls.doc: **The ratio is positive at every state flow of positive density.** The paper's `g > 0` elsewhere is a statement on `ℝ_{>0}`, so this is what lets it be applied.

decls.name: fmLoss_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem fmLoss_eq_zero {mu : V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ y, 0 < mu y) (hinv : ∀ y, ∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y = mu y) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (nu : V → ℝ) : B.fmLoss g nu mu = 0
decls.doc: **`𝓛_{g,ν}(F + F₀) = 0`** (`proofs.tex:678`), in its general form: at a state flow that is `π̂_←`-invariant the ratio is `≡ 1` and `g(1) = 0`.

decls.name: fmLoss_pos
decls.statement: theorem fmLoss_pos {mu : V → ℝ} (hr : ∀ y, 0 < B.stateRatio mu y) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nu : V → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) {y : V} (hy : B.stateRatio mu y ≠ 1) : 0 < B.fmLoss g nu mu
decls.doc: **`𝓛_{g,ν}(F) > 0`** (`proofs.tex:676`), in its general form: `ν > 0`, `g ≥ 0` on the ratios and `g > 0` at one of them.

decls.name: AdmissibleEps
decls.statement: def AdmissibleEps (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the admissible `ε`** (`proofs.tex:664`): `2 ε 1_γ ≤ F*` edgewise, which is the form the *Admissibility* step uses and, for a `{0,1}`-valued `1_γ`, is the statement's `ε ≤ ½ min_{(u→v)∈γ} F*(u→v)`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow
decls.statement: noncomputable def perturbedFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the perturbed edgeflow `F := F* − ε1_γ`** (`proofs.tex:665`).

decls.name: edgeFlow_pos_of_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_pos_of_hatEdge (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {u v : V} (he : G.hatEdge u v) : 0 < B.edgeFlow lam c u v
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*, first half** (`proofs.tex:675`): `λ > 0` and `π̂_← > 0` give `F* > 0` on every edge of `Ĝ` — on an edge of `G` by `PositiveOnEdges`, on the wrap edge because `π̂_←(s₀ → s_f) = 1`.

decls.name: exists_admissibleEps
decls.statement: theorem exists_admissibleEps (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) (hsupp : ∀ u v, γ.circ u v ≠ 0 → G.hatEdge u v) : ∃ eps : ℝ, 0 < eps ∧ B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*, second half** (`proofs.tex:675`): "`ε` is well defined and positive".

decls.name: epsCirc_le_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_le_perturbedFlow {lam : V → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} {c : V → V → ℝ} (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps c) (u v : V) : epsCirc eps c u v ≤ B.perturbedFlow lam eps c u v
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*** (`proofs.tex:675`): `2ε1_γ ≤ F*` edgewise gives `F₀ = ε1_γ ≤ F* − ε1_γ = F`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow_add_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem perturbedFlow_add_epsCirc (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : B.perturbedFlow lam eps c + epsCirc eps c = B.edgeFlow lam 1
decls.doc: **`F + F₀ = F*`** (`proofs.tex:678`).

decls.name: edgeInflow_edgeFlow_one
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_edgeFlow_one (lam : V → ℝ) : edgeInflow (B.edgeFlow lam 1) = lam
decls.doc: **`μ_{F*} = λ`** (`proofs.tex:673`), "since the rows of `π̂_←` sum to `1`".

decls.name: edgeInflow_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_perturbedFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (v : V) : edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c) v = lam v - eps * edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: **`μ_F = λ − ε ∂γ`** (`proofs.tex:676`).

decls.name: edgeInflow_perturbedFlow_ge
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_perturbedFlow_ge {lam : V → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} {c : V → V → ℝ} (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps c) (v : V) : lam v / 2 ≤ edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c) v
decls.doc: **The perturbed state flow is at least `λ/2`, hence positive.** This is the point at which `eq_smul_invProb` — uniqueness of the invariant measure among *non-negative* vectors — becomes applicable to `μ_F`, and the paper's `ε` hypothesis is exactly what buys it: summing `ε 1_γ(u→v) ≤ ½ F*(u→v)` over `u` against `∑_u F*(u→v) = λ(v)` gives `ε ∂γ(v) ≤ ½ λ(v)`.

decls.name: sum_edgeInflow_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeInflow_perturbedFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : ∑ v, edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c) v = 1 - eps * ∑ v, edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: The total mass of the perturbed state flow, `∑ μ_F = 1 − ε ∑_v ∂γ(v)`.

decls.name: isCirculation_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem isCirculation_perturbedFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (eps : ℝ) {c : V → V → ℝ} (hc : IsCirculation c) : IsCirculation (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c)
decls.doc: **`F = F* − ε1_γ` is again a `0`-flow**: `F*` is a circulation (`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, `proofs.tex:995–996`) and so is `ε1_γ`.

decls.name: not_invariant_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem not_invariant_perturbedFlow (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : ¬ ∀ y, ∑ x, edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ) x * B.phat x y = edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ) y
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the step `𝓛_{g,ν}(F) > 0` rests on** (`proofs.tex:676`): `μ_F π̂_← ≠ μ_F`.

decls.name: frozen_unstable_full_fm
decls.statement: theorem frozen_unstable_full_fm (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nu : V → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : (∀ u v, 0 ≤ epsCirc eps γ.circ u v) ∧ (∀ u v, epsCirc eps γ.circ u v ≤ B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ u v) ∧ B.fmLoss g nu (edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ + epsCirc eps γ.circ)) = 0 ∧ 0 < B.fmLoss g nu (edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ))
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the FM half** (statement `proofs.tex:680–690`, proof `proofs.tex:692–704`), in one statement.

decls.name: pcut
decls.statement: noncomputable def pcut : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`, the backward kernel of `G` itself** (`proofs.tex:1091`): `π_←` with the row at `s₀` emptied.

decls.name: pcut_src
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem pcut_src (s' : V) : B.pcut G.src s' = 0

decls.name: pcut_of_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem pcut_of_ne_src {s : V} (hs : s ≠ G.src) (s' : V) : B.pcut s s' = B.pb s s'

decls.name: pcut_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem pcut_nonneg (s s' : V) : 0 ≤ B.pcut s s'

decls.name: pcut_row_sum_of_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem pcut_row_sum_of_ne_src {s : V} (hs : s ≠ G.src) : ∑ s', B.pcut s s' = 1
decls.doc: Off the source, `π_←` is a probability: `pcut` inherits `row_sum`.

decls.name: pcut_row_sum_src
decls.statement: theorem pcut_row_sum_src : ∑ s', B.pcut G.src s' = 0
decls.doc: At the source the row is empty: this is the deficit the marginal argument reads off.

decls.name: CutBalance
decls.statement: def CutBalance (pf : V → V → ℝ) (fout : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`, the frozen-backward family on `G`** (`proofs.tex:1091`): the family `Θ_{π_←}` of `theo:universality_graphs`*(2)* with `π̂_←` replaced by the kernel of `G` itself, in the same coordinates — `f_out(u) π_→(u → v) = π_←(v → u) f_out(v)` at every transition.

decls.name: cutBalance_zero
decls.statement: theorem cutBalance_zero (pf : V → V → ℝ) : B.CutBalance pf 0
decls.doc: The family is not empty: `f_out ≡ 0` is in it, whatever the forward policy.

decls.name: cutBalance_invariant
decls.statement: theorem cutBalance_invariant {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hcb : B.CutBalance pf fout) (u : V) : ∑ v, fout v * B.pcut v u = fout u
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`, the marginal argument** (`proofs.tex:1091`): summing the constraint over `v` at fixed `u`, the rows of `π_→` summing to `1`, makes `f_out μ` invariant under `π_←`.

decls.name: cutBalance_src_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem cutBalance_src_eq_zero {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hcb : B.CutBalance pf fout) : fout G.src = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`: the marginal argument forces `f_out(s₀) = 0`** (`proofs.tex:1091`).

decls.name: cutInvariant_step
decls.statement: theorem cutInvariant_step (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {fout : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hinv : ∀ u, ∑ v, fout v * B.pcut v u = fout u) {u v : V} (he : G.Edge u v) (hu : fout u = 0) : fout v = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`: the zero propagates along the edges of `G`.** Invariance under `π_←` reads `f_out(u) = ∑_v f_out(v) π_←(v → u)` with every term non-negative, so `f_out(u) = 0` kills every term; and `π_←(v → u) > 0` at every out-neighbour `v` of `u`, by `PositiveOnEdges` and because such a `v` is not the source.

decls.name: cutInvariant_eq_zero_of_reach
decls.statement: theorem cutInvariant_eq_zero_of_reach (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {fout : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hinv : ∀ u, ∑ v, fout v * B.pcut v u = fout u) {a b : V} (hr : G.Reach a b) (ha : fout a = 0) : fout b = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`: the zero propagates along a walk of `G`** — the one-step lemma iterated along `Relation.ReflTransGen`.

decls.name: loop_closure_necessary
decls.statement: theorem loop_closure_necessary (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hcb : B.CutBalance pf fout) : fout = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`** (`proofs.tex:1091–1093`): *on `G` itself, i.e.

files.title: Freezing the backward policy does not restore stability of the detailed-balance loss either

decls.name: IsEdgeflow
decls.statement: def IsEdgeflow (G : MarkedGraph V) (F : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **An edgeflow of the loop closure `Ĝ`** (`brunswic2024theory` §2: "an assignment `F` of a non-negative value on each edge"): `F ≥ 0`, and `F = 0` off the edges of `Ĝ`.

decls.name: IsFlow
decls.statement: def IsFlow (G : MarkedGraph V) (F : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **A flow**, Definition 1 of `brunswic2024theory` transported to `Ĝ`: an edgeflow satisfying flow matching, which on the loop closure is conservation at every vertex.

decls.name: IsZeroFlow
decls.statement: def IsZeroFlow (G : MarkedGraph V) (F₀ : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **A `0`-flow**, Definition 2 of `brunswic2024theory`: a flow satisfying the reward constraint for the null reward, i.e.

decls.name: Stable
decls.statement: def Stable (G : MarkedGraph V) (L : (V → V → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`eq:def_stability`** (`cv_divergence.tex:183–185`), Definition 3 of `brunswic2024theory` at `p = 1`: a loss `𝓛` on edgeflows is *stable* when `𝓛(F + F₀) ≥ 𝓛(F)` for every flow `F` and every `0`-flow `F₀` that is a subflow of `F` (`F₀ ≤ F` edgewise).

decls.name: not_stable_of_witness
decls.statement: theorem not_stable_of_witness {G : MarkedGraph V} {L : (V → V → ℝ) → ℝ} {F F₀ : V → V → ℝ} (hF : IsFlow G F) (hF₀ : IsZeroFlow G F₀) (hsub : ∀ u v, F₀ u v ≤ F u v) (hlt : L (F + F₀) < L F) : ¬ Stable G L
decls.doc: A single flow strictly improved by adding a `0`-subflow refutes `eq:def_stability`.

decls.name: edgeFlow_one_eq_edgeMeasure
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_one_eq_edgeMeasure (lam : V → ℝ) : B.edgeFlow lam 1 = Balance.edgeMeasure B.phat lam
decls.doc: **`F* = λ₂`**: the balanced edgeflow `F*(u→v) = λ(v) π̂_←(v→u)` of `Graph.Universality` is the edge measure `λ₂(u,v) = π̂_←(v→u) λ(v)` of `Balance.Lift`.

decls.name: phat_pos_of_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem phat_pos_of_hatEdge (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {u v : V} (he : G.hatEdge u v) : 0 < B.phat v u
decls.doc: `π̂_←(v → u) > 0` on every edge `u → v` of `Ĝ`.

decls.name: phat_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem phat_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge {u v : V} (he : ¬ G.hatEdge u v) : B.phat v u = 0
decls.doc: `π̂_←(v → u) = 0` off the edges of `Ĝ`.

decls.name: edgeFlow_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) {u v : V} (he : ¬ G.hatEdge u v) : B.edgeFlow lam c u v = 0
decls.doc: `F* = 0` off the edges of `Ĝ`.

decls.name: circ_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem circ_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge {lam : V → ℝ} (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) {u v : V} (he : ¬ G.hatEdge u v) : γ.circ u v = 0
decls.doc: An admissible `ε > 0` forces `1_γ = 0` off the edges of `Ĝ`: there `2ε1_γ ≤ F* = 0`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem perturbedFlow_eq_zero_of_not_hatEdge {lam : V → ℝ} (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) {u v : V} (he : ¬ G.hatEdge u v) : B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ u v = 0
decls.doc: **`F = F* − ε1_γ` vanishes off the edges of `Ĝ`.**

decls.name: perturbedFlow_pos_of_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem perturbedFlow_pos_of_hatEdge (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {eps : ℝ} {c : V → V → ℝ} (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps c) {u v : V} (he : G.hatEdge u v) : 0 < B.perturbedFlow lam eps c u v
decls.doc: **`F = F* − ε1_γ` is positive on every edge of `Ĝ`**: `2ε1_γ ≤ F*` gives `F ≥ F*/2 > 0`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow_isEdgeflow
decls.statement: theorem perturbedFlow_isEdgeflow {lam : V → ℝ} (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : IsEdgeflow G (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*** (`proofs.tex:695`): "`F` is a flow".

decls.name: invariant_edgeInflow_of_pushEdge_eq
decls.statement: theorem invariant_edgeInflow_of_pushEdge_eq {F : V → V → ℝ} (hcirc : IsCirculation F) (heq : Balance.pushEdge B.phat F = F) : ∀ y, ∑ x, edgeInflow F x * B.phat x y = edgeInflow F y
decls.doc: **"Summing over `v` at each `u`"** (`proofs.tex:701`): if a circulation `F` is in edge-level balance, `F K₂ = F`, then its inflow is `π̂_←`-invariant.

decls.name: pushEdge_perturbedFlow_ne
decls.statement: theorem pushEdge_perturbedFlow_ne (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : Balance.pushEdge B.phat (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ) ≠ B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ
decls.doc: **Edge-level balance fails at `F`** (`proofs.tex:701`): `F K₂ ≠ F`, since otherwise `μ_F π̂_← = μ_F`, contradicting `not_invariant_perturbedFlow`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow_isFlow
decls.statement: theorem perturbedFlow_isFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : IsFlow G (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*** (`proofs.tex:695`): "`F` is a flow", in the sense of Definition 1 — an edgeflow of `Ĝ` that is conserved at every vertex.

decls.name: epsCirc_isZeroFlow
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_isZeroFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : IsZeroFlow G (epsCirc eps γ.circ)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*** (`proofs.tex:695`): "`F₀` is a `0`-subflow", in the sense of Definition 2 — a flow with zero inflow at `s_f`, because `γ` avoids `s_f`.

decls.name: edgeMeasure_pos_iff_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem edgeMeasure_pos_iff_hatEdge (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (u v : V) : 0 < Balance.edgeMeasure B.phat lam u v ↔ G.hatEdge u v
decls.doc: **`λ₂` is positive exactly on the edges of `Ĝ`**: `λ₂(u,v) = π̂_←(v→u) λ(v)` with `λ > 0`.

decls.name: dbLoss
decls.statement: noncomputable def dbLoss (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nuHat F : V → V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the DB loss with frozen backward policy, read on edgeflows** (`proofs.tex:701`, through `prop:db_lift`, `proofs.tex:524–531`): `𝓛_{DB,g,ν̂}(F) = ∫ g(d(FK₂)/dF) dν̂ = ∑_{u,v} ν̂(u,v) g((FK₂)(u,v) / F(u,v))`, with `K₂` the edge lift of `π̂_←`.

decls.name: dbLoss_eq_edgeRatio
decls.statement: theorem dbLoss_eq_edgeRatio {F : V → V → ℝ} (hF : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ F u v) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nuHat : V → V → ℝ) : B.dbLoss g nuHat F = ∑ u, ∑ v, nuHat u v * g (Balance.marg₁ F v * B.phat v u / (Balance.marg₁ F u * Balance.disint F u v))
decls.doc: **`prop:db_lift`, read here**: for a non-negative edgeflow the DB loss is the `g`-divergence of the detailed-balance edge ratio `F(v) π̂_←(v→u) / (F(u) π_→^F(u→v))`, with `F(·)` the first marginal and `π_→^F` the disintegration.

decls.name: dbLoss_sub_eq_of_support
decls.statement: theorem dbLoss_sub_eq_of_support {g : ℝ → ℝ} {nuHat nuHat' F F' : V → V → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ u v, G.hatEdge u v → nuHat' u v = nuHat u v) (hF : ∀ u v, ¬ G.hatEdge u v → F u v = 0) (hF' : ∀ u v, ¬ G.hatEdge u v → F' u v = 0) : B.dbLoss g nuHat F' - B.dbLoss g nuHat F = B.dbLoss g nuHat' F' - B.dbLoss g nuHat' F
decls.doc: **Between two edgeflows of `Ĝ`, the DB loss difference sees `ν̂` only on the edges.** Off the edges both ratios are `0/0 = 0`, so the terms `ν̂(u,v) g(0)` cancel; any `ν̂'` agreeing with `ν̂` on the edges gives the same difference.

decls.name: dbLoss_eq_zero_of
decls.statement: theorem dbLoss_eq_zero_of {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) {nuHat F : V → V → ℝ} (hnu0 : ∀ u v, ¬ G.hatEdge u v → nuHat u v = 0) (hr : ∀ u v, G.hatEdge u v → Balance.pushEdge B.phat F u v / F u v = 1) : B.dbLoss g nuHat F = 0
decls.doc: **The DB loss vanishes at edge-level balance**: ratio `1` on every edge of `Ĝ`, `ν̂ = 0` off them, and `g(1) = 0`.

decls.name: dbLoss_pos_of
decls.statement: theorem dbLoss_pos_of {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nuHat F : V → V → ℝ} (hnupos : ∀ u v, G.hatEdge u v → 0 < nuHat u v) (hnu0 : ∀ u v, ¬ G.hatEdge u v → nuHat u v = 0) (hrpos : ∀ u v, G.hatEdge u v → 0 < Balance.pushEdge B.phat F u v / F u v) {u₀ v₀ : V} (he₀ : G.hatEdge u₀ v₀) (hne : Balance.pushEdge B.phat F u₀ v₀ / F u₀ v₀ ≠ 1) : 0 < B.dbLoss g nuHat F
decls.doc: **The DB loss is positive at one unbalanced edge**: `ν̂ > 0` on the edges of `Ĝ` and `0` off them, positive ratios on the edges, and one edge whose ratio is not `1`; `g > 0` off `1` does the rest.

decls.name: dbRatio_edgeFlow_eq_one
decls.statement: theorem dbRatio_edgeFlow_eq_one (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {u v : V} (he : G.hatEdge u v) : Balance.pushEdge B.phat (B.edgeFlow lam 1) u v / B.edgeFlow lam 1 u v = 1
decls.doc: **At `F + F₀ = F*` the DB ratio is `1` on every edge of `Ĝ`** (`proofs.tex:701`, "this holds by construction"): `F* = λ₂` is `K₂`-invariant (`Balance.pushEdge_edgeMeasure_graph`) and `F* > 0` on the edges.

decls.name: dbRatio_perturbedFlow_pos
decls.statement: theorem dbRatio_perturbedFlow_pos (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) {u v : V} (he : G.hatEdge u v) : 0 < Balance.pushEdge B.phat (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ) u v / B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ u v
decls.doc: **At `F` the DB ratio is positive on every edge of `Ĝ`** — what `g > 0` on `ℝ_{>0}` needs: `π̂_←(v→u) > 0`, the outflow of `F` at `v` equals its inflow, which is `≥ λ(v)/2 > 0`, and `F(u→v) > 0`.

decls.name: frozen_unstable_full_db
decls.statement: theorem frozen_unstable_full_db (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nuHat : V → V → ℝ} (hnupos : ∀ u v, G.hatEdge u v → 0 < nuHat u v) (hnu0 : ∀ u v, ¬ G.hatEdge u v → nuHat u v = 0) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : (∀ u v, 0 ≤ epsCirc eps γ.circ u v) ∧ (∀ u v, epsCirc eps γ.circ u v ≤ B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ u v) ∧ B.dbLoss g nuHat (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ + epsCirc eps γ.circ) = 0 ∧ 0 < B.dbLoss g nuHat (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the DB half** (statement `proofs.tex:680–690`, *The DB case* `proofs.tex:701`), in the four-part form of `frozen_unstable_full_fm`.

decls.name: frozen_not_stable_fm
decls.statement: theorem frozen_not_stable_fm (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) (hsupp : ∀ u v, γ.circ u v ≠ 0 → G.hatEdge u v) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nu : V → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) : ¬ Stable G (fun F => B.fmLoss g nu (edgeInflow F))
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the FM loss is unstable in the sense of `eq:def_stability`** (`proofs.tex:689`).

decls.name: frozen_not_stable_db
decls.statement: theorem frozen_not_stable_db (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) (hsupp : ∀ u v, γ.circ u v ≠ 0 → G.hatEdge u v) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nuHat : V → V → ℝ} (hnupos : ∀ u v, G.hatEdge u v → 0 < nuHat u v) : ¬ Stable G (B.dbLoss g nuHat)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the DB loss is unstable in the sense of `eq:def_stability`** (`proofs.tex:689`, and "the same pair `(F, F₀)` therefore witnesses DB instability", `proofs.tex:701`).

decls.name: sigmaStar

decls.name: nrmL2

decls.name: meanL2
