decls.statement: theorem sum_sq_div_eq_one_add_chiSq {X : Type*} [Fintype X] {q p : X → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 < p x) (hq1 : ∑ x, q x = 1) (hp1 : ∑ x, p x = 1) : ∑ x, q x ^ 2 / p x = 1 + chiSq q p
decls.doc: `∑_x q(x)²/p(x) = 1 + χ²(q‖p)`, the identity the factor `1 + χ²` of `eq:silva_bound` stands for.

decls.name: wSupport
decls.statement: noncomputable def wSupport {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pB : X → T → ℝ) : Finset (X × T)
decls.doc: The pairs `(x,τ)` over which `w_min` is a minimum: those with `p_B(τ|x) > 0`.

decls.name: wMin
decls.statement: noncomputable def wMin {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`w_min := min{ p_{E,T}(x) p_B(τ|x) : p_B(τ|x) > 0 }`** of `prop:silva_no_uniform`.

decls.name: wMin_le
decls.statement: theorem wMin_le {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) {x : X} {t : T} (ht : 0 < pB x t) : wMin pET pB h ≤ pET x * pB x t

decls.name: wMin_pos
decls.statement: theorem wMin_pos {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hET : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) : 0 < wMin pET pB h

files.title: The Silva et al. total-variation bound, with the constant written out

decls.name: sq_sub_weighted_le
decls.statement: theorem sq_sub_weighted_le {T : Type*} [Fintype T] {w f : T → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hw : ∀ τ, 0 ≤ w τ) (hw1 : ∑ τ, w τ = 1) : (c - ∑ τ, w τ * f τ) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ τ, w τ * (c - f τ) ^ 2
decls.doc: For a probability weight `w` on a finite set, `(c − ∑ w f)² ≤ ∑ w (c − f)²`.

decls.name: logLipschitz
decls.statement: theorem logLipschitz {a b C : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (haC : a ≤ C) (hbC : b ≤ C) : |a - b| ≤ C * |Real.log a - Real.log b|
decls.doc: `|a − b| ≤ C |log a − log b|` for `0 < a ≤ C` and `0 < b ≤ C`.

decls.name: sq_sub_le_sq_mul_log_sq
decls.statement: theorem sq_sub_le_sq_mul_log_sq {a b C : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (haC : a ≤ C) (hbC : b ≤ C) : (a - b) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * Real.log (a / b) ^ 2
decls.doc: The squared form used in the proof: `(a − b)² ≤ C² (log(a/b))²` for `0 < a ≤ C`, `0 < b ≤ C`.

decls.name: tv_le_sqrt_residual
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_sqrt_residual {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET π pT : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {M Pinf : ℝ} (hET_pos : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hET_sum : ∑ x, pET x = 1) (hπ_pos : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hB_nonneg : ∀ x τ, 0 ≤ pB x τ) (hB_sum : ∀ x, ∑ τ, pB x τ = 1) (hF_pos : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → 0 < pF τ) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ τ, pB x τ * (pF τ / pB x τ)) (hM : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → pF τ / pB x τ ≤ M) (hPinf : ∀ x, π x ≤ Pinf) : tv pT π ≤ (Fintype.card X : ℝ) / 2 * max M Pinf * Real.sqrt ((1 + chiSq (unif X) pET) * residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_explicit`** (`silva_comparison.tex:29–39`), with `M` and `‖π‖_∞` presented as upper bounds: if `p_{E,T}` and `π` have full support, `p_B(·|x)` is a probability law dominating the forward trajectories into `x` (`hdom`), `p_F` is positive on the support of `p_B`, and `p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x) ≤ M`, `π ≤ Pinf`, then `TV(p_T, π) ≤ (|𝒳|/2) · max(M, Pinf) · sqrt((1 + χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T})) · 𝓔(p_F))`.

decls.name: tv_le_sqrt_residual_max
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_sqrt_residual_max {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET π pT : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} (hX : (Finset.univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hsupp : ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × T)).filter fun p => 0 < pB p.1 p.2).Nonempty) (hET_pos : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hET_sum : ∑ x, pET x = 1) (hπ_pos : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hB_nonneg : ∀ x τ, 0 ≤ pB x τ) (hB_sum : ∀ x, ∑ τ, pB x τ = 1) (hF_pos : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → 0 < pF τ) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ τ, pB x τ * (pF τ / pB x τ)) : tv pT π ≤ (Fintype.card X : ℝ) / 2 * max (((Finset.univ : Finset (X × T)).filter fun p => 0 < pB p.1 p.2).sup' hsupp fun p => pF p.2 / pB p.1 p.2) ((Finset.univ : Finset X).sup' hX π) * Real.sqrt ((1 + chiSq (unif X) pET) * residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_explicit` with the paper's own constants**: `M` is the maximum of `p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x)` over the support of `p_B`, and `‖π‖_∞` the maximum of `π`.

files.title: The state-space dependence of the Silva bound is unavoidable

decls.name: abs_exp_sub_one_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_exp_sub_one_le {u s : ℝ} (h : |u| ≤ s) : |Real.exp u - 1| ≤ Real.exp s - 1
decls.doc: If `|u| ≤ s` then `|e^u − 1| ≤ e^s − 1`: the upper half is monotonicity of `exp`, the lower half is `1 − e^{−s} ≤ s ≤ e^s − 1`.

decls.name: tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {π pT : X → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hπ : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hπ1 : ∑ x, π x = 1) (hET : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pET x) (hB : ∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (hF : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) (hw : 0 < w) (hwle : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → w ≤ pET x * pB x t) : tv pT π ≤ 2⁻¹ * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt (residual pET π pB pF / w)) - 1)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`(i)**, in the form its proof uses: with `w` any positive lower bound for `p_{E,T}(x) p_B(τ|x)` on the support of `p_B`, `TV(p_T,π) ≤ ½ (e^{√(𝓔(p_F)/w)} − 1)`.

decls.name: tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy_wmin
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy_wmin {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {π pT : X → ℝ} (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hπ : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hπ1 : ∑ x, π x = 1) (hET : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hB : ∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (hF : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) : tv pT π ≤ 2⁻¹ * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt (residual pET π pB pF / wMin pET pB h)) - 1)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`(i)** with the paper's own constant `w_min`.

decls.name: deltaPB
decls.statement: def deltaPB (X : Type*) [DecidableEq X] : X → X → ℝ
decls.doc: The backward kernel of a graph in which each terminal `x` has one incoming trajectory, identified with `x` itself: `p_B(τ|x) = 1` for `τ = x` and `0` otherwise.

decls.name: deltaPB_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem deltaPB_nonneg (x t : X) : 0 ≤ deltaPB X x t

decls.name: deltaPB_pos_iff
decls.statement: theorem deltaPB_pos_iff {x t : X} : 0 < deltaPB X x t ↔ t = x

decls.name: deltaPB_sum
decls.statement: theorem deltaPB_sum (x : X) : ∑ t, deltaPB X x t = 1

decls.name: hdom_deltaPB
decls.statement: theorem hdom_deltaPB (pF : X → ℝ) (x : X) : pF x = ∑ t, deltaPB X x t * (pF t / deltaPB X x t)
decls.doc: The domination identity holds for the one-parent kernel, with `p_T = p_F`.

decls.name: energy_deltaPB
decls.statement: theorem energy_deltaPB (pET pF π : X → ℝ) : residual pET π (deltaPB X) pF = ∑ x, pET x * Real.log (pF x / π x) ^ 2
decls.doc: `𝓔(p_F)` for the one-parent kernel: one term per terminal state.

decls.name: Star
decls.statement: abbrev Star (K : ℕ)
decls.doc: The terminal states of the star DAG: `x* = inl false`, `x' = inl true`, and the `K` filler states `b₁,…,b_K = inr i`.

decls.name: starPi
decls.statement: noncomputable def starPi (K : ℕ) : Star K → ℝ
decls.doc: The target `π` of the star witness: `π(x*) = π(x') = ¼`, `π(bᵢ) = 1/(2K)`.

decls.name: starPF
decls.statement: noncomputable def starPF (K : ℕ) : Star K → ℝ
decls.doc: The forward policy of the star witness: `p_F(s_o→x*) = ⅜`, `p_F(s_o→x') = ⅛`, `p_F(s_o→bᵢ) = 1/(2K)`.

decls.name: starPET
decls.statement: noncomputable def starPET (K : ℕ) : Star K → ℝ
decls.doc: The uniform training distribution on the `K+2` terminals.

decls.name: card_star
decls.statement: theorem card_star (K : ℕ) : (Fintype.card (Star K) : ℝ) = (K : ℝ) + 2

decls.name: starPET_pos
decls.statement: theorem starPET_pos (K : ℕ) (x : Star K) : 0 < starPET K x

decls.name: starPET_sum
decls.statement: theorem starPET_sum (K : ℕ) : ∑ x, starPET K x = 1

decls.name: star_chiSq
decls.statement: theorem star_chiSq (K : ℕ) : chiSq (unif (Star K)) (starPET K) = 0
decls.doc: `χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T}) = 0`: the training distribution *is* the uniform one.

decls.name: star_tv
decls.statement: theorem star_tv (K : ℕ) : tv (starPF K) (starPi K) = 1 / 8
decls.doc: **`TV(p_T,π) = ⅛`** for the star witness, for every `K`.

decls.name: starK_pos
decls.statement: theorem starK_pos : (0 : ℝ) < K

decls.name: starK_one
decls.statement: theorem starK_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K

decls.name: starPi_pos
decls.statement: theorem starPi_pos (x : Star K) : 0 < starPi K x

decls.name: starPF_pos
decls.statement: theorem starPF_pos (x : Star K) : 0 < starPF K x

decls.name: starPi_sum
decls.statement: theorem starPi_sum : ∑ x, starPi K x = 1

decls.name: starPF_sum
decls.statement: theorem starPF_sum : ∑ x, starPF K x = 1

decls.name: star_Mprime
decls.statement: theorem star_Mprime : MprimeLe (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) (starPi K) 1
decls.doc: **`M' ≤ 1`** for the star witness.

decls.name: star_energy
decls.statement: theorem star_energy : residual (starPET K) (starPi K) (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) = ((Real.log (3 / 2)) ^ 2 + (Real.log 2) ^ 2) / ((K : ℝ) + 2)
decls.doc: **`𝓔(p_F) = ((log 3/2)² + (log 2)²)/(K+2)`** for the star witness: the log-ratios vanish on the `bᵢ`.

decls.name: log_sq_sum_le_one
decls.statement: theorem log_sq_sum_le_one : (Real.log (3 / 2)) ^ 2 + (Real.log 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1
decls.doc: `(log 3/2)² + (log 2)² ≤ 1`: `log(3/2) ≤ 1/2` because `log x ≤ x − 1`, and `log 2 < 0.6931471808` by `Real.log_two_lt_d9`; the sum of squares is at most `0.7305`.

decls.name: exists_star_witness
decls.statement: theorem exists_star_witness {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∀ x, 0 < starPi K x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 < starPF K x) ∧ (∑ x, starPi K x = 1) ∧ (∑ x, starPF K x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 0 < starPET K x) ∧ (∑ x, starPET K x = 1) ∧ chiSq (unif (Star K)) (starPET K) = 0 ∧ MprimeLe (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) (starPi K) 1 ∧ 0 < residual (starPET K) (starPi K) (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) ∧ residual (starPET K) (starPi K) (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) ≤ ε ∧ tv (starPF K) (starPi K) = 1 / 8
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`(ii)**: for every `ε > 0` the star witness with `K` large has `χ² = 0`, `M' ≤ 1`, `𝓔(p_F) ≤ ε` and `TV(p_T,π) = ⅛`.

decls.name: no_state_space_free_bound
decls.statement: theorem no_state_space_free_bound : ¬ ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto F (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ (X T : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π pT : X → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 < π x) → (∑ x, π x = 1) → (∀ x, 0 < pET x) → (∑ x, pET x = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) → (∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) → (∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) → chiSq (unif X) pET = 0 → MprimeLe pB pF π 1 → tv pT π ≤ F (residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`, the "in particular"**: no function of the residual alone, vanishing as the residual vanishes, bounds the total variation over all finite instances with `χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T}) = 0` and `M' ≤ 1`.

decls.name: no_three_argument_bound
decls.statement: theorem no_three_argument_bound : ¬ ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto (fun e => F e 0 1) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ (X T : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π pT : X → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, 0 < π x) → (∑ x, π x = 1) → (∀ x, 0 < pET x) → (∑ x, pET x = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) → (∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) → (∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) → MprimeLe pB pF π c → tv pT π ≤ F (residual pET π pB pF) (chiSq (unif X) pET) c
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`, the "in particular" in the paper's three-argument form**: no `F(𝓔, χ², M')` with `F(·,0,1) → 0` bounds `TV`, when `F`'s third slot may be fed any bound on `M'`.

files.title: The hypotheses, the constant and the path space of the Silva bound: three remarks of Appendix B
variables: variable {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq X]

decls.name: mVal
decls.statement: noncomputable def mVal (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) : ℝ
decls.doc: `M := max{ p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x) : p_B(τ|x) > 0 }` of `silva_comparison.tex:32`, as a value.

decls.name: piInf
decls.statement: noncomputable def piInf (π : X → ℝ) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) : ℝ
decls.doc: `‖π‖_∞ = max_x π(x)`, as a value.

decls.name: mPrime
decls.statement: noncomputable def mPrime (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) : ℝ
decls.doc: `M' := max(M, ‖π‖_∞)` of `silva_comparison.tex:32`, as a value.

decls.name: mem_wSupport
decls.statement: theorem mem_wSupport {pB : X → T → ℝ} {x : X} {t : T} (ht : 0 < pB x t) : (x, t) ∈ wSupport pB

decls.name: ratio_le_mVal
decls.statement: theorem ratio_le_mVal {pB : X → T → ℝ} (pF : T → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) {x : X} {t : T} (ht : 0 < pB x t) : pF t / pB x t ≤ mVal pB pF hs

decls.name: mVal_le_mPrime
decls.statement: theorem mVal_le_mPrime (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) : mVal pB pF hs ≤ mPrime pB pF π hs hX

decls.name: mPrime_le_iff
decls.statement: theorem mPrime_le_iff (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (c : ℝ) : mPrime pB pF π hs hX ≤ c ↔ MprimeLe pB pF π c
decls.doc: The value `M'` and the library's `MprimeLe` agree: `M' ≤ c ↔ MprimeLe pB pF π c`.

decls.name: chiSqE
decls.statement: noncomputable def chiSqE (q p : X → ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: `χ²(q‖p)` in `[0,∞]`: a state with `p = 0 < q` contributes `+∞`, a state with `p = q = 0` contributes `0`.

decls.name: chiSqE_eq_ofReal
decls.statement: theorem chiSqE_eq_ofReal {q p : X → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 < p x) : chiSqE q p = ENNReal.ofReal (chiSq q p)
decls.doc: On full support `chiSqE` is the library's real `chiSq`.

decls.name: chiSqE_unif_eq_top
decls.statement: theorem chiSqE_unif_eq_top {pET : X → ℝ} {x₀ : X} (h0 : pET x₀ = 0) : chiSqE (unif X) pET = ⊤
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(1)**: off full support of `p_{E,T}`, `χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T}) = +∞`.

decls.name: logSqE
decls.statement: noncomputable def logSqE (a b : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: `log(a/b)²` in `[0,∞]`, with `log 0 = −∞` and `log(+∞) = +∞`: it is `+∞` as soon as `a = 0` or `b = 0`.

decls.name: residualE
decls.statement: noncomputable def residualE (pET π : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: The residual `𝓔(p_F)` of `silva_comparison.tex:24–26` in `[0,∞]`.

decls.name: residualE_eq_ofReal
decls.statement: theorem residualE_eq_ofReal {pET π : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} (hET : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pET x) (hπ : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hB : ∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) (hF : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) : residualE pET π pB pF = ENNReal.ofReal (residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: On the setting of `prop:silva_explicit` (`π > 0`, `p_F > 0` on the support of `p_B`), `residualE` is the library's real `residual`.

decls.name: residualE_eq_top_of_pF_zero
decls.statement: theorem residualE_eq_top_of_pF_zero {pET π : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {x₀ : X} {t₀ : T} (hET : 0 < pET x₀) (hB : 0 < pB x₀ t₀) (hF0 : pF t₀ = 0) : residualE pET π pB pF = ⊤
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(2)**: if `p_F(τ) = 0` for a trajectory `τ` into `x` with `p_{E,T}(x) > 0` and `p_B(τ|x) > 0`, then `𝓔(p_F) = +∞`.

decls.name: rhsE
decls.statement: noncomputable def rhsE (c : ℝ) (chi E : ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: The right side `c · [(1 + χ²) 𝓔]^{1/2}` of `prop:silva_explicit` in `[0,∞]`, with `c = (|𝒳|/2) M'` the (finite, nonnegative) prefactor.

decls.name: rhsE_ofReal
decls.statement: theorem rhsE_ofReal {c chi E : ℝ} (hchi : 0 ≤ chi) (hE : 0 ≤ E) : rhsE c (ENNReal.ofReal chi) (ENNReal.ofReal E) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * Real.sqrt ((1 + chi) * E))
decls.doc: On finite values `rhsE` is the real right side of `prop:silva_explicit`.

decls.name: tv_le_rhsE
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_rhsE {pET π pT : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {M Pinf : ℝ} (hET_pos : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hET_sum : ∑ x, pET x = 1) (hπ_pos : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hB_nonneg : ∀ x τ, 0 ≤ pB x τ) (hB_sum : ∀ x, ∑ τ, pB x τ = 1) (hF_pos : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → 0 < pF τ) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ τ, pB x τ * (pF τ / pB x τ)) (hM : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → pF τ / pB x τ ≤ M) (hPinf : ∀ x, π x ≤ Pinf) : ENNReal.ofReal (tv pT π) ≤ rhsE ((Fintype.card X : ℝ) / 2 * max M Pinf) (chiSqE (unif X) pET) (residualE pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_explicit` read in `[0,∞]`**: under the proposition's hypotheses the extended-real bound holds, with `chiSqE` and `residualE`.

decls.name: rhsE_eq_top_of_not_full_support
decls.statement: theorem rhsE_eq_top_of_not_full_support {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {pET : X → ℝ} {x₀ : X} (h0 : pET x₀ = 0) {E : ℝ≥0∞} (hE : E ≠ 0) : rhsE c (chiSqE (unif X) pET) E = ⊤
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(1), the right side**: off full support of `p_{E,T}` and with `𝓔(p_F) ≠ 0`, the right side of `prop:silva_explicit` is `+∞` (for a positive prefactor).

decls.name: one_add_chiSqE_eq_top
decls.statement: theorem one_add_chiSqE_eq_top {pET : X → ℝ} {x₀ : X} (h0 : pET x₀ = 0) : 1 + chiSqE (unif X) pET = ⊤
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(1), the case `𝓔(p_F) = 0`**: the product under the root is `(1 + χ²)·𝓔` with `1 + χ² = +∞` and `𝓔 = 0` — the paper's `∞·0`.

decls.name: rhsE_eq_top_of_residual_top
decls.statement: theorem rhsE_eq_top_of_residual_top {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (chi : ℝ≥0∞) : rhsE c chi ⊤ = ⊤
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(2), "the bound holds but carries no information"**: when `𝓔(p_F) = +∞` the right side of `prop:silva_explicit` is `+∞` (for a positive prefactor), so the bound holds for every `p_T` and says nothing.

decls.name: tv_le_rhsE_of_pF_zero
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_rhsE_of_pF_zero {pET π pT : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {x₀ : X} {t₀ : T} (hET : 0 < pET x₀) (hB : 0 < pB x₀ t₀) (hF0 : pF t₀ = 0) : rhsE c (chiSqE (unif X) pET) (residualE pET π pB pF) = ⊤ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (tv pT π) ≤ rhsE c (chiSqE (unif X) pET) (residualE pET π pB pF)

decls.name: termMarginal
decls.statement: noncomputable def termMarginal (into : T → X) (pF : T → ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ
decls.doc: The terminal marginal `p_T(x) = ∑_{τ into x} p_F(τ)` of a trajectory weight `p_F`, where `into τ` is the terminal state of `τ`.

decls.name: identity_iff_domination
decls.statement: theorem identity_iff_domination (into : T → X) {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} (hF : ∀ t, 0 ≤ pF t) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (x : X) : termMarginal into pF x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t) ↔ ∀ t, into t = x → pB x t = 0 → pF t = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(3)**: for a backward policy `p_B(·|x)` living on the trajectories into `x`, the identity `p_T(x) = 𝔼_{p_B(·|x)}[p_F/p_B]` holds **if and only if** `p_B(·|x)` dominates the forward trajectories into `x` (`p_B(τ|x) = 0 ⇒ p_F(τ) = 0`).

decls.name: uniformBackProb
decls.statement: noncomputable def uniformBackProb {S : Type*} (parents : S → Finset S) : List S → ℝ
decls.doc: The probability that the **uniform backward policy** retraces the path `s₀ → s₁ → ⋯ → s_n` from its last state: the product over its steps of `1/#parents(s_{i+1})`.

decls.name: uniformBackProb_pos
decls.statement: theorem uniformBackProb_pos {S : Type*} (parents : S → Finset S) : ∀ l : List S, l.IsChain (fun a b => a ∈ parents b) → 0 < uniformBackProb parents l | [], _ => by simp only [uniformBackProb]; norm_num | [_], _ => by simp only [uniformBackProb]; norm_num | a :: b :: l, h => by rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h have hc : (0 : ℝ) < ((parents b).card : ℝ)
decls.doc: Along a path of the graph (each state a parent of the next) the uniform backward policy charges the path.

decls.name: identity_of_uniformBackward
decls.statement: theorem identity_of_uniformBackward {S : Type*} (parents : S → Finset S) (into : T → X) (path : T → List S) (hpath : ∀ t, (path t).IsChain (fun a b => a ∈ parents b)) {pF : T → ℝ} (hF : ∀ t, 0 ≤ pF t) (x : X) : termMarginal into pF x = ∑ t, (if into t = x then uniformBackProb parents (path t) else 0) * (pF t / if into t = x then uniformBackProb parents (path t) else 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(3), "automatic for the uniform `p_B`"**: the backward policy that charges each trajectory into `x` with its uniform retracing probability dominates every forward trajectory weight, so the identity holds for every nonnegative `p_F`.

decls.name: identity_fails_without_domination
decls.statement: theorem identity_fails_without_domination : ∃ (pB : Unit → Bool → ℝ) (pF : Bool → ℝ), (∀ t, 0 ≤ pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ pB () t) ∧ ∑ t, pB () t = 1 ∧ termMarginal (fun _ => ()) pF () ≠ ∑ t, pB () t * (pF t / pB () t)
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(3), "an assumption under the extension to learnable `p_B`"**: a backward policy that is a probability but vanishes on a charged forward trajectory breaks the identity.

decls.name: star_mVal_lt_piInf
decls.statement: theorem star_mVal_lt_piInf {K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) {π : Fin K → ℝ} (hπ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hπ1 : ∑ x, π x = 1) {x₀ : Fin K} (hx₀ : π x₀ = 1 / 2) (hs : (wSupport (deltaPB (Fin K))).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset (Fin K)).Nonempty) : mVal (deltaPB (Fin K)) (fun _ => (K : ℝ)⁻¹) hs = (K : ℝ)⁻¹ ∧ piInf π hX = 1 / 2 ∧ mVal (deltaPB (Fin K)) (fun _ => (K : ℝ)⁻¹) hs < piInf π hX
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_hypotheses`(5)**: on a star `s_o` with `K ≥ 3` terminal children (`p_B(τ|x) = 1`, the one-parent kernel `deltaPB`), the uniform forward policy has `M = 1/K`, while a target with `π(x₀) = ½` at one child has `‖π‖_∞ = ½ > M`.

decls.name: inhabit_star
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_star : ∃ (π : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport (deltaPB (Fin 3))).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty), (∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) ∧ ∑ x, π x = 1 ∧ π 0 = 1 / 2 ∧ mVal (deltaPB (Fin 3)) (fun _ => ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) hs < piInf π hX
decls.doc: **Inhabitation of `star_mVal_lt_piInf`** (kb 0025): `K = 3` children, `π = (½, ¼, ¼)`, so `M = 1/3 < ½ = ‖π‖_∞`.

decls.name: le_one_of_sum_eq_one
decls.statement: theorem le_one_of_sum_eq_one {Y : Type*} [Fintype Y] {p : Y → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ p y) (h1 : ∑ y, p y = 1) (y : Y) : p y ≤ 1
decls.doc: A probability weight is at most `1` pointwise.

decls.name: mPrime_le_fixedGraph
decls.statement: theorem mPrime_le_fixedGraph (pB : X → T → ℝ) {pF : T → ℝ} {π : X → ℝ} (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hF1 : ∀ t, pF t ≤ 1) (hπ1 : ∀ x, π x ≤ 1) : mPrime pB pF π hs hX ≤ max 1 ((wSupport pB).sup' hs fun p => 1 / pB p.1 p.2)
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, the fixed-graph bound**: since `p_F(τ) ≤ 1` and `‖π‖_∞ ≤ 1`, every forward trajectory law has `M' ≤ max(1, max_{τ,x : p_B(τ|x) > 0} 1/p_B(τ|x))`.

decls.name: mPrime_le_fixedGraph_of_prob
decls.statement: theorem mPrime_le_fixedGraph_of_prob (pB : X → T → ℝ) {pF : T → ℝ} {π : X → ℝ} (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hF0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ pF t) (hF1 : ∑ t, pF t = 1) (hπ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hπ1 : ∑ x, π x = 1) : mPrime pB pF π hs hX ≤ max 1 ((wSupport pB).sup' hs fun p => 1 / pB p.1 p.2)
decls.doc: The fixed-graph bound for probability laws: `p_F` and `π` nonnegative and summing to `1`.

decls.name: tree_pB_eq_one
decls.statement: theorem tree_pB_eq_one {into : T → X} (hinj : Function.Injective into) {pB : X → T → ℝ} (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) {x : X} {t : T} (ht : 0 < pB x t) : pB x t = 1
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, on a tree `p_B(τ|x) = 1`**: when each terminal state has at most one trajectory (`into` injective) and `p_B(·|x)` is a probability on the trajectories into `x`, `p_B(τ|x) = 1` on its support.

decls.name: tree_mVal_le_one
decls.statement: theorem tree_mVal_le_one {into : T → X} (hinj : Function.Injective into) {pB : X → T → ℝ} (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) {pF : T → ℝ} (hF1 : ∀ t, pF t ≤ 1) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) : mVal pB pF hs ≤ 1
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, on a tree `M ≤ 1`**.

decls.name: LadderTraj
decls.statement: abbrev LadderTraj (n : ℕ)
decls.doc: The trajectories of the **ladder graph of depth `n`** into its only terminal state `x`: one of the two parallel edges at each of the `n` stages.

decls.name: ladderPB
decls.statement: noncomputable def ladderPB (n : ℕ) : Unit → LadderTraj n → ℝ
decls.doc: The uniform backward policy on the ladder: `½` at each of the `n` stages.

decls.name: ladderOne
decls.statement: noncomputable def ladderOne : Unit → ℝ
decls.doc: The constant `1` on the single terminal state: the ladder's `π(x)` and `p_{E,T}(x)`.

decls.name: ladderPB_eq
decls.statement: theorem ladderPB_eq (n : ℕ) (x : Unit) (t : LadderTraj n) : ladderPB n x t = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹

decls.name: card_ladderTraj
decls.statement: theorem card_ladderTraj (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (LadderTraj n) = 2 ^ n
decls.doc: `x` has `2ⁿ` incoming trajectories.

decls.name: ladderPB_pos
decls.statement: theorem ladderPB_pos (n : ℕ) (x : Unit) (t : LadderTraj n) : 0 < ladderPB n x t

decls.name: ladderPB_sum
decls.statement: theorem ladderPB_sum (n : ℕ) (x : Unit) : ∑ t, ladderPB n x t = 1
decls.doc: The uniform backward policy is a probability on the `2ⁿ` trajectories into `x`.

decls.name: ladder_wSupport_nonempty
decls.statement: theorem ladder_wSupport_nonempty (n : ℕ) : (wSupport (ladderPB n)).Nonempty

decls.name: unit_univ_nonempty
decls.statement: theorem unit_univ_nonempty : (univ : Finset Unit).Nonempty

decls.name: ladder_sup_inv_pB
decls.statement: theorem ladder_sup_inv_pB (n : ℕ) : (wSupport (ladderPB n)).sup' (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) (fun p => 1 / ladderPB n p.1 p.2) = 2 ^ n
decls.doc: `max_{τ,x} 1/p_B(τ|x) = 2ⁿ` on the ladder.

decls.name: ladder_mPrime_le
decls.statement: theorem ladder_mPrime_le (n : ℕ) {pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ} (hF0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ pF t) (hF1 : ∑ t, pF t = 1) : mPrime (ladderPB n) pF ladderOne (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) unit_univ_nonempty ≤ 2 ^ n
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, the ladder: `M' ≤ 2ⁿ`** for every forward trajectory law, as the instance of the fixed-graph bound.

decls.name: ladder_balanced
decls.statement: theorem ladder_balanced (n : ℕ) : mVal (ladderPB n) (fun t => ladderOne () * ladderPB n () t) (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) = 1 ∧ piInf ladderOne unit_univ_nonempty = 1
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, the balanced solution**: `p_F(τ) = π(x) p_B(τ|x)` has `M = ‖π‖_∞ = 1`.

decls.name: ladder_mVal_ge
decls.statement: theorem ladder_mVal_ge {n : ℕ} (pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ) (t₀ : LadderTraj n) : pF t₀ * 2 ^ n ≤ mVal (ladderPB n) pF (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n)
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`: mass `c` on one trajectory gives `M ≥ c 2ⁿ`**.

decls.name: ladder_residual_eq
decls.statement: theorem ladder_residual_eq (n : ℕ) (pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ) : residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) pF = ∑ t, ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * Real.log (pF t * 2 ^ n) ^ 2
decls.doc: The residual on the ladder: one term per trajectory, `2⁻ⁿ (log(p_F(τ) 2ⁿ))²`.

decls.name: ladder_term_eq
decls.statement: theorem ladder_term_eq {n : ℕ} (pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ) (t₀ : LadderTraj n) : ladderOne () * (ladderPB n () t₀ * logRatio ladderOne (ladderPB n) pF () t₀ ^ 2) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * Real.log (pF t₀ * 2 ^ n) ^ 2
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`: the term of `𝓔` on the concentrated trajectory**, `p_{E,T}(x) p_B(τ₀|x) (log(p_F(τ₀)/(π(x)p_B(τ₀|x))))² = 2⁻ⁿ (log(c 2ⁿ))²` for `p_F(τ₀) = c`.

decls.name: tendsto_ladder_term
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_ladder_term {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * Real.log (c * 2 ^ n) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`: `2⁻ⁿ (log(c 2ⁿ))² → 0`** as `n → ∞`, for every `c > 0`.

decls.name: ladderT0
decls.statement: def ladderT0 (n : ℕ) : LadderTraj n
decls.doc: The trajectory `τ₀` on which the mass is concentrated.

decls.name: ladderPFc
decls.statement: noncomputable def ladderPFc (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : LadderTraj n → ℝ
decls.doc: **The trajectory law of `rem:silva_model_constant`**: mass `c` on `τ₀` and the remaining mass `1 − c` spread uniformly over the other `2ⁿ − 1` trajectories.

decls.name: two_pow_sub_one_pos
decls.statement: theorem two_pow_sub_one_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1

decls.name: sum_ladder_split
decls.statement: theorem sum_ladder_split (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) : ∑ t : LadderTraj n, (if t = ladderT0 n then a else b) = a + ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) * b
decls.doc: A sum over the ladder's trajectories of a function taking one value on `τ₀` and another elsewhere.

decls.name: ladderPFc_pos
decls.statement: theorem ladderPFc_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1) (t : LadderTraj n) : 0 < ladderPFc n c t

decls.name: ladderPFc_sum
decls.statement: theorem ladderPFc_sum {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c : ℝ) : ∑ t, ladderPFc n c t = 1

decls.name: ladder_residual_ladderPFc
decls.statement: theorem ladder_residual_ladderPFc (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) (ladderPFc n c) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * Real.log (c * 2 ^ n) ^ 2 + ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) * (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * Real.log ((1 - c) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) * 2 ^ n) ^ 2)
decls.doc: The residual of the family, in closed form.

decls.name: tendsto_ladder_residual
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_ladder_residual {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) (ladderPFc n c)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.log (1 - c) ^ 2))
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`: `𝓔(p_F) → (log(1 − c))²`** along the family, for `0 < c < 1`.

decls.name: log_one_sub_cEps_sq
decls.statement: theorem log_one_sub_cEps_sq {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : Real.log (1 - (1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (ε / 2)))) ^ 2 = ε / 2

decls.name: cEps_pos
decls.statement: theorem cEps_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : 0 < 1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (ε / 2))

decls.name: cEps_lt_one
decls.statement: theorem cEps_lt_one (ε : ℝ) : 1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (ε / 2)) < 1

decls.name: tendsto_ladder_residual_eps
decls.statement: theorem tendsto_ladder_residual_eps {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) (ladderPFc n (1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (ε / 2))))) atTop (𝓝 (ε / 2))
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`: `𝓔(p_F) → ε/2`** for `c := 1 − e^{−√(ε/2)}`.

decls.name: ladder_witness
decls.statement: theorem ladder_witness {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) pF ≤ ε ∧ (1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (ε / 2))) * 2 ^ n ≤ mPrime (ladderPB n) pF ladderOne (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) unit_univ_nonempty
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, the display**: for every `ε > 0` and every `n` large enough there is a full-support trajectory law on the ladder with `𝓔(p_F) ≤ ε` and `M' ≥ (1 − e^{−√(ε/2)}) 2ⁿ`.

decls.name: ladder_pF_ne_zero_of_residualE_ne_top
decls.statement: theorem ladder_pF_ne_zero_of_residualE_ne_top {n : ℕ} {pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ} (h : residualE ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) pF ≠ ⊤) (t : LadderTraj n) : pF t ≠ 0
decls.doc: On the ladder a trajectory law with finite residual has no zero: `p_B > 0` on every trajectory and `p_{E,T}(x) = 1`, so a zero of `p_F` makes `𝓔 = +∞` (`rem:silva_hypotheses`(2)).

decls.name: ladder_sSup_ge
decls.statement: theorem ladder_sSup_ge {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (ε / 2))) * 2 ^ n ≤ sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) pF ≤ ε ∧ m = mPrime (ladderPB n) pF ladderOne (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) unit_univ_nonempty}
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, the display in the paper's supremum form**: `sup{M'(p_F) : 𝓔(p_F) ≤ ε} ≥ (1 − e^{−√(ε/2)}) 2ⁿ` for `n` large, the supremum over full-support trajectory laws on the ladder (bounded above by `2ⁿ`, `ladder_mPrime_le`).

decls.name: ladder_no_uniform_constant
decls.statement: theorem ladder_no_uniform_constant {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ¬ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ), (∀ t, 0 < pF t) → ∑ t, pF t = 1 → residual ladderOne ladderOne (ladderPB n) pF ≤ ε → mPrime (ladderPB n) pF ladderOne (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) unit_univ_nonempty ≤ C
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, "no constant is uniform in the depth"**: for every `ε > 0` no `C` bounds `M'` over all depths `n` and all full-support trajectory laws with `𝓔(p_F) ≤ ε`.

decls.name: ladder_mVal_exceeds_one
decls.statement: theorem ladder_mVal_exceeds_one : ∃ pF : LadderTraj 1 → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ 1 < mVal (ladderPB 1) pF (ladder_wSupport_nonempty 1) ∧ mPrime (ladderPB 1) pF ladderOne (ladder_wSupport_nonempty 1) unit_univ_nonempty ≤ 2
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant`, "`M` can exceed `1`"** on a graph with several backward paths into a terminal state: the depth-`1` ladder with mass `¾` on one of its two trajectories has `M ≥ 3/2`, while `M' ≤ 2 = max(1, 1/min p_B)`.

decls.name: pathCount
decls.statement: noncomputable def pathCount (into : T → X) (x : X) : ℕ
decls.doc: `P(x)`, the number of trajectories into `x`.

decls.name: exists_pB_le_inv_pathCount
decls.statement: theorem exists_pB_le_inv_pathCount (into : T → X) {pB : X → T → ℝ} {x : X} (hBsupp : ∀ t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hB1 : ∑ t, pB x t = 1) : 0 < pathCount into x ∧ ∃ t, into t = x ∧ pB x t ≤ 1 / (pathCount into x : ℝ)
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `min_τ p_B(τ|x) ≤ 1/P(x)`**: a probability `p_B(·|x)` charging each of the `P(x)` trajectories into `x` (and nothing else) gives one of them mass at most `1/P(x)`.

decls.name: pathCount_div_le_inv_wMin
decls.statement: theorem pathCount_div_le_inv_wMin (into : T → X) {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hET : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hBpos : ∀ x t, into t = x → 0 < pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (x : X) : (pathCount into x : ℝ) / pET x ≤ 1 / wMin pET pB hs
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `1/w_min ≥ P(x)/p_{E,T}(x)` for every `x`**, for a full-support backward policy and a full-support training law.

decls.name: sup_pathCount_div_le_inv_wMin
decls.statement: theorem sup_pathCount_div_le_inv_wMin (into : T → X) {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hET : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hBpos : ∀ x t, into t = x → 0 < pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) : univ.sup' hX (fun x => (pathCount into x : ℝ) / pET x) ≤ 1 / wMin pET pB hs
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, the display**: `1/w_min ≥ max_x P(x)/p_{E,T}(x)`.

decls.name: mPrime_le_of_le_one
decls.statement: theorem mPrime_le_of_le_one (pB : X → T → ℝ) {pF : T → ℝ} (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hF1 : ∀ t, pF t ≤ 1) : mPrime pB pF π hs hX ≤ max ((wSupport pB).sup' hs fun p => 1 / pB p.1 p.2) (piInf π hX)
decls.doc: The `M'` values are bounded above over forward trajectory laws with `p_F ≤ 1`, by `max(max 1/p_B, ‖π‖_∞)` — so the suprema below are suprema of bounded sets.

decls.name: le_of_forall_one_sub_pow_mul_le
decls.statement: theorem le_of_forall_one_sub_pow_mul_le {P S : ℝ} (L : ℕ) (h : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η < 1 → (1 - η) ^ L * P ≤ S) : P ≤ S
decls.doc: From `(1 − η)^L P ≤ S` for every `η ∈ (0,1)`, `P ≤ S`.

decls.name: pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime
decls.statement: theorem pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime [Nonempty T] (into : T → X) {pB : X → T → ℝ} (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hBpos : ∀ x t, into t = x → 0 < pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (x : X) : (pathCount into x : ℝ) ≤ sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pF : T → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ m = mPrime pB pF π hs hX}
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `sup_{p_F} M' ≥ P(x)`**, the supremum over full-support forward **trajectory laws** (see SCOPE; the Markov form is `pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime_markov`).

decls.name: sup_pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime
decls.statement: theorem sup_pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime [Nonempty T] (into : T → X) {pB : X → T → ℝ} (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hBpos : ∀ x t, into t = x → 0 < pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) : univ.sup' hX (fun x => (pathCount into x : ℝ)) ≤ sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pF : T → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ m = mPrime pB pF π hs hX}
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `sup_{p_F} M' ≥ max_x P(x)`** over full-support trajectory laws.

decls.name: nextOn
decls.statement: def nextOn : List S → S → Option S
decls.doc: The state following `s` on the path `l`, if any.

decls.name: pathProb
decls.statement: noncomputable def pathProb (pol : S → S → ℝ) : List S → ℝ
decls.doc: The probability a forward policy `pol` assigns to a path `s₀ → s₁ → ⋯ → s_n`: the product over its steps of `pol(s_i → s_{i+1})`.

decls.name: pol_le_one
decls.statement: theorem pol_le_one {succ : S → Finset S} {pol : S → S → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ s, ∀ s' ∈ succ s, 0 < pol s s') (hsum : ∀ s, (succ s).Nonempty → ∑ s' ∈ succ s, pol s s' = 1) {s s' : S} (h : s' ∈ succ s) : pol s s' ≤ 1
decls.doc: A step of a stochastic, positive policy along an edge has probability at most `1`.

decls.name: pathProb_mem_Icc
decls.statement: theorem pathProb_mem_Icc {succ : S → Finset S} {pol : S → S → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ s, ∀ s' ∈ succ s, 0 < pol s s') (hsum : ∀ s, (succ s).Nonempty → ∑ s' ∈ succ s, pol s s' = 1) : ∀ l : List S, l.IsChain (fun a b => b ∈ succ a) → 0 ≤ pathProb pol l ∧ pathProb pol l ≤ 1 | [], _ => by simp only [pathProb]; norm_num | [_], _ => by simp only [pathProb]; norm_num | a :: b :: l, h => by rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩

decls.name: nextOn_rel
decls.statement: theorem nextOn_rel {R : S → S → Prop} : ∀ {l : List S} {s b : S}, l.IsChain R → nextOn l s = some b → R s b | [], _, _, _, h => by simp only [nextOn, reduceCtorEq] at h | [_], _, _, _, h => by simp only [nextOn, reduceCtorEq] at h | a :: c :: l, s, b, hc, h => by rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc simp only [nextOn] at h split_ifs at h with hsa · obtain rfl

decls.name: nextOn_of_infix
decls.statement: theorem nextOn_of_infix : ∀ {l : List S} {a b : S}, l.Nodup → [a, b] <:+: l → nextOn l a = some b | [], _, _, _, h => absurd h.length_le (by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega) | [_], _, _, _, h => absurd h.length_le (by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega) | c :: d :: l, a, b, hnd, h => by simp only [nextOn] rw [List.infix_cons_iff] at h rcases h with hpre | hinf · rw [List.cons_prefix_cons] at hpre obtain ⟨rfl, hpre'⟩
decls.doc: On a path visiting each state at most once, the state after `a` is `b` whenever `a, b` are consecutive on it.

decls.name: concPolicy
decls.statement: noncomputable def concPolicy (succ : S → Finset S) (l : List S) (η : ℝ) (s s' : S) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The policy concentrated on a path `l`**: at a state of `l` it follows `l` with probability `1 − η` and spreads `η` uniformly over the successors; elsewhere it is uniform.

decls.name: concPolicy_pos
decls.statement: theorem concPolicy_pos (succ : S → Finset S) (l : List S) {η : ℝ} (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) (s : S) : ∀ s' ∈ succ s, 0 < concPolicy succ l η s s'

decls.name: concPolicy_sum
decls.statement: theorem concPolicy_sum (succ : S → Finset S) {l : List S} (hl : l.IsChain (fun a b => b ∈ succ a)) (η : ℝ) (s : S) (hs : (succ s).Nonempty) : ∑ s' ∈ succ s, concPolicy succ l η s s' = 1

decls.name: pathProb_concPolicy_ge
decls.statement: theorem pathProb_concPolicy_ge (succ : S → Finset S) {l : List S} (hnd : l.Nodup) {η : ℝ} (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) : ∀ m : List S, m <:+: l → (1 - η) ^ (m.length - 1) ≤ pathProb (concPolicy succ l η) m | [], _ => by simp only [pathProb, List.length_nil, zero_tsub, pow_zero, le_refl] | [_], _ => by simp only [pathProb, List.length_singleton, tsub_self, pow_zero, le_refl] | a :: b :: r, hm => by have hab : nextOn l a = some b
decls.doc: Along its own path the concentrated policy has probability at least `(1 − η)^{#steps}`.

decls.name: pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime_markov
decls.statement: theorem pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime_markov {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq X] (succ : S → Finset S) (path : T → List S) (hchain : ∀ t, (path t).IsChain (fun a b => b ∈ succ a)) (hnodup : ∀ t, (path t).Nodup) (into : T → X) {pB : X → T → ℝ} (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hBpos : ∀ x t, into t = x → 0 < pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (x : X) : (pathCount into x : ℝ) ≤ sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pol : S → S → ℝ, (∀ s, ∀ s' ∈ succ s, 0 < pol s s') ∧ (∀ s, (succ s).Nonempty → ∑ s' ∈ succ s, pol s s' = 1) ∧ m = mPrime pB (fun t => pathProb pol (path t)) π hs hX}
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `sup_{p_F} M' ≥ P(x)` over full-support Markov forward policies.** Trajectories `t` are paths `path t` of a graph with successor sets `succ`, each visiting a state at most once (as on a DAG), and a Markov policy `pol` — positive on every edge, a probability on the successors of every non-sink state — gives `p_F(t) = pathProb pol (path t)`.

decls.name: sup_pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime_markov
decls.statement: theorem sup_pathCount_le_sSup_mPrime_markov {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq X] (succ : S → Finset S) (path : T → List S) (hchain : ∀ t, (path t).IsChain (fun a b => b ∈ succ a)) (hnodup : ∀ t, (path t).Nodup) (into : T → X) {pB : X → T → ℝ} (π : X → ℝ) (hs : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hX : (univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hBsupp : ∀ x t, pB x t ≠ 0 → into t = x) (hBpos : ∀ x t, into t = x → 0 < pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) : univ.sup' hX (fun x => (pathCount into x : ℝ)) ≤ sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pol : S → S → ℝ, (∀ s, ∀ s' ∈ succ s, 0 < pol s s') ∧ (∀ s, (succ s).Nonempty → ∑ s' ∈ succ s, pol s s' = 1) ∧ m = mPrime pB (fun t => pathProb pol (path t)) π hs hX}
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `sup_{p_F} M' ≥ max_x P(x)`** over full-support Markov forward policies.

decls.name: walksInto
decls.statement: def walksInto (E : S → S → Prop) (s₀ x : S) : Set (List S)
decls.doc: The walks from `s₀` to `x` in the graph with edge relation `E`: the trajectories into `x`.

decls.name: pumpRest
decls.statement: def pumpRest (c w₂ : List S) (k : ℕ) : List S
decls.doc: `w₂` with the cycle `c` (a closed walk from `v`) inserted `k` times after `v`.

decls.name: pumpRest_succ
decls.statement: theorem pumpRest_succ (c w₂ : List S) (k : ℕ) : pumpRest c w₂ (k + 1) = c ++ pumpRest c w₂ k

decls.name: length_pumpRest
decls.statement: theorem length_pumpRest (c w₂ : List S) (k : ℕ) : (pumpRest c w₂ k).length = k * c.length + w₂.length

decls.name: getLast
decls.statement: theorem getLast?_cons_self_of {v : S} {c : List S} (hc : c.getLast? = some v) : (v :: c).getLast? = some v

decls.name: isChain_pumpRest
decls.statement: theorem isChain_pumpRest {E : S → S → Prop} {v : S} {c w₂ : List S} (hcE : (v :: c).IsChain E) (hc : c.getLast? = some v) (hw₂ : (v :: w₂).IsChain E) : ∀ k, (v :: pumpRest c w₂ k).IsChain E | 0 => by simpa only [pumpRest, List.replicate_zero, List.flatten_nil, List.nil_append] using hw₂ | k + 1 => by have ih

decls.name: getLast
decls.statement: theorem getLast?_pumpRest {v : S} {c w₂ : List S} (hc : c.getLast? = some v) : ∀ k, (v :: pumpRest c w₂ k).getLast? = (v :: w₂).getLast? | 0 => by simp only [pumpRest, List.replicate_zero, List.flatten_nil, List.nil_append] | k + 1 => by have ih

decls.name: walksInto_infinite
decls.statement: theorem walksInto_infinite {E : S → S → Prop} {s₀ x v : S} {w : List S} (hw : w ∈ walksInto E s₀ x) (hv : v ∈ w) {c : List S} (hcne : c ≠ []) (hcE : (v :: c).IsChain E) (hc : c.getLast? = some v) : (walksInto E s₀ x).Infinite
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, "when a cycle lies on the trajectories into `x`, these are infinitely many"**: if a walk from `s₀` to `x` visits a state `v` that lies on a cycle (a nonempty closed walk `v → ⋯ → v`), the walks from `s₀` to `x` form an infinite set.

decls.name: iInf_eq_zero_of_summable
decls.statement: theorem iInf_eq_zero_of_summable {ι : Type*} [Infinite ι] {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hs : Summable p) : ⨅ i, p i = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `inf_τ p_B(τ|x) = 0`**: a summable nonnegative family on an infinite index set — in particular a probability `p_B(·|x)` on infinitely many trajectories — has infimum `0`.

decls.name: iInf_pB_walksInto_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem iInf_pB_walksInto_eq_zero {E : S → S → Prop} {s₀ x v : S} {w : List S} (hw : w ∈ walksInto E s₀ x) (hv : v ∈ w) {c : List S} (hcne : c ≠ []) (hcE : (v :: c).IsChain E) (hc : c.getLast? = some v) {pB : walksInto E s₀ x → ℝ} (hB0 : ∀ τ, 0 ≤ pB τ) (hB1 : HasSum pB 1) : ⨅ τ, pB τ = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, the two combined**: on a graph where a cycle lies on a walk into `x`, every probability `p_B(·|x)` on the walks into `x` has `inf_τ p_B(τ|x) = 0`.

decls.name: exists_ratio_gt
decls.statement: theorem exists_ratio_gt {ι : Type*} {pB : ι → ℝ} (hB0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ pB i) (hBs : Summable pB) (hinf : {i | 0 < pB i}.Infinite) {ν : ι → ℝ} (hν0 : ∀ i, 0 < ν i) (hν1 : HasSum ν 1) (R : ℝ) : ∃ pF : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < pF i) ∧ HasSum pF 1 ∧ ∃ i, 0 < pB i ∧ R < pF i / pB i
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `sup_{p_F} M' = +∞`**: when `p_B(·|x)` charges infinitely many trajectories, for every `R` some full-support trajectory law `p_F` has a ratio `p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x) > R` at a charged `τ` — so `M' ≥ M > R`.

decls.name: exists_ratio_gt_walksInto
decls.statement: theorem exists_ratio_gt_walksInto {E : S → S → Prop} {s₀ x v : S} {w : List S} (hw : w ∈ walksInto E s₀ x) (hv : v ∈ w) {c : List S} (hcne : c ≠ []) (hcE : (v :: c).IsChain E) (hc : c.getLast? = some v) {pB : walksInto E s₀ x → ℝ} (hBpos : ∀ τ, 0 < pB τ) (hB1 : HasSum pB 1) (R : ℝ) : ∃ pF : walksInto E s₀ x → ℝ, (∀ τ, 0 < pF τ) ∧ HasSum pF 1 ∧ ∃ τ, 0 < pB τ ∧ R < pF τ / pB τ
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, `sup_{p_F} M' = +∞` on the walks into `x`**: on a graph where a cycle lies on a walk into `x`, for every probability `p_B(·|x)` charging each walk into `x` and every `R`, some full-support trajectory law `p_F` on those walks has `p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x) > R` at some walk `τ` — so `M' ≥ M > R`.

decls.name: not_hasSum_const_one
decls.statement: theorem not_hasSum_const_one {ι : Type*} [Infinite ι] (c : ℝ) : ¬ HasSum (fun _ : ι => c) 1
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, "there being no uniform distribution on an infinite set"**: no constant function on an infinite type sums to `1`.

decls.name: doubling_terminal_infinite
decls.statement: theorem doubling_terminal_infinite : (Set.range fun j : ℕ => GFNBounds.Doubling.St.lad (j + 1)).Infinite
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, the counter-example graph `eq:counterexample_graph`**: its ladder states `1, 2, 3, …` — the states with a terminal edge to `s_f` — form an infinite set, and no uniform probability exists on it.

decls.name: doubling_no_uniform_terminal_law
decls.statement: theorem doubling_no_uniform_terminal_law (c : ℝ) : ¬ HasSum (fun _ : Set.range (fun j : ℕ => GFNBounds.Doubling.St.lad (j + 1)) => c) 1

decls.name: target_x2_lt_one
decls.statement: theorem target_x2_lt_one {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) (ht : t ≠ fun i => if i = 1 then 1 else 0) : t 1 < 1
decls.doc: A probability `κ` on `{x₁,…,x_N}` other than `δ_{x₂}` has `κ(x₂) < 1`.

decls.name: termMass_Fk_pos
decls.statement: theorem termMass_Fk_pos (k : ℝ) : 0 < ∑ y, Fk M k y (cycGraph M).snk
decls.doc: The terminal mass of `F_k` is `1`, so its terminal law is not a junk value.

decls.name: cycle_flows_target
decls.statement: theorem cycle_flows_target {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgc : ContinuousAt g 1) {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) (ht : t ≠ fun i => if i = 1 then 1 else 0) : (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ u v, 0 ≤ Fk M k u v) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ u v, Fk M k u v ≠ 0 → (cycGraph M).Edge u v) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, edgeInflow (Fk M k) x = edgeOutflow (Fk M k) x) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ j, 0 < extT M t (xC M j) + ∑ v ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, Fk M k (xC M j) v ∧ 0 < fmRatio (cycGraph M) (extT M t) (Fk M k) (xC M j)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ∑ y, Fk M k y (cycGraph M).snk) ∧ (∀ nu : cycV M → ℝ, Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) (Fk M k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k) = fun v => if v = xC M 1 then 1 else 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k)) (extT M t) = 1 - t 1) ∧ 0 < 1 - t 1
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, the flows `lem:cycle_counterexample` supplies**: on `𝒞_N`, `N = M + 2`, for a probability target `κ ≠ δ_{x₂}` on `{x₁,…,x_N}`, the flows `F_k`, `k ∈ ℕ`, are nonnegative, carried by the edges and exactly flow-matching; for `k ≥ 1` every denominator `κ + f_→` and every ratio is positive (the loss is defined) and the terminal mass is `1`; their loss tends to `0` for every training weight; their terminal law is `δ_{x₂}`, at total variation `1 − κ(x₂) > 0` from `κ`.

decls.name: loss_Fk_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem loss_Fk_nonneg {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 < r → 0 ≤ g r) {nu : cycV M → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ v, 0 ≤ nu v) {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : 0 ≤ fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) (Fk M k)

decls.name: cycle_no_bound_along_Fk
decls.statement: theorem cycle_no_bound_along_Fk {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgc : ContinuousAt g 1) (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 < r → 0 ≤ g r) {nu : cycV M → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ v, 0 ≤ nu v) {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) (ht : t ≠ fun i => if i = 1 then 1 else 0) : ¬ ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto Φ (𝓝[≥] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k)) (extT M t) ≤ Φ (fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) (Fk M k))
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space`, "no model-free bound tending to `0` with the loss holds"** (and the same sentence of `rem:silva_model_constant`), along the flows `F_k` where the loss is defined (`k ≥ 1`): for every training weight `ν ≥ 0`, every generator `g ≥ 0` on `(0,∞)` continuous at `1` with `g(1) = 0`, and every probability `κ ≠ δ_{x₂}` on `{x₁,…,x_N}`, no `Φ` with `Φ(L) → 0` as `L → 0` through `L ≥ 0` (so `Φ(0) = 0`) bounds `TV(terminal law ‖ κ) ≤ Φ(𝓛)` along `(F_k)_{k≥1}`.

decls.name: cycle_no_model_free_bound
decls.statement: theorem cycle_no_model_free_bound {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgc : ContinuousAt g 1) (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 < r → 0 ≤ g r) {nu : cycV M → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ v, 0 ≤ nu v) {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) (ht : t ≠ fun i => if i = 1 then 1 else 0) : ¬ ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto Φ (𝓝[≥] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ F : cycV M → cycV M → ℝ, (∀ u v, 0 ≤ F u v) → (∀ u v, F u v ≠ 0 → (cycGraph M).Edge u v) → (∀ x ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, edgeInflow F x = edgeOutflow F x) → (∀ x ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, 0 < extT M t x + ∑ v ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, F x v) → 0 < ∑ y, F y (cycGraph M).snk → tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) F) (extT M t) ≤ Φ (fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) F)
decls.doc: **The same, over the flow-matching flows on `𝒞_N` on which the loss and the terminal law are defined** — the reading "model-free": no `Φ` bounds the total variation by the loss over the nonnegative, edge-carried, exactly flow-matching flows with every denominator `κ + f_→` positive and positive terminal mass.

decls.name: cycle_no_bound_punctured
decls.statement: theorem cycle_no_bound_punctured {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgc : ContinuousAt g 1) (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 < r → 0 ≤ g r) (hgpos : ∀ r, 0 < r → r ≠ 1 → 0 < g r) {nu : cycV M → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ v, 0 ≤ nu v) (hnu2 : 0 < nu (xC M 1)) {t : Fin (M + 2) → ℝ} (ht0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (hsum : ∑ i, t i = 1) (ht : t ≠ fun i => if i = 1 then 1 else 0) : ¬ ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto Φ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k)) (extT M t) ≤ Φ (fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) g nu (extT M t) (Fk M k))
decls.doc: **The punctured reading**: if `Φ` is only asked to tend to `0` as `L → 0` with `L > 0`, the conclusion still holds along `(F_k)_{k≥1}` when `ν(x₂) > 0` and `g > 0` off `1` — the source class has `g` vanishing exactly at `1` — since `ρ_k(x₂) = (1+k)/(κ(x₂)+k) ≠ 1` for `κ(x₂) ≠ 1`, so the loss never vanishes.

decls.name: diamondSucc
decls.statement: def diamondSucc : Fin 4 → Finset (Fin 4)
decls.doc: The successor sets of the diamond DAG `s₀ → a, s₀ → b, a → x, b → x` on `Fin 4`.

decls.name: diamondPath
decls.statement: def diamondPath : Bool → List (Fin 4)
decls.doc: The two trajectories of the diamond.

decls.name: diamondEdges
decls.statement: def diamondEdges : Finset (Fin 6 × Fin 6)
decls.doc: The edges of the diamond as a marked graph on `Fin 6`: `0 = s₀` (source mark), `1 = o` (the DAG's root), `2 = a`, `3 = b`, `4 = x` (the terminal state), `5 = s_f`.

decls.name: diamondGraph
decls.statement: def diamondGraph : MarkedGraph (Fin 6)
decls.doc: The diamond DAG as a `MarkedGraph`.

decls.name: diamondFlow
decls.statement: noncomputable def diamondFlow (q : ℝ) (u v : Fin 6) : ℝ
decls.doc: The unit-mass edge flow of the Markov policy sending `o → a` with probability `q`, `o → b` with `1 − q`, and deterministic elsewhere.

decls.name: diamondTarget
decls.statement: noncomputable def diamondTarget : Fin 6 → ℝ
decls.doc: The target `δ_x`.

decls.name: diamondGraph_internal
decls.statement: theorem diamondGraph_internal : diamondGraph.internal = {1, 2, 3, 4}

decls.name: diamondPol
decls.statement: noncomputable def diamondPol (q : ℝ) (s s' : Fin 4) : ℝ
decls.doc: The Markov forward policy of the family on `Fin 4` (`0 = o, 1 = a, 2 = b, 3 = x`, the numbering of `diamondSucc`).

decls.name: pathProb_diamondPol
decls.statement: theorem pathProb_diamondPol (q : ℝ) (b : Bool) : pathProb (diamondPol q) (diamondPath b) = if b then 1 - q else q
decls.doc: The trajectory law of the family: `p_F(o → a → x) = q`, `p_F(o → b → x) = 1 − q`, the probabilities the Markov policy `diamondPol q` gives the two paths `diamondPath`.

decls.name: diamond_ratio_one
decls.statement: theorem diamond_ratio_one {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) : ∀ x ∈ diamondGraph.internal, 0 < diamondTarget x + ∑ v ∈ diamondGraph.internal, diamondFlow q x v ∧ fmRatio diamondGraph diamondTarget (diamondFlow q) x = 1

decls.name: residual_not_divergence_FM_loss
decls.statement: theorem residual_not_divergence_FM_loss : (∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nu : Fin 6 → ℝ), g 1 = 0 → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → fmLossTarget diamondGraph g nu diamondTarget (diamondFlow q) = 0) ∧ (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → residual (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1) (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℝ) / 2) (fun b => pathProb (diamondPol q) (diamondPath b)) = 2⁻¹ * Real.log (2 * q) ^ 2 + 2⁻¹ * Real.log (2 * (1 - q)) ^ 2) ∧ (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → q ≠ 1 / 2 → 0 < residual (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1) (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℝ) / 2) (fun b => pathProb (diamondPol q) (diamondPath b))) ∧ ¬ ∃ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nu : Fin 6 → ℝ), g 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → residual (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1) (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℝ) / 2) (fun b => pathProb (diamondPol q) (diamondPath b)) = fmLossTarget diamondGraph g nu diamondTarget (diamondFlow q)
decls.doc: **`rem:silva_model_constant` and `rem:path_space`, "a class that does not contain the idealized residual"**: on the diamond family every divergence-based FM loss (any `g` with `g(1) = 0`, any `ν`) vanishes identically, with every denominator positive, while the idealized residual `𝓔(p_F) = ½(log 2q)² + ½(log 2(1−q))²` of the same models does not; hence no such loss equals `𝓔` on the family.

decls.name: inhabit_not_full_support
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_not_full_support : chiSqE (unif Bool) (fun b => if b then 1 else 0) = ⊤ ∧ rhsE 1 (chiSqE (unif Bool) (fun b => if b then 1 else 0)) 1 = ⊤
decls.doc: Item (1): a training law with a zero, on `Bool`.

decls.name: inhabit_pF_zero
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_pF_zero : residualE (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1) (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℝ) / 2) (fun b => if b then 1 else 0) = ⊤
decls.doc: Item (2): one terminal, two trajectories charged `½` each, `p_F = (0, 1)`.

decls.name: inhabit_uniformBackward
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_uniformBackward : termMarginal (fun _ : Unit => ()) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) () = ∑ _t : Unit, (if () = () then uniformBackProb (fun s : Bool => if s then {false} else ∅) [false, true] else 0) * (1 / if () = () then uniformBackProb (fun s : Bool => if s then {false} else ∅) [false, true] else 0)
decls.doc: Item (3): the uniform backward policy on the two-state path `false → true`.

decls.name: wSupport_deltaPB_nonempty
decls.statement: theorem wSupport_deltaPB_nonempty {Y : Type*} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (y : Y) : (wSupport (deltaPB Y)).Nonempty
decls.doc: The one-parent kernel on a nonempty type charges its diagonal.

decls.name: inhabit_tree
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_tree (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : mVal (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) (wSupport_deltaPB_nonempty (Sum.inl false)) ≤ 1
decls.doc: The tree hypotheses hold for the star of `prop:silva_no_uniform`(ii) (`into = id`), and give `M ≤ 1` there.

decls.name: ladder_pathCount
decls.statement: theorem ladder_pathCount (n : ℕ) : pathCount (fun _ : LadderTraj n => ()) () = 2 ^ n
decls.doc: The ladder has `P(x) = 2ⁿ`.

decls.name: ladder_sSup_mPrime_eq
decls.statement: theorem ladder_sSup_mPrime_eq (n : ℕ) : sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pF : LadderTraj n → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < pF t) ∧ ∑ t, pF t = 1 ∧ m = mPrime (ladderPB n) pF ladderOne (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n) unit_univ_nonempty} = 2 ^ n ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ 1 / wMin ladderOne (ladderPB n) (ladder_wSupport_nonempty n)
decls.doc: **`rem:path_space` on the ladder, and a consistency check with `rem:silva_model_constant`**: the lower bound `sup M' ≥ P(x) = 2ⁿ` meets the fixed-graph upper bound `M' ≤ 2ⁿ`, so over full-support trajectory laws `sup M' = 2ⁿ` exactly, and `1/w_min ≥ 2ⁿ`.

decls.name: diamondPB_wSupport_nonempty
decls.statement: theorem diamondPB_wSupport_nonempty : (wSupport (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℝ) / 2)).Nonempty

decls.name: inhabit_markov_diamond
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_markov_diamond : (2 : ℝ) ≤ sSup {m : ℝ | ∃ pol : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ, (∀ s, ∀ s' ∈ diamondSucc s, 0 < pol s s') ∧ (∀ s, (diamondSucc s).Nonempty → ∑ s' ∈ diamondSucc s, pol s s' = 1) ∧ m = mPrime (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℝ) / 2) (fun t => pathProb pol (diamondPath t)) (fun _ => 1) diamondPB_wSupport_nonempty unit_univ_nonempty}
decls.doc: **The Markov hypotheses hold on the diamond DAG**, whose terminal `x` has `P(x) = 2`: the Markov-policy supremum of `M'` is at least `2`.

decls.name: inhabit_cycle_walks
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_cycle_walks : (walksInto (cycGraph 0).Edge (srcC 0) (xC 0 1)).Infinite
decls.doc: **The cycle hypotheses hold on `𝒞₂`**: the walk `s₀ → x₁ → x₂` visits `x₁`, which lies on the cycle `x₁ → x₂ → x₁`, so the walks into `x₂` are infinitely many.

decls.name: exists_pos_hasSum_one
decls.statement: theorem exists_pos_hasSum_one {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] [Nonempty ι] : ∃ p : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < p i) ∧ HasSum p 1
decls.doc: Every nonempty countable type carries a full-support probability: `2^{-encode i}`, normalized.

decls.name: inhabit_cycle_ratio
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_cycle_ratio : ∃ pB : walksInto (cycGraph 0).Edge (srcC 0) (xC 0 1) → ℝ, (∀ τ, 0 < pB τ) ∧ HasSum pB 1 ∧ (⨅ τ, pB τ) = 0 ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ pF : walksInto (cycGraph 0).Edge (srcC 0) (xC 0 1) → ℝ, (∀ τ, 0 < pF τ) ∧ HasSum pF 1 ∧ ∃ τ, 0 < pB τ ∧ R < pF τ / pB τ
decls.doc: **The cycle bundle of `exists_ratio_gt_walksInto` and `iInf_pB_walksInto_eq_zero` holds on `𝒞₂`**: the walks into `x₂` carry a full-support probability `p_B`, and for it `inf p_B = 0` and every `R` is exceeded by a ratio `p_F/p_B`.

decls.name: inhabit_geometric
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_geometric : (⨅ n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / 2 / 2 ^ n) = 0 ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ pF : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < pF n) ∧ HasSum pF 1 ∧ ∃ n, 0 < (1 : ℝ) / 2 / 2 ^ n ∧ R < pF n / ((1 : ℝ) / 2 / 2 ^ n)
decls.doc: The geometric law `2^{-(n+1)}` on `ℕ` inhabits the infinite-support hypotheses: its infimum is `0` and its ratios are unbounded.

decls.name: inhabit_cycle_no_bound
decls.statement: theorem inhabit_cycle_no_bound (M : ℕ) : (¬ ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto Φ (𝓝[≥] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ F : cycV M → cycV M → ℝ, (∀ u v, 0 ≤ F u v) → (∀ u v, F u v ≠ 0 → (cycGraph M).Edge u v) → (∀ x ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, edgeInflow F x = edgeOutflow F x) → (∀ x ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, 0 < extT M (fun _ => 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 2)) x + ∑ v ∈ (cycGraph M).internal, F x v) → 0 < ∑ y, F y (cycGraph M).snk → tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) F) (extT M fun _ => 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ Φ (fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) (fun r => (r - 1) ^ 2) (fun _ => 1) (extT M fun _ => 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 2)) F)) ∧ (¬ ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto Φ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → tvFin (termLaw (cycGraph M) (Fk M k)) (extT M fun _ => 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ Φ (fmLossTarget (cycGraph M) (fun r => (r - 1) ^ 2) (fun _ => 1) (extT M fun _ => 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 2)) (Fk M k)))
decls.doc: **The no-bound hypotheses hold on every `𝒞_N`**: `g(r) = (r − 1)²`, `ν ≡ 1` and the uniform target on `{x₁,…,x_N}`, which is not `δ_{x₂}`.

Closures to bucket A: the training-speed theorem whole, and the closing paragraph of the finite-graph universality theorem
variables: variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : MarkedGraph V}

decls.name: ofReal_le_inv_display
decls.statement: theorem ofReal_le_inv_display {L0 Lk a : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L0) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hpos : 0 < L0 → Lk ≤ (L0⁻¹ + a)⁻¹) (hzero : L0 = 0 → Lk ≤ 0) : ENNReal.ofReal Lk ≤ ((ENNReal.ofReal L0)⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal a)⁻¹
decls.doc: **The paper's convention `𝓛(μ₀)^{−1} := +∞`, read in `[0,∞]`.** If `L_k ≤ (L₀^{−1} + a)^{−1}` whenever `L₀ > 0`, and `L_k ≤ 0` whenever `L₀ = 0`, then `ofReal L_k ≤ ((ofReal L₀)^{−1} + ofReal a)^{−1}` in `ℝ≥0∞`, where `0^{−1} = ∞` and `∞^{−1} = 0`.

decls.name: gammaStar_ofReal
decls.statement: theorem gammaStar_ofReal {b3v U0 L0 γ0 m0 : ℝ} (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hL0 : 0 ≤ L0) : ENNReal.ofReal (gammaStar b3v U0 L0 γ0 m0) = min (min (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / b3v)) (ENNReal.ofReal (U0 ^ 2 / 2) * (ENNReal.ofReal L0)⁻¹)) (ENNReal.ofReal (γ0 * m0 ^ 2))
decls.doc: **`γ_* := min(1/b₃, (‖u₀‖²/2)𝓛(μ₀)^{−1}, γ₀m₀²)` with `𝓛(μ₀)^{−1} := +∞`, exactly** (`proofs.tex:1051`): `DiscreteGlobal.gammaStar`'s case split (the middle entry dropped at `𝓛(μ₀) = 0`) is the printed minimum read in `[0,∞]`.

decls.name: gamma0W_logSq_eq_gamma0At
decls.statement: theorem gamma0W_logSq_eq_gamma0At (wmin W Bhat : ℝ) : gamma0W logSq (1/2) wmin W Bhat = gamma0At Gamma3Val wmin W Bhat
decls.doc: **Item *3*'s `γ₀` is Theorem 10's** for `g = (log x)²` at `a = 1/2`, with `Γ₃` the supremum of `|g'''|` within the window (`TrainingSpeedAssembled.gamma0W`).

decls.name: eps0W_logSq_eq_eps0At

decls.name: IsFullTarget
decls.statement: structure IsFullTarget (G : MarkedGraph V) (R : V → ℝ) (Z : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **A target of mass `Z` with full support on the terminating states** (`proofs.tex:1140`).

decls.name: freezeSink

decls.doc: **"freezing `π_←(s_f → ·) := R`"** (`proofs.tex:1140`), with the row normalized: `π_←(s_f → ·) := R/Z`, every other row that of `B`.

decls.name: freezeSink_pb_snk
decls.statement: theorem freezeSink_pb_snk (B : BackwardPolicy G) {R : V → ℝ} {Z : ℝ} (hR : IsFullTarget G R Z) (hZ : 0 < Z) (x : V) : (freezeSink B hR hZ).pb G.snk x = R x / Z

decls.name: freezeSink_pb_of_ne
decls.statement: theorem freezeSink_pb_of_ne (B : BackwardPolicy G) {R : V → ℝ} {Z : ℝ} (hR : IsFullTarget G R Z) (hZ : 0 < Z) {s : V} (hs : s ≠ G.snk) (x : V) : (freezeSink B hR hZ).pb s x = B.pb s x

decls.doc: A target on `𝒮` vanishes at both marks.

decls.name: PositiveOffDirect
decls.statement: def PositiveOffDirect (B : BackwardPolicy G) : Prop
decls.doc: **Positivity on every edge but the direct one `s₀ → s_f`.** The hypothesis the closing paragraph actually has at its disposal after freezing: a target on `𝒮` gives `π_←(s_f → s₀) = 0`.

decls.name: positiveOffDirect_of_positiveOnEdges
decls.statement: theorem positiveOffDirect_of_positiveOnEdges {B : BackwardPolicy G} (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) : PositiveOffDirect B

decls.name: freezeSink_positiveOffDirect
decls.statement: theorem freezeSink_positiveOffDirect {B : BackwardPolicy G} (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} {Z : ℝ} (hR : IsFullTarget G R Z) (hZ : 0 < Z) : PositiveOffDirect (freezeSink B hR hZ)
decls.doc: **The frozen policy is positive on every edge but `s₀ → s_f`.**

decls.name: freezeSink_positiveOnEdges_iff
decls.statement: theorem freezeSink_positiveOnEdges_iff {B : BackwardPolicy G} (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} {Z : ℝ} (hR : IsFullTarget G R Z) (hZ : 0 < Z) : (freezeSink B hR hZ).PositiveOnEdges ↔ ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk
decls.doc: **FINDING (`proofs.tex:1140`): the closing paragraph cannot invoke item *(3)* when `s₀ → s_f` is an edge.** The frozen policy is positive on every edge of `G` — the hypothesis of `theo:universality_graphs` — **iff** `G` has no edge `s₀ → s_f`: a target on `𝒮` does not charge `s₀`, so freezing sets `π_←(s_f → s₀) = 0`.

decls.name: breach_of_reach_ne_snk
decls.statement: theorem breach_of_reach_ne_snk (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) {a b : V} (h : G.Reach a b) (hb : b ≠ G.snk) : B.BReach b a
decls.doc: A walk of `G` ending off `s_f` is reversed by the backward chain.

decls.name: breach_of_reach_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem breach_of_reach_ne_src (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) {a b : V} (h : G.Reach a b) (ha : a ≠ G.src) : B.BReach b a
decls.doc: A walk of `G` starting off `s₀` is reversed by the backward chain.

decls.name: breach_snk_src
decls.statement: theorem breach_snk_src (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) : B.BReach G.snk G.src
decls.doc: `s_f` reaches `s₀` backwards: its row charges some in-neighbour.

decls.name: breach_all_off
decls.statement: theorem breach_all_off (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) (x y : V) : B.BReach x y
decls.doc: **Irreducibility of the backward chain under positivity off `s₀ → s_f`.**

decls.name: invProb_pos_off
decls.statement: theorem invProb_pos_off (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (y : V) : 0 < lam y

decls.name: invProb_unique_off
decls.statement: theorem invProb_unique_off (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) {lam lam' : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (h' : B.IsInvProb lam') : lam = lam'
decls.doc: Uniqueness of the invariant probability, `BackwardPolicy.invProb_unique`'s ratio maximum principle under positivity off `s₀ → s_f`.

decls.name: frozenBalance_eq_off
decls.statement: theorem frozenBalance_eq_off (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hP : PositiveOffDirect B) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hne : fout ≠ 0) (hfb : B.FrozenBalance pf fout) : 0 < ∑ z, fout z ∧ (∀ x, fout x = (∑ z, fout z) * lam x) ∧ pf = B.reversal lam
decls.doc: `theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*, the forward inclusion (`BackwardPolicy.frozenBalance_eq`), under positivity off `s₀ → s_f`.

decls.name: frozenFamily
decls.statement: def frozenFamily (B : BackwardPolicy G) : Set ((V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ))
decls.doc: **The frozen-backward family `Θ_{π_←}`** (`proofs.tex:1133`): pairs `(π_→, f_out)` with `π_→` a Markov kernel, `f_out ≥ 0`, and `(f_out μ) ⊗ π_→ = π̂_← ⊗ (f_out μ)`.

decls.name: edgeOf
decls.statement: def edgeOf (θ : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: The edge flow of a member, `e(u → v) = f_out(u) π_→(u → v)`; its initial flow, once the wrap edge is cut, is `e(s₀ → ·)`.

decls.name: cutOut
decls.statement: noncomputable def cutOut (G : MarkedGraph V) (e : V → V → ℝ) (u : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: The star outflow of an edge flow on `𝒮`: `f_out⋆(u) = ∑_{w ≠ s_f} e(u → w)`.

decls.name: cutPol
decls.statement: noncomputable def cutPol (G : MarkedGraph V) (e : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: The star forward policy, `π_→⋆(u → v) = e(u → v)/f_out⋆(u)`.

decls.name: cutDefect
decls.statement: noncomputable def cutDefect (G : MarkedGraph V) (e : V → V → ℝ) (fi ft : V → ℝ) (v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **The defect of `equ:FM_const` on `𝒮` for the pair `(F_init, F_term)`**, the edge flow `e` read as the generative flow `(π_→⋆, f_out⋆)` on `𝒮`: `D(v) = F_init(v) + ((f_out⋆μ)π_→⋆)(v) − F_term(v) − f_out⋆(v)`.

decls.name: cutResidual
decls.statement: noncomputable def cutResidual [MeasurableSpace V] (G : MarkedGraph V) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (e : V → V → ℝ) (fi ft : V → ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞
decls.doc: **`def:universality`'s residual for the pair `(F_init, F_term)`**: `‖δf_init‖_{L^p(μ)} + ‖δf_term‖_{L^p(μ)}` in `[0,∞]`, `μ` the counting measure on `𝒮`, `δf_init = D⁻`, `δf_term = D⁺`.

decls.name: balancedMember
decls.statement: noncomputable def balancedMember (B : BackwardPolicy G) (lam : V → ℝ) (Z : ℝ) : (V → V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ)
decls.doc: **The balanced flow of initial mass `Z`**: `(π̂_←^λ, (Z/λ(s₀))λ)`, item *(3)*'s element.

decls.name: edgeOf_balancedMember
decls.statement: theorem edgeOf_balancedMember {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (Z : ℝ) : edgeOf (balancedMember B lam Z) = B.edgeFlow lam (Z / lam G.src)
decls.doc: The balanced member's edge flow is item *(3)*'s `edgeFlow` at `c = Z/λ(s₀)`.

decls.name: cutDefect_edgeFlow
decls.statement: theorem cutDefect_edgeFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) (v : V) : cutDefect G (B.edgeFlow lam c) (B.initFlow lam c) (B.termFlow lam c) v = B.fmDefect lam c v
decls.doc: On item *(3)*'s flow, with its own initial flow and terminal flow, `cutDefect` **is** `BackwardPolicy.fmDefect`.

decls.name: cutResidual_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem cutResidual_eq_zero [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSingletonClass V] {e : V → V → ℝ} {fi ft : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ v ∈ G.internal, cutDefect G e fi ft v = 0) (p : ℝ≥0∞) : cutResidual G p e fi ft = 0
decls.doc: A defect vanishing on `𝒮` has residual `0` at **every** `p`.

decls.name: universality_graphs_closing
decls.statement: theorem universality_graphs_closing [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSingletonClass V] (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {R : V → ℝ} {Z : ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z) (hR : IsFullTarget G R Z) : (∀ x, (freezeSink B hR hZ).pb G.snk x = R x / Z) ∧ (∀ s, s ≠ G.snk → ∀ x, (freezeSink B hR hZ).pb s x = B.pb s x) ∧ PositiveOffDirect (freezeSink B hR hZ) ∧ ((freezeSink B hR hZ).PositiveOnEdges ↔ ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk) ∧ (∃ lam : V → ℝ, (freezeSink B hR hZ).IsInvProb lam) ∧ (∀ lam lam' : V → ℝ, (freezeSink B hR hZ).IsInvProb lam → (freezeSink B hR hZ).IsInvProb lam' → lam = lam') ∧ ∀ lam : V → ℝ, (freezeSink B hR hZ).IsInvProb lam → (∀ x, 0 < lam x) ∧ (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) ∈ frozenFamily (freezeSink B hR hZ) ∧ (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z).2 ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ θ ∈ frozenFamily (freezeSink B hR hZ), θ.2 ≠ 0 → (∑ v, edgeOf θ G.src v = Z ↔ θ = (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z))) ∧ (∀ x, edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) x G.snk = R x) ∧ (∀ v, 0 ≤ edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) G.src v) ∧ (∀ v, v ∉ G.internal → edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) G.src v = 0) ∧ ∑ v ∈ G.internal, edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) G.src v = Z ∧ (∀ v, v ∉ G.internal → R v = 0) ∧ ∑ v ∈ G.internal, R v = Z ∧ (∀ v ∈ G.internal, cutDefect G (edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z)) (edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) G.src) R v = 0) ∧ (∀ p : ℝ≥0∞, cutResidual G p (edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z)) (edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) G.src) R = 0) ∧ (∀ p : ℝ≥0∞, ⨅ θ ∈ frozenFamily (freezeSink B hR hZ), cutResidual G p (edgeOf θ) (edgeOf (balancedMember (freezeSink B hR hZ) lam Z) G.src) R = 0)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`, the closing paragraph** (`proofs.tex:1140`, proof `:1167`): *for every target `R` with full support on the terminating states of `G`, freezing `π_←(s_f → ·) := R` produces a frozen-backward family whose unique balanced flow [matches] `R` exactly: the universality infimum vanishes and is attained, simultaneously for every `p ∈ [1,+∞]`.* With `R` of mass `Z` and the row frozen to `R/Z` (`freezeSink`): * the frozen policy has sink row `R/Z`, the other rows of `B`, and is positive on every edge but `s₀ → s_f` — on every edge iff there is no such edge (`freezeSink_positiveOnEdges_iff`); * its backward chain has a unique invariant probability `λ`, positive everywhere; * the balanced flow of initial mass `Z` lies in `Θ_{π_←}` and is the **unique** non-trivial member of initial mass `Z`; * its terminal flow `e(· → s_f)` is `R`, its initial flow `e(s₀ → ·)` is a distribution carried by `𝒮` of mass `Z`, and so is `R`: the pair `(F_init, R)` is a pair of `def:universality`; * flow matching holds exactly on `𝒮`, so its residual for that pair is `0` at every `p`, and the infimum of the residual over `Θ_{π_←}` for that pair is `0` at every `p`, attained.

decls.name: universality_graphs_strongly_universal
decls.statement: theorem universality_graphs_strongly_universal [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSingletonClass V] (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) : ∀ (R : V → ℝ) (Z : ℝ) (hZ : 0 < Z) (hR : IsFullTarget G R Z), ∃ θ ∈ frozenFamily (freezeSink B hR hZ), (∀ v, 0 ≤ edgeOf θ G.src v) ∧ (∀ v, v ∉ G.internal → edgeOf θ G.src v = 0) ∧ ∑ v ∈ G.internal, edgeOf θ G.src v = Z ∧ ∑ v ∈ G.internal, R v = Z ∧ ∀ p : ℝ≥0∞, cutResidual G p (edgeOf θ) (edgeOf θ G.src) R = 0
decls.doc: **"The family is strongly universal over terminal targets"** (`proofs.tex:1140`): for every target `R` of mass `Z > 0` with full support on the terminating states, the family frozen at `R` contains a flow whose initial flow is a distribution on `𝒮` of mass `Z` and whose residual for the pair (that initial flow, `R`) is `0` at every `p` at once.

decls.name: item_three_masses_on_internal
decls.statement: theorem item_three_masses_on_internal (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hB : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) {Z c : ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z) (hc : c = Z / lam G.src) : B.termFlow lam c G.src = Z * B.pb G.snk G.src ∧ ∑ v ∈ G.internal, B.termFlow lam c v = Z * (1 - B.pb G.snk G.src) ∧ ∑ v ∈ G.internal, B.initFlow lam c v = Z * (1 - B.pb G.snk G.src) ∧ (0 < B.pb G.snk G.src ↔ G.Edge G.src G.snk) ∧ (∑ v ∈ G.internal, B.termFlow lam c v = Z ↔ ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk) ∧ (∑ v ∈ G.internal, B.initFlow lam c v = Z ↔ ¬ G.Edge G.src G.snk)
decls.doc: **FINDING (`proofs.tex:1136–1138`, item *(3)*).** Under the theorem's own hypotheses, item *(3)*'s flow at `c = Z/λ(s₀)` has, on `𝒮`, initial and terminal mass `Z(1 − π_←(s_f → s₀))`, and its terminal flow `F_term = Z π_←(s_f → ·)` charges `s₀ ∉ 𝒮` by `Z π_←(s_f → s₀)`.
